1.name: Punishment Posting
1.overview: A 'worthless' tape recorder goes missing, which Pritam wants back. Pedro gets dumped in the cyber cell and wants to go back to the crime branch. When they meet, they strike a deal.

1.name: The Missing Boy
1.overview: Pedro sees his one shot at redemption when the Sports Minister's son is kidnapped. But as the case goes out of his control, Pedro makes a decision he can't undo.

1.name: The Blackmail
1.overview: While Pedro chases control, Pritam chases logic. With Vinny still missing, their efforts reveal an unsettling truth - the case is moving on someone else's terms.

1.name: The Blue Whale
1.overview: Digging into Vinny's secret online game, Pedro and Pritam uncover a digital maze. A subtle discovery rattles the family, as Pritam's past creeps closer than he expects.

1.name: Catch Me If You Can
1.overview: Pedro wants to catch a criminal, but Pritam wants to track a mind. The hunt flips, turning the case into a cat-and-mouse game where Pedro isn't sure who is chasing whom.

1.name: The Trap
1.overview: Time's up! Is Martin really their guy? Pritam, Pedro and the entire police squad better act quick… before Vinny loses his life.

1.name: Aarambh
1.overview: Seventeen-year-old Meenu Rawat accuses spiritual leader Baapji of sexual assault. Newly appointed ACP Jasleen Singh Soin takes charge of the case, and her uphill battle begins.

1.name: Aastha
1.overview: Despite resistance and rising violence, Jasleen arrests Baapji. Advocate Bhalerao steps in to represent Meenu. But before the bail hearing, Meenu's father lands in trouble.

1.name: Shakti
1.overview: At the bail hearings, the defence attacks Meenu's credibility, claiming she's a habitual liar. Outside, tensions rise as Baapji's son Kashyap gains control.

1.name: Arth
1.overview: While exposing the disappearance of a child devotee, Amitabh's career is jeopardised. Jasleen uncovers proof of a ritual, which is in fact an industrial-scale abuse.

1.name: Yudh
1.overview: Kashyap mysteriously dies in custody, and Baapji takes advantage of it. Outraged by the orchestrated media narrative, Amitabh helms a movement, appealing to the survivors.

1.name: Nyaya
1.overview: The defence presents one last witness to exonerate Baapji, which shocks Meenu. Finally, she takes the stand for the last time, recounting her assault with unflinching courage.

1.name: Sajan, Na Ghar Ke Na Ghat Ke
1.overview: Sajan Agarwal, works as a manager for an advertising company and is fascinated by his glamorous boss, Sanjana. Sajan's wife, Kashmira is suspicious of his friendship with Sanjana. Will Sajan be able to balance between the wife and the boss?

1.name: Sajan Pe Laga Lipstick Ka Nishan
1.overview: Sajan and Sanjana have a moment in the lift. Later, Sanjana calls Sajan into her cabin for a discussion on a new lipstick brand. She leaves a lipstick mark on his shirt, which could land Sajan in a lot of trouble at home.

1.name: Sajan Ki Shirt Ban Gayi Musibat
1.overview: Sajan gives a sizzling presentation of 'Mandakini' lipstick, wearing a wet shirt. The shirt, later lands him in a lot of problems. It also invites the wrath of his 'nocturnal' Dadi!

1.name: Sanjana-sajan Lock Lips
1.overview: Sajan is worried because his boss, Sanjana wants him to get the lipstick-stained shirt to office and he can't find it. He pretends to have a 'gas' problem. Sanjana decides to give him a mouth to mouth treatment. Will Sajan recover now?

1.name: Sanjana's Saadi Pad Gayi Bhaari
1.overview: Kashmira's mother tries to make her realise that Sajan is not loyal to her and doesn't remember important dates. Sanjana asks Sajan to get her sari from the laundry. The sari create a lot of confusion. In short, Sanjana ki saadi pad gayi Sajan pe bhaari!

1.name: Sanju's 'goonda'wala Fantasy
1.overview: Sanjana calls up Sajan to tell him that she is going to visit his house to pick her sari. Sajan is in a soup because Kashmira has worn the sari! Sajan tries various tricks including behaving like a 'filmi' goonda to make Kashmira take it off but with hilarious consequences!

1.name: Madam De Gayi Gift
1.overview: Sajan asks his friend Khiloni to bail him out. Sanjana, however, slaps Khiloni hard! Later, she reaches Sanju's house and decides to gift the sari to Kashmira. Sajan heaves a sigh of relief but Madam has a change of mind!

1.name: Sajan's 'wet' Dream
1.overview: Sajan's happiness turns fourfold when a drenched Sanjana comes knocking at his door! One look at her wet hair and his imagination starts running wild. While Kashmira is on her way back home, Sajan and Sanjana are disturbed by a knock at the door.

1.name: Sajan Ki Baj Gayi Band
1.overview: Sanjana plays with her words to seduce Sajan which sends his imagination racing. As the rain comes to a stop, Sanjana decides to leave. Just then, Sajan's mother-in-law comes knocking at the door and sees Sanjana!  Will she tell her daughter about Sanjana? Kya Sajan Ka Bajega Band?

1.name: Sajan's Pants Are Off
1.overview: Sajan brings a snake to the office with the intention of impressing Sanjana by saving her. Bhupesh spills hot tea on him and Sajan rushes to clean it. When he puts his pants out to dry, someone takes them away!

1.name: Sajan, Caught With Pants Down?
1.overview: Sajan tries his best to keep himself from being seen in his underwear. Just then Sanjana calls Sajan for an urgent meeting. During Sajan's presentation, the snake crawls up his leg. Later, Kashmira arrives at Sajan's office.

1.name: Holi Ke Rang, Sanjana Ke Sang
1.overview: Sanjana is surprised to see Sajan without his pants. Sajan tells Kashmira that he does not like celebrating Holi. Later, Sanjana tells him that she loves playing Holi. Chedilal applies colour on Sajan and he fantasises about playing Holi with Sanjana.

1.name: Bhaang, Ladoo Aur Sanjana!
1.overview: Sanjana asks Sajan to get bhaang for her. Sajan tells his friend that Kashmira doesn't want him to play Holi. Sanjana calls Sajan and urges him to play Holi with her. Sajan reaches office with bhaang ladoos and a water gun.

1.name: Sajan Ko Yaad Rahegi Yeh Holi
1.overview: Sajan eats a bhaang laddoo at Sanjana's insistence. She, too, eats a few laddoos. Watch if a high-on-bhaang Sanjana fulfills Sajan's 'Holi' fantasies.

1.name: Sanjana Decides To Visit Sajan
1.overview: Sanjana asks Sajan to have dinner with her to discuss a project. Sajan recalls his promise to Kashmira about taking her mother for dinner and lies to Sanjana that his mother-in-law is sick. Sanjana decides to visit Sajan's home to see his ailing mother-in-law. Will Sajan be caught this time?

1.name: Sajan Ki Saas Ne Li Uski Saans
1.overview: Sajan's friend pretends to be his mother-in-law in front of Sanjana and her father but his family returns home earlier than expected. Later, Sanjana arranges a prayer meeting for Sajan's ailing mother-in-law!

1.name: Sajan-sanjana Chale Date Pe!
1.overview: Sanjana sends a doctor to Sajan's house to cure his mother-in-law! On Sanjana's order, Sajan dresses up smartly for office. Sanjana tells Sajan that she wants to go on a date with him.

1.name: Phas Gaya Re Sajan!
1.overview: Sanjana asks Sajan to pretend to be her boyfriend to get rid of her ex-boyfriend, Chandan. Bhupesh finds Sanjana in Sajan's arms. Chandan threatens Sajan on finding out that he is married! Later, at home, Sajan has a tough time explaning to Kashmira.

1.name: Sajan Wants To Be Sanjana's Love
1.overview: Sajan tells Sanjana that Chandan is at his house. He calls Sajan and threatens to reveal his secret. Sajan appears with his face covered before Chandan. Kashmira is furious when Sajan blurts out that he wants to be Sanjana's love forever.

1.name: Hot Model Aur Phas Gaya Sajan
1.overview: Sanjana asks Sajan to shoot a romantic ad with a hot model. The same pictures are soon shared on the social network. Later, Kashmira asks Sajan for the password to his social network account. Sajan shares his worry with Sanjana and his mother-in-law overhears the same!

1.name: Sanjana Ne Padha Sajan Ka Haath
1.overview: Sajan stops Kashmira from checking his social network account. Sanjana informs Sajan that the client will be using his photograph for their commercial. Meanwhile, Sajan imagines lifting Sanjana to help her fetch a book. Later, Sanjana reads Sajan's palm.

1.name: Ab Toh Sajan Doob Gaya
1.overview: Sanjana asks Sajan about his acts of bravery. Sajan lies about swimming across many rivers in a single breath. Sanjana wants Sajan to teach her swimming. Later, Sajan asks Khiloni to help him learn swimming. Khiloni lies to Kashmira that Sajan drowned while rescuing a woman!

1.name: Madam Ne Pehna Swimsuit?
1.overview: Sanjana tells Sajan about her dream of swimming in the sea. Sajan's imagination starts running wild again! He also imagines seeing Sanjana in a swimming costume. Will Sajan's dreams bear any fruit?

1.name: Sajan Ki Haath Safaai!
1.overview: Sanjana asks Sajan to take the measurements of a model. The model turns out to be a mannequin. While taking the measurements, Sajan accidentally breaks her hand! Ab kya karega Sajan?

1.name: Sajan Is Attacked!
1.overview: Sanjana recalls her friend's story about a killer when she sees a hand poking out of a sack under Sajan's desk. Meanwhile, the same killer enters Sajan's cabin. Mistakenly, Sanjana hands over a knife to the actual killer who then attacks Sajan.

1.name: Sajan's Topless Portrait!
1.overview: Sajan receives a text message from Sanjana saying that she wishes to paint a topless portrait of him. He workouts for a perfectly toned body. Later, Sanjana realises that she had by mistake sent the message to Sajan when he removes his shirt and poses for a portrait in front of her.

1.name: Sajan Strips For Madam
1.overview: Sanjana asks Sajan to completely strip down for the portrait. Meanwhile, even as a naked Sajan waits for Sanjana, Kashmira catches him in the same state! Later, a Bengali baba predicts that Sajan might leave Kashmira for another woman.

1.name: Madam Ke Baalon Mein Uljha Sajan
1.overview: A baba advises Sajan to attach a few strands of Sanjana's hair to a magical doll to have complete control over Sanjana. Sajan tries his best to complete his task, while Bhupesh tries to make Sajan drink the enchanted water.

1.name: Will Sajan Get Lucky?
1.overview: Bhupesh squeezes the 'mystical' lemon on Sajan's head. Sajan manages to cut off a few strands of Sanjana's hair when she requests him for a head massage. The moment Sajan attaches the hair to the enchanted doll, Sanjana asks him to stay and continue to work in the same office.

1.name: Sajan Ke Paas Bandook!
1.overview: Sajan dreams of hypnotising Sanjana with a doll. Later, he gets to know about the fake black magician. Chedilal tells Sajan and Bhupesh that Sanjana used to like a goon, Mannu. Sajan starts keeping a pistol in order to impress Sanjana.

1.name: Sajan Joins Madam's Gang
1.overview: Khiloni pretends to be a goon before Sanjana, to help Sajan prove his machoism. Sanjana tells Sajan that she is the leader of Kali Bijli gang and asks him to join her. Later, Sajan narrowly escapes the police.

1.name: Sajan Gets Cold Feet
1.overview: Sanjana asks Sajan to deliver a package for the last time. Chedilal also pretends to be involved in smuggling. Sajan encounters the police while he is on a mission and later panics seeing them in the office. Out of fear, Sajan confesses to Sanjana that he was lying about being a goon.

1.name: Sajan Ki Shirt Safed Kaise?
1.overview: Sajan and Sanjana go to a disco. A tarot card reader tells Sanjana that the man of her dreams will meet her in white shirt and blue trousers. Kashmira confronts Sajan for coming home late. Guess, who turns up wearing a white shirt?

1.name: Saala Pad Gaya Sajan Pe Bhaari
1.overview: Sajan is irritated to learn that Sanjana is interested in Bhupesh. Later, Sanjana confronts Sajan for being rude to Bhupesh. Bhupesh gets promoted to Sajan's position. Back home, a possessed Kashmira punishes Sajan for speaking ill about Bhupesh!

1.name: Sajan Ki Nayi Chaal
1.overview: While Sanjana and Bhupesh romance, a frustated Sajan disguises as a pregnant woman and claims that it is Bhupesh's child. Will Madam catch Sajan's bluff or is Bhupesh in trouble?

1.name: Sajan Wants Madam Ki Sympathy
1.overview: Sanjana tells Sajan that she can't help comforting people who are sad or upset. The next day, Sajan narrates his dukhbhari kahani to Sanjana, claiming that Kashmira doesn't treat him well. Later, at home, Sajan faces Dadi!

1.name: Madam Ne Ki Sajan Ki Taarif
1.overview: Sajan sneaks out at night to have pizza with Sanjana. The following day, Sanjana puts a board outside her cabin reading, 'Dogs and Sajan not allowed'. Later, in the evening, she pays Kashmira a visit! Why?

1.name: Sanjana's Secret Tattoo
1.overview: Sajan is shocked to see Kashmira in Sanjana's cabin. Sanjana gifts Kashmira and Sajan a holiday package to Goa. The following day, Sanjana tells Sajan that she has got a tattoo done. Meanwhile at home, Kashmira insists that Sajan gets her name tattooed.

1.name: Kya Sajan Pakda Jaayega?
1.overview: Sanjana ignores Sajan in the lift. He comes to know about Sanjana's displeasure with tattoos. He goes to a hospital to get it removed, but bumps into his sister-in-law and Kashmira!

1.name: Sajan Ke 'model' Sapne
1.overview: Kashmira comes to know that Sajan got the tattoo removed. Sanjana later asks Sajan to model for an ad campaign. But Sajan's happiness is short-lived!

1.name: Sanjana's Night Out With Sajan
1.overview: Sanjana invites Sajan for dinner as her father Chhedilal is going out of town. When Sanjana's Russian friend does not turn up at the last moment, she decides to spend the night at Sajan's place!

1.name: Sapne Sajan Ke!
1.overview: Sajan falls off the bed dreaming about Sanjana. He sneaks into Kashmira's room. Later, Sajan lies to Sanjana that Kashmira doesn't like her. He returns home drunk!

1.name: Ab Biwi, Madam Saath Mein!
1.overview: Sanjana is frightened after meeting Dadi. Kashmira fights with Sajan for not taking her to the movie. Sajan is shocked to learn that Sanjana has hired Kashmira!

1.name: Kashmira Ne Li Sajan Ki Class
1.overview: Sanjana and Kashmira enter the office together. Sajan feels left out. Kashmira is Sajan's new boss and wants him to complete his work on time. Sajan requests Sanjana to fire Kashmira.

1.name: Sajan, Sanjana Saath Saath!
1.overview: Kashmira catches Sajan inside Sanjana's tent. Sajan wants to quit his job, but Sanjana wants Kashmira to leave. Sanjana plans to send Kashmira to Singapore, but she declines the offer and later quits her job.

1.name: Sajan, Sanjana Ka Dostana
1.overview: Sanjana confides in Chedilal about being friendless. Sajan hides his identity and becomes a friend to Sanjana. Later, Sajan finds himself in trouble when Chedilal and Kashmira, thinking him to be Sanjana’s anonymous friend call and talk about him.

1.name: Sajan Ka Naya Affair?
1.overview: Sanjana calls and disturbs Sajan while he romances with Kashmira. She complains to him about her anonymous friend not answering her call. Sajan pulls a prank on Bhupesh. Sanjana tells Kashmira that Sajan is having an affair. Is Sajan in trouble again?

1.name: Khiloni Ki Anokhi Salah
1.overview: Sanjana gets irritated listening to Sajan's shayari. Khiloni advises Sajan to keep away from Sanjana in order to attract her towards him. Sajan applies the same theory at home and romances with Kashmira to get rid of her, while at office he avoids Sanjana to get her attention.

1.name: Sajan Gets Romantic
1.overview: Sajan continues to ignore Sanjana. He gifts a bottle of expensive scotch to Khiloni! Kashmira gets irritated when Sajan wakes her up in the night and tries to act romantic. Will Khiloni's plan work for Sajan?

1.name: Swiss Alps Are Calling Sajan
1.overview: Sanjana asks Sajan if he would like to go to the mountains for some office work. Sajan tells her that he has phobia for mountains. What will Sajan do when the trip is actually a visit to Switzerland with Madam?

1.name: Sajan Ki Nayi Mushkil
1.overview: Sanjana insists that Sajan should get his NOC form signed by Kashmira. Acting on Khiloni's advice, he tries to provoke his family. Later, he resorts to emotional drama to convince Kashmira.

1.name: Sajan Ke Saath Hua Dhokha
1.overview: Sajan faints on learning that he is going to Nainital and not Switzerland. Later, he learns about Sanjana's adventurous camping trip. He takes Khiloni's advice to go camping with her.

1.name: Sajan Bana Sajni
1.overview: Sajan behaves like a woman and plans for a kitty party in front of Sanjana. Later, Sajan introduces his friends, Mrs Takkar and Kanchu to Sanjana. At home, Kashimira is shocked to see Sajan in her nightgown.

1.name: Sajan Ko Mila Invitation
1.overview: Sajan continues to behave like a woman. Sanjana panics when Sajan enters the ladies toilet. Kashmira tells Sanjana about Sajan's weird behaviour. Later, Sanjana invites Sajan to join her for the camp.

1.name: Sanjana, Sajan Are Friends?
1.overview: Sanjana compliments Sajan for having found a true friend in him. Sajan confesses to Sanjana that he behaved like a woman to make her feel less lonely. Later, Khiloni advises Sajan to save his job by proving his masculinity.

1.name: Madam Ne Maangi Sajan Ki Kidney
1.overview: Bhupesh collects the wrong diagnostic report of Haseena from the hospital. The family members misunderstand thinking Haseena's kidneys have failed! To test Sajan's loyalty towards the company, Sanjana asks Sajan to donate one of his kidneys to Chedilal!

1.name: Bura Phasa Sajan
1.overview: Sajan is in a dilemma whether to donate his kidney or not after Kashmira asks him to donate his kidney to her mother. Meanwhile, Chedilal and Sanjana continue with their prank. Will Sajan donate his kidney to anyone?

1.name: Sajan Ki Anokhi Demand
1.overview: Bhupesh tells the family members that he collected the wrong medical report. Sajan demands Chedilal to give him a share in the company in exchange of his kidney. Later, Kashmira learns about Sajan's decision to give his kidney to Chedilal.

1.name: Madam Ko Khaana Hai Achaar
1.overview: Sanjana asks Sajan to get her the pickle he brought in his lunchbox. Sajan flatters Kashmira to get the pickle jar from her. Later, he manages to steal the jar and gives it to Sanjana!

1.name: Sajan Ki Khiloni Chachi
1.overview: Sajan retrieves the pickle jar from Sanjana. She expresses her desire to learn the pickle recipe from Sajan's aunt. Khiloni disguises as his aunt. Meanwhile, Kashmira invites Sajan's aunt for dinner.

1.name: Ab Kya Karega, Sajan?
1.overview: Sajan promises to take Kashmira out for dinner. Sanjana calls for a meeting and asks her employees to work overtime. What will now happen to Sajan and Kashmira's dinner date?

1.name: Dadi Ne Diya Sajan Ko Order
1.overview: Sanjana-Sajan go to a restaurant for a client meeting. Kashmira is angry to see them together. Dadi orders Sajan to take Kashmira out for dinner. Sajan pretends to be sick so that he can leave the office.

1.name: Sajan Sirf Sach Bolega
1.overview: A client introduces Sanjana to a pill that makes people speak the truth. She decides to test the pill on Sajan. Later, Sajan humiliates Kashmira when she asks him about her sari. The next day, he confides his deed to Sanjana.

1.name: Kashmira Kholegi Sajan's Raaz
1.overview: The effect of the truth pill continues. Sajan fails to stop himself from insulting Chedilal. Sanjana stops Chedilal from firing Sajan. Kashmira decides to make the most of 'Sajan's truth telling' exercise. Will Sajan land in some big trouble?

1.name: Sajan Bana Kaam Wali Bai!
1.overview: Sajan is made to sit on the hot seat and is bombarded with questions. Later, Sanjana tells Sajan that her maid has left the job. Sajan reaches her house disguised as a maid.

1.name: Meet Shanta Lopez!
1.overview: A woman called Shanta Lopez visits Sanjana's house. Later, Sanjana questions Sajan for coming late to office. Kashmira suspects Sajan's actions and asks Bhupesh to spy on him. Later, Chedilal tries to flirt with Shanta.

1.name: Kab Tak Bachega Sajan?
1.overview: Sanjana confronts Sajan for being late to work. She asks Shanta to make dinner at Kashmira's house. Later, Kashmira and Bhupesh find women's clothes in Sajan's bag!

1.name: Chedilal Ki Shaadi Shanta Se?
1.overview: Sanjana asks Shanta to marry Chedilal. Sajan tries hard to explain Kashmira about the women's clothes in his bag. Khiloni visits Sanjana's house as Shanta's husband!

1.name: Sajan's Madam Gayi Out Of Hand
1.overview: How will Sajan tackle a hypnotised Sanjana as she gets too hot to handle? Sajan is in deep trouble when Khiloni tells him about the stolen book!

1.name: Sajan Hypnotises Kashmira
1.overview: Sajan retrieves the book from the gorilla and hypnotises Kashmira. Meanwhile, what is Sanjana doing in Sajan's house?

1.name: Kya Bhupesh Ki Lottery Lagegi?
1.overview: Will Sajan succeed in his attempt to hypnotise his family and erase the memory of Sanjana's visit? Later, Bhupesh buys a lottery ticket with Sajan's money!

1.name: Sajan Bana Crorepati
1.overview: Sajan claims the lottery money. He tells Chedilal to make him his business partner and gifts a bike to Bhupesh. Later, he tries to brag about his changed status before Sanjana.

1.name: Sajan Ko Mila Thenga
1.overview: Chedilal and Sanjana want Sajan to prove that he is a crorepati. Later, a shock awaits Sajan when he calls the lottery office. How will Sajan deal with it?

1.name: Meet Janu, Madam's Cousin!
1.overview: Sanjana deliberately puts Sajan into trouble when Kashmira calls him. Kashmira misunderstands Sajan to be with another woman. Meanwhile, Madam's cousin, Janu arrives on the scene!

1.name: Kashmira Ka Ban Gaya Janu
1.overview: Sajan gets angry on seeing Janu romance Kashmira. However, he is unaware about a bigger plan!

1.name: Janu Ne Li Sajan Ki Jaan
1.overview: Janu continues to romance with Kashmira. At the office, Sanjana tells Sajan about Janu's past affairs with married women. Is there cause for concern for Sajan?

1.name: Madam Bheegi Baarish Mein
1.overview: Sanjana expresses her desire to get drenched in the rain. Despite being sick, Sajan goes to the office the next day to watch her enjoy the rain. Will everything happen as Sajan wished?

1.name: Madam Ki Fantasy
1.overview: Bhupesh finds Sajan jumping up and down in the rain and asking Sanjana to join him. Later, Sanjana tells Sajan about her fantasy to see a man, drenched!

1.name: Sajan Baal Baal Bacha?
1.overview: Chedi invites Kashmira's mother for tea. Sajan starts using a hair tonic. But will it benefit him?

1.name: Sajan Ka Ujda Chaman!
1.overview: Sajan covers his head with a bandana and goes to office. Sanjana is disgusted to see his bald head and asks him to stay away from her. Sajan's problems double up when Kashmira too asks him to not come home!

1.name: Sajan Ko Mili Jadui Dawai
1.overview: Sajan is depressed as everyone ignores him because of his baldness. Meanwhile, Khiloni provides him with a quick solution to get his hair back.

1.name: Sajan Ka Paanv Kabar Mein
1.overview: Sanjana asks Sajan to spend a night with her at the cemetery. Fear grips Sajan at the graveyard when someone in a mask scares him!

1.name: Bhaago Sajan, Bhoot Aaya?
1.overview: Someone slaps Sajan inside the lift when the lights go off. Later, some uncanny incidents leave him unnerved. Someone calls out his name when he is alone at home! Who is it?

1.name: Sajan Ke Peeche Bhoot?
1.overview: Sajan tells Sanjana about his encounter with a ghost. The next day, they visit a graveyard where an old man tells them that they resemble people from the past!

1.name: Madam High 'spirit' Mein!
1.overview: Sanjana wants to meet Johny's ghost. At night, she disguises herself as Julie and tries to flirt with Sajan to summon Johny's spirit.

1.name: Sajan Ko Mila Johny Se Chutkara
1.overview: Sanjana orders Sajan to summon Dadi's ghost or else! Sajan tries to insult Kashmira to summon Dadi. Later, Dadi's ghost saves Sanjana and Sajan from Johny's ghost!

1.name: Sajan Ka Naya Dhong
1.overview: Khiloni reminds Sajan about his marriage anniversary after he plans to go out with Sanjana for dinner. Later, he pretends to have lost his memory in order to avoid Kashmira's anger. Will Sajan succeed in his act?

1.name: Sajan Bana Chaprasi!
1.overview: Sajan ends up squatting flies and preparing tea for Sanjana after Chedilal makes him a peon! His situation gets worse at home. Find out why.

1.name: Kya Pakda Jayega Sajan?
1.overview: Sanjana flirts with Sajan to summon Dadi, hoping that he will recall everything. Later, she calls him to her house and asks him to give a back massage to Chedilal. Is Sajan falling into Sanjana's trap?

1.name: Sajan Bana Madam Ka Chamcha
1.overview: The loss of another major client leads Sanjana to put ridiculous suggestions into effect. Soon, she turns Sajan into her personal office pet!

1.name: It's A Dog's Life For Sajan!
1.overview: Bhupesh finds Sanjana tying a dog's collar on Sajan's neck. Later, Sanjana asks Kashmira to treat Sajan like a dog. What happens next that makes Sajan an 'aggressive dog!'

1.name: Madam Ke Liye Kuch Bhi Karega
1.overview: Sajan brags that he can spend money to get Sanjana out of any problem. She lies to him that someone is threatening to release her obscene pictures if she doesn't pay him. What will Sajan do?

1.name: Sajan Ne Ki Chori
1.overview: Sanjana tells Sajan that the kidnapper is blackmailing her for more money. Sajan steals money from Kashmira's purse and later, disguises himself as a robber!

1.name: Sajan Ne Ki Maang Puri
1.overview: Sanjana manipulates Sajan into getting more money for her, getting him into trouble with Kashmira. Later, Sajan is depressed when he sees Sanjana!

1.name: Sajan Ban Gaya Love Guru
1.overview: Sajan is beaten up by Manu for insulting him in front of Sanjana. However, Sanjana reveals to him that she was pretending to be Manu's wife all this time. Later, Sajan poses as Love Guru, Aashiq Awara.

1.name: Madam Ne Dil Ki Raaz Kholi!
1.overview: Sajan puts a fake snake under Sanjana's desk and tries to act heroic by saving her. Later, Sanjana calls Love Guru Aashiq Awara and bares her heart to him.

1.name: Phas Gaya Bechara Sajan
1.overview: Chedilal is unhappy about Sanjana's decision to marry Love Guru Aashiq Awara. Meanwhile, is Kashmira having an affair with Aashiq Awara?

1.name: Sajan Hua Badnaam
1.overview: To make her company famous, Sanjana makes Sajan a part of her controversy and tells the media that he had tried to harass her. Later, Kashmira drives Sajan out of the house! Where will Sajan go?

1.name: Chedi Complains Against Sajan
1.overview: Sajan wears a sari to stop people from recognising him. Later, he manages to convince Kashmira about the controversy. Meanwhile, Chedilal is adamant on filing a FIR against Sajan.

1.name: Madam Ki Tarkeeb Kaam Ayegi?
1.overview: Sajan’s mother-in-law presents his case in court, while Chedilal defends Sanjana. The two try to prove their respective clients to be innocent. Later, Sanjana comes up with a plan and shares it with Sajan. What is it?

1.name: Hum Tum Ek Gufe Mein Phase Ho
1.overview: Sanjana and Sajan get stranded and find shelter in a cave when their car breaks down. Sajan falls unconscious due to extreme cold and finds himself in a sticky situation. The next day, Sanjana plays a prank on him.

1.name: Sanjana Is Pregnant!
1.overview: While Sanjana tells Sajan that she is pregnant with his child, at home, Kashmira, too desires to have a child. Ab kya karega Sajan?

1.name: Kashmira Seduces Sajan
1.overview: Sanjana tells Sajan that she will do a DNA test to prove that he is the father. Meanwhile, Kashmira tries to seduce Sajan!

1.name: Madam Ne Bataya Kashmira Ko
1.overview: Khiloni advises Sajan to use poison when he decides to commit suicide. At Chedi's birthday party, Sanjana tells Kashmira that she is pregnant with Sajan's child!

1.name: Sajan Turns Into A Matchmaker
1.overview: Kashmira gets angry when Sajan suggests Chedi's marriage with his mother-in-law. The following day, Sanjana arranges for a date for her dad. Will Sajan be able to persuade his mother-in-law to go on a date?

1.name: Sajan Sedates His Mother-in-law
1.overview: Kashmira finds her mother with Chedilal at the restaurant. Later, Sajan tries to manipulate his mother-in-law to elope with Chedilal. After Kashmira falls asleep, he manages to sedate his mother-in-law and take her to Chedilal.

1.name: Sajan Bana Babysitter!
1.overview: Sajan brings his mother-in-law to Sanjana's house where they set up the marriage altar. The following day, Sanjana asks Sajan to look after her friend's baby. Can Sajan do it?

1.name: Sajan Ka Bachcha Kahan Hai?
1.overview: Kashmira throws Sajan out of the house on seeing him with a baby. Later, Sajan stops Sanjana from finding out that the baby is missing!

1.name: Sajan Ke Peeche Chedi!
1.overview: Sajan's mother-in-law meets Chedilal and learns about his plan to expose Sajan. Sajan tries to hide something from Sanjana. Will he be caught?

1.name: Bhupesh, Madam Saath Saath
1.overview: Sajan tells Sanjana's friend that Chedilal stole the baby from him. Kashmira comes in with the baby before any action is taken. Meanwhile, Sanjana and Bhupesh plan a new prank on Sajan.

1.name: Murda Gayab!
1.overview: Sanjana tells Sajan that she is going to confess to the police about Bhupesh's murder. Later, Sajan finds Bhupesh's body missing.

1.name: Murda Gayab!
1.overview: Sanjana tells Sajan that she is going to confess to the police about Bhupesh's murder. Later, Sajan finds Bhupesh's body missing.

1.name: Sajan Ka Naya Natak
1.overview: Sajan learns about the prank that Sanjana and Bhupesh had played on him. Chedilal tries to commit suicide! Later, Sanjana asks Sajan to comfort Chedilal by acting as a man possessed.

1.name: Sajan Pe Hua Bhoot Sawar!
1.overview: Sajan pretends to be possessed by Chedi's dead wife in order to please Sanjana. But, later, Chedi gets possessive of his late wife, putting Sajan in a spot!

1.name: Madam Ka Plan
1.overview: Sajan seeks refuge in Sanjana's house after being thrown out of his own house. But, he is in trouble when Chedi wants to communicate with his dead wife. Sanjana comes up with a plan to end the game!

1.name: The Rajni Fever!
1.overview: Sajan comes to know that Sanjana is an ardent fan of Rajnikant and lies to her that the superstar is his childhood buddy. Later, confusion makes way for chaos when Sanjana calls a look-alike of the famous actor to her office.

1.name: Sajan Meets Thalaiva!
1.overview: Fearing exposure, Sajan tells Khiloni to kidnap him, so that he doesn't have to go to office. Later, he notices the lookalike of Rajnikant and understands Sanjana's plan.

1.name: Sajan Bana Sanjana Ka Bhai!
1.overview: Everyone is eagerly waiting to celebrate Raksha Bandhan. Since Sanjana doesn't have a brother, she decides to tie a rakhi on Sajan and make him her brother!

1.name: Sanjana Ne Bandhi Sajan Ko Rakhi!
1.overview: Sanjana seeks Kashmira’s permission to let her tie rakhi on Sajan’s hand. Sajan tries to avoid her and makes a desperate attempt to flee.

1.name: Sajan Turns Into A Chef!
1.overview: Sajan gets himself arrested, hoping to evade Sanjana. But, she is adamant about tying him a rakhi and comes to the police station. The next day, Sajan lies to Sanjana about his culinary skills and then finds himself in a fix!

1.name: Sanjana Ki Lajawab Dishes
1.overview: Sajan falsely praises Sanjana's cooking after she prepares shahi paneer. Sanjana asks him to teach some other dishes as well. How will Chedilal react when he will be served the dishes prepared by Sanjana?

1.name: Sajan Banega Krishna Kanhaiya
1.overview: Kashmira gets angry with Sajan after she learns that he has been teaching Sanjana how to cook. The next day, she tells Sajan that she wants him to take part in the Janmashtami celebrations. Will Sajan oblige?

1.name: Sajan Bana Giridhari!
1.overview: Sajan gets into an argument with his neighbour regarding the Janmashtami celebrations. The next day, at work, Sajan jumps at the idea of Sanjana playing Radha's role opposite him.

1.name: Sajan Ka Fitness Mantra
1.overview: A scared Sajan, unaware of Chidchide's plan, climbs over the human pyramid to break the handi. Later, Kashmira asks Sajan to join her for an early morning jog!

1.name: Sajan Ka Power Yoga
1.overview: Sajan expresses his wish to be Sanjana's partner in doing power yoga. Later, Bhupesh shoots a video of Sajan doing yoga. Why?

1.name: Sajan Breaks His Arm!
1.overview: Sajan is forced to go on a fitness run with Kashmira and then with Sanjana. Khiloni suggests that Sajan fake an injury in order to escape the rigorous regime. But, Sanjana gets a little too worried about Sajan!

1.name: Sanjana Bani Naagin!
1.overview: Sajan asks his friend, Khiloni to break his hand before his meeting with Sanjana. Later, Sajan overhears Sanjana talking over the phone about her role as a Naagin and mistakes her to be one!

1.name: Sajan Is Scared Of Sanjana
1.overview: Sajan runs home after meeting Sanjana. Later, he sees a snake in his house and his fear of Sanjana grows bigger. The next day, Chedi gets to know about Sajan's fear and scares him.

1.name: Sanjana Naagin, Sajan Sapera
1.overview: Sanjana continues to fool Sajan by pretending to be an Ichchhadhari Naagin. Meanwhile, Khiloni gives Sajan a pungi to tame her and the others. Will Sajan come to know about Sanjana's plan?

1.name: Shak Ke Ghere Mein Sajan
1.overview: Chedilal's dominating sister visits India to get Sanjana married. Kashmira becoes suspicious when an upset Sajan tells her about it.

1.name: Sanjana Tricks Her Aunt
1.overview: Sajan goes to Sanjana's house disguised as a potential suitor for marriage, but Chedi recognises him. Soon, Kashmira comes in with her mother, leaving Sajan in a panic.

1.name: Sajan Bana Madam Ka Dulha
1.overview: Sajan disguises himself as a prospective groom for Sanjana. Later, Sanjana's aunt insists that the groom's family stays at Kashmira's house. Meanwhile, Kashmira waits for Sajan at home. How will Sajan play the double role?

1.name: Sajan Ki Atki Jaan
1.overview: Sanjana tells Kashmira that she does not want to marry and asks her help to avoid the groom and his family. But, Sanjana's aunt brings a lawyer to get them married. What will Sajan do?

1.name: Sajan Ne Piya Syrup
1.overview: Sanjana mocks Sajan's physique when he volunteers to model for an ad. Later, Khiloni gives Sajan a syrup to tone down his physique. Will it work for Sajan?

1.name: Andher Nagri Mein Sajan
1.overview: Bhupesh deceives Sajan and takes him to the terrace instead of taking him to Sanjana's office. Will it land Sajan in some fresh trouble at office and at home?

1.name: Sajan Ki Kismat Hi Kharab
1.overview: Sajan curses himself for having no vision as Sanjana takes him to a water park and wears a bikini. While returning home, they are abducted by a dangerous mental patient. How will Sajan and Sanjana save themselves?

1.name: Sajan Ne Kho Di Property
1.overview: Sanjana calls Chedi irresponsible and their argument takes an ugly turn when he decides to give away all his possessions. Who will Chedi give away his property to?

1.name: Sajan's Promise To Sanjana
1.overview: Sanjana gets furious on learning that Chedi has transferred his property in Ramvati's name. Sajan promises her that he will find a solution to this problem. Can he?

1.name: Sajan Ne Banaya Plan
1.overview: Sajan uses Khiloni in his plan to stop Bhupesh, Ramvati and Kashmira from taking over Chedi's property. Later, he tries to warn Chedi about Ramvati's intentions.

1.name: Sajan Bana Shehzada!
1.overview: Sajan reads Sanjana's personal diary and learns about her wish to have a boyfriend from a royal family. He asks a local vendor to visit the office dressed as royalty and introduce himself as Sajan's grandfather!

1.name: Sajan Ke Rangeen Shauk!
1.overview: The vendor in a Maharaja's disguise visits Sanjana's house pretending to be Sajan's grandfather. Sajan reveals about a tradition of his royal dynasty to have a girlfriend apart from a wife. What will happen when Kashmira learns about this?

1.name: Dada Ke Chakkar Mein Phasa Sajan
1.overview: Sajan lies about his grandfather's part time job when Sanjana finds him selling vegetables on the streets. Later, Kashmira invites his grandfather and requests him to stay with them!

1.name: Sanjana Bani Sajan Ki Gf!
1.overview: Sanjana makes Sajan's day as she agrees to be his girlfriend. But, his wild fantasies soon meet a dead end! Find out why.

1.name: Sajan Ko Chahiye Sukoon
1.overview: Sajan and Kashmira's romance comes to an abrupt halt with Kashmira's family interrupting them. Meanwhile, Sanjana's aunt also starts troubling her at night. The next day, Sajan and Sanjana exchange ideas to solve their problems.

1.name: Sajan Ko Sona Padega Tent Mein!
1.overview: Sanjana's aunt says that her snoring reminds her of her husband. The next day, Sajan tells Kashmira that he will not stay in the house till her family leaves. Later, Sajan has another idea to solve Sanjana's problem.

1.name: Sanjana Sajan Ke Saath?
1.overview: Sajan goes through a troubled night, with no other choice but to sleep in a tent. However, when asked about it, he lies to Sanjana and Kashmira. Later, fed up with her aunt, Sanjana requests Sajan to allow her to sleep in the tent with him. What will Sajan do now?

1.name: Kashmira Is Anxious!
1.overview: Kashmira is worried with Sanjana's arrival and persuades her mother and brother to apologise to Sajan. Later, Kashmira's grandmother arrives and scares them.

1.name: Sajan Ne Diya Sanjana Ko Tohfa
1.overview: Sanjana is in a bad mood as Chedi has forgotten her birthday. Meanwhile, Sajan finds out that it is her birthday and lies about remembering it. What will he gift Sanjana??

1.name: Sajan Ka Tohfa Pad Gaya Mehenga
1.overview: Sajan gifts a pair of earrings to Sanjana. However, he panics when he realises that the earrings are a family heirloom. What will he do?

1.name: Sanjana's Birthday Party
1.overview: Sajan is worried when his mother-in-law visits his office. He desperately tries to keep her from seeing Sanjana. Soon, Sanjana invites Sajan's family for her birthday party!

1.name: Sajan, Khiloni Ka Bangkok Trip
1.overview: Sajan asks Sanjana for a leave as he wants to go on a trip with Khiloni to Bangkok. Khiloni tells Sajan that Kashmira has found their tickets for Bangkok. Sajan leaves for home but Sanjana calls him back for some official work.

1.name: Begani Shaadi Mein Sajan Deewana
1.overview: Sanjana tells Sajan that she will attend Khiloni's sister's marriage with him. Kashmira and the others too plan to go along with him. What will Sajan do now?

1.name: Who Is Dadi's Soulmate?
1.overview: Sajan persuades Dadi, but faces problems in convincing Sanjana. Khiloni lies about the marriage getting cancelled, while Sanjana decides to help. Later, Dadi talks to Sajan about her soulmate!

1.name: Sajan Ne Kheli Nayi Chaal
1.overview: Sajan convinces a local street vendor to pretend as Khiloni's grandfather in front of Sanjana and in return, promises to take him to Bangkok with them. Will their plan to fool Sanjana work out?

1.name: Sajan Chala Bangkok?
1.overview: Dadi tells Sajan that Khiloni's 'grandfather' was the childhood friend whom she liked. The next day, Khiloni's sister shows up at Sanjana's office and Sajan is left with no other option but to spill the beans about his Bangkok trip!

1.name: Sajan Ki Nayi Chalupanti!
1.overview: Sajan gifts Sanjana a flower vase with a spy camera planted inside and is thrilled when she promises to place it in her bedroom. Later at night, his fantasies are shattered when he watches the footage on his phone.

1.name: Sanjana Aurat Nahi Aadmi Hai!
1.overview: Sajan gets restless after finding out that Sanjana is actually a man and tries to avoid her. Meanwhile, Kashmira calls Sanjana over for dinner. What will Sajan do when Sanjana decides to spend the night at his place?

1.name: Sajan Is Confused!
1.overview: Sanjana pretends to enter the men's washroom in front of Sajan and confuses him. Sajan also catches her shaving while he goes to offer his resignation. Later, Sajan takes the police to Sanjana's place and makes wild claims.

1.name: Shreyas Talpade On The Show
1.overview: Sajan reads a notice in the newspaper that actor, Shreyas Talpade, is looking for a couple to act in his movie and sends photographs of Sanjana. Later Shreyas pays them a surprise visit.

1.name: Kya Sajan Banega Madam Ka Hero?
1.overview: Shreyas Talpade tells Sanjana that she's been selected as the main heroine in his next movie. He then gives her a narration, while Sajan impresses him with his creative inputs. Will Sajan get a role too?

1.name: Sajan Ko Mila Ek Naya Role
1.overview: Chedilal tells Sajan about his plan to cast Kashmira and her mother in his movie. Later, Shreyas offers Sajan a role in his film. However, Sajan is not happy with his role.

1.name: Sajan Ban Gaya Pregnant
1.overview: Sajan tries to stop Sanjana and Shreyas Talpade from working together in a movie. Later, he comes to office disguised as a pregnant woman!

1.name: Sajan Ban Gaya Dadaji!
1.overview: Sajan is shocked to see Sanjana in a new avatar. Young and energetic again, Sanjana scares Sajan by chasing him on skates. Later, Dadi asks Sajan to disguise himself as Dadaji and pretend to be her lover.

1.name: Has Sanjana Fired Sajan?
1.overview: Dadi forces Sajan to dress up as Dadaji, creating problems in his office. In an attempt to make Dadi hate him, Sajan tries to ruin the memories related to Dadaji. But, things turn ugly when Sanjana hires a new creative head.

1.name: Sajan Gets His Job Back
1.overview: Bhupesh saves Sajan's skin! The next day, Sanjana scolds Sajan, but is happy to learn that Rajan is gone. Later, Sanjana's aunt has a proposal for her.

1.name: Sajan Sanjana Ka Sticky Affair!
1.overview: Sanjana uses a powerful glue to get stuck to Sajan. Sajan is delighted but is soon in for big trouble!

1.name: Sajan Ko Hai Dadi Ka Darr
1.overview: Sajan and Sanjana try to find a way to separate their hands. Later, Sajan is scared to face Dadi. Meanwhile, who is this childhood friend who Sanjana is missing?

1.name: Sajan Ke Udd Gaye Tote!
1.overview: Chedi tells Sajan a bitter truth that totally frustrates him! What is it? How will Sajan deal with the new equation that he has to share now with Sanjana?

1.name: Sajan Ka Naya Position
1.overview: Chedi and Sanjana surprise Sajan by giving him a new position in office and decide to hold a puja for him. But Sajan has other plans.

1.name: Sajan Chala Dubai!
1.overview: Sajan overhears that Chedi is going to Dubai. Later, he panics when he is told to retrieve a special package from a Sheikh in Dubai since Chedi can't go.

1.name: Sajan Bana Smuggler
1.overview: Sajan has a nightmare in which Sanjana deceives him. Bhupesh tells him about a friend who is in jail for smuggling gold. Sanjana asks Sajan to smuggle gold biscuits for her from Dubai. Will Sajan follow her orders?

1.name: Sajan Ke Peeche Padi Police!
1.overview: Sajan sneaks into Chedi's house and beats him with a stick to make him run. The next day, Sajan panics on seeing a policeman chase him and tells him that Chedi is making him smuggle gold. Later, Sajan accuses Bhupesh of being a thief.

1.name: Lut Gaya Sajan!
1.overview: Bhupesh plans to take revenge on Sajan and keeps office stationary in his bag. Soon, Sanjana gives Sajan a huge amount of money for safe-keeping but it gets stolen. The next day, Sajan decides to tell Sanjana about the theft.

1.name: Sajan Ne Kiya Saas Pe Vaar!
1.overview: Sajan is desperate to pay off Sanjana and tells Kashmira’s mother to sell her land. Unable to convince her, he takes a drastic step!

1.name: Phas Gaye Sajan
1.overview: Sajan scares Kashmira and Chedi that the kidnappers are demanding ransom. Chedi agrees to pay the ransom but Sajan is caught in a tight spot when Dadi threatens him!

1.name: Sanjana's Copycat
1.overview: Sanjana suggests the idea of a double-role for an ad, but Sajan doesn't believe in the existence of doppelgangers. His opinion changes when he meets Raseela, Sanjana's lookalike. Later, she enters Sajan's room while Kashmira is asleep beside him.

1.name: Sanjana Is Kidnapped!
1.overview: Sajan meets Raseela in the office and learns that she has abducted Sanjana for money. Later, he falls unconscious after meeting Raseela's gang.

1.name: Sajan Is Pregnant?
1.overview: Sajan accidentally gets injected by Lalwani's experimental fertility medicine. Later, he sees Sanjana treating her pregnant friend with a lot of care! The next day, he pretends to be ill and goes for a check-up. What is he ailing from?

1.name: Sajan Ki Baj Gayi Band
1.overview: Sanjana does a research on male pregnancy and starts to doubt Sajan and the doctor. Later, she and Kashmira confront the doctor to find out the truth.

1.name: Sajan Ki Godh Bharai!
1.overview: Sajan is having a good time pretending to be pregnant. Later, he goes to the doctor and finds himself in a soup! Back home, a baby shower is organised for him and that's not all!

1.name: Madam Bani Gayi Bewdi!
1.overview: Sanjana is tired of Chedilal's drinking habit so, Sajan gives her a suggestion. The following day, Sanjana gets tanked and creates a scene in the office in front of Chedilal. Can Sajan control madam this time?

1.name: Sanjana Gets Drunk!
1.overview: Sajan is arrested by the police after Sanjana accuses him of making her dance. Later, Chedi decides to quit alcohol after seeing Sanjana drunk!

1.name: Sharaabi Sajan!
1.overview: The cops arrest Sajan for drinking and dancing on the streets. The next day, Sajan takes a hasty decision when Sanjana refuses to quit drinking.

1.name: Kya Chedi Ko Hua Hai Pyaar?
1.overview: Sajan decides to quit his job, as he believes that Sanjana's drinking habit is affecting his life. Later, Sanjana plays around with Sajan, while Chedi gets romantic with Kashmira's mother.

1.name: Sajan Works Overtime
1.overview: Sanjana continues to seduce Sajan in order to win the challenge against Chedi. Meanwhile, Sanjana shows up in office while Kashmira asks Sajan to work overtime!

1.name: Kya Madam Hongi Impress?
1.overview: Sanjana continues to trouble Sajan, only to win her challenge against Chedi. Later, Khiloni gives some tips to Sajan to impress Sanjana.

1.name: Sanjana's Mysterious Lover
1.overview: An ecstatic Sanjana tells Sajan about her mysterious lover. Sajan decides to write Sanjana a letter. But when Sanjana tells Kashmira about her mystery man, she frightens Sanjana with her advice.

1.name: Sajan Flirts With Sanjana
1.overview: Sajan enjoys flirting with Sanjana on the phone. However, Sanjana taps the call to get the caller arrested. Will Sanjana find out the identity of the caller?

1.name: Sajan Ke Paas Kaala Dhan!
1.overview: Sanjana requests Sajan to deposit the black money in a bank. At the same time, Kashmira and her mother also try to convince Sajan to deposit their money!

1.name: Sajan Phir Phans Gaya Re
1.overview: Sanjana asks Sajan to convert Chedi's black money into white. Bhupesh notices Sajan giving the money to the liftman. To double the trouble, Karishma too gives money to Sajan!

1.name: Sajan Is In Trouble
1.overview: Sanjana and Kashmira notice a negative vibe around Sajan and decide to do something about it. They make him work harder and later, humiliate him for his efforts. Will Sajan be able to cope up with their challenges?

1.name: Sajan Ho Gaya Buddha?
1.overview: Sanjana tries to convince Sajan that he has grown old. Kashmira and Khiloni too play along. How will Sajan handle the situation?

1.name: Sajan In A Soup
1.overview: Sajan's happiness knows no bounds when Sanjana asks him to meet her in the evening, during the power cut. However, his excitement goes for a toss. Find out why.

1.name: Sanjana Ne Maangi Maafi Sajan Se!
1.overview: Sajan is shocked to learn about Kashmira and her mother’s secrets. Later, Sanjana apologises to Sajan, but gets angry at him again. What has he done now?

1.name: Wajah Tum Ho Cast Visit
1.overview: Sajan loses control over himself! He sneaks into the office late at night to see Sanjana's pictures on her laptop. Later, the lead pair of Wajah Tum Ho visit their office!

1.name: Sajan Ko Hua Sanjana Se Pyaar?
1.overview: Sajan meets his old friend who tells him that he was madly in love with a girl. Later, Sajan starts thinking about Sanjana and sees her everywhere. He even mistakes his mother-in-law to be his boss. Sajan's strange behaviour strikes Kashmira as odd and she confronts him.

1.name: Sanjana Wants A Massage
1.overview: Sanjana’s request for a massage fires up Sajan’s imagination. Later, Kashmira’s attempt to seduce Sajan ends up in a fiasco!

1.name: Sajan In A Tight Situation
1.overview: Sanjana agrees to help Sajan after he confides his addiction to her. Later, she calls the police to arrest him. To get out of the situation, Sajan lies about being a tightrope walker!

1.name: Sajan Ki Langdi Chaal
1.overview: Sajan arrives at the office on a wheelchair and claims to have lost control of his legs. Will Sanjana and Chedi believe him?

1.name: New Girl In Sajan's Office
1.overview: With Kashmira and her mother at home and Sanjana in office, how will Sajan tackle them all? Will the new girl in office help him?

1.name: Sajan, Madam Ka Costume Drama
1.overview: Sajan continues to fantasise about Sanjana. Sanjana requests Sajan to accompany her to a costume party. What will happen when Kashmira finds out about it?

1.name: Sajan Quits His Job!
1.overview: Sajan's conscience pricks him and he quits his job. Later, he regrets his decision and tries to get his job back. Will Sanjana oblige.

1.name: Sanjana To Get Married?
1.overview: Sanjana is worried on learning that her aunt has found a suitable groom for her. Later, her decision to evade marriage makes Sajan insecure.

1.name: Sanjana To Marry Bhupesh
1.overview: Sanjana's aunt decides to stay at Sajan's house to give her lessons on being an ideal daughter-in-law. Later, Sanjana tells Sajan that she's going to marry Bhupesh!

1.name: Bhupesh Dominates Sanjana
1.overview: Sajan tries to make Sanjana hate Bhupesh but his plan backfires. Upon Khiloni's advice, Sajan tells Bhupesh that Sanjana admires men who dominate women.

1.name: Sanjana's New Hobby
1.overview: Sajan advises Sanjana to pick up a hobby and they go fishing together. However, Sajan gets into trouble as Sanjana informs Kashmira about the trip. Later, Sanjana involves Sajan in her new pastime.

1.name: Sajan Ka Naya Hobby!
1.overview: Sajan looks forward to swimming with Sanjana. But, soon he gets bored, and Khiloni comes up with a new idea!

1.name: Sajan Bana Santa Claus!
1.overview: Sajan misunderstands Sanjana and ends up undressing in office! However, he soon realises that Sanjana had actually asked him to play Santa Claus. Later, Kashmira overhears Sajan and Khiloni's conversation.

1.name: Has Santa Arrived?
1.overview: Kashmira's mother wants to see her husband in Santa's costume, while Kashmira waits for Sajan. Meanwhile, Sanjana too is waiting for her surprise from Santa Claus! So who will have a merry Christmas?

1.name: Sajan Versus Tarzan!
1.overview: After failing to be Sanjana's Santa Claus, Sajan is in trouble again as Kashmira wants him to take her to the new Tarzan movie. But what happens when Sanjana expresses her love for Tarzan?

1.name: Madam Ka Albela Aashiq
1.overview: Sanjana is a big fan of an anonymous poet called Albela Aashiq and is desperate to meet him. Sajan tells her that he is Albela Aashiq. Later, Khiloni helps Sajan steal Kashmira's diary filled with similar poems to give Sanjana a proof.

1.name: Sanjana Fines Sajan
1.overview: Kashmira fails to find her diary and accuses Sajan of stealing it. Meanwhile, Sanjana learns about Sajan's lies and decides to fine him Rs 25 lakhs!

1.name: Sajan Ne Ki Charity
1.overview: Sajan gives his money away and watch to a random beggar as an act of charity to impress Sanjana. Later, he imagines Sanjana confessing her love to him.

1.name: Sanjana Steals Kashmira's Shoes!
1.overview: Kashmira accuses Sajan of stealing her sari. Later, Sanjana steals Kashmira's golden shoes!

1.name: Sajan Ke Paas Itne Paise?
1.overview: The family refuses to believe Sanjana has a sleepwalking disorder. Sanjana comes to Sajan's house with a sack full of money. Does that mean fresh trouble for Sajan?

1.name: Sajan To Marry Sanjana?
1.overview: Sajan decides to separate from Kashmira when he learns that Sanjana will only marry a divorcee. Later, he goes on a date with Sanjana. Will the two finally hit it off?

1.name: Sajan Still Loves Kashmira?
1.overview: Sajan plans to divorce Kashmira but keeps talking about her on his date with Sanjana! What will Sanjana do next?Meanwhile, Kashmira tries to commit suicide.

1.name: Sajan Ban Gaya Bawarchi
1.overview: Sanjana takes Sajan’s help when her cook goes on leave. On Khiloni’s advice, Sajan disguises himself as Durjan, his twin brother!

1.name: Phir Phas Gaya Sajan
1.overview: Sajan goes to Sanjana's house as Durjan and plans to leave before Kashmira arrives. But Kashmira, along with her mother and brother arrive before time. Is this the end of Sajan's double role?

1.name: Sanjana To Marry Durjan?
1.overview: Sanjana decides to marry Durjan and goes to Kashmira's house to fix their engagement. Sajan forgets to take along his phone. Will this land him in trouble?

1.name: Sajan Ki Ho Gayi Maut?
1.overview: Planning to teach Sajan a lesson, Sanjana takes help from his family and pretends that Sajan is dead. A bewildered Sajan starts believing that he had in fact died! Will he come to know about the plan?

1.name: Kashmira Banegi Dulhania!
1.overview: Unaware of Sanjana's prank, Sajan gets depressed as she convinces Kashmira to get married again. Seeing Kashmira happy, Sajan goes mad. How will he react when he learns the truth?

1.name: Sanjana Ya Kashmira?
1.overview: Sajan daydreams about Sanjana, while Kashmira tells Sajan to give a fresh start to their relationship. Whom will Sajan select?

1.name: Sajan Ki Yaadgaar Date!
1.overview: Kashmira tricks Sajan to reveal his secret plans of dating Sanjana. Later, Sajan goes on a date with Sanjana! Will everything go smooth?

1.name: Meet Sajan's Bobby Uncle!
1.overview: Sajan lies to Kashmira when she accuses him of deceiving her. Later, Bobby Uncle is eager to meet Sajan's well-educated wife. What will Sajan do now?

1.name: Bobby Uncle Ne Di Sajan Ko Tension
1.overview: Sajan and Sanjana act like a couple and wait for Bobby uncle to leave. However, Bobby uncle decides to stay overnight. How long can they continue with their act?

1.name: Athithi Tum Kab Jaoge?
1.overview: On Sajan's insistence, Sanjana visits his house to meet Bobby uncle in the night. Later, Bobby uncle scolds Sajan and Kashmira on seeing them together.

1.name: Madam Aur Sajan Honeymoon Pe?

1.overview: Avinash's relentless interrogation of Bhati ends tragically, with Bhati dying in custody.  Avinash now faces the consequences of his actions.

1.name: Avinash encounters Rafiq
1.overview: Avinash Mishra tracks down Rafiq Khazi at a wedding. Can he and his team capture him and uncover the truth?

1.name: A huge responsibility for Avinash
1.overview: Inspector Avinash fights to lower crime, but a wealthy businessman's son is kidnapped. Can he catch the culprits before it's too late?

1.name: Avinash gets ambushed
1.overview: Avinash and his team close in on a gang's hideout. But the criminals spot them, leading to a deadly shootout. Will Avinash prevail?

1.name: Avinash receives a tip
1.overview: Avinash tracks Bablu Pandey, only to learn from Pinky that Azimuddin Gulam Sheikh orchestrated the child's shooting. Will Avinash believe Pinky?

1.name: Avinash warns Devi
1.overview: Avinash confronts Devi at the police station, demanding answers about Bhati and Bablu. He threatens to expose her. Will Devi crack under pressure?

2.name: Shadyantra
2.overview: Crucial intel about Devi leads Avinash to Nepal. Chaos erupts in Varun's school when a boy is found dead. Meanwhile, Sheikh saves an actress from trouble, who ends up meeting Veer.

2.name: Vyavastha
2.overview: Nandlal shakes up the Special Task Force with strict discipline. Varun's name surfaces in his school's case, fuelling conflict. New alliances begin to form in the shadows.

2.name: Lakshman Rekha
2.overview: Avinash's work affects his home life when Poonam has a traumatic experience. Meanwhile, Avinash finds out about Gujjar, Devi, Sheikh, their new ally, and their big plan.

2.name: Asura Bhaag I
2.overview: Avinash leads his team into Chambal's dangerous ravines chasing the elusive Abhay Gujjar. Meanwhile, Suman finds a clue at a medical college that may solve a long-standing mystery.

2.name: Asura Bhaag II
2.overview: Kabir sets the stage for Avinash to invade Gujjar's lair in the Badlands. Realising that the deal with Sheikh won't be fulfilled, the Naxal troop tries to intimidate him.

2.name: Vishwasghaat
2.overview: Baljeet and Suman's divorce shocks all, and a courtroom clash sparks humiliation. Avinash cracks his son Varun's case. A wedding celebration turns tense with unexpected trouble.

2.name: Maharathi
2.overview: Amidst allegations of corruption, Laxmikant takes an extreme step. Suman makes a shocking discovery about the lab assistant Sharda Awasthi, and she calls Baljeet for help.

2.name: Yudh Viram
2.overview: Investigation on Sharda answers a lot of unsolved mysteries and sheds light on Sheikh's past. Meanwhile, Sheikh sends Imran to kill Avinash.

2.name: Takhta Palat
2.overview: The suspended STF team decides to fight back and go after Mahaveer. Ahalawat proves his worth and gives Gaya Prasad a fighting chance in court.

2.name: Mahabharat
2.overview: A crucial witness jeopardises the STF team's case, but a new friend welcomes Avinash. Devi cleans house to safeguard Sheikh, but another battle awaits the supercop.

1.name: Khali Bus Ka Suhana Safar
1.overview: Rajaram is a struggling writer, branded as boring and humiliated by publishers when they tell him that he will never find any readers. A disheartened Rajaram talks to his best friend and decides to write about sexual fantasies common people have which leads to his first hit story. With this success, the pseudonym Mastram is born.

1.name: Master Ji Ka Danda
1.overview: After Rajaram becomes a hit author under the pseudonym Mastram and starts earning good money, his uncle advises him to think about his personal life and meet a girl for marriage. Meanwhile, Rajaram talks to Gopal and finds another inspiration from a person from his school days, giving birth to another spicy and saucy story for his next book.

1.name: Mallu Aunty Ka Malmal
1.overview: Facing writer’s block and unable to find inspiration for his next book, Rajaram’s new neighbors, a Malayali couple, enter his life and the unsatisfied wife becomes the inspiration for his new book.

1.name: Baniye Ka Lollypop
1.overview: Rajaram and Madhu have their first date. At the same time, Rajaram's observations draw inspiration for his next steamy story.

1.name: Bua Ke 56 Aasan
1.overview: Rajaram meets Madhu’s widowed aunt, who is incidentally quite young. Will this meeting with a new person result in further cementation of the relationship between Rajaram and Madhu? Or will this result in new inspiration for Mastram’s new story?

1.name: Vaibhav Ki Didi
1.overview: Heading to Delhi for the wedding shopping. Rajaram, his uncle and Gopal check into a shady hotel and it's not long before Rajaram's uncle runs into trouble with the police. Rajaram rushes to the station to find that the inspector is none other than his school friend’s elder sister, resulting in a resurfacing of past memories and teenage fantasies.

1.name: Abhineteri Ka Nirman
1.overview: To find peace and solace to write his next story, Rajaram decides to go to Chamba for a while to focus. On arrival, Rajaram learns that the actress Indurekha is shooting there. Thanks to a white lie, Rajaram makes his way into the actress’s dressing room. In order to impress her, Rajaram creates a new story on the concept of the casting couch.

1.name: Madhu Ki Do Saheliyan
1.overview: Madhu begins to doubt Rajaram, so she turns to her two friends to help her test Rajaram’s loyalty. The girls invite him over for an offer that is too difficult to say no to. Will Rajaram take the offer, or will he pass Madhu’s test?

1.name: Sonu Ka Joban
1.overview: As turbulence hits his personal life, Rajaram decides to pen a letter to Madhu, calling it quits and breaking off the marriage.

1.name: Mastram Se Rajaram
1.overview: Rajaram is travelling to Mumbai in a train. Things turn wild when sparks fly between the train conductor and Rajaram. What follows is a passionate moment between the two. However, little does Rajaram know that Madhu is also onboard the same train.

1.name: He's back
1.overview: While burying scandals for cricketers and starlets, Rana Naidu contends with his father’s sudden release from jail. An illicit encounter irks Naina.

1.name: Teen karod
1.overview: Naga tries to bond with his family. Rana handles Prince’s latest problem, while a tentative friendship forms between Nitya and her neighbor, Rehaan.

1.name: Koi mar gaya kya?
1.overview: A car accident leaves OB — and his condition — in a vulnerable position. An unexpected meeting leads Naga to the chilling truth about his son.

1.name: Baap bete ke rishte
1.overview: With a plan and agenda of his own, Naga seeks to coax a confession out of Prince. Rana’s deal with Rehaan’s mother suffers a devastating setback.

1.name: Kitna gurda, kitna goo
1.overview: Trailed by a dogged cop, Rana takes matters into his own hands. Jaffa is drawn into the darkness when a party at his apartment spirals out of control.

1.name: Bheje ku light, gote ku tight
1.overview: Mining his past for a blockbuster film, Prince is forced to recall a harrowing night. Rana returns to Hyderabad in search of a notorious figure.

1.name: Nitya
1.overview: Memories of their late sister on her birthday bring the brothers together. A rebellious Nitya seeks out Rehaan in his childhood home.

1.name: Tu kya kiya?
1.overview: After asking Prince to accompany Ani to a glamorous award ceremony, Rana’s well-laid plans take a dark turn as Surya finally confronts Naga.

1.name: Maharaj
1.overview: Scrambling to keep Jaffa out of trouble, Tej and Rana begin to clash. Confined to a hotel room, Naina’s suspicions reach a boiling point.

1.name: Game over g*ndu
1.overview: As news of Surya’s presence in Mumbai spreads, Rana faces pressure to help him escape. Bullets fly in a bloody confrontation where no one is safe.

2.name: One Last Job
2.overview: Rana faces a deadly mission to rescue his kidnapped son and must — reluctantly — team up with his estranged father while relying on a wealthy benefactor.

2.name: Bada Kutta
2.overview: As an enraged Rana confronts underworld kingpin Rauf in prison, a dissatisfied Naina confides in her new friend, Naveen.

2.name: Well Played, Mr Naidu
2.overview: In a tense game of blackmail and manipulation, Rauf pushes Rana to his limit. Family tensions come to a head during Ani's birthday party.

2.name: Kacchaa Limbu Saalaa
2.overview: Naga and Tej plan a heist at Oberoi Studios to retrieve a valuable item. Naina gets closer to Naveen, putting more strain on an already stressed Rana.

2.name: It Will Never Be Okay
2.overview: After Tej is brutally beaten in prison, Rana knows he must get him out quickly — all while protecting Nitya, who's caught in a deadly shootout.

2.name: Double Dholki
2.overview: Deep in Viraj Oberoi's debt, Rana has to clean up after a grisly murder. Meanwhile, Anjali manipulates Naga into taking on a suicidal mission.

2.name: Sumdi Mein Lomdi
2.overview: Naveen sees an opportunity to put Rana behind bars. Jaffa and Tasneem's wedding celebrations bring the entire family together — for a fateful event.

2.name: One Last Job, Again
2.overview: After a brutal attack puts some of his family in the hospital, Rana finally goes on the offensive against Rauf and his team.

1.name: K.O.
1.overview: Brothers Dev and Ravi return to Shaktigarh to hunt for the perpetrator of a brutal attack, while facing their callous father after years apart.

1.name: Counterpunch
1.overview: The brothers join forces in their search for vengeance. After returning to the scene of the crime, they stumble upon key evidence.

1.name: Sparring Partner
1.overview: A suspect's death leads to questions as Dev confronts Joyna. Raka seeks support elsewhere, while the rival boxing clubs prepare for an emergency trial.

1.name: Rope-a-Dope
1.overview: Ravi begins his training — and uses a surprise inspection to coerce a confession. Kookie toys with life and death, unleashing his wrath on Dev.

1.name: Low Blow
1.overview: Dev and Ravi's infiltration into a dangerous hideout turns explosive. A violent interrogation leads to an unexpected run from the law.

1.name: Underdog
1.overview: After breaking the rules, Ravi pleads his case ahead of the Olympic trials. Dev and Joyna search for clues and Arvind spirals after a shocking find.

1.name: Suckerpunch
1.overview: As the truth emerges, Dev must escape danger at every turn. Ravi claws his way to the final to face an old nemesis, but an attack may threaten his rise.

1.name: Behroopiya
1.overview: An assassination attempt on the Viceroy shakes the foundations of the British Raj. As the Empire unleashes the ruthless Lt. Col. Dyer to hunt down those responsible, Rash Behari Bose races to finish the mission he set in motion. Sachindranath Sanyal struggles against his family's legacy of operating in the shadows, throwing his engagement to Pratibha Lahiri into question.

1.name: Shaagird
1.overview: After a narrow escape, Rash contemplates his next move. Sachin is torn between the promise of love and his dream of fighting on the frontlines of the freedom struggle, facing a choice that could alter the course of his life. Meanwhile, Dyer's relentless investigation for British India's Most Wanted Man leads him to Benaras.

1.name: Ekla Cholo Re
1.overview: Rash and Sachin reunite with Pishima, caretaker of the Revolutionaries' Calcutta safe house. After years underground, the legendary Bagha Jatin returns with an audacious plan: to execute the greatest heist the British Empire has ever seen. DCP Tegart closes in on the elusive revolutionary and, determined not to let Jatin slip away a second time, unwittingly walks into a carefully laid trap.

1.name: Paigaam
1.overview: The Revolutionaries go underground. As Dyer tightens the noose around Rash, an unforeseen obstacle throws his hunt into disarray. In Benaras, 18-year-old rebel Kartar Singh Sarabha joins forces with Pratibha, who takes a bold risk to deliver a message that could alter the rebellion's fate. And when a message from Ghadar leader Lala Hardayal reaches Rash, a dying revolution surges back to life.

1.name: Shabaash!
1.overview: A devastating incident leaves Rash and Jatin confronting the cost of their cause, as Sachin fights for his life. Just as Dyer narrows in on the hiding Revolutionaries, the tide begins to turn, as thousands answer the call of revolution.

1.name: Komagata Maru

Disguised among the crowds, Rash, Kartar, and Pishima arrive to receive the revolutionaries returning home to fight for freedom. But the British are ready for them. As Dyer and Tegart race to unravel the insurgent plot, Rash finds himself trapped at the heart of a conspiracy on the verge of exposure.

1.name: Aur Bhi Aayenge
1.overview: An ally and a mole are both revealed. Pratibha challenges Jatin's perspective on the role of women in the revolution as Pishima holds on against torturous circumstances. The Revolutionaries scatter to execute their plans, leaving themselves dangerously exposed. Meanwhile, Tegart pieces together a single, devastating clue that could bring the entire revolution crashing down.

1.name: Ghadar!
1.overview: Heartbreaking news months before Ghadar day leaves the Revolutionaries reeling and forces Rash to confront the terrible cost of freedom. When all hope seems lost, Pratibha arrives at the training camp with a bold plan that could save the rebellion. But as the dream of revolution is reborn, the mole finally plays his cards, threatening to bring the entire movement crashing down.

Bhopa sacks I.G Chauhan due to his incompetence - Bhopa finds the perfect solution to control Ujag

3.name: Kaam Vatika
3.overview: After losing his girlfriend Natasha and the water-tight case of the Dahiyas, a devastated Ujagar goes to visit his family. This visit opens a new door for Ujagar and he joins the Intelligence Bureau (IB). Pammi accuses Babita of selling herself to Baba Nirala. Hukum Singh’s special friend Sonia Hirawat, a big shot Image maker from London, arrives to help Hukum create a new Image for the Pradesh, but soon she learns who the real King is! Sonia decides to make the most of this opportunity for hers

3.name: Swarg Lok
3.overview: Baba’s vision of creating his own ‘Swarg Lok’ starts turning into a reality as Sonia executes a grand event where Baba takes avatar as BHAGWAN NIRALA. A new threat for Aashram rises from the Jungle of Karara as Ex-C.M Sunderlal manages to provoke the naxals who are against the encroachment of their forest land. As Bhagwan’s popularity spreads across the globe, Pammi gets more restless and decides to kill Baba. This reckless act of Pammi once again puts her and Akki’s life in Danger.

3.name: Halahal
3.overview: Bhopa offers Tinka a seat in Hukum Singh’s Cabinet. Baba turns down Banno’s demand of making their underage son a minister. Unwilling to give up, Banno approaches Hukum Singh, who makes her a better offer! Meanwhile Pammi and Akki who have taken shelter in a Basti, start posting letters to various Government authorities in order to seek justice. In the drugs investigation against Aashram, Ujagar and his boss Avinash Dubey are able to crack a link. After arresting the big broker Harry Ahuja, they

3.name: Kuchakra
3.overview: Ujagar’s investigation once again comes to a dead end after Tinka and Rocky are transferred to Judicial custody on the orders of the court. Bhopa gets the letters traced and raids the Basti to catch Pammi and Akki. In a rescue operation set up by Ujagar, Pammi and Akki safely escape to Delhi border. Pammi and Akki take shelter in outskirts of Delhi and with the help of Akki’s friend, Ravindra Rawat, they approach various News Channels to break Pammi’s story to the world.

3.name: Shankh Naad
3.overview: Trouble rises for Bhagwan Nirala as Akki manages to hack a popular TV Channel and Pammi’s video spreads like fire. Sonia immediately springs into action to do the damage control. District Judge Rastogi, who also saw Pammi’s video, takes cognizance of the matter and Bhagwan is summoned to appear in Court. Sunderlal grabs this opportunity and announces his support for Pammi. On the other hand pressure mounts on Hukum to get the district Judge transferred.

3.name: Mahabhiyog
3.overview: Sunderlal makes a deal with Baba which causes trouble for Hukum Singh as his Cabinet protests in ‘No Confidence’ vote . Banno comes to the rescue of Hukum and unfurls the past of Baba and Bhopa. She hands him the original FIR copies of cases on Monty Singh and Bhopa. Sunderlal’s lawyers back-out right before the hearing date but Ujagar manages to get a female activist lawyer Sunita, to fight Pammi’s case in the Court. The trial takes an unexpected turn when Bhagwan claims he is incapable of havi

3.name: Kopa - Bhavan
3.overview: Baba Nirala frames Pammi for murder, ensuring her imprisonment. In isolation, the anger bews inside Pammi and she makes a decision to finally make Baba Nirala pay for all his sins. But in a shocking twist, Baba emerges as her savior, securing her release and welcoming her back into the Aashram. Is this a second chance or another deadly trap? Will Baba Nirala fall into Pammi’s trap and lose his empire?

3.name: Prayashchit
3.overview: Determined to free Pammi, Akki risks everything to infiltrate the heavily guarded Aashram. Meanwhile, an unexpected moment leaves Bhopa questioning his loyalties. Will his growing conflict change the game?

3.name: Prem - Paash
3.overview: As Bhopa gives in to forbidden desires, a secret affair begins to unravel within the Aashram’s walls. Meanwhile, Ujagar stumbles upon a witness whose testimony could finally expose Baba Nirala’s hidden sins. Will the truth finally surface?

3.name: Kaala - Sach
3.overview: Pammi masterfully drives a wedge between Baba Nirala and Bhopa, shaking the very foundation of the Aashram. But just when it seems like she’s winning, she makes a shocking choice—walking straight into Baba Nirala’s clutches. What is she planning?

3.name: Agni - Pareeksha
3.overview: With Ujagar reopening the case, Pammi reignites her battle for justice. But can she take down the all-powerful Baba Nirala, or will she once again fall victim to his ruthless schemes? The ultimate showdown begins!

1.name: Arjun and Saanjh Ki Dosti
1.overview: Beyhadh is a romantic thriller showcasing lives of Maya, Arjun and Saanjh. Arjun and Saanjh are dancing in front of Ganesha idol, while Maya enters the venue and bows down before the deity. Saanjh's parents advise her to marry Arjun. However, Saanjh clears it to them that Arjun is not her boyfriend. Next morning, Saanjh wakes Arjun up from sleep and reminds him of his job interview.

1.name: Arjun Bags A New Job
1.overview: Arjun enters Maya’s office for a job interview. He impresses Maya with his confidence and charm. On the other hand, Saanjh tells her family that she is eagerly waiting to meet Arjun. Maya offers Arjun a job in her company. Later, Arjun’s family congratulate him for getting a new job.

1.name: Maya Fires Arjun From His Job
1.overview: Arjun reaches his office and meets Maya. Arjun informs Saanjh that he has reached a studio for a photoshoot. Maya orders Arjun to look after the male models. Saanjh reaches the venue to meet Arjun. Dev introduces himself to Saanjh. Arjun beats Dev for troubling Saanjh. Maya fires Arjun from his job.

1.name: Arjun Ki Chalaki
1.overview: Arjun tells Saanjh that she need not apologize to Maya. Saanjh’s parents advise her to marry Arjun at the earliest. Saanjh reminds her family that she doesn’t wish to marry Arjun. Next day, Arjun comes to Maya’s office. Will Arjun be able to retain his job?

1.name: Arjun Ka Presentation
1.overview: Maya asks Arjun to give a presentation within two hours. Arjun seeks helps from his colleagues to prepare the presentation. However, they refuse to help Arjun. Saanjh comes to Maya’s office to meet her friend Arjun. After a while, Arjun enters the conference room to give his presentation.

1.name: Maya Terminates Arjun From Work
1.overview: Arjun impresses a client of Maya’s company with his presentation. Saanjh’s boss tells her that they have to meet Maya to discuss about her legal case. Saanjh tells Arjun that she is afraid to meet his boss. Saanjh and colleagues meet Maya in a restaurant. Maya hands Arjun over his termination letter.

1.name: Arjun Steals Maya's Film Passes
1.overview: Maya tells Arjun that he should not have consumed alcohol in her company. She asks Arjun to prepare the client presentation by midnight. Maya's assistant informs Arjun that her boss has received two film passes. Arjun and Saanjh plan to go to the theatre to watch movie. Arjun steals Maya's film passes.

1.name: Maya Punishes Arjun
1.overview: Arjun brings his friends to a theatre to watch movie. Arjun gets shocked to see Maya and her mother entering into the theatre. Saanjh tells Arjun that he should not have stolen Maya’s film passes. Later, Maya decides to lodge a police complaint against Arjun for stealing her film passes.

1.name: Arjun Traps Maya in Elevator
1.overview: Arjun decides to teach Maya a lesson for locking him inside a restroom. Arjun cuts out the main electricity when Maya is inside an elevator of her office. After a while, Arjun opens the door of the elevator and asks Maya to come out of it. When Maya finally comes out of the elevator she collapses in Arjun’s arms.

1.name: Arjun Plans To Celebrate Maya's Birthday
1.overview: Saanjh asks Arjun to apologize to Maya for his past mistakes. She also informs Arjun that she is going to visit Maya’s office in the evening. Arjun enters Maya’s cabin but does not apologize to her. Later, Arjun tells Saanjh that they must go to Maya’s house at midnight to celebrate her birthday.

1.name: Maya Ka Birthday
1.overview: Arjun and Saanjh decide to celebrate Maya's birthday. They bring a cake and enter Maya's apartment. A security guard stops them from meeting Maya. Maya's father intrude into her house. Maya locks herself in a room. Arjun and Saanjh return home. Arjun's mother thanks him and Saanjh for remembering her birthday.

1.name: Arjun Celebrates Maya's Birthday
1.overview: Arjun celebrates his mother's birthday along with his family. Next morning, Maya and her mother go to a temple. Maya's father enters the temple and stands behind her. Two stray dogs attack Maya's father. Arjun informs Saanjh that he is going to celebrate Maya's birthday in the office.

1.name: Arjun Smears Cake On Maya's Face
1.overview: Arjun and his colleagues celebrate Maya's birthday. Arjun applies cake on Maya's face. Maya suddenly walks out of her office. Saanjh advises Arjun to apologize to Maya. Maya comes home and locks herself in a room. Maya's mother requests her to open the door.

1.name: Rashmi Finds Alliance for Saanjh
1.overview: Rashmi tells Saanjh's parents that she has found an alliance for their daughter. Maya's father comes to her house. His wife clears it to him that she would not allow him to meet Maya. Maya's father demands cash from his wife.

1.name: Arjun Climbes Maya's Apartment
1.overview: Arjun climbs into Maya's apartment. Maya's mother gets shocked to see Arjun in Maya's room. Arjun tells Maya that he requires her signatures on office documents. Maya challenges Arjun to climb down from her multi-floored apartment. On the other hand, Saanjh's mother advise her to share her feelings to Arjun.

1.name: Maya Hides Arjun's Secret
1.overview: Saanjh tells her brother that Arjun may not agree to marry her. Arjun comes to Maya's office. Maya's colleagues blame Arjun for stealing confidential information from Maya's computer. He also asks Arjun as to where he was on the earlier night. Arjun refuses to answer and moves out of the office.

1.name: Arjun Catches The Thief
1.overview: Arjun decides to check the CCTV footage of Maya's cabin. Arjun and Maya enter the cabin and switch on the laptop. Later, Arjun calls Saanjh and informs her that he is stuck in the office along with Maya. Next morning, Arjun and Maya decide to catch the person who had stolen confidential information from company's database.

1.name: Ashwin Gives A Gifts To Maya's Mother
1.overview: Maya offers salary hike to Arjun. Later, Arjun's mother saves him from falling off the building roof. On the other hand, Ashwin comes to Maya's house. Maya's mother requests him to not cause any trouble to Maya. Ashwin gives a gift to Maya's mother.

1.name: Maya Slits Her Wrist
1.overview: Maya's mother tells her that her husband Ashwin still loves her a lot. Maya burns the saree gifted by Ashwin. She asks her mother to not befriend Ashwin.
