Saanjh's brother advises her to reveal her feelings to Arjun. Maya notices her mother and Arjun chatting with each other. Later, Maya takes her mother in the car. Maya's mother spots Maya's bleeding wrist.

1.name: Saanjh Meets Jitendra
1.overview: Maya's mother request her to look after her health. Saanjh tells Arjun that she is going to meet Jitendra Kumar in a restaurant. Ashwin comes to Maya's house. He demands five lakh rupees from Maya's mother. However, she refuses to give him the money. Jitendra kumar meets Saanjh and Arjun in the restaurant.

1.name: Arjun Saves Maya From Ashwin's Humiliation
1.overview: Ashwin approaches Maya and demands money from her. Maya requests Ashwin to not cause her any trouble. Arjun stops Ashwin from slapping Maya. He angrily asks Ashwin to stay away from Maya. Maya hurriedly moves out of the restaurant. Next day, Maya allows her staff to leave early from the office.

1.name: Jitendra Refuses To Marry Saanjh
1.overview: Jitendra advises Saanjh to reveal her feeling to Arjun. When Maya gets into her car, Arjun follows her and requests for a lift. Arjun, along with a few school children, enters Maya's car. After a while, the car stops due to traffic jam. Arjun and his small friends get out of the car and play in the rain.

1.name: Maya Returns Arjun's Wallet
1.overview: Arjun tells Saanjh that a goon might have attacked Ayan. Arjun and Saanjh meet Ayan in an old building. Ayan tells them that a girl has looted him. Maya angrily asks her mother as to why she met Arjun. Maya’s mother advises her to befriend Arjun. Maya calls Arjun to her cabin and returns him his wallet.

1.name: Maya Meets Saanjh's Family
1.overview: Arjun gives instructions to a model while doing photoshoot for his company. Saanjh congratulates Suman on the occasion of her wedding anniversary. Arjun tells Maya that he is going to meet Saanjh. Later, Arjun introduces Maya to Saanjh’s family. Maya decides to participate in the wedding anniversary celebration.

1.name: Saanjh Prepares To Propose Arjun
1.overview: Saanjh and her family celebrate her parents’ wedding anniversary. Later, Saanjh’s parents advise her to propose to Arjun for marriage. Maya calls Arjun and asks him to come to her office at the earliest. While giving presentation, Arjun tells his colleagues that he wishes to use Maya as a model for their company’s campaign.

1.name: Arjun Impresses Maya With His Presentation
1.overview: Arjun shows his presentation to Maya and his colleagues. Arjun calls Saanjh and informs her that his boss has liked his presentation. Maya gives a tuxedo to Arjun. Later, she brings Arjun to a fashion event. Maya and Arjun walk in front of media, holding each other’s hands.

1.name: Maya And Arjun Attend The Fashion Event
1.overview: Arjun calls Saanjh and asks her as to why she did not attend the fashion event. Saanjh replies Arjun that the security guard did not allow her to enter the hall. Saanjh requests Arjun to meet her after the event. Next morning, Arjun meets Saanjh on the terrace of her apartment.

1.name: Ashwin Meets Maya In The Shopping Mall
1.overview: Arjun gifts a photo-frame to Maya. Prem advises Saanjh to propose Arjun for marriage. Saanjh promises Prem that she would propose Arjun on the same day. Arjun and Saanjh plan to go for shopping. Maya buys a watch in the shopping mall. Ashwin enters the mall and stands before Maya.

1.name: Arjun Introduces Jhanvi To Saanjh
1.overview: Arjun meets Maya and her mother. He introduces them to Saanjh. Maya’s mother advises her to befriend Arjun. On the other hand, Vandana thanks Arjun for gifting her a saree. Jahnavi meets Ashwin and asks him to stay away from her daughter. She furthers tells Ashwin that she may soon reveal his secret to Maya.

1.name: Maya Refuses To Meet Saanjh
1.overview: Prem tells Suman that Arjun should not have gone into Saanjh's room at the night. He reminds Suman that Saanjh has fallen for Arjun. Next morning, one of Maya's clients meets Arjun and praises him for his photography skills. Saanjh comes to Maya's office. However, Maya refuses to meet Saanjh.

1.name: Arjun Yells At Maya
1.overview: Maya calls Saanjh to her cabin. Saanjh tells Maya that she was waiting for her for last five hours. She further informs Maya that she is a very close friend of Arjun. Maya refuses to accept Saanjh's presentation. Saanjh returns home and meets Arjun. Later, Arjun angrily asks Maya to not cause any harm to Saanjh.

1.name: Saanjh Comes to Maya's House
1.overview: Arjun enters into Maya's room and yells at her for insulting Saanjh. He clears it to Maya that Saanjh is his best friends. He instructs Maya to not hurt Saanjh in the future. Later, Arjun returns home and meets Saanjh. Saanjh thanks Arjun for standing by her. Next day, Saanjh comes to Maya's house.

1.name: Maya Gives A Gift Box To Saanjh
1.overview: Saanj comes to Maya's house. Maya serves food to Saanjh. Arjun's mother tells him that he should not have allowed Saanjh to visit Maya's house. Ashwin meets Jhanvi tells her that he loves her a lot. Saanj tells Maya that she wishes to go back to her house.

1.name: Saanjh Hands Over Maya's Gift To Arjun
1.overview: Saanjh meets Arjun and tells him that Maya has given him a gift. She further tells Arjun that Maya has fallen for him. Next morning, Saanjh tells Vandana that Maya had gifted a watch to Arjun. Vandana tells Saanjh that she should marry Arjun. On the other hand, Arjun reaches the office and meets Maya.

1.name: Arjun Drops Maya To Her House
1.overview: Arjun tells Maya that no one can break his friendship with Saanjh. Ashwin tells Shipra that he had forced Jhanvi to eat sweets. Suman tells Vandana that she will not allow Maya to interfere in Arjun's personal life. Arjun drops Maya to her house. Maya notices her mother lying unconscious in her room. Saanjh's mother welcomes her and Arjun to her house.

1.name: Arjun Rushes To Help Maya
1.overview: Arjun rushes to Maya's house. He learns that Maya's mother has fallen unconscious. He brings Maya's mother to a hospital. On the other hand, Prem tells Saanjh that Arjun doesn't love her. He advises Saanjh to forget Arjun and move on with her life. Saanjh tells her parents that she is going to the hospital to help Arjun.

1.name: Maya's Father Threatens Her In The Hospital
1.overview: A doctor informs Maya that Jhanvi's health is stable. Ashwin comes to the hospital and meets Maya. He tells Maya that he has bought a cadbury for Jhanvi. Suman scolds Prem for misbehaving with Vandana. Maya asks Arjun to stay along with her in the hospital for a night.

1.name: Maya Comes To Arjun's House
1.overview: Maya requests Arjun to accompany her in the hospital. Arjun falls asleep on the sofa. Saanjh makes a call to Arjun but fails to reach him. Maya breaks Arjun's phone into pieces. Next morning, the doctor checks Jhanvi's health and tells Maya that her mother is now stable. Maya comes to Arjun's house to meet him.

1.name: Maya Gifts A Mobile To Arjun
1.overview: Maya comes to Arjun’s house. She gifts a new mobile phone to Arjun. Later, Arjun’s family invites Maya for the breakfast. Saanjh enters the room and meets Maya. Arjun’s mother tells Maya that she treats Saanjh as her family member. Later, Maya calls Arjun to her office.

1.name: Arjun And Saanjh Go To Lonavala
1.overview: Saanjh calls Arjun and tells him that she is planning to go to Daman for picnic. Arjun replies Saanjh that they should rather plan their picnic to Lonavala. Ashwin's girlfriend asks him to bring money from Jhanvi. Saanjh's mother asks her to reveal her feelings to Arjun once she reaches Lonavala.

1.name: Maya Proposes Arjun
1.overview: Maya asks Arjun to meet her at 'tiger point'. Arjun tells Saanjh that soon he is going to give her a surprise. Arjun reaches 'tiger point' to meet Maya. He notices a hot air balloon on the surface. Maya blindfolds Arjun and handcuffs him inside the basket of the balloon. She holds a ring before Arjun. She tells Arjun that she loves him.

1.name: Arjun And Saanjh Fight Over Maya
1.overview: Arjun clears it to Saanjh that he doesn't love Maya. Saanjh asks Arjun to stop working for Maya. Maya returns home and meets her mother. She tells Jhanvi that she loves Arjun a lot. On the other hand, Arjun tells Saanjh that he will not resign from his job.

1.name: Maya Gives Promotion to Arjun
1.overview: Maya tells Arjun that she has promoted him as senior photographer in her company. Saanjh comes to Maya's office and meets Arjun. Maya tells Arjun that she has invited Saanjh to celebrate his promotion. Later, Saanjh tells Arjun that Maya has promoted him not because of his talent but because she loves him.

1.name: Arjun Brings Maya To Roadside Tea Stall
1.overview: Saanjh tells Arjun that Maya has promoted him because she has fallen for him. Arjun yells at Saanjh and asks her to not be jealous of him. Saanjh angrily walks out from the office. On the other hand, Vandana and Suman meets a pandit. Arjun brings Maya to a roadside tea stall. He offers tea to Maya.

1.name: Arjun Brings Ice Cream
1.overview: Saanjh tells Suman that Arjun has gone to meet Maya. Suman advises Saanjh to wait until Arjun realizes her love and comes back into her life. Maya invites Arjun in her house and offers him ice-cream. Next morning, Arjun meets Saanjh and assures her that he would have lunch along with her in the afternoon.

1.name: Maya Gives Expensive Gifts
1.overview: Arjun tells Maya that he is going out for lunch. Arjun's colleagues request him to participate in the office party. Arjun informs Saanjh that he can not join her for the lunch. Vandana makes a call to Saanjh. She asks Saanjh to come home. Saanjh reminds Arjun that Maya is trying to impress him by giving him expensive gifts.

1.name: Police Arrests Arjun's Brother
1.overview: Saanjh tells Arjun that Maya is trying to impress him by offering expensive gifts. Jhanvi tells Maya that she should not have given gifts to Arjun. Arjun comes to Maya's house. He returns the gifts to Maya and clears it to her that she can not influence him by money. Police arrests Ayan for his alleged involvement in drug trade. Arjun comes to police station and request the police to release Ayan from jail.

1.name: Maya Bails Arjun's Brother Out
1.overview: A policeman asks Arjun to bail Ayan out of jail. He ends up slapping Arjun for his misconduct. Maya enters the police station. She brings a lawyer to release Ayan out from jail. Maya learns that the policeman has misbehaved with Arjun. She slaps the policeman for his mistake. Maya assures Ayan that she would help him in times of need.

1.name: Arjun Brings Maya To The Terrace
1.overview: Maya drops Arjun to his house in her car. She requests Arjun to take her to the terrace of his building. Arjun makes a call to his brother. He requests Ayan to not allow Saanjh to meet Maya. Arjun brings Maya to the terrace. Arjun assures Maya that he would treat her as a friend and not the boss.

1.name: Arjun And Maya's Photograph
1.overview: Saanjh notices Maya and Arjun on the terrace of the building. Saanjh breaks down in tears in front of her father. Prem comforts Saanjh and requests her to calm down. Maya hugs Arjun close to her. Ashwin secretly captures Maya and Arjun's photograph in his mobile phone. Next morning, Arjun and Maya learn that their photograph has been published in a newspaper.

1.name: Maya Ka Ateet
1.overview: Arjun clears it to Saanjh that he does not love Maya. Ashwin learns that Arjun and Saanjh are close friends. Arjun makes a call to Maya. He asks Maya as to why she lied to him about her past. Ashwin meets Jhanvi and tells her that he is going to reveal Maya's secret to Arjun.

1.name: Arjun Infuses Maya's Life With Color
1.overview: Maya reaches her office rushes to the basement. Arjun shouts at Maya for keeping her secret from him. Arjun tells Maya that they should renovate the basement of her office. He further advises Maya to forget the bitter past incidences of her life. Later, Arjun also tells Maya that she should infuse her life with new colors.

1.name: Arjun Gifts A Dress To Maya
1.overview: Ayan makes a call to Saanjh. He tells her that Arjun has brought a gift for her. Arjun gifts a new red-colored dress to Maya. He advises Maya to not stuck in the past and to move on with life. Later, Saanjh meets Arjun and asks him to gift her the dress. Arjun informs Ayan that the gift was meant for Maya and not Saanjh.

1.name: Vandana Ka Ateet
1.overview: Arjun tells Ayan that he had given the gift to Maya. Vandana enquires Saanjh about the dress given by Arjun. Saanjh informs Vandana that the gift was meant for Maya. Vandana yells at Arjun for breaking Saanjh's heart. Arjun shouts back at his stepmother and asks her to not interfere in his personal life. Later, Vandana informs Saanjh that Arjun's mother died due to cancer.

1.name: Maya Reveals Her Past To Arjun
1.overview: Maya tells Arjun that her father Ashwin used to torture her when she was a child. She informs Arjun that her childhood memories still haunt her. Arjun returns home and meets Vandana. Vandana informs Arjun that she has decided to move out of the house. Arjun apologizes to Vandana for his past mistakes. He requests Vandana to not leave the house.

1.name: Arjun Brings Maya To His House
1.overview: Saanjh's parents spot Arjun and Maya together on a terrace. Saanjh informs her parents that Arjun has apologized to his mother for his past mistakes. Later, Suman tells Prem that they should reveal Arjun's truth to Saanjh. Arjun brings Maya to his house. Later, Saanjh tells Vandana that Arjun doesn't love her anymore.

1.name: Arjun Beats Ashwin
1.overview: Ashwin comes to Arjun’s house. He meets Vandana and tells her that Maya and Arjun have fallen for each other. Arjun drags Ashwin out of his house and starts beating him. Saanjh requests Arjun to not interfere in Maya’s personal life. Later, Maya asks Arjun to get ready to go to Mauritius the next day. Vandana and Ayan informs Saanjh that Arjun is going to Mauritius.

1.name: Saanjh Spots Arjun And Maya
1.overview: Maya meets Arjun at the at the airport. She tells Arjun that she too would come to Mauritius along with him. Saanjh spots Arjun and Maya together at the airport. She returns home and meets her parents. She tells Vandana that Arjun might have started liking Maya. Arjun and Maya board the aeroplane.

1.name: Arjun And Maya Reach Mauritius
1.overview: Arjun and Maya reach Mauritius. Maya hires a luxurious car and brings Arjun near a beach. Arjun makes a call to Saanjh. However, Saanjh refuses to answer the call. Arjun and his crew go to an islet. Arjun starts taking photographs of the beautiful surroundings. Arjun's colleagues tells him that that they must return to the mainland. However, Arjun prefers to stay on the islet.

1.name: Maya Rescues Arjun
1.overview: Maya learns that Arjun is trapped on an islet. Maya rides a speedboat and heads towards the sea in search of Arjun. Prem asks Saanjh to go to Mauritius. He advises Saanjh to reveal her feelings to Arjun. Maya rescues Arjun from the islet. She scolds Arjun for being careless.

1.name: Arjun Proposes Maya
1.overview: Saanjh comes to Mauritius to meet Arjun. She reaches the hotel and assumes that Arjun has planned a surprise for her. She sits in a boat and rows it out into the sea. Maya wears an oxygen mask and gets into the water. Arjun gives a ring to Maya. Saanjh gets shocked to see Arjun and Maya together into the water.

1.name: Saanjh Gets The Shock Of Her Life
1.overview: Saanjh gets the shock of her life when she spots Arjun and Maya exchanging rings with each other. Later, Maya and Arjun visit a temple. A pujari advises Arjun to not stay along with Maya. He tells Arjun that he may lose his family if he marries Maya.

1.name: Saanjh Meets Arjun In Mauritius
1.overview: Saanjh meets Arjun and Maya in the resort. Arjun thanks Saanjh for coming all the way to Mauritius. Saanjh notices that one of Maya's earrings is missing. Next day, Saanjh visits a temple. She finds Maya's earring in front of the temple. Saanjh tells Arjun that the pujari has passed away.

1.name: Arjun Brings Maya
1.overview: Arjun, Maya and Saanjh board a plane to India. Saanjh returns home and meets her parents. She informs them that Arjun doesn’t love her. On the other hand, Arjun requests Maya to meet his mother. Later, he brings Maya to his house. Vandana gets shocked to see Maya along with Arjun.

1.name: Arjun Stops Ashwin
1.overview: Vandana comes to Saanjh's house. She comforts Saanjh and requests her to calm down. Maya brings Arjun to her house. Jhanvi informs Maya that she has decided to stay along with Ashwin. Ashwin brings a cake for his family. Maya smashes the cake on Ashwin's face. Arjun asks Ashwin to get out from the house.

1.name: Maya Stops Jhanvi
1.overview: Maya angrily asks Ashwin to get out from her house. Prem asks Vandana to not interfere in Saanjh's life. Vandana clears it to Prem that she will not end her relationship with Saanjh come what may. Maya stops her mother from moving out of her house. Arjun returns home and meets his mother.

1.name: Ashwin Throws Jhanvi Off A Bridge
1.overview: Jhanvi and Ashwin come to a bridge over a river. Ashwin throws Jhanvi off the bridge. Maya jumps in the water to save her mother. As soon as Arjun reaches the scene, Ashwin informs him that Maya has fallen off the bridge. Ashwin rescues Maya and Jhanvi from the water. Arjun and Ashwin admit Maya to a hospital.

1.name: Saanjh Decides To Walk Away
1.overview: A doctor tells Arjun that Maya is out of danger and her health is stable. Ashwin secretly enters Maya's hospital room. He tries to suffocate Maya with a pillow. Maya shouts at Ashwin and calls Arjun to her room. Saanjh returns home and meets her parents. She tells them that she must walk away from Arjun's life.

1.name: Saanjh Moves Out Of Her House
1.overview: Arjun informs Maya that Ashwin has saved her life. Saanjh's brother requests her to not go to abroad. Maya wakes up and finds Arjun sleeping beside her. The doctor tells Arjun that he has decided to discharge Maya from the hospital. Vandana requests Saanjh to not walk away from Arjun's life.

1.name: Arjun Stops Saanjh
1.overview: Arjun learns that Saanjh is going to Singapore. He rushes towards the airport to meet Saanjh. A doctor tells Maya that he has decided to discharge her from the hospital. On the other hand, Prem requests Arjun to not interfere in Saanjh's life. Saanjh tells Arjun that she loves him a lot.

1.name: Maya Invites Saanjh For A Party
1.overview: Arjun tells Maya that Saanjh loves him a lot. Maya replies Arjun that she is already aware about Saanjh's infatuation towards him. Prem tells Saanjh that she should not have returned home. Maya invites Vandana and Saanjh to her house for a party. Maya informs the media that she was abused by her father in her childhood.

1.name: Arjun Proposes Maya For Marriage
1.overview: The media ask Ashwin as to why he abused his family in the past. Maya clears it to the media that she has decided to forgive Ashwin for his past mistakes. Later, Maya tells Arjun that her father may ill-treat her in the future. Arjun proposes Maya for marriage in front of media.

1.name: Saanjh's Boss Fires Her
1.overview: Maya tells Ashwin that he would not be able to torture her in the future. On the other hand, Saanjh tells her parents that she is going to forget her bitter past and move forward in her life. Saanjh's learns that her boss has fired her from his law firm.

1.name: Saanjh Accepts Maya's Job Offer
1.overview: Saanjh receives an email from an unknown person who advises her to accept the job offered by Maya. Vandana comes to Jhanvi's house. She tells Jhanvi that she wishes to match Arjun and Maya's natal charts. Maya tells Arjun that her parents must not share their natal charts with the astrologer.

1.name: Maya Asks Arjun For A Secret Promise
1.overview: Astrologer tells Vandana that Arjun and Maya's natal charts are matching well. He further tells Arjun and Maya that they can marry each other. Later, Arjun informs Maya that he had bribed the astrologer to foretell a match in their charts. Ashwin prepares lunch and serves it to his family. Maya forces Ashwin to taste the food prepared by him. Maya asks Arjun for a promise that he would not let anyone else enter in their relationship.

1.name: Maya's Mother Claims Shares
1.overview: Maya meets Arjun and tells him that Jhanvi has gone missing from the house. Later, Maya and Arjun find Jhanvi in the office. Jhanvi claims her shares in Maya's company. Maya tells her parents that she has decided to resign from her post. Maya informs her staff that she has promoted Arjun as the Managing Director of the company. Saanjh finds out that Maya's medical insurance was rejected several times by the insurer.

1.name: Saanjh Finds Out Maya's Secret
1.overview: Sanchi gets a mail from an anonymous person asking her to stop Maya and Arjun's proposed wedding. Saanjh finds out that Maya is suffering from depression and mental illness. She decides to inform the truth to Arjun. Later, Maya clears it to Arjun that she is determined to marry him.

1.name: Saanjh Reveals Maya's Secret
1.overview: Saanjh plans to find out Maya's background. She learns that Maya had tried to commit suicide in the past. Saanjh meets Arjun and tells him that Maya is suffering from depression. She also informs Arjun that Maya was once suspended from her school. Jhanvi tells Arjun that she herself is suffering from mental illness.

1.name: Saanjh Refuses To Attend Arjun's Wedding
1.overview: Jhanvi tells Saanjh that her daughter Maya is not suffering from depression. Vandana comes to Prem's house. She invites Prem and his family to Arjun's wedding. Arjun scolds Saanjh for giving mental stress to Maya. Saanjh clears it to her parents that she will not attend Arjun's 'haldi' ceremony. Maya slap Ashwin for misbehaving with her.

1.name: Maya Slaps Ashwin
1.overview: Maya slaps Ashwin for misbehaving with her. She instructs Ashwin to not interfere in her personal life. Maya meets Jhanvi and tells her that Ashwin would not trouble her in the future. Jhanvi replies Maya that Ashwin may reveal her past to Arjun. Saanjh tells her mother that she does not wish to attend Arjun's wedding.

1.name: Jhanvi Cancels Maya's Haldi Ceremony
1.overview: Vandana and her relatives gather for Arjun's 'haldi' ceremony. Ashwin comes to Maya's house. Maya stops Ashwin from applying turmeric on her face. Maya locks herself in her room. Jhanvi cancels the 'haldi' ceremony. Ashwin tells Jhanvi that he wants his shares in Maya's company. Arjun comes to Jhanvi's house to meet Maya. He comforts Maya and requests her to calm down.

1.name: Ashwin Plans To Stop Maya's Wedding
1.overview: Ashwin meets Saanjh and tells her that Arjun should not marry Maya. He further tells Saanjh that he can help her reunite with Arjun. Saanjh angrily asks Ashwin to not interfere in her personal life. On the other hand, Maya's family get ready for her 'mehendi' ceremony. Jhanvi instructs the security guards to not allow Ashwin to enter the hall.

1.name: Ashwin Fires A Bullet
1.overview: Arjun and Maya's families gather for the Mehendi ceremony. Ashwin, on the other hand, fixes silencer to his gun and points it at Maya. Jhanvi spots Ashwin in the adjacent apartment. She pushes Maya forward and saves her from getting hurt by the bullet. Vandana learns that Arjun had bribed her astrologer to lie to her about Maya's natal chart.

1.name: Maya Tattooes Her Name On Arjun
1.overview: Arjun intrudes into Maya's house. An astrologer informs Vandana that Maya can go to any extent to marry Arjun. On the other hand, Arjun spots his name tattooed on Maya's hand. Later, Maya tattooes her name on Arjun's chest. Arjun returns home and meets his mother. Vandana gets shocked to see Maya's name tattooed on Arjun's chest.

1.name: Arjun's Bachelor's Party
1.overview: Vandana requests Saanjh to stop Arjun and Maya's wedding. Ayan and his friends arrange bachelor's party for Arjun. Ayan forces Arjun to drink alcohol. Arjun advises Ayan to lure and marry a rich girl, the way he has attracted Maya. Ayan asks Arjun if he really loves Maya.

1.name: Arjun Promises Maya
1.overview: Arjun meets Maya in front of a small temple. He promises Maya to that he would fulfil all her wishes. Ashwin plans to ruin Maya's wedding. Jhanvi vows to prevent Ashwin from causing any harm to Maya. Later, Arjun informs Vandana that Maya has demanded seven promises from him. Saanjh decides to participate in Arjun’s wedding.

1.name: Vandana Asks Saanjh To Stop Arjun's Wedding
1.overview: Arjun’s family participate in his wedding procession as they walk towards the wedding venue. Ashwin kidnaps Vandana and tells her that his daughter Maya is mentally ill. He requests Vandana to not allow Arjun to marry Maya. Later, Vandana calls Saanjh and asks her to stop Arjun and Maya’s wedding.

1.name: Vandana Stops Arjun's Wedding Ceremony
1.overview: Vandana plans to stop Arjun and Maya’s wedding. She intrudes into their wedding ceremony and asks Arjun to not marry Maya at any cost. She further tells Arjun that Maya is mentally ill. Arjun clears it to his mother that he is determined to marry Maya. Jhanvi comes to Ashwin’s house and points a gun at him.

1.name: Maya Gets Married To Arjun
1.overview: Asha tells Sonakshi that she should get married in the near future. Dev gets shocked to see Sonakshi and her daughter Suhana in the school. He meets Sonakshi and asks her to stop following him. Sonakshi’s friend Jatin meets her in her office. Dev and his colleagues plan to organize a party in their office.

1.name: Police Interrogate Arjun
1.overview: The police come to Arjun’s wedding hall. They interrogate Arjun about Ashwin’s death. A policeman reminds Arjun that he was not on good terms with Ashwin. The police bring Arjun to the police station for further probing. Arjun clears it to the police that he has not killed Ashwin. Saanjh shows Ashwin’s post-mortem report to the police. She tells the police that Ashwin has died due to heart attack.

1.name: Maya Refuses To Marry Arjun
1.overview: Maya tells Arjun that she does not wish to put his life in risk. She further tells Arjun that she will not marry him. Arjun clears it to Maya that he is determined to marry her. Arjun and his family come to Maya’s house for Ashwin’s ‘chautha’. A police tells his constable that Ashwin has died under mysterious circumstances.

1.name: Arjun Brings Maya To His House
1.overview: Maya's mother asks Maya to stay along with Arjun in his house. Vandana tells Saanjh that Arjun should not have married Maya at any cost. Vandana tells Ayan that Maya comes from a dysfunctional family. Arjun yells at his mother for disrespecting Maya. Arjun brings Maya to his house.

1.name: Maya Apologizes To Vandana
1.overview: Saanjh and Ayan welcome Maya to Arjun's house. Maya pushes a bowl of rice with one of her feet and enters the house. A small piece of glass hurts Maya's leg. Arjun brings Maya to his room. Later, Maya meets Vandana and tells her she wishes to win her heart.

1.name: Janhavi Spots Ashwin In Her House
1.overview: Janhavi calls Maya and tells her that Ashwin has returned home. Maya and Arjun rush to Janhavi's house. Baffled Janhavi tells Maya that she has not seen Ashwin in her bungalow. A doctor tells Arjun that Maya's mother is shocked due to Ashwin's sudden death. Vandana tells Saanjh that she is concerned for Arjun's future.

1.name: Saanjh Gifts Honeymoon Tickets To Arjun and Maya
1.overview: Arjun and Maya come to Vandana's house. Saanjh gifts honeymoon tickets to the newly married couple. Vandana tells Saanjh that she should not have forced Arjun and Maya to go abroad for honeymoon. Arjun and Maya get ready to go to Switzerland for their honeymoon. A policeman comes to Janhavi's house. He tells Arjun and Maya that they can not leave the city until the investigation of Ashwin's death is completed.

1.name: Police Arrest Arjun, Maya and Janhavi
1.overview: A policeman informs Saanjh that Ashwin has been murdered. He presents Ashwin's post-mortem report to Saanjh. The police arrest Arjun, Maya and Janhavi and bring them to the police station. The police interrogate them separately and force them to confess the crime. Arjun learns that Ashwin was murdered by injecting an injection in his body.

1.name: Vandana Blames Maya For Ashwin's Murder
1.overview: A policeman tells Arjun that he would soon find out Ashwin's murderer. Saanjh requests Vandana to not interfere in Arjun and Maya's marriage. Vandana informs Saanjh that she had asked the police to reinvestigate the case of Ashwin's murder. Maya learns that Vandana suspects her to be Ashwin's murderer.

1.name: The Police Blame Janhavi For Ashwin's Death
1.overview: Vandana angrily throws one of Maya's dresses on the floor. She refuses to put the dress in the washing machine. Arjun tells Maya that Janhavi has killed Ashwin. Arjun and Maya come to a police station to meet Janhavi. The police informs them that they have found Janhavi's gun in Ashwin's house.

1.name: Janhavi Decides To Commit Suicide
1.overview: Maya requests the police to not put Janhavi behind bars. Saanjh informs the police that they can not arrest Janhavi in the evening. The police allow Janhavi to go back to her house. Janhavi pushes Maya out of her car and moves towards her house. Janhavi plans to commit suicide.

1.name: Arjun and Maya Stop Janhavi From Committing Suicide
1.overview: Janhavi tells Arjun that she has spotted Ashwin in her house. Arjun and Maya remind Janhavi that Ashwin is not alive. A doctor tells Arjun that Janhavi is mentally unstable and needs counselling. Saanjh tells her brother that she loves Arjun. The doctor explains Arjun a method to treat Janhavi.

1.name: Police Come To Maya's House To Arrest Janhavi
1.overview: Arjun tells Saanjh that Janhavi might have killed Ashwin. He requests Saanjh to save Janhavi from police inquiry. The police come to Maya's house to arrest Janhavi. Saanjh clears it to the police that they can not arrest Maya's mother. She presents Janhavi's anticipatory bail letter to the police. Later, Saanjh interrogates Maya about Janhavi's involvement in Ashwin's murder.

1.name: Vandana Slaps Maya For Ruining Arjun's Life
1.overview: Vandana meets Maya in a temple. She slaps Maya and angrily asks her to not cause any harm to her son. Arjun invites one of his friends to Janhavi's house. He tells Janhavi that he can contact Ashwin's spirit with the help of 'Ouija Board'. Later, Janhavi calls Maya and asks her to come to their godown. She tells Maya that she knows the name of Ashwin's murderer.

1.name: Janhavi Calls Maya To Godown
1.overview: Janhavi calls Maya and asks her to come to their godown. She informs Maya that she knows Ashwin's murderer. Arjun, Maya and Saanjh rush to the godown. A policeman comes to Saanjh's house and meets her father. Arjun and Maya fail to search Janhavi in the godown. Saanjh tells Arjun that they should file Janhavi's missing complaint in a police station.

1.name: Police Handcuff Arjun For Ashwin's Murder
1.overview: Arjun and Maya come to a police station to lodge Janhavi's missing complaint. A police inspector blames Arjun for Ashwin's murder. Ayan informs Vandana that the police will soon arrest Arjun for killing Ashwin. Vandana comes to the police station and yellls at Maya for ruining Arjun's life. Maya tells the police that she had killed Ashwin.

1.name: Janhavi Slips Into A State Of Coma
1.overview: Maya asks police to not arrest Arjun. The police inform Maya that Janhavi has tried to commit suicide. Maya assumes that Janhavi has murdered Ashwin. Maya and Arjun rush to a hospital to see Janhavi. A doctor tells Maya that her mother is in a coma and may not regain consciousness.

1.name: Maya Returns Her Golden Chain To Vandana
1.overview: Maya instructs her servants to look after her ailing mother. Arjun and Maya come to Vandana's house. Arjun calls Maya on the terrace of the house. Maya returns a golden chain to Vandana. She clears it to Vandana that she will continue to stay along with Arjun in the future.

1.name: Arjun Plans To Bring Janahvi To His House
1.overview: Maya comes to Janhavi's house. She punishes a nurse for not looking after her mother. Arjun tells Maya that they should take Janhavi to his house. Arjun and Maya come to Vandana's house. Vandana clears it to Arjun that she will not allow him to bring Janhavi to her house at any cost.

1.name: Arjun And Maya Move Out Of Janhavi's House
1.overview: Arjun tells Vadana that he does not wish to stay along with her. Saanjh requests Arjun to not walk out of Vandana's house. Arjun and Maya come to Janhavi's house. Arjun tells Maya that he always wanted to stay in a big mansion like hers. Ayan tells Vandana that she should not have allowed Arjun to leave her house.

1.name: Vandana Refuses To Forgive Maya
1.overview: Saanjh tells Arjun that she has decided to resign from Maya's company. Vikram praise Arjun for his progress in the company. Maya requests Saanjh to not leave her organization. Maya and Saanjh come to Vandana's house. Maya apologizes to Vandana for her past mistakes. Vandana clears it to Maya that she will not forgive her at any cost.

1.name: Arjun Admits Maya To Hospital
1.overview: Arjun tells Ayan that he is not going to stay in Vandana's house in the future. Maya falls unconscious in front of Vandana's house. Arjun and Saanjh admit Maya to a hospital. A doctor informs Arjun that Maya is pregnant. Later. Saanjh excitedly informs the news to Vandana.

1.name: Arjun Secretly Meets Saanjh
1.overview: Ayan meets with a minor accident. Later, Ayan tells Saanjh that Arjun should not have misbehaved with Vandana. Arjun offers alcoholic beverage to Maya. However, Maya refuses to drink it. Arjun secretly meets Saanjh in a restaurant. He consumes alcohol despite Saanjh's pleading to him to refrain from the drink.

1.name: Maya Disallows Vandana From Meeting Her Son
1.overview: Maya gets upset to see Arjun drunk. Arjun tells Saanjh that he loves her a lot. Arjun returns home and meets Maya. Maya tells Arjun that he should not have broken her trust. Arjun apologizes to Maya for drinking alcohol. Next day, Vandana and Ayan comes to Maya's house. Maya tells them that Arjun doesn't wish to meet them.

1.name: Arjun Saves Saanjh From Fire
1.overview: Maya greets Arjun as he enters her house. Vandana requests Ayan to meet Arjun on the day of 'Holi'. Arjun gets shocked to learn that many of his employees are resigning from his company. On the eve of Holi, Vandana and her family gather to celebrate Holika. Saanjh's dress catches fire as she stands near a bonfire. Arjun saves Saanjh from the fire.

1.name: Arjun Plays Holi With Saanjh
1.overview: Arjun and his friends gather to celebrate Holi. Saanjh applies color on Arjun's face. Maya gets upset seeing Arjun and Saanjh playing holi with each other. Maya tells Suman that Saanjh's friendship with Arjun may not go down well with their friends. Suman brings Saanjh back to her house.

1.name: Maya Loses Her Child
1.overview: Saanjh angrily asks Maya to not ruin her friendship with Arjun. Saanjh plans to reveal Maya's secret to Arjun. Maya falls on her stomach as soon as Saanjh holds one of her hands. Arjun rushes towards Maya but soon he learns that Maya has lost her baby. Arjun breaks his friendship with Saanjh.

1.name: Maya And Arjun's Love Turns Into Revenge
1.overview: After three years of unusual married life, Arjun and Maya's relationship has turned toxic. Maya panics when she finds Arjun missing from his room. She soon learns that Arjun wishes to give her a surprise. Saanjh meets Ayan in an airport. Ayan informs Saanjh that he is planning to get married. Arjun anxiously tells Maya that he doesn't want to stay with her anymore.

1.name: Saanjh Plans To Move On With Her Life
1.overview: Arjun angrily tells Maya that he hates her a lot. On the other hand, Saanjh meets her family and gives them several gifts. Vandana advises Saanjh to move on with her life. Saanjh informs her family that she has a boyfriend. Maya tells her mother that she will not allow Arjun to walk out of her life.

1.name: Arjun Plans To Divorce Maya
1.overview: Maya tells Arjun that she has decided to celebrate their wedding anniversary. While having breakfast, Arjun tells Maya that he wants to divorce her. Saanjh meets Maya in a jewelry shop. Saanjh wishes Maya for her wedding anniversary. Maya invites her friends to her house for the anniversary celebration.

1.name: Arjun Spoils Maya's Party
1.overview: Maya gifts a necklace to Arjun on the occasion of their marriage anniversary. Arjun angrily throws the necklace on the floor. He notices a microphone hidden in the necklace. Arjun yells at Maya for her misbehaviour. On the other hand, Ayan introduces his girlfriend to his family.

1.name: Arjun And Maya Hold A Press Conference
1.overview: Saanjh finds out that Arjun and Maya are not on good terms with each other. Saanjh comes to Vandana's house. Arjun and Maya hold a press conference. In front of media, Arjun gives credit of his success to Maya and Janhavi. Maya tells the media that Arjun loves her unconditionally.

1.name: Saanjh Introduces Samay To Arjun
1.overview: Maya tells the media that she is pregnant. Vandana tells Saanjh that she was not responsible for Maya's miscarriage in the past. Saanjh and Samay come to a pub for a party. Ayan and Saanjh get shocked to see Arjun in the pub. Saanjh introduces Samay to Arjun.

1.name: Arjun Plans To Move Out Of Maya's House
1.overview: Saanjh tells Arjun that she had informed Maya about Ayan's proposed engagement. Arjun gets shocked to see Maya in a pub. Arjun brings Maya back to their house. He offers a bowl of soup to Janhavi. Arjun asks Maya as to why she didn't inform him about Ayan's engagement.

1.name: Arjun Puts A Knife On His Neck
1.overview: Arjun saves Maya from falling off the balcony of her apartment. Saanjh tells her family that she is concerned for Arjun's future. Vandana advises Saanjh to move on with life. On the other hand, Maya invites Arjun for breakfast. Arjun puts knife against his neck.

1.name: Arjun Plans To Go Out Of Town
1.overview: Arjun tells Maya that he is planning to go out of town along with his staff. Arjun comes to his office and meets his team. Maya enters Arjun's cabin and disturbs him in his work. Maya finds a bouquet of flowers on her desk. She assumes that Arjun has given her the bouquet.

1.name: Samay Meets Maya
1.overview: Maya finds a fish pond in front of her cabin. She gets shocked to see Samay' in her office. Samay'a tells Maya that he missed her a lot. Saanjh asks Arjun if he is on good terms with Maya. Arjun clears it to Saanjh that he will continue to stay with Maya in the future.

1.name: Ayan And Arjun Mend Their Relationship
1.overview: Maya asks Samay to meet her in a cafe. Arjun gets shocked to see Ayan and Saanjh in a restaurant. Ayan tells Saanjh that he doesn't wish to keep any relationship with Arjun. Maya puts Samay in her car and brings him to an isolated place. Saanjh advises Ayan and Arjun to mend their broken relationship.

1.name: Arjun Reunites With His Family
1.overview: Maya asks Samay' to not interfere in her personal life. Arjun comes to Ayan's house to meet Vandana. Vandana tells Arjun that he should not have broken his relationship with his family. Arjun apologizes to Vandana for his past mistakes. He further tells Vandana that Maya is going to London.

1.name: Maya Stabs An Injection On Arjun's Neck
1.overview: Arjun tells Ayan that Maya is extremely possessive about him. Vandana advises Arjun to stay away from alcohol. Arjun gets shocked to see Maya in an ambulance. Arjun boards the ambulance as it heads towards a hospital. Maya stabs an injection on Arjun's neck. She brings Arjun to her house.

1.name: Ayan Molests Maya
1.overview: Maya locks Arjun in a room. Ayan intrudes into Maya's house to teach her a lesson. He tells Maya that he wants to meet Arjun. Maya replies Ayan that Arjun is not home. Ayan finds Arjun in a room. He approaches towards Maya and molests her. The police arrest Ayan for his crime.

1.name: Police Arrest Ayan
1.overview: Maya tells Arjun that his brother molested her in her house. The police put Ayan behind bars for molesting Maya. Saanjh and Vandana come to the police station to meet Ayan. Ayan tells Saanjh that he has not molested Maya. Vandana angrily asks Arjun to not blame her son for the alleged crime.

1.name: Arjun Decides To Take Legal Action Against Ayan
1.overview: Ayan clears it to Saanjh that he has not molested Arjun's wife. Arjun decides to take legal action against Ayan for molesting Maya. Saanjh tells Samay' that she will not allow Maya to win the court case. Arjun convinces Maya to let doctors do her medical tests. Saanjh comes to the Court to lead Ayan's case against Maya.

1.name: Saanjh Questions Arjun About His Relationship With Maya
1.overview: Saanjh asks Arjun as to where he was when his wife was being molested by Ayan. Arjun replies Saanjh that he was asleep during the incident. Saanjh tells the Judge that Maya had spread false rumours about her pregnancy. She further states that Maya was not molested by Ayan.

1.name: Saanjh Exposes Maya In Court
1.overview: Saanjh instructs Maya to stand in the witness-box. She asks Maya as to why she cancelled her London trip. Maya replies Saanjh that she cancelled the trip as she was concerned about Arjun's health. Saanjh tells the Judge that Maya had locked Arjun in her room at the time of her alleged molestation by Ayan.

1.name: Court Finds Ayan Guilty Of Molesting Maya
1.overview: Maya shows her injury marks to the Judge. She tells the Judge that she is a victim and not a criminal. Maya's lawyer calls Samay' to the witness box. Samay' tells the Court that he had stopped Ayan from molesting Maya. The Judge finds Ayan guilty in the molestation case.

1.name: Judge Sentences Ayan To Jail
1.overview: The Judge sentences Ayan to jail for attempting to rape Maya. A few women try to blacken Saanjh's face. Maya stops the women from attacking Saanjh. Samay tells Saanjh that he should not have come to the Court. Saanjh's mother advises her to not lose her self respect. She advises her to marry Samay.

1.name: Vandana Attacks Maya
1.overview: Saanjh asks Samay as to why he hide his secrets from her. Samay assumes that Saanjh is aware of his relationship with Maya. On the other hand, Vandana requests Arjun to forgive Ayan for his mistake. Arjun refuses to help his mother. Vandana attacks Maya with a knife.

1.name: Arjun Admits Vandana To A Hospital
1.overview: Arjun stops Vandana from attacking Maya. Vandana falls unconscious on the road. Arjun admits Vandana to a hospital. Saanjh and her mother come to the hospital to see Vandana. Saanjh's mother blames Maya for Vandana's condition. Later, a doctor tells Arjun that he can take Vandana back to his house. Arjun requests Saanjh to look after Vandana.

1.name: Maya Brings Vandana To Her House
1.overview: Arjun requests Saanjh to look after his mother. Vandana tells Saanjh that she doesn't wish to go to Maya's house. Saanjh replies Vandana that she can not help her anymore. Maya brings Vandana to her house. Saanjh asks Vandana to not reveal their secret plan to anyone.

1.name: Maya Tortures Vandana
1.overview: Maya tells Arjun that she will not take him away from his family. Vandana learns that Maya has installed many CCTV cameras in her house. Maya tells Vandana that she can track all her moves through the cameras. Maya forces Vandana to not keep her mobile phone beside her bed. Saanjh tries to contact Vandana on her phone, but fails to reach her.

1.name: Vandana Apologizes To Maya
1.overview: Saanjh tells Samay' that she would soon release Ayan from jail. Samay' tries to call Maya but fails to reach her. Vandana informs Saanjh that Maya is observing her every move through cameras. Vandana apologizes to Maya for her past mistakes. Arjun asks Vandana to not interfere in his personal life.

1.name: Maya Drops Vandana's Phone In Water
1.overview: Saanjh tries to call Vandana but fails to reach her. Maya drops Vandana's phone in a bucket filled with water. Later, Maya gifts a new mobile phone to Vandana. While going to office, Maya forces Vananda to talk to Janhavi. In Maya's absence, Vandana goes to her room.

1.name: Maya Injures Vandana's Hand
1.overview: Vandana secretly enters Maya's room. She plans to open Maya's cupboard. Maya comes to her house and starts searching for Vandana. Maya spots Vandana in her room. She traps one of Vandana's hands between two doors. Vandana starts yelling and requests Maya to open the doors. Later, Saanjh comes to Maya's house. She gets shocked to see Vandana's bleeding hand.

1.name: Saanjh Informs Arjun About Maya's Atrocities
1.overview: Maya reminds Vandana that she had deliberately injured her hand in the past. Vandana calls Saanjh and asks her to stay away from Maya's house. Samay' calls Maya and tells her that he wishes to meet her. On the other hand, Saanjh informs Arjun that Maya has broken one of Vandana's hands.

1.name: Maya Advises Samay To Marry Saanjh
1.overview: Saanjh tells Arjun that Maya has injured Vandana's hand. Samay meets Maya and tell her that he loves her a lot. Maya replies Samay that she is happily married to Arjun. Samay reminds Maya that he had helped her win legal case against Ayan. Maya advises Samay to marry Saanjh.

1.name: Maya Whips Herself With A Belt
1.overview: Arjun spots injury marks on one of Vandana's hands. He apologizes to Vandana for his past mistakes. He plans to beat Maya for attacking his mother. He locks Maya in a room. Maya whips herself with a belt. Arjun stops Maya from attacking herself. Maya tells Arjun that she had not injured Vandana's hand.

1.name: Samay Proposes Saanjh For Marriage
1.overview: Maya tells Vandana that she loves Arjun a lot. Arjun meets Vandana and tells her that Maya has mental illness. He tells Vandana that they must look after Maya. Vandana replies Arjun that he has made a mistake by marrying Maya. On the other hand, Samay proposes Saanjh for marriage.

1.name: Vandana Dumps Trash On Saanjh's Head
1.overview: Maya apologizes to Vandana for her past mistakes. Saanjh tells her mother that she wishes to invite Vandana for her engagement ceremony. Samay and Saanjh come to Maya's house. Vandana angrily dumps trash on Saanjh's head. Saanjh collects the trash in a bag and goes back to her house.

1.name: Samay Cuts His Own Finger
1.overview: Maya finds out that Vandana had sent a secret message to Saanjh. Vandana tells Maya that she should not have insulted Saanjh. She further tells Maya that she wishes to go to Saanjh's house. Maya advises Samay to get engaged to Saanjh. Samay anxiously cuts one of his fingers.

1.name: Vandana Plans To Give A Secret Gift To Saanjh
1.overview: Vandana tells Maya that she is going to attend Saanjh's engagement ceremony. Saanjh's mother tells her that she is excited as her daughter is getting married. Samay' meets Maya and tells her that he doesn't wish to marry Saanjh. Maya clears it to Samay' that she can not leave Arjun to marry him.

1.name: Saanjh And Samay' Exchange Rings
1.overview: Saanjh finds Vandana's letter in her gift box. She reads out the letter which mentions a few digits of a mobile number. Saanjh calls Vandana and asks her to find a proof against Maya in her room. Vandana plans to enter the room where Maya monitors her CCTV footages. Saanjh and Samay exchange rings at their engagement ceremony.

1.name: Saanjh Plans To Expose Samay
1.overview: Saanjh secretly steals Maya's mobile phone. Vandana tries to scan CCTV footages in Maya's house. Janhavi signs to Vandana that Maya was not molested by Ayan. Vandana learns that Maya is suffering from depression. Saanjh finds out that Maya is secretly talking to Samay over mobile phone.

1.name: Saanjh Questions Samay' On His Relationship With Maya
1.overview: Maya returns home from Saanjh's engagement ceremony. She learns that Vandana had tried to contact Saanjh in her absence. Saanjh confronts Samay on his relationship with Maya. Maya asks Vandana as to why she tries to mend her relationship with Saanjh. Samay and Saanjh come to Maya's house.

1.name: Saanjh Fails To Expose Maya's Secret
1.overview: Saanjh asks Maya if she has secret relationship with Samay'. Maya tells Saanjh that she worships her friendship with Samay'. Maya requests Saanjh to marry Samay'. Arjun angrily asks Saanjh to not interfere in Maya's personal life. Later, Saanjh requests Samay' to not meet Maya in the future.

1.name: Maya threatens Vandana With Knife
1.overview: Maya notices Ashwin's photo in Janhavi's room. Maya reminds Janhavi that she had killed Ashwin on the day of her wedding. Maya enters Vandana's room. She puts Vandana to sleep. Next morning, Vandana informs Arjun that Maya had threatened her with a knife. Vandana calls Saanjh and asks her to come to Arjun's house.

1.name: Saanjh Intrudes Into Maya's House
1.overview: Saanjh comes to Arjun's house in the guise of a courier delivery girl. Vandana welcomes her to the house. Arjun and Maya too enter the house. Vandana asks Saanjh to hide behind a bush. Saanjh enters Janhavi's room to find a proof against Maya. Saanjh finds a pen drive in the room.

1.name: Maya Finds Saanjh In Her House
1.overview: Vandana and Saanjh scan CCTV footages of Maya's house. They learn that Ayan had not molested Maya. Later, Maya finds out that her CCTV cameras are not working properly. Samay informs Maya that Saanjh is hiding in her house. Saanjh appears before Maya. Maya shoots Saanjh with her gun.

1.name: Arjun Admits Maya In Hospital
1.overview: Saanjh tells Maya that she has forwarded the content of her pen drive to Samay' and her father. Maya aims a gun towards Saanjh and Vandana. Maya falls unconscious as soon as Arjun and Samay' enter her room. Arjun admits Maya in a hospital. A doctor tells Arjun that Maya is pregnant.

1.name: Arjun Informs Saanjh About Maya's Pregnancy
1.overview: Saanjh enters Maya's hospital room. She tells Maya that she will soon put her behind bars as she has got proofs against her. Arjun informs Saanjh that his wife Maya is pregnant. He angrily asks Saanjh to not interfere in his life. He also clears it to Saanjh that he doesn't love her.

1.name: Samay Kills Saanjh's Father
1.overview: Saanjh informs her father that she has sent an important email to him. Samay throws Prem on an electricity box. Prem falls on the ground when he gets electric shock. On the other hand, Maya informs Janhavi that she is pregnant. Arjun tells Maya that Prem has passed away.

1.name: Arjun Comforts Saanjh As Prem Passes Away
1.overview: Arjun informs Maya and Janhavi that Prem has passed away. He goes to Saanjh's house to comfort her family. Samay enters anxiously and tells Maya that she has forced him to murder Prem. Maya clears it to Samay that she is not responsible for Prem's murder.

1.name: Saanjh Lights Her Fathers Pyre
1.overview: Arjun asks Saanjh to light her father's pyre. Later, Maya welcomes Arjun as he returns home. Arjun tells Maya that he is upset as Saanjh has lost her father. Arjun visits Saanjh's house to comfort her. Saanjh tells Arjun that she is missing her father a lot.

1.name: Maya Throws Samay Out Of Her House
1.overview: Samay secretly takes Arjun and Saanjh's photo in his camera. He comes to Maya's house. He shows the photograph to Maya and advises her to leave Arjun. He tells Maya that Arjun always spends his time with Saanjh. Maya angrily asks Samay to get out from her house.

1.name: Maya Drowns Janhavi in Water
1.overview: Samay' advises Arjun to not interfere in his wife's life. Maya anxiously tells Janhavi that Arjun should not leave her alone. She reminds Janhavi that she had tried to kill her in the past. Maya takes Janhavi to her washroom. She drowns Janhavi in a bathtub filled with water.

1.name: Arjun Saves Janhavi From Drowning
1.overview: Arjun gets shocked to see Maya lying unconscious in the washroom. Later, he saves Janhavi from drowning in bathtub. Saanjh tells her family that she is responsible for Prem's death. A doctor tells Arjun that he must take care of his pregnant wife. Maya asks Arjun to choose between her and Saanjh.

1.name: Maya Decides To Kill Saanjh
1.overview: Arjun comes to Saanjh's house. He tells Saanjh that Maya doesn't want him to meet her in the future. He apologizes to Saanjh for hurting her feelings. Vandana tells Arjun that he should not distance himself from Saanjh. Arjun informs Vandana that Maya is pregnant. On the other hand, Maya decides to kill Saanjh.

1.name: Saanjh Blames Maya For Prem's Murder
1.overview: Arjun requests Vandana to come to his house. Samay calls Maya and tells her that Arjun has broken his relationship with Saanjh. Later, Maya thanks Arjun for taking her to a psychiatrist. Saanjh tells her mother that Maya is responsible for Prem's death. Samay assures Saanjh that he would punish Maya for her sin.

1.name: Arjun Stops Samay From Attacking Maya
1.overview: Samay tells Saanjh that Maya is involved in Prem's murder. Samay and Saanjh enter Maya's house. Samay asks Maya as to why she killed Prem. Arjun stops Samay from hurting Maya. Maya requests Saanjh to leave her house. She reminds Saanjh that she is pregnant. Samay tells Maya that he would marry Saanjh within a week.

1.name: Samay Holds Maya Responsible For Prems Murder
1.overview: Saanjh tells Vandana that Samay is not involved in Prem's murder. Samay tells Saanjh that they should perform Prem's 'Asthi visarjan'. Samay secretly enters into Maya's house. Maya tells Samay that she is not responsible for Prem's murder. She angrily asks Samay to get out from her house.

1.name: Tattoo Reveals Samay's Secret In Front Of Saanjh
1.overview: Saanjh and Samay stand before a river to immerse Prem's mortal remains. Saanjh notices a tattoo of Maya's name on Samay's body. Later, Saanjh and Samay return to Prem's house. Samay calls Maya and tells her that he wants to meet her. Maya invites Samay to her house.

1.name: Saanjh Finds Out Rajiv's Secret
1.overview: Saanjh meets a girl in a hospital. The girl tells Saanjh that Rajiv is hiding his real identity from her. Saanjh learns that the real name of her fiance is Rajiv. The girl informs Saanjh that Rajiv had helped Maya to get her company back from her father. On the other hand, Maya starts hitting Rajiv with a cricket ball.

1.name: Rajiv Plans To Blackmail Maya
1.overview: Rajiv tells Maya that he is aware of all her secrets. Rajiv plays a video of Maya killing her father. He informs Maya that Saanjh had sent the video to him. Maya requests Rajiv to not harass her. Arjun tells Maya that he would continue to love her in the future.

1.name: Rajiv Kidnaps Shubh
1.overview: Rajiv hides in a tank filled with water and holds Maya's hand. Maya flicks away Rajiv's hand and goes to her house along with Arjun. On the other hand, Saanjh tells her mother that she cannot marry Samay. Rajiv calls Saanjh and informs her that he has kidnapped Shubh.

1.name: Rajiv Forces Maya To Come To His House
1.overview: Rajiv calls Maya and asks her to sing a song for him. Later, He forces her to come to his house. He tells Maya that he would reveal her past to her family if she doesn't follow his instructions. Maya comes to Rajiv's house. Rajiv asks Maya to wear bridal dress.

1.name: Maya Secretly Meets Rajiv
1.overview: Rajiv wears groom's attire and decorates his bed with flowers. Maya enters his wearing a bridal dress. She requests Rajiv to not cause her any harm. She reminds Rajiv that she is pregnant. Rajiv allows Maya to go back to her house. Maya meets Janhavi and tells her that she is worried for her future.

1.name: Maya Reveals Her Past To Arjun
1.overview: Saanjh tells her mother that she does not want to marry Rajiv. Maya informs Arjun that she had affair with Rajiv in the past. Arjun learns that Rajiv has returned in Maya's life. Maya tells Arjun that Rajiv wants to take Saanjh away from them. Rajiv tells Saanjh that he loves Maya a lot.

1.name: Arjun Decides To Save Saanjh From Rajiv
1.overview: Maya informs Arjun that Rajiv had tried to immolate himself to impress her. She tells Arjun that Rajiv would kill Saanjh after their marriage. She requests Arjun to save Saanjh from Rajiv. Arjun finds out that Rajiv has kidnapped Shubh. Rajiv asks Saanjh to get ready for their wedding.

1.name: Saanjh Gets Ready To Marry Rajiv
1.overview: Rajiv tells Suman that Shubh wants to give them a surprise. Saanjh gets ready to marry Rajiv. Saanjh and Rajiv exchange garlands in front of all guests. Arjun enters the wedding hall along with Shubh. Rajiv secretly escapes from the hall. Arjun asks Saanjh if Maya is involved in Prem's murder.

1.name: Rajiv Abducts Maya
1.overview: Arjun tells Saanjh's family that he is going out to search Rajiv. Rajiv comes to Maya's house. He tells Janhavi that he is going to marry Maya. Rajiv abducts Maya and brings her near a river. Maya clears it to Rajiv that she does not love her.

1.name: Arjun Rescues Maya From Rajiv
1.overview: Arjun and Saanjh plan to rescue Maya from Rajiv. Rajiv tells Maya that he wants to spend rest of his life with her. Saanjh requests Rajiv to not cause any harm to Maya. Rajiv gets injured when a heavy anchor hits his stomach. Arjun angrily tells Maya that he will not forgive her for her mistakes.

1.name: Arjun Organizes Maya's Baby Shower
1.overview: Arjun prepares a cake and offers it to Saanjh. Later, Arjun comes to a mental asylum to meet his pregnant wife Maya. Maya thanks Arjun for supporting her through thick and thin. Arjun invites his family for Maya's baby shower. A police enters the hall to arrest Maya.

1.name: Ayan And Saanjh Attend Maya's Baby Shower
1.overview: Ayan enters Maya's house to attend her baby shower. Arjun and Maya get shocked to see Saanjh in their house. Maya apologizes to Saanjh for her past mistakes. Ayan reminds Saanjh that Maya was involved in Prem's murder. He advises Saanjh to stay away from Maya. Ayan angrily tells Vandana that Maya has ruined his life.

1.name: Maya Spots Arjun Along With Saanjh
1.overview: Ayan tells Maya that Arjun doesn't love her. He informs Maya that Arjun spent his time with Saanjh in her absence. Ayan takes Maya to Saanjh's house. Arjun meets Saanjh on the terrace of her apartment. Arjun gets shocked to see Maya along with Ayan. Saanjh clears it to Maya that she doesn't love Arjun.

1.name: Maya Hits Ayan With Her Car
1.overview: Maya tells Ayan that though she is mentally ill, she loves Arjun a lot. Ayan records Maya's statement in a camera. Maya requests him to not share the video with Arjun. Later, Maya hits Ayan with her car. She steals his camera and goes back to her house. Saanjh gets shocked to see Ayan in pool of blood.

1.name: Saanjh Blames Maya For Ayans Accident
1.overview: Saanjh calls Arjun and informs him that Ayan has met with an accident. Arjun rushes towards the hospital to see Ayan. Later, Saanjh tells Arjun that Maya wanted to kill Samay. Arjun asks Saanjh to not blame Maya for Ayan's accident. Saanjh advises Vandana to stay away from Maya. Vandana decides to reveal Maya's secret to Arjun.

1.name: Maya Loses Her Child
1.overview: Maya anxiously tells Vandana that she had rammed her car into Ayan. Vandana angrily tells Maya that she is going to inform Arjun about her evil intentions. Maya tries to stop Vandana from leaving her house. Maya falls on her stomach when Vandana tries to hold her hands. Arjun admits Maya in a hospital. He learns that Maya has lost her baby.

1.name: Arjun Loses His Cool
1.overview: Maya gets a miscarriage after falling from the stairs. Arjun is completely shattered and blames his mother for the incident. Police comes to arrest Arjun's mother after Maya filed a case of domestic violence. However, Arjun told the police that Maya is mentally ill and asks them to go back. Find out what happened next.

1.name: Arjun Ends Relationship With Maya
1.overview: Arjun loses his cool and tells Maya that he doesn't care for her anymore and that their relationship was a mere adjustment. He wants everyone to leave him alone. Vandana expresses her guilt to Saanjh and asks her to take care of Arjun. Find out what happened next.

1.name: Ayan Comes Out Of Coma
1.overview: Maya follows Vandana back home to kill her. Maya tells her that Bandar was the bond between her and Arjun and Vandanda was responsible to break it. Meanwhile, Ayan comes out of coma and informs Saanjh that Maya tried to kill him and she should call police before something serious happens. Watch this episode of Beyhadh to find out what happens next.

1.name: Maya's Killing Streak Continues
1.overview: Saanjh hurries back to Vandana's apartment to save her. Upon reaching the apartment, Saanjh is relieved to find Vandana sleeping in her bed. She immediately calls up Ayan and tells him that Vandana is alright. After cutting the call, Saanjh cuddles near Vandana but to her utter shock, she finds that Vandana has no pulse. Find out what happens next!

1.name: Arjun Kills Maya
1.overview: Maya provokes Arjun to kill her. In a fit of rage, Arjun attacks Maya. Maya explains to Arjun that she does not regret killing the one responsible for the death of her unborn child. Then, Arjun loses his cool and pushes Maya. Arjun, too, falls on the ground and loses consciousness. Maya hits her head onto a table and bleeds profusely.

1.name: Arjun Is Arrested
1.overview: The police arrest Arjun for Maya's murder. Ayaan and Saanjh are in disbelief about the entire incident. The police suspect that Arjun murdered Maya for financial gains. Later, in the police station, Ayaan claims that Arjun is being framed. But, Arjun makes a startling claim by stating that he killed Maya.

1.name: Maya's Confession
1.overview: Arjun reveals to Saanjh that Maya threatened to murder her if he did not kill her. He also said that Maya had confessed that she had plotted a fake rape scene to trap Ayaan. Watch this episode of Beyhadh to find out what happens next!

1.name: Ayaan Performs Final Rites of His Mother
1.overview: Ayaan performs final rites of his mother and is heart broken that Arjun couldn't be there alongside.ewly assigned investigation officer Ranvir Singh interrogates Arjun and tells him that he has Maya's letter as evidence to prove him guilty. Saanjh however thinks there is a conspiracy behind the chain of events. See this episode of Beyhadh to find out what happens next.

1.name: Saanjh In Police Custody
1.overview: Saanjh, who believes that Maya has framed Arjun in her murder, sneaks into Maya's apartment to find evidence to prove her point. But, her plan fails as the police also arrive at the scene and arrest her. Later, the police interrogate Saanjh and Arjun. During the interrogation, the police show Maya's diary to Arjun. In the diary, Maya has claimed that Arjun wanted to kill her unborn child.

1.name: Arjun's Trial Begins
1.overview: Ayaan meets Arjun at the prison where they both notice that the media have already given their verdict by deeming Arjun to be Maya's murderer. Meanwhile, Arjun feels that Maya had made the plan to frame him for her murder, long back. He also tells Ayaan that he now hates and despises Maya more than anything else. Later, Arjun and Saanjh are produced before the court where their trial commences. The public prosecutor accuses Arjun of marrying Maya for extorting her wealth and of having an extrama

1.name: Saanjh Appears As A Witness
1.overview: During the courtroom proceedings, Pooja claims in the court that Arjun consipred with Saanjh to kill Maya. Pooja produces key witnesses in the case to prove that Arjun was having an affair with Saanjh. Arjun in a fit of rage, raises his hand on Pooja.

1.name: Arjun's Startling Confession
1.overview: During the courtroom proceedings, Pooja proves that Arjun attacked Maya with an intention to kill her. Arjun's fingerprints are also found on Maya's neck, proving that he attacked her. When Pooja stresses on the point that Arjun conspired with Saanjh, Arjun loses his cool and shouts out in anger that he killed Maya and Saanjh is innocent.

1.name: Maya's New Avatar
1.overview: Saanjh recalls Arjun's words and checks Maya's dead body to determine whether Maya is still alive. Then, she meets Arjun in the prison and informs him about it. Arjun is now absolutely sure that Maya is still alive. Later, Saanjh informs Ayaan that she will get Arjun released from prison at any cost. Meanwhile, Maya takes on a new avatar to come back into Arjun's life with a vengeance. Keep watching Beyhadh to find out what happens next.

1.name: Revenge
1.overview: Arjun is seething with revenge while serving his sentence, fully aware that Maya is still alive. Maya is patiently waiting for an opportunity to get back into Arjun's life. Arjun's quest for revenge is making him more angrier than ever. His rage is fuelling his desire to get out of prison and find Maya. Meanwhile, Saanjh arrives at the prison to meet Arjun. A few prisoners try to molest her but Arjun arrives to her rescue.

1.name: Arjun Reveals His Plan To Saanjh
1.overview: Maya learns that Arjun is about to be hanged. Meanwhile, Arjun tells Saanjh in a letter that the attack on her in the jail was planned by him. He wanted to be transferred to a solitary prison and that all of this is the part of his plan to escape from the jail. However, Ayaan reads this letter as well and makes a plan of his own.

1.name: Maya Meets A Match
1.overview: Arjun and Maya are headed for a collision course. Both want to destroy each other. Arjun is planning an escape and informs Saanjh about it. Saanjh advises him against it. Then, Ayaan meets the police and informs that Arjun is planning an escape. Will Arjun's great escape materialise? Watch this episode to find out.

1.name: Arjun's Great Escape
1.overview: Arjun is preparing himself to break out of prison. He plans an escape with the help of Saanjh. At night, Arjun's plan bears fruit and he escapes from his cell. Unfortunately for him, a constable finds out that he has escaped and alerts the other officers. A surprise in the form of Ayaan awaits Arjun when he gets out of the prison. What follows is a twist Arjun would have never fathomed, even in his dreams.

1.name: Maya's Coffin
1.overview: The tale takes an unexpected turn as Ayaan tricks Arjun and administers an injection to Arjun, which knocks him out. A doctor is called in to check on Arjun. Then, Arjun is taken to the hospital and Saanjh accompanies him. While on the way, the ambulance meets with an accident. As the attention of the police is distracted, Arjun makes an escape.

1.name: Love And Destruction
1.overview: Ayaan conspired with Saanjh to help Arjun escape from prison. Maya tries to escape from the coffin after hearing news about Arjun on the radio. Then, Maya learns that Arjun has escaped from prison. Later, Saanjh arrives at the police station and questions the police officer about the whereabouts of Arjun. Saanjh pretends to be innocent. Meanwhile, Arjun is preparing to himself to exact revenge on Maya.

1.name: The Return Of Samay'
1.overview: The police are forced to release Saanjh, Suman, and Subh. Before leaving the police station, Saanjh reveals to the police that she will get Ayaan out of jail and prove Arjun's innocence and challenges him to stop her from doing so. Meanwhile, Maya is distraught that Arjun has taken away their opportunity to get together after their death. Later, Arjun shares his plan to take his revenge on Maya with Saanjh.

1.name: Saanjh Admitted In Asylum
1.overview: Maya is terrified to see Samay alive again. She runs away from him but Samay catches up and tells her that he is the only person in the world who can truly love her but Maya manages to escape. Meanwhile, Arjun and Saanjh dress up as an old couple and visit the asylum where Maya had stayed. Saanjh, who acts like a patient with multiple personality disorder, plans to visit the room where Maya was kept in order to gain clues about who had helped her in planning all of what she had done.

1.name: Knocking On Deaths Door
1.overview: After cheating death, Samay has come to exact revenge on Maya. Upon being confronted, Maya tries to run away from Samay. But, Samay, like death, follows Maya like a shadow. Meanwhile, Saanjh finds herself in trouble when the inmates at the asylum confront her.evertheless, Saanjh has decides to sneak into Maya's room and find some clues about Maya.

1.name: Maya's Race Against Time
1.overview: Samay reveals to Maya the events that occurred after she had tried to kill him. Meanwhile, Saanjh assures Arjun that she will be safe. Then, she sneaks into Maya's room and searches for any clues. Maya is still facing the barrel of the gun. Samay gives the gun to Maya and asks her to shoot him. Will Maya pull the trigger and end Samay's time on the Earth, once and for all? Watch this episode to find out.

1.name: Arjun Saves Saanjh
1.overview: The ward boy takes away Saanjh's phone in order to provide information. Arjun waits patiently outside for Saanjh's signal. Meanwhile, Maya finds company in Samay's company and the latter informs her that Arjun and Saanjh are searching for her. He shows her the video footage of the ward boy forcefully administering electric shock treatment to Saanjh. Then, Arjun saves Saanjh and sends a message to Maya.ow, Maya is more determined than ever to kill Saanjh.

1.name: Police Surround Arjun and Saanjh
1.overview: The police surround Arjun and Saanjh and order him to surrender. Arjun comes up with a plan to sneak out of the hospital without being caught by the police. When the police barge into the hospital ward, Arjun and Saanjh have managed to escape. Maya and Samay learn about Arjun and Saanjh's escape through the news channels and waits to meet Arjun and Saanjh.

1.name: Arjun Finds Maya
1.overview: Despite being with Samay', Maya plans to kill both him and Sanjh and get together with Arjun. Meanwhile, the police raids Sanjhs house, and they learn about the location of Sanjh and Arjun from Shubh's laptop. The police stops the bus Arjun and Sanjh were travelling, however, the duo manage to escape. They continue their search for Maya, and Arjun finally sees her in a market. Will he be able to confront him? Watch to find out.

1.name: Rajeev Traps Saanjh
1.overview: While Arjun chases the clue left behind by Maya, Rajeev torments Saanjh in the jungle. Saanjh steps into a trap set for her and Rajeev reveals himself from the shadows. Despite all the pleading from Saanjh, Rajeev prepares to burn her to death as Rajeev enters a race against time to save her from his hands.

1.name: Arjun Saves Saanjh
1.overview: Arjun manages to trace down the clue left behind by Saanjh and save her from being harmed by Rajeev. A fight ensues between the due and Arjun manages to escape with Saanjh before the police arrives. Arjun tells Saanjh takes he cannot risk her life anymore in order to chase down Maya and that he will surrender to the police. But just before he could do so, Rajeev traces them down and threatens to kill Saanjh.

1.name: Another Betrayal
1.overview: Rajeev calls Maya and then kills Saanjh. Maya is pleased with the fact that, finally, all the biggest obstacle between her and Arjun is dead. Rajeev tells Maya that he is bringing along Arjun with him so that she can kill him with her own hands. However, when Rajeev arrives, he brings along with him two coffins. Maya is shocked to see Arjun in one of those. How will she react? Watch to find out.

1.name: Samay's Confession
1.overview: Arjun and Samay' tie up Maya on a chair. Samay' goes on to tell Maya how Arjun and Saanjh had convinced him to join them when he had gone to kill the former. Samay' tells Maya that before committing another crime for her, he wanted to test whether she deserves such loyalty. Later, Saanjh collapses and Arjun takes her away to get her some rest while Samay' is left to watch after Maya.

1.name: Maya Turns The Game On Its Head
1.overview: The police surrounds the place where Arjun, Maya, Saanjh, and Rajeev were hiding. They break in to find the dead body of Rajeev with Arjun standing at the stop with a bloody knife in his hands. Just when the police were about to shoot Arjun, Maya runs in to stop them. She explains to them that Arjun had saved him from Rajeev, who had kidnapped him. What is the truth behind Rajeevs death, and where is Saanjh? Watch to find out.

1.name: Ayaan Learns About Maya's Return
1.overview: Maya shows Saanjh's video to Arjun and tells him that she feels bad for Saanjh, who is under her captivity. Maya's behaviour annoys Arjun but Saanjh's mother and brother prevents him from raising his hand at Maya. Then, Maya looks at Jhanvi and tells her that she has now fulfilled the duties of a daughter, wife and friend. Suddenly, Jhanvi falls unconscious out of shock, prompting Arjun to take her to a hospital.

1.name: How Maya Won The Battle
1.overview: Maya warns Ayaan not to repeat the mistake of hitting her in the future. She also proceeds to tell everyone how she managed to get the better of Samay' by hurting his ego and then went on to execute the kidnapping of Saanjh. Arjun tells Maya that she will never be able to win her love to which she replies that all she needs is his presence. Eventually, Maya reveals to Arjun that she has kept Saanjh in this city.

1.name: Arjun Admitted In Hospital
1.overview: Maya is delighted to have Arjun along her side, and she hopes for a fresh start with him in his life. Later, Arjun goes down with a pain in his stomach, and he is admitted to a hospital. The doctor tells Maya that Arjun will undergo an operation in his appendix. Meanwhile, a nurse in the hospital delivers a note to Suman. What is written in that note? Watch to find out.

1.name: Arjun Rescues Saanjh
1.overview: Arjun asks Suman to take his place on the operating table while he searches for Saanjh. Meanwhile, Maya is worried and concerned about Arjun's well-being and demands to see him. However, Ayaan manages to calm her down. Later, Arjun reaches the place where Maya had kept Saanjh captive. Will Arjun be able to save her? Will Maya get to know about Arjun's disappearance? Watch to find out.

1.name: Maya Comes To Take Her Revenge
1.overview: Saanjh tries to escape from Arjun and kill herself, but he comes and rescues her. Arjun realises that a time bomb has been placed in Saanjh's body. Maya arrives and threatens to kill Saanjh by pressing the button. Maya asks Arjun to fulfill the vows that he had promised but he refuses to budge.

1.name: Maya Is Behind Bars
1.overview: A shocking revelation comes to the fore. Maya's mother tries to kill her daughter as she is disappointed with her. In the meantime, the police surround the area. Maya is arrested by the police and her game comes to an end. With Maya behind bars, will Arjun and Saanjh's love become eternal? Or will Maya conspire to break their bond of love and friendship? Watch this episode to find out.

1.name: Maya's Courtroom Drama
1.overview: Saanjh is sceptical of Arjun's love for her. She believes that Arjun does not love her but merely out of courtesy he is showing her affection. Later, during the courtroom proceedings Maya attacks her lawyer, Pooja. After the situation is brought under control Maya announces that she is fight the case on her own.

1.name: The Murder That Destroyed Arjun's Life
1.overview: Maya's mother appears before the judge to testify against her daughter. She claims that Maya has anger management issues which led to her unlawful behaviour. She makes a startling revelations by claiming that Maya killed her own father. During the courtroom proceedings. Maya's reveals the details behind her conspiracy to frame Arjun.

1.name: Maya In Prison
1.overview: Saanjh argues before the judge that the evidence proves that Maya is guilty. The judge announces a death sentence and Maya is sent to prison. While the police escort Maya to the prison, Arjun hands over the divorce papers to her. Later, Saanjh informs Arjun that they should not turn their friendship into a romantic relationship.

1.name: Maya's Escape Plan
1.overview: Maya is met with hostility from her fellow inmates when she steps inside the prison. The inmates are aware of the crimes committed by Maya. Arjun wants to propose to Saanjh and make her realise that he truly loves her. But, he does not get the opportunity to express his feelings. Meanwhile, Asha, who is pregnant, now shares her cell with Maya. In no time, Maya manipulates Asha to get out of the prison. Will Maya's plan work out? Watch this episode to find out.

1.name: Arjun Expresses His Feelings to Saanjh
1.overview: While on the way to the hospital, Maya fakes an injury and finds her way out of the hospital. Meanwhile, Jhanvi asks Arjun to make Saanjh realise the feelings he has towards her. Upon much compulsion, Arjun comes up with a plan to propose Saanjh. Find out what happens next!

1.name: Arjun Is Missing
1.overview: Maya is determined to save Arjun at any cost and break out of prison. Ayaan tries to call up Arjun but his phone is not reachable. The family members are worried as Arjun has not reached home yet. Later, Saanjh comes face to face with Maya to find out about Arjun.

1.name: Saanjh Visits the Morgue
1.overview: Saanjh tells Maya that she will go to any length to save Arjun from her dubious plans. As Saanjh leaves the prison, Maya notices that it is already 9 pm and the deadline given by the kidnappers is about to expire. An extremely worried Maya thinks of a plan to save Arjun from the kidnappers while Saanjh heads out to find Arjun's whereabouts.

1.name: Arjun Attempts To Escape
1.overview: Maya comes up with a plan to call the kidnappers before they hurt Arjun. Meanwhile, Saanjh is still in search of Arjun, who has been kidnapped. Finding an opportunity, Maya calls up the kidnappers, but its too late as Arjun is hit on the head by the kidnappers.

1.name: Will Saanjh Find Arjun Before Maya Does?
1.overview: Maya's plan backfires as she attempts to call up the kidnappers from the jailers cabin. The jailer confines Maya in the room, where she has set fire. The kidnappers grow restless and decide to end Arjun's life. Saanjh is worried about Arjun's safety and wants to find Arjun before Maya does. Saanjh wants to think a step ahead of Maya and find Arjun. Will she able to do as planned? Watch this episode to find out.

1.name: Maya Is Caught By The Prison Guards
1.overview: The kidnappers fear that the police might barge into their hideout. They hide an unconscious Arjun when the police do arrive. The police leave without conducting a search and Arjun still remains elusive. Later, Maya calls up the kidnappers when they are about to kill Arjun. She asks the kidnappers to spare Arjun's life. But, the kidnappers refuse to listen to her. Maya is caught by the prison guards and brought before the jailer. Meanwhile, Arjun regains consciousness and hides in a freezer to e

1.name: Arjun's Death
1.overview: Saanjh relies on her intuition to find out where Arjun is. Maya is in a state of despair as she desperately wants to meet Arjun. The jailer fears that Maya might breath her last as she is refusing to eat. Meanwhile, Maya and Ayaan reach the spot where Arjun is located and help him get out of the freezer. Then, the jailer calls up the police inspector who is investigating the case and informs him to get Arjun to the hospital. But, the inspector replies that Arjun is dead.

1.name: Maya Attempts Suicide
1.overview: Devastated on hearing that Arjun is dead, Maya tries to escape from the clutches of the police and locks herself inside a hospital room.
