Meanwhile, Saanjh and Ayan are elated when they see that Arjun is alive and rush him to the hospital. Maya tries to hang herself from a ceiling fan in the hospital.

1.name: Love Comes Knocking
1.overview: Maya is overjoyed to learn that Arjun is still alive. Arjun assures Saanjh that Maya will never stand between him and his happiness. Arjun tries to impress Saanjh by surprising her. But, their date is cut short thanks to the call from the jailer, who asks Arjun to come to the prison immediately. This upsets Saanjh as she believes that Maya will never them alone.

1.name: Maya's Gift For Saanjh
1.overview: Saanjh's mother is worried about Arjun and Saanjh's future together as Maya is still alive. Saanjh recalls the threatening words Maya had uttered during their last meeting about Arjun's death. Later, Saanjh receives a gift and in it she finds broken bangles. Who has sent this gift? Maya? Watch this episode to find out.

1.name: Will Maya Stop Arjun and Maya's Wedding?
1.overview: Arjun learns that Maya is in solitary confinement. Saanjh is in a state of fear following the gift from Maya.evertheless, Arjun decides to marry Saanjh. Maya's mother decides to meet Maya and inform her about the wedding. Will the wedding take place as planned? Or will Maya's shadow spoil the future of Arjun and Saanjh? Watch this episode to find out.

1.name: Maya's Resurrection
1.overview: Arjun and Saanjh forget about Maya for a brief period and enjoy the ceremonies. While in custody, Maya claims that on the day of Arjun's wedding, she will transform into her previous self. A person sent by Maya makes sure Arjun and Saanjh are reminded about Maya. After learning of his presence, Arjun tries to chase him down.

1.name: Arjun Confronts Maya
1.overview: Arjun has no other choice but to meet Maya in an attempt to persuade her to stop her evil intentions. But, Maya refuses to listen to Arjun. Later, Arjun and Saanjh try to find solace in each others company and forget about Maya. Meanwhile, Maya is busy planning her next move in order to harm Saanjh.

1.name: The Sangeet Ceremony
1.overview: Arjun and Ayan are left frustrated when the security agencies demand huge sums for offering their services. Then, Ayan tells Arjun that he will arrange a metal detector from his friend. Meanwhile, Arjun asks Ayan and Shubh to bring in all their friends to provide security for the ceremony. On the other hand, Maya has designed another plan to disrupt the ceremony. Will Maya be able to make her plan work? Find out!

1.name: Saanjh Is Stabbed
1.overview: Arjun and Saanjh forget about Maya and enjoy their wedding forgetting the ominous signs. The hitman sent by Maya is planning to kill Saanjh. Meanwhile, Maya is rejoicing in anticipation of Saanjh's death. Then, tragedy strikes Arjun and Saanjh as the bride to be is stabbed.

1.name: Will Maya Be Hanged?
1.overview: When Saanjh locks herself inside the room, Arjun enters through the window and persuades her. He helps Saanjh get ready for their wedding. Meanwhile, the jailer informs Maya that the time for her hanging is minutes away. Maya asks that jailer that she wants to call Lalvani as her last wish. What final surprises does Maya have up her sleeves and will she be hanged? Watch this episode to find out.

1.name: Arjun Weds Saanjh
1.overview: Arjun and Saanjh learn that Maya's death sentence has been pardoned. Realising she and Arjun are not safe with Maya still alive, Saanjh decides to call off the wedding. But, Arjun wants to go ahead with the marriage and ties the knot with Saanjh. Maya learns from her informer that Arjun and Saanjh are now married. Even after completing the wedding formalities, the fear of Maya's arrival is still lurking behind the corner for Saanjh.

1.name: Maya's End Or A New Beginning?
1.overview: After witnessing an unpleasant event, Saanjh decides to leave the house. But, Arjun calms her down and assures her of safety. Meanwhile, in the prison, the jailer makes Maya watch Arjun and Saanjh's wedding. Then, Maya's mother meets the jailer and bribes her to kill Maya. The jailer hatches a plan to kill Maya later that night. Is this the end of Maya? Watch this episode to find out.

1.name: Will Arjun Kill Maya?
1.overview: The jailer's plan to kill Maya backfires on her as Maya turns the tables on her and kills her. After conducting an inquiry, Maya is sent to solitary confinement. Meanwhile, Saanjh learns about this and suffers a brain stroke. Arjun having had enough of Maya's ominous presence in his life, deices to end her life. Will Arjun pull the trigger and kill Maya? Watch this episode to find out.

1.name: Five Years Later
1.overview: Five years have passed since Arjun last saw Maya. He returns home and finds something eerie in the house. He pulls out a gun in a bid to neutralise the threat. However, Saanjh arrives with her family and friends and congratulates Arjun on his latest achievements. Arjun is ecstatic to see his daughter, Arohi and shares the happiness with his family. But, Maya's last words that she will return one day, still haunt Arjun.

1.name: Maya's New Ploy
1.overview: Arjun is worried that Maya might arrive into their lives at any moment and their happiness will be at stake once she arrives. Meanwhile, Maya is plotting her next move to exact revenge on Saanjh. At Arjun's residence, a journalist makes the mistake of asking him about Maya. Arjun loses his cool and shouts at the journalist and asks her leave. Arohi overhears Maya's name and asks Arjun about her.

1.name: Maya's Death
1.overview: Tulsi meets Maya for the last time before leaving. Maya kills Tulsi in a bid to escape. Then, Maya falls unconscious as per her plan. The doctor arrives at the scene and declares Maya dead. After Maya is shifted to the morgue, she wakes up, ready to escape and exact revenge on Saanjh.

1.name: Maya Returns
1.overview: Maya sets fire to the morgue to wipe out any evidence that could prove that she is still alive. The hospital staff believe that Maya's dead body was charred in the accident. Later, Maya escapes and finds Arjun's house. She stands outside his house and sees him with Saanjh and Arohi. Maya is heartbroken and decides to exact revenge on Saanjh using Arohi.

1.name: Maya Meets Arohi
1.overview: Lalwani finds Maya before Arjun's bodyguards do and helps her escape. The next day, Maya arrives at Arohi's school and creates a distraction to gain Arohi's trust. Maya pretends to be one of the staff and starts working in the school. Meanwhile, Saanjh suspects that something bad is about to happen.

1.name: Arohi's New Friend
1.overview: Maya meets Arohi and tries to befriend her. But, before she can do so, Arjun and Saanjh arrive at the school. Maya gets terrified and wears a mask to hide her identity. Arjun bumps into Maya but does not recognize her. Later, Saanjh arrives at a graveyard to meet a stranger.

1.name: Arjun's Nightmare
1.overview: Arjun wakes up from a nightmare, in which he saw Saanjh getting killed. Arjun believes that someone has entered the property and orders the guards to conduct a search. Meanwhile, at school, Aarohi sees Maya coming out of the store room. She questions Maya about the need to access the store room, which is out of bounds for the staff. Later, Lalwani arrives at Arjun's factory and mixes a substance in the solution.

1.name: Aarohi is Missing
1.overview: Lalwani does his job and escapes before Arjun can catch hold of him. Aarohi bumps into Maya and finds her secretive. Jhanvi arrives at the school but fails to find Aarohi. Meanwhile, Arjun suspects something to be wrong and orders all the stocks to be recalled. But, the damage has been done as children who have eaten the chocolates being to fall sick.

1.name: Arjun's Death Trap
1.overview: Arjun finds an old tape recorder. When he plays it, he discovers Maya's favourite song and reaises that she has escaped from the morgue. He goes to Maya's psychiatrist to enquire about Maya. Meanwhile Maya tries to get close to Arohi. Later, Arjun decides to make a plan to take his revenge on Maya.

1.name: Maya's Grand Entry
1.overview: Arjun gets ready to kill Maya and loads his gun with bullets. Meanwhile, Saanjh suspects that Arjun is hiding something from her. Arjun reaches the venue for the garba night. While he is searching for Maya, she comes and pats his back. Will Arjun manage to accomplish what he has come for? Watch the episode to find out.

1.name: Maya Takes Her Revenge
1.overview: Arjun points a gun at Maya and plans to shoot her. But she tells him that Saanjh's life is in danger. Meanwhile, Saanjh narrowly escapes being hit by a truck while coming to the garba venue. Later, Arjun and Saanjh reach Aarohi's school and find her lying unconscious. They find out that she has been poisoned. Maya disguises herself as a hospital nurse and comes to take her revenge. Will she succeed? Watch the episode to find out.

1.name: Saanjh Is Separated From Aarohi
1.overview: Maya arrives at the hospital, while Aarohi is being operated upon. She makes sure Aarohi lives and reveals that her intention was never to harm Aarohi. She does want to take revenge but not at the cost of Aarohi's life. After Aarohi is discharged from the hospital, Ayaan decides to take Aarohi along with him for her own safety.

1.name: Maya's New Plan
1.overview: Saanjh breaks down remembering Aarohi. Meanwhile, Maya tells Lalwani that she merely used Aarohi to hurt Arjun. Then, Arjun is informed by his bodyguards about Maya's whereabouts. But, when they reach the spot, Maya is no where to be found. Later, Saanjh is diagnosed with depression. Wanting to help Saanjh, Arjun assures Saanjh that Maya will never be able to take away their happiness.

1.name: The Surrogate Mother
1.overview: Maya calls up Arjun and lets him know that he cannot stop her from meeting him. Later, Arjun and Saanjh arrive at the fertility centre and meet the woman who has been chosen as the surrogate mother for their child. When she is taken inside the operation theatre, Maya plays out her plan and gives money to the woman. Will Arjun and Saanjh find out Maya's plan before its too late? Watch this episode to find out.

1.name: Maya Meets Arjun
1.overview: On his way to the hospital, Arjun encounters the surrogate woman who was supposed to carry Saanjh's child. Realising that something is wrong, he rushes to the hospital and notices Maya, who informs him that now she is the surrogate mother. Maya puts forth a condition before Arjun and asks him to take her home. Arjun gets furious at this and tries to choke Maya.

1.name: Maya Arrives In Arjun's House
1.overview: Maya asks Saanjh to take the decision: to either take her home or put her behind bars. Maya then arrives at Arjun's house. Maya's mother is shocked to see her. They are informed that Maya is the surrogate mother to Arjun and Saanjh's child.

1.name: Maya Returns
1.overview: Everyone gets worried after seeing Maya back in the house. Arjun arrives at the police station to file a complaint against Maya but thinks of Sanjh and stops. Meanwhile, Maya makes Sanjh feel guilty for being unable to be a mother. How Arjun and Sanjh face problem after allowing Maya live in their house? Watch this episode to find out.

1.name: The Beginning of Maya's Revenge
1.overview: Maya's obsession blurs into a vengeful quest to destroy Saanjh's life. At midnight, Maya enters her mother's room. Before she can carry out her evil pursuits, her mother turns around, which saves her life. Maya's mother then warns Arjun about the storm that is about to hit their lives.

1.name: Maya's New Strategy
1.overview: Saanjh's mother sees her daughter taking care of Maya. She expresses her displeasure to Saanjh, who informs that Maya is the surrogate to her child. Maya overhears this conversation. After they leave the kitchen, Maya mixes a substance in a glass of milk. What is Maya upto this time? Watch this episode to find out.

1.name: Seed of Suspicion
1.overview: Maya claims that Suman tried to kill her. While Suman tries to prove her innocence, Maya succeeds in plating the seed of suspicion in Saanjh's mind but fails to do the same with Arjun. Maya can't fathom the thought that Arjun does not trust her anymore.

1.name: Saanjh's Prank On Arjun
1.overview: Maya's words haunt Arjun and he wakes up from a nightmare. He searches for the Saanjh in the house but does not find her. Everyone suspects that Maya has done something to Saanjh. But, to Arjun's relief, he finds Saanjh outside. This turns out to be a prank played on Arjun. Maya and Arjun head to the clinic to determine if Maya is pregnant. Watch and find out what happens next.

1.name: Maya's Fast
1.overview: Saanjh is worried that Maya and Arjun are nowhere to be found. She is unaware that they are at the clinic to determine whether Maya is pregnant. Maya is relived to know that she is pregnant but Arjun is not happy about it. Then, Maya informs Saanjh that she is observing fast for Arjun.

1.name: Saanjh's Concern
1.overview: Maya informs Saanjh that she wants to apply Mehendi. Arjun is still thinking about Maya's decision to keep fast for him. When Maya sees Arjun with Saanjh, she gets distressed. Will Arjun feed Maya and end her fast? Watch this episode to find out.

1.name: Maya's Rage
1.overview: Arjun makes it clear to Maya that he rejects having loved her. Maya is furious that Arjun thinks about her this way. In anger, Maya takes the car and drives away, forcing Saanjh to follow her. Arjun now has to stop Maya before she hurts herself and his child.

1.name: Maya's Anger
1.overview: Arjun is informed by the doctor that he has to take special care of Maya as any emotional trauma can have adverse effects on the pregnancy. Later, Arjun shouts at Saanjh for not taking care of Maya. Saanjh breaks down but knows that Arjun is taking care of Maya as she is pregnant with her child.

1.name: When Death Comes Knocking
1.overview: Maya's mother claims that Maya tried to kill her, which Maya claims to be an allegation. Maya announces that she will leave the house, unable to bear this humiliation. Will Arjun stop Maya from leaving the house? Watch this episode to find out.

1.name: Maya's Manipulation
1.overview: At the baby shower, Maya and Arjun arrive at their house. Saanjh is disappointed to see Arjun taking care of Maya. Then, Maya informs Saanjh that she wants Arjun in return for giving her the child. Saanjh slaps Maya. Surprisingly, Arjun slaps Saanjh and informs her that she did a mistake by bringing Maya into the house. Then, Maya goes into labor and is rushed to the hospital.

1.name: A New Life is Born
1.overview: The doctor informs Arjun and Saanjh that the delivery has been successful. But, before Arjun and Saanjh can get the time to spend with their daughter, Maya escapes with the newborn. Arjun and Saanjh find Maya and Saanjh decide to speak with her. When Saanjh meets Maya, the latter pulls out a gun on her. Will Arjun save Saanjh at the cost of Maya's life? Watch this episode to find out.

2.name: Maya Sets Her Crosshairs
2.overview: Maya saves Rishi from drowning into the ocean. His father is angry at him for being careless, but Rishi is glad to find the love of his life. Later that day, Maya beats Rudra in fencing and invokes the hatred in his heart for her. Guests start arriving for the anniversary party while Maya solidifies her revengeful plan. Stay Tuned!

2.name: Maya Is Always A Step Ahead
2.overview: Rishi is busy finding Maya's address, and she already knows about it. Meanwhile, MJ gets to know about the article issue raised in Rudra and Ananya's company. MJ offers to help them, but Rudra refuses and leaves the house. Rishi enters Maya's house and finds her standing with a gun in her hand. Stay Tuned!

2.name: MJ Senses The Trouble
2.overview: Maya gets a fire alarm on her phone and rushes back to the house to see that her mother tried to bake her brother's favorite cake, and it got ruined. Meanwhile, MJ finds the rope mark on Rishi's foot and suspects the danger vividly. Next Morning, Rudra sets his mission to sign Maya for their company. Let's see how that goes for him. Stay Tuned!

2.name: Rishi's First Date With Maya
2.overview: Rishi's friends are curious to know about his new crush, and to his surprise, he finds Maya waiting outside the college. On the other hand, Rudra is trying to be apologetic to Ananya for his behaviour and breaks the big news. Meanwhile, MJ is still concerned about the welfare of his sons. Stay Tuned!

2.name: Rudra's Deal With Maya
2.overview: Rudra gets into Rishi's room and takes his cell away as he was busy with that, even he asks Rishi to be careful with the things he is going through. The next morning, Rudra goes out to meet Maya for a deal and she asks him for a dare. Will Rudra be able to comply with the dare? Watch to know more!

2.name: Day 2 Of Rudra's Contract
2.overview: Rudra goes to Vasai to meet Maya for his next task. Meanwhile, MJ had asked Aamir to put a tracker in Rudra's car, and so Aamir follows it to Vasai. But things aren't meant to be that easy when you're competing against Maya. Later, Maya receives a text from Rishi saying he's coming to see her, but Maya has something else in her mind. Stay Tuned!

2.name: Keeping The Fire Alive
2.overview: Maya calls Rishi and asks him to meet where she decides to end things with him. Rishi comes back home and talks with his brother. Rudra helps him understand an important relationship lesson. It's late at night, Rudra is talking to Anu when he gets interrupted by Maya about his next task. Stay Tuned!

2.name: Loyalty, Commitment And Passion
2.overview: Rudra completes the third and final task of Maya's contract, but little did he know about the actuality behind them. The next morning, Maya breaks the news of her becoming their investor to Rudra, which makes him extremely angry, and he leaves the office. Meanwhile, MJ is trying to deceive Ananya to tell him about their new investor. Stay Tuned!

2.name: Journey Of The Hurt
2.overview: MJ is desperate to know the investor of his son's company and gets a hint from Ananya. Rishi comes back disturbed because of his break up and asks for help from the ladies. At the office, Ananya meets Maya and couldn't handle her excitement. She breaks the news to Rudra that MJ has arranged a press conference for Maya. Stay Tuned as Rudra runs down to save Maya.

2.name: Rudra's Feud With MJ
2.overview: Rudra saves Maya from being pecked on by the media. On the other hand, MJ comes over to Rudra's office to meet him. Rudra tells him that he isnt invited there and also indicates the fact that their relationship is over. MJ tries to stop him but Rudra is angry and still upset about something from their past. Later Rudra gets MJ thrown out of his office. Stay tuned!

1.name: Powerplay
1.overview: Zarina Malik, co- owner of the Mumbai Mavericks, races against time to find a new financial partner, or risk losing the team. Meanwhile the team has a young recruit who gets his first taste of the big, bad world of the PPL.

1.name: Bunny
1.overview: Zarina realizes she's made a deal with the devil, while Prashant struggles to adapt to his new surroundings. Vayu finds himself on the brink, needing to make hard decisions in his career and relationships.

1.name: Inner Circle
1.overview: The team is in Chennai to take on their arch rivals, and the hosts and their fans are extremely hostile, with good reason. Meanwhile, a mysterious figure takes stock of the team.

1.name: Wrong Foot
1.overview: The team is at an endorsement shoot. Dhawan's masterplan is close to becoming reality. Vayu makes headway with Meera; Arvind confronts problems closer to home.

1.name: Away Game
1.overview: A forgotten past comes back to haunt Coach Suri. Vayu can't deal with the pressure from the media. Meanwhile, Prashant has been practicing hard; will his efforts pay off?

1.name: Opening Bid
1.overview: It's matchday! Mavericks vs Hurricanes. Dhawan's grand plan is finally coming together. However, the smallest cog in the wheel can upset the best laid plans.

1.name: FoW
1.overview: Things are coming to a head. Zarina, Arvind, Prashant, Vayu all face crises of their own. The pressure is too much, and something has to give…

1.name: Corridor of Uncertainty
1.overview: Dhawan goes into damage control mode as secrets start to spill out, but there is a silver lining for him.

1.name: Hammer Price
1.overview: Arvind's vulnerability triggers a chain reaction. An old friend shows up to advise Zarina. And can Vayu pull himself together at this crucial time?

1.name: Maximum
1.overview: The finals of the PowerPlay League is here. But the question is of the larger game. Who will win?

2.name: Run Up
2.overview: The PowerPlay League is around the corner and even as Bhaisaab steps out of the shadows; Zarina, Handa, Vayu, and Arvind weigh their options. The storm gathers.

2.name: Paddle Sweep
2.overview: The PowerPlay League auctions are underway, the teams competing tooth and nail for the gods of cricket. But the machinations behind the scenes don’t always translate well under pressure in the auction room. All as the fate of the PPL hangs in the balance.

2.name: Hawk-Eye
2.overview: Bhaisaab attempts a novel approach to neutralize the Home Minister’s threat and tempts Zarina with forbidden fruit. Vayu finds that his nemeses are not relegated to other teams alone, but are closer to home.

2.name: Doctored
2.overview: After a surprising turn by Arvind in the opening game against the Mavericks, the players come under the scanner for using performance enhancing drugs. Zarina rethinks her strategy of dealing with her commitments

2.name: Block Hole
2.overview: Bhaisaab must deal with an old adversary lurking in the darkness, while Zarina, Vayu, and Rohini must all make a choice from which there’s no coming back.

2.name: Turn
2.overview: Outmaneuvered, Bhaisaab’s empire is on the verge of annihilation. On the field, Vayu must confront his demons to conquer the present. But it will come at a price he never believed he’d have to pay.

2.name: Yo Yo
2.overview: Arvind and Vayu strive to prove their mettle as captains, but blocking their path is their own teams’ management. Zarina’s indoctrination is complete. Rohini boldly decides to stay in the game.

2.name: Crossing the Line
2.overview: It’s a must-win situation for Arvind’s floundering bits-and-pieces team. Zarina takes matters into her own hands on learning her darkest nightmares are true. And Bhaisaab unleashes his most ruthless avatar yet.

2.name: Four Slips and a Gully
2.overview: A dark night in the gallows brings light to some. Zarina demands her pound of flesh. And Bhaisaab’s carefully laid out plans begin to unravel.

2.name: Switch Hit
2.overview: While the cricketers battle it out on the field in a PPL final in which it’s hard to pick favorites, Bhaisaab belts out his sharpest blows in an all-or-nothing crusade to retain his dominion.

3.name: Domestic Games
3.overview: The Roy Commission is set up to investigate corruption in cricket. In an all out war between Dhawan and Bhaisaab, Zarina Malik is pressured to pick a side.

3.name: Devil's Number
3.overview: An insidious operation is underway to secure the TV broadcast rights in the auctions for the upcoming international series. A revelation from the past threatens to destroy the life that Vayu and Rohini have built.

3.name: Captain's Knock
3.overview: It's the finals of the Wadia Cup and the selectors must choose between Vayu and Rohit as captain of India. Mantra finds her raison d'etre, Rohini sinks deep into her quest of challenging the past.

3.name: Take the Light
3.overview: The Roy Commission comes to a surprising conclusion based on facts from an unexpected source. Vayu and Rohit battle it off the field in the arena of sponsorships.

3.name: Swing and a Miss
3.overview: Mantra goes public with her campaign. Zarina is on the verge of true power, only to be challenged by an unexpected contender at the last minute. The Indian team resents its new rookie.

3.name: Not Quite Cricket
3.overview: It's the first test between India and Pakistan, and the best laid plans...

3.name: Sticky Wicket
3.overview: Mantra is pushed into the corner as she negotiates impossible odds. Match fixing rears its ugly head, but the stakes are a lot more than mere money this time. Imaad's stellar performance in the previous match results in his biggest nightmare coming to life.

3.name: Test
3.overview: The second game against Pakistan is a test in the truest sense, a crucible of interference from the outside as the powers that be activate a game behind the game. The players must battle the opposition on the field and outside of it.

3.name: Castled
3.overview: It's time for scores to be settled. Victory at all costs: using compassion or subterfuge, using words or... bullets.

3.name: Cricket is the Winner
3.overview: As India take on Pakistan in the final test, the gentleman's game is incinerated, giving rise to a new cricketing order from its ashes.

1.name: Peace and War
1.overview: Flight commander Ajay Ahuja is called in to train the Golden Arrows. As the Indo-Pak peace talks begin, General Musharraf considers his next move.

1.name: Sada-e-Sarhad
1.overview: Baldy struggles to get his head in the game, but a unique bonding exercise brings the squad together. As they celebrate, trouble looms in the mountains.

1.name: Safed Sagar
1.overview: General Musharraf and the prime minister lock horns. The Golden Arrows race to uncover the infiltrators, but a shocking incident jolts the squadron.

1.name: Golden Arrows
1.overview: Panic grips the Indian forces as the Kargil War quickly escalates and Ahuja is pulled into peril. Amid nationwide outrage, a plan to fight back emerges.

1.name: Bombs Away
1.overview: A high-altitude bombing strategy brings new challenges for the Golden Arrows. As Dhali grapples with guilt, General Musharraf's plans begin to unravel.

1.name: Line of Control
1.overview: As international pressure mounts, a bold formation tactic could signal a momentous shift as the war reaches a turning point.

1.name: JHANDU
1.overview: A shocking incident at a wedding procession ignites a series of events entangling the lives of two families in the lawless city of Mirzapur.

1.name: GOODA
1.overview: Guddu and Bablu have a life-altering choice to make. Munna gets a lesson in loyalty. A new, diabolical contender for Mirzapur emerges.

1.name: WAFADAR
1.overview: A generation-old rivalry is rekindled.

1.name: VIRGINITY
1.overview: Akhandanand tests the boys' moral fibre, leading them down a path of no return. And Sweety must choose between Munna and Guddu.

1.name: BHAUKAL
1.overview: Guddu and Bablu hatch an ambitious plan to increase the gun trade, but for this, both the cops and criminals of Mirzapur must cooperate.

1.name: BARFI
1.overview: A meeting of the mafia heads of Purvanchal masquerading as a Holi party leads to a fracas' that threatens to transform all equations.

1.name: LIONS OF MIRZAPUR
1.overview: Guddu and Bablu have come into their own in their private and professional lives as gangsters. But is it time for a rethink?

1.name: TANDAV
1.overview: Tempers reach a head between Guddu and Bablu while they're in exile. And it's time for the Mr. Purvanchal contest.

1.name: YOGYA
1.overview: Three generations of Tripathis show the world who they really are.

3.name: Tetua
3.overview: While Ramakant is tried for the murder of SSP Maurya, Guddu and Golu's claim to the throne is questioned because Kaleen Bhaiya's body is missing. Madhuri vows to fulfill her father's mission of a crime free state.

3.name: Mexico
3.overview: Guddu and Golu kickstart the business again, but are still looking for a supply of opium which would allow them to establish control over Purvanchal's underworld. In the hunt for the same control, Sharad tries to crack a deal with one of Guddu's old allies, while Madhuri tries to eliminate Guddu.

3.name: Pratishodh
3.overview: Guddu cements his power over Mirzapur while Sharad finally makes a very strong ally. Golu receives a threat from Bharat. Ramakant turns down Robin's offer and faces danger in prison. Meanwhile Madhuri strategises to bring Guddu down in other ways.

3.name: Kekadaa
3.overview: Ramakant's case is in danger with the appearance of a new witness. In an attempt to save her father's opium business from collapsing, Shabnam turns to Guddu for help. Meanwhile Golu gets some much awaited information about the still missing Kaleen Bhaiya.

3.name: Traahi
3.overview: Golu plans an attack outside Mirzapur without Guddu. Guddu returns from Nepal to find Golu missing. Sharad senses something is amiss in Siwan and decides to shift his most guarded secret to Jaunpur.

3.name: Bhasmasur
3.overview: Purvanchal is set ablaze with a gang war between Sharad and Guddu. Madhuri makes strong decisions to break the police-gangster nexus, while a ghost from the past resurfaces. Ramakant finds a purpose in prison, which catches Lala's attention.

3.name: Bum-pilaat
3.overview: Purvanchal is thrown into turmoil following the shocking incident in the jail. Dadda confronts his son, while Sharad and Bharat have a fallout as well. A baithak is called to resolve the gang feud.

3.name: Raja Beta
3.overview: Guddu goes down a dark downward spiral as he loses people close to him. A new judge is assigned before Ramakant's final hearing. Meanwhile, Saloni discovers her husband's secrets. IG Dubey is reinstated and is tasked with one mission: Capturing Guddu Pandit.

3.name: Ansh
3.overview: Beena is compelled to find safety after the fall of Guddu. Madhuri urges Sharad to let go of the past for a better future. Will Shatrughan be able to convince Saloni to keep his secret? A broken Dimpy wants to take matters into her own hands.

3.name: Pratibimbh
3.overview: Golu returns to Mirzapur only to discover the chaos that ensued in her absence. Madhuri inaugurates Aam Bagh despite the threat of JP Yadav looming large. As Dussehra closes in, there is only one question: Who will ascend the throne of Mirzapur?

1.name: Episode 1
1.overview: After their newborn disappears from the hospital, Anvita and Alok receive disturbing birthday packages each year that keep the search alive.

1.name: Episode 2
1.overview: A potential lead forces Anvita to question her search for her missing daughter. Meanwhile, Madhu escalates her efforts to halt the investigation.

1.name: Episode 3
1.overview: Anvita's suspicions grow as she examines an old photo for clues, while her visions intensify. A mysterious death raises flags for Inspector Khurana.

1.name: Episode 4
1.overview: An unexpected confession adds a new layer to the case. Apeksha's birthday party is thrown into turmoil when Anvita makes a shocking accusation.

1.name: Episode 5
1.overview: A threatening message deepens the rift between Anvita and Alok while she seeks crucial evidence. The police track down a woman tied to Rhea's birth.

1.name: Episode 6
1.overview: As the mystery behind Anvita's hallucinations unravels, Madhu finds herself cornered. A tragic incident disrupts the investigation.

1.name: Episode 7
1.overview: Shreya's revelation begins to connect the pieces of Apeksha's disappearance as the truth finally comes to light.

1.name: Arranged Family
1.overview: Nikhil's visit to his in-laws turns disastrous.  His blunder angers Prakash.  Can they mend their relationship?

1.name: The Mad House
1.overview: Car wrecked. Blame shifted. Well-meaning attempts at fixing things fail spectacularly.

1.name: Conditions Apply
1.overview: Family fun turns tense. Will Nikhil handle the relatives' prying questions at the Sharma anniversary?

1.name: Stuck In The Middle
1.overview: Anita's parents disapprove of Nikhil. A silent treatment ensues, leaving Nikhil to navigate family conflict and a new job offer.

1.name: Home Sweet Home
1.overview: Father-in-law's emergency forces Nikhil's hand. Family reunion triggers a long-overdue confession.

2.name: Fresh Start
2.overview: In-laws visit tests Anita's relationship with Nikhil's family. Will she succeed?

2.name: Surprise, Surprise!
2.overview: Anita's awkwardness reaches new heights as her parents join her at a raucous comedy show. The night surprises her, but a fresh twist awaits at home.

2.name: Spilling The Beans
2.overview: Mum-in-law's wisdom, a family secret, and an 80th birthday trip.

2.name: Something's Missing
2.overview: Shreya's shocking revelation throws the Solanki family into turmoil as they head to Hasmukhbhai's birthday. But a surprise guest awaits, ready to disrupt the celebrations.

2.name: House Of Cards
2.overview: With the unexpected arrival of Jason at the party, Shreya is caught completely unawares. As rumour mills at the Solanki household start to churn, the party has only just begun.

2.name: Home
2.overview: The Solankis are back in Mumbai, still wounded from their explosive fight at Hasmukhbhai's birthday. Shreya and Nikhil are estranged, leaving Anita caught in the middle.

3.name: Circle Of Life
3.overview: The Solankis and Sharmas are back with another season, come join them as they navigate new milestones in the journey that is life. Thodi takraar, dah-sanskaar aur dher saara pyaar!

3.name: Not Kidding
3.overview: Nikhil and Anita continue their journey towards what might or might not be parenthood. Vandana becomes aware of some hard decisions that Kiran wants to take. Shreya and Sudha discover different flavours and facets of solitude. #DiceWTF3

3.name: Here We Go Again
3.overview: A day out to the arcade sees the folks bond together on the topic of Nikhil and Anita's 'future', leaving them cornered. Meanwhile, Shreya sets out to sort her personal and professional life...to interesting results.

3.name: Zor Se Bolo
3.overview: An old acquaintance surprises Nikhil and Anita, who find themselves babysitting an adult. Vandana and Kiran discuss the repercussions of the family dinner as Sudha asserts her dominance on the road. Shreya tries to get everyone together for a truce.

3.name: That's All Folks
3.overview: The folks come back together for Shreya’s house-warming party. Nikhil tries to break the tension between him and Kiran as Anita attempts reaching out to Sudha. Shreya and Balan sense what was in front of them for a while. We arrive at yet another milestone in their lives, but do they know, what is about to come their way? Find out in this season finale. That’s All Folks!

3.name: Diwali Special - Ghar Wali Diwali
3.overview: Sudha finds herself alone on Diwali before she is greeted by a surprise visitor: Anita. The mother and daughter duo spends the festival of lights like it's meant to be: with a healthy serving of food, gossip, and rangoli.

4.name: Truth Bombs
4.overview: The Sharmas are back for one last season. While Nikhil & Anita have some important news to share with the family at dinner, Akshata decides to drop a few bombs too! Will Sudha & Prakash be onboard with their children’s decisions or will they resist?

4.name: The Damaad Test
4.overview: Sudha and Prakash are determined to find out whether Sid is the right choice for their daughter, Akshata. They convince Nikhil to host a dinner for the new couple and secretly “test” the new damaad. What starts off as a casual dinner with laughter, eventually turns into a disaster when Akshata finds out what her parents are upto. Will she forgive her parents and will the family accept Sid?

4.name: Ladkiwale Vs. Ladkewale
4.overview: The Sharmas finally meet the Bhats, and the families quickly realise that they have very different approaches to life and parenting. Amidst the chaos, Anita and Nikhil's adoption agent pays them a surprise visit. Will the Sharmas handle both situations smoothly, or will they blow up under pressure?

4.name: Are We Ready?
4.overview: The wedding preparations have begun! While Akshata and Prakash don’t see eye to eye on the wedding planning, Sudha decides to step back and let go from making decisions for her children. With two weeks to go for the wedding, Anita and Sid start questioning some of their major life decisions.

4.name: What The Future? (Series Finale)
4.overview: In the season finale, celebrations are in full swing and the family gets emotional. Anita questions whether she is ready to become a mother, and Sid makes a decision about his future. Find out what happens?

1.name: Ambitious. Prude. Feminist. Slut.
1.overview: Damini has a battle to fight with her board of directors and an itch that won't go away. All hinges on the final hearing of a crucial court case which is in Anjana's hands. Anjana has to deal with a new entrant in Arya's life. Siddhi's mother makes Siddhi's marriage resume her personal project. Umang has a confrontation with a sweaty client at work which leaves her mortified. It’s disaster week!

1.name: Strong Girls Don't Break.
1.overview: Along with being schooled on feminism and dealing with an irregular cycle, Damini finds herself being surprisingly open with Jeh. Anjana finally meets Varun's new girlfriend and has an allergic reaction to her. Siddhi goes on a blind date set up by her mother that ends in a climactic manner. A gym client can't seem to keep his hands to himself but Umang gives him a lesson he'll never forget.

1.name: Long Way From Ludhiana.
1.overview: Umang gets a new private training client who leaves her tongue-tied. Miss VeeVee makes an appearance to help Anjana feel better. Damini gets trolled and has to deal with a new hire at work. Jeh comes to her rescue with a new 'pet' project. Sneha takes a drastic step to get Siddhi in shape. Siddhi makes a new bestie but his idea of being open and free isn't exactly what Siddhi has in mind.

1.name: Ex Why Zzz
1.overview: Anjana has her hands full with Amma, Kavya, a toddler birthday party and an inflexible boss. Varun is moving on but can she? Siddhi's got cam-girl on her mind but isn't sure if she can take the next step. Samara and Umang take their work-outs to the next level. Akanksha takes charge and Damini loses control. Can Kutta and Jeh be her salvation?

1.name: Love Her. Hate Her.
1.overview: Siddhi and Sneha's strained relationship comes to a head when Sneha gets a nasty surprise at a baby shower. Miss VeeVee is excited for her first 'meet and greet' and Anjana is desperate to rein her in. Umang and Samara take the next big step in their relationship. Damini has a breakdown but the doctor is there with the right medicine.

1.name: Fuck This Bar.
1.overview: Flashback to three years ago, when the girls met for the very first time. Things have changed yet remained the same. Memories and nostalgia help the girls take stock of their lives and make certain decisions in their present.

1.name: Gone Girls.
1.overview: A surprise birthday, a bonding trip and a music fest-- the girls take on Goa. Old loves, new loves and lost loves are all on the cards. But sometimes too much partying can lead to unintended consequences, especially when you don't remember what exactly happened the night before!

1.name: Fam-Jam-Wham-Bam
1.overview: The girls have to deal with what happened the night before. Siddhi is suffering from the MALV syndrome. Anjana isn't quite sure what to do with Arjun. Umang is adrift not knowing where her relationship stands and Damini gets some nasty news that she can't deal with. And to top it all off-- there are those three men to deal with.

1.name: Reality Bites.
1.overview: It's Diwali. A new year and new beginnings. Damini and Jeh are sending some good vibrations to the world and the troll story gains traction. Varun meets Arjun for the first time, Mihir has a surprise for Siddhi and Umang has to deal with unexpected visitors. Fireworks aren't the only thing that will be exploding tonight.

1.name: Dancing on the Edge
1.overview: When your world spirals out of control, the only thing to do is to hang on as desperately as you can. And that's what Damini, Anjana, Siddhi and Umang need to do. Relationships and friendships are put to the test with decisions to be taken, fires to be put out and fall-outs to be dealt with. All isn't well. All might not end well.

2.name: Together Forever?
2.overview: The four girls reunite when a crisis hits one of them and they reconcile in the beautiful city of Istanbul. They make promises of everlasting friendship and catch up on all that has happened in their lives in the past few months. Will they also go back to Truck Bar or will they find another spot to hangout?

2.name: Love Is A 4-Letter Word.F@#k Lust Hate Loss Fate
2.overview: Damini is juggling her writer's block and her relationship with Jeh. Anjana has cold feet since Arjun is getting serious about their relationship and dealing with a misogynist senior. Umang chances upon Samara's public breakdown and feels an intense urge to meet her. Siddhi is trying to prove her worth, gets into an interesting repartee with a comedian. Will Anjana and Umang find their closure?

2.name: Spring Cleaning
2.overview: True to it's name, this episode is about cleaning and mending old wounds. Umang is trying her best to be Samara's emotional support by putting her together bit by bit. Anjana's senior is now brash with his misogyny which makes her quit her firm. Viju eventually confronts Siddhi about the controversy and Sneha defends her. Damini clears some mental cobwebs and finds the drive to write.

2.name: Hell Bent!
2.overview: An episode of determination and grit. Damini finally finishes her book and tries to pitch it to various publishers. Siddhi performs her first stand up with Amit. Anjana meets another lawyer who is her equal in intellect and they strike upon an electrifying chemistry. Umang finally persuades Samara to lift herself up which leads to Samara accepting a certain repressed emotion.

2.name: Love Is In The Air
2.overview: While trying to avoid love, the girls fall into a complex cycle of relationships. Varun is seeking solace in Anjana's company, she doesn't know why. Siddhi is taken into Amit's world. A distraught Damini involuntarily ends up seeking her answers from Jeh who comes up with a brilliant plan for her. Is Samara finally coming out of the closet to claim her love or will she still hide?

2.name: Crossroads
2.overview: An episode of dilemma and decisions. #Umara has started trending on social media but is Umang's popularity making Samara insecure? Jeh and Damini have hit a sweet spot and are seeing more of each other. But she is in for an unforeseen shock. Siddhi starts seeing a pattern. Anjana is offered to be a part of Shashank's firm. Will she accept the offer despite the slippery slope that she is on?

2.name: Step Into The Light
2.overview: The Drama never ends just gets convoluted. Anjana cannot contain her attraction to Shashank and is basking in the thrill of their relationship. Umang and Samara are now a team. Siddhi invites her father for her show. Will that help them resolve their differences? Will Damini be able to control her life this time or will she have to just go with the flow? The episode ends with a sweet surprise.

2.name: Hooking Up And Breaking Up
2.overview: When all starts going well, one has to be careful. Samara is taking over the planning and preparations, leaving Umang perturbed. Shashank and Anjana fight it out at work as a formidable team. Will this chemistry transition from professional to personal? Amit wants commitment but does Siddhi want to be anyone’s girlfriend yet? A certain thought leads Damini to Jeh. Will she tell him the truth?

2.name: Noughts And Crosses
2.overview: The wedding has begun! But not without complications of the heart. Damini's panic attack makes Warsi invite himself for the wedding. Umang is on the brink of a meltdown with how the wedding has become a media circus. Siddhi has a surprise visitor at Udaipur. Anjana has some truths to face. There are games, dancing, photo shoots, break ups, and a whole lot of chaos.

2.name: The One
2.overview: The season finale is an all-emotional roller coaster ride. The girls are finding themselves amidst all the debris of shattered hearts and broken souls. Anjana faces Sushmita's brunt. Siddhi chooses to move away from home but gets a rude shock in the end. Damini has a complication in her pregnancy. Samara and Umang walk down the aisle, but is this wedding too good to be true?

3.name: Of love, loss and everything in between.
3.overview: Siddhi bids farewell to Viju in the most beautiful way. Six months pass and her words dry up. Damini is trying very to be a serious journalist and find domestic bliss with Jeh. Anjana finds herself in the middle of Arya's Happy Family fantasy and Umang feels the urge to make her family happy again. Will the impromptu trip to Ludhiana help Umang find a place in her father's heart?

3.name: Gulaal.
3.overview: Umang wants to build her own fitness studio. Anjana can't wrap her head around Arya's pre-teen tantrums. Damini is feral and wild, just not with Jeh. Siddhi sees red while trying to be Sneha's armour. A holi party where secrets spill out in nooks and corners, where drunk confessions are made and where an entrepreneur is born. Will the storm calm down when the bhaang wears off the next morning?

3.name: We are fine.
3.overview: The aftermath of a high is not always a low. The girls have learnt to deal with all the lemons that life throws at them. Anjana is calmly dealing with Varun being at her house now. Siddhi is the new boss in town. Damini finds herself being challenged and irked. Umang will need some help being honest with her friend. Will they find the perfect place for the fitness studio of her dreams?

3.name: Sparks fly.
3.overview: UMAMI fitness studio opens to much fanfare and Umang finally has her own place in the city. Anjana is the unwillingly referee between Varun and Kavya. Damini is not giving Jeh the space that he needs despite making space for him at her house. Siddhi finds herself on stage with a former lover turned adversary. Will she take to the mic and unleash her grief or will she continue bottling it up?

3.name: Leap of faith.
3.overview: Samara's fans make Umang's life miserable, but she finds a friend in one of her studio recruits. Siddhi's first show is met with a solitary laugh instead of a roaring applause. Arya loves her parents being under the same roof, flaunts it even. Damini dons the role of a campaign manager with complete zest. Will Jeh understand Damini's priorities? Will Siddhi allow Sneha to make a friend?

3.name: When love is gone.
3.overview: Umang and Meher are in a whirlwind of passion but is Umang being the saviour again? Anjana gets rudely reminded that she can't play happy family with a family that is not hers. Damini loses her grip on Jeh, feels lost and pulls him to her, tighter than before. Will she realise that the threads of their relationship are fraying? Will Umang break her own heart or someone else's?

3.name: Mirror Mirror on the wall.
3.overview: A thunderstorm is brewing, lightning and all. Jeh moves in but maybe Damini doesn’t want him anymore? Varun wants to go back to Kavya but maybe Anjana is not ready to let him leave her home and heart? Siddhi rebelled against growing up but maybe she will have to? Umang feels like she is back to square one, maybe she needs a new path? Will this grand birthday party save them from the storm?

3.name: Birthday Bumps.
3.overview: The sky is different and so is the mood. It’s time to celebrate. Treasure hunts with tiaras, picnics by the lake, some caustic remarks, some hidden secrets spilled out, this is how Siddhi’s 25th birthday is brought in. While there is cake at this birthday, it does not end up leaving a sweet aftertaste. Will the bruised hearts heal each other or will they end up in scabs?

3.name: Games people play.
3.overview: The getaway is coming to an end and peace hasn't been restored yet. Siddhi apologises to Sneha and breaks down in Mihir's arms. Umang needs to wrap her head around all her swirling feelings. Anjana is drawn to the happy family that she can finally have. Damini and Dhananjay make a good team. Will Shashank finally let go of his grudge? Will Jeh break his own heart this time to understand Damini's?

3.name: The good in goodbye.
3.overview: One needs to say goodbye to the broken pieces. Damini watches Jeh move out of her home and life. Siddhi and Sneha grieve together.Umang breaks down and breaks up. Anjana realizes that she does not need Varun to have her own happy family. Umang’s closures, Siddhi’s airport chase, Damini’s cocoon and Anjana letting go. Will their safe space get demolished? Will the New Year bring in new hope?

1.name: All that glitters is gold
1.overview: Tara Khanna and Karan Mehra have landed the biggest wedding in Delhi. Angad Roshan, heir to the Roshan Cycles empire, is marrying Aliya Saxena, a journalist. For the Roshans, something is definitely amiss. Tara and Karan must investigate who Aliya really is, or there might not be a wedding at all. No better way to start the wedding season.

1.name: Star struck lovers
1.overview: Harsimran Mann, a Dubai princess, is marrying Joginder Sethi, of the Sethi Hotel Group. Made In Heaven has planned for Harsimran’s favorite Bollywood superstar Sarfaraz Khan to headline the first night. With a Mann-Sethi business deal on the line, this wedding has a lot more riding on it than meets the eye. And with Sarfaraz in attendance, the bride has nothing but stars in her eyes.

1.name: It’s never too late
1.overview: Gayatri Mathur, a sixty-plus widow, is marrying Bijoy Chatterjee, a Bengali architect. It’s a distinctively sweet union that has everyone’s support except the people that matter most - her children. On the flip side, Karan’s college friend Bubbles is getting married to man that Karan knows a bit better than he would have hoped.

1.name: The price of love
1.overview: Priyanka Mishra is marrying Vishal Shrivastava, an IAS officer and the plan is to fund the wedding themselves. The Mishras are disappointed that they can’t splurge on their only daughter’s wedding till their in-laws find a way to change that. Can Karan and Tara balance the parents and the kids?

1.name: A marriage of convenience
1.overview: Sukhmani Sadana wins a contest that will determine who marries Jeet Gill, a wealthy NRI. The promise of an American life as an American wife is a big deal for a Ludhiana girl. Tara and Karan know that this isn’t a prestigious destination wedding for Made in Heaven, but one must do what is required in the given circumstances. After all, it is what it is.

1.name: Something old, something new
1.overview: Geetanjali Sinha, a Wharton graduate, is marrying Nikhil Swarup, a doctor residing in London. A wedding so straightforward couldn’t have come at a better time. That is, of course, until it turns out that Geetanjali is a manglik. Tara and Karan aren’t in the best space to negotiate between superstition and logic.

1.name: A royal affair
1.overview: Samar Ranawat, a Rajput prince, is marrying Devyani Singh, a pilot making her the first working woman in the royal household. A lavish celebration of progress and woman empowerment is interrupted when a mehendiwali is sexually assaulted during an event. Tara and Karan need to get the girl justice while making sure the show goes on.

1.name: Pride and bridezilla
1.overview: Tarana Ali is getting married and is using the opportunity to make a music video for herself. Her father has gone into debt. On the flip side, the peon at the Made In Heaven office is bailed out by Tara and Karan from taking a loan to fund his daughter’s wedding. Rich or poor, nothing seems to be more important to a man’s ego than how he gets daughter married.

1.name: The great escape
1.overview: Political party leader Brajesh Yadav’s daughter, Nutan Yadav is marrying Vishal Singh, a man groomed to be the next prime minister. Everyone knows this wedding is merely a front for the political coalition but when Tara and Karan uncover a harsh truth, they must decide between their principles and their business.

2.name: Mirror mirror on the wall
2.overview: A grand colonial-themed wedding is at hand. But when the groom discovers the bride’s attempts at skin lightening, it looks like the marriage is off the table.

2.name: Beauty and the beast
2.overview: Anik and Adhira seem very much in love. But what lies beneath Anik’s charm and confidence? And what is the real story behind Adhira’s chipped tooth?

2.name: And they lived happily ever after
2.overview: Kriti and Gulshan decide to sacrifice their once-in-a-lifetime kind of love for the sake of their children who are now engaged. But are their children really in love?

2.name: Love story
2.overview: A Bollywood wedding in France is destined to have a lot of drama. But is this love story all it’s cracked up to be?

2.name: The heart skipped a beat
2.overview: A Dalit Buddhist wedding rankles the traditional notions of the groom’s family while a young boy struggles to come to terms with his mother’s second marriage.

2.name: Warrior princesses
2.overview: A woman watches as her husband takes in a second wife while a lesbian couple wonder if a celebration can take place without their family support.

2.name: A taste of heaven
2.overview: A couple with a ten-year age difference overcome all familial objections to get together. But are all obstacles surmountable?

1.name: Episode 1
1.overview: After two victims of a brutal crime are found on a roadside, DCP Vartika Chaturvedi assigns only her most trusted officers to lead the investigation.

1.name: Episode 2
1.overview: With few leads to go on, Vartika's team focuses on identifying the exact bus where the crime occurred. Media leaks trigger backlash against the police.

1.name: Episode 3
1.overview: Disturbing details about the night of the crime emerge when bus driver Jai Singh is interrogated further. The hunt begins for his five accomplices.

1.name: Episode 4
1.overview: The fourth suspect is captured. As public outrage mounts, Vartika and Commissioner Kumar Vijay must defend the police against rumors of misconduct.

1.name: Episode 5
1.overview: The pursuit of the final two suspects escalates. Vartika must manage the team’s anger, her child’s fears and her own guilt. Kumar faces irate activists.

1.name: Episode 6
1.overview: Male victim Akash is tempted to speak to the media, to Vartika’s dismay. The chief minister continues with his mission to take down Vartika and Kumar.

1.name: Episode 7
1.overview: The fifth suspect surprises the police. Protests outside Parliament become riots. The search for the final suspect leads to a chase in Naxal territory.

2.name: Episode 1
2.overview: Vartika and her team are alerted about a gruesome quadruple murder. Evidence points to a crime syndicate not seen in the city for 20 years.

2.name: Episode 2
2.overview: After another murder, veteran inspector Viren Chaddha joins the team. As case details leak to the press, Vartika suspects an informant among the police.

2.name: Episode 3
2.overview: The team's investigation of two suspects leads to eye-opening findings. Amid pressure to appease the media and the public, Vartika faces a moral dilemma.

2.name: Episode 4
2.overview: Against a ticking clock, Vartika takes the case in a new direction. Neeti finds a common link between the murders. Another tip-off leads to a suspect.

2.name: Episode 5
2.overview: The team finds the suspects' hideout. But with Lata still missing, Vartika must determine if she's running or hiding — and finally uncover her story.

3.name: Episode 1
3.overview: After her transfer to Assam, Vartika unearths a network smuggling young women to Delhi under the guise of jobs. Neeti probes an injured baby's case.

3.name: Episode 2
3.overview: Vartika's investigation uncovers deeper connections as Khushi reveals startling truths about Baby Noor. Kalyani's court hearing takes a shocking turn.

3.name: Episode 3
3.overview:
Rahul's confessions about working with Kalyani help the team draw links to the bride trade.

Neeti and Simran edge closer to the missing mother's location.

3.name: Episode 4
3.overview: The hunt for Shabnam intensifies, revealing fresh leads. Kusum gets bail and meets Meena. A deeper probe into the Santro car lands Simran in trouble.

3.name: Episode 5
3.overview: As Vartika's meeting with Mithul Khanna goes awry, Shabnam has a tearful reunion with her children. Neeti searches for her missing colleague.

3.name: Episode 6
3.overview: Shaken by tragic news, the team races to find the missing women as Vartika's career hangs in the balance. Will they catch Meena before all hope is lost?

1.name: The Family Man
1.overview: Srikant Tiwari, a member of TASC, a discreet intelligence agency, is assigned to interrogate suspected ISIS recruits. Balancing his personal life with work becomes a challenge for this family man, and things get out of hand on both fronts.

1.name: Sleepers
1.overview: A scooter bomb goes off at Kala Ghoda. Srikant learns about a mission called Zulfiqar. Suspects in the blast case tell him about a drop box near Victoria College. He arranges for round-the-clock surveillance at the drop box location.

1.name: Anti-National
1.overview: When he finds out that one of the hospitalised prisoners is part of Mission Zulfiqar, Srikant interrogates the prisoner’s friend, Moosa, about it. Someone called Kareem has used the dropbox. TASC monitors Kareem’s hostel room, but Kareem gives them the slip.

1.name: Patriots
1.overview: TASC is in a quandary. They fear Kareem and his men have a devious plan. They get to Kareem’s car, only to realise that things are not what they seem.

1.name: Pariah
1.overview: ISI agent Sameer sends the Kala Ghoda bomber to Kashmir to execute Mission Zulfiqar. Srikant is ‘punished’ and sent to Kashmir, but when his boss, Kulkarni, tells him it was planned, Srikant starts digging into Zulfiqar.

1.name: Dance of Death
1.overview: Srikant discovers that he’s been after the wrong suspect all this time.

1.name: Paradise
1.overview: Srikant searches for Sajid at a wedding in Baramulla. Pakistan’s PM finds out about Zulfiqar and tries to stop it.

1.name: Act of War
1.overview: Srikant helps CIA locate Faizan, a wanted man hiding in Balochistan. Srikant slips into Pakistan to interrogate Faizan.

1.name: Fighting Dirty
1.overview: Srikant tries to thwart a plan to smuggle nerve gas canisters from Kashmir into Delhi.

1.name: The Bomb
1.overview: TASC realises that Mission Zulfiqar is not over. There is a Plan B. And it has already been put to action.

2.name: Exile
2.overview: Srikant Tiwari has started a new life as an IT employee, but he can't stay away from adventure when JK is sent to Chennai to nab a former foreign insurgent. Chennai TASC agent, Muthu and JK are faced with a hostage situation in Chennai. And Dhriti may have a boyfriend.

2.name: Weapon
2.overview: Suchitra wants Srikant to go for couple counselling. Prime Minister Basu wants to make up for India's recent foreign policy faux pas. Bhaskaran activates an elite unit with Major Sameer's help. A creep harasses Raji.

2.name: Angel of Death
2.overview: Suchitra's birthday dinner triggers a showdown between Srikant and Suchitra. Srikant quits his IT job and joins back TASC. Raji's boss is onto her secret life and blackmails her.

2.name: Eagle
2.overview: Srikant starts investigating in Chennai. Sajid teams up with Selva and Raji. Wonder who they are targeting! Inspector Umayal starts investigating Nanda's disappearance.

2.name: Homecoming
2.overview: Inspector Umayal wants to join the TASC team in their mission. All roads lead to the old base.

2.name: Martyrs
2.overview: Srikant and team manage to nab Raji. But they find out the hard way that they are way in over their heads. TASC suffers a tragic loss.

2.name: Collateral Damage
2.overview: Raji is injured days before the D-Day and needs treatment. Simmering tensions between Suchitra and Dhriti hit a crescendo. Sajid bids adieu to Raji, for he has another, personal mission to accomplish in Mumbai. Meanwhile, Srikant is hit by another debilitating personal crisis.

2.name: Vendetta
2.overview: The hunt is on for Dhriti. Meanwhile, JK and Muthu decide to check out Tigris Aviation, and walk into a trap. Dhriti's loss of innocence is gruesome.

2.name: The Final Act
2.overview: News about JK forces Srikant to rush back to Chennai. Raji hears about Sajid's fate. Dhriti finds out the true nature of Srikant's job. Prime Minister Basu reaches Chennai for bilateral talks with the Lankan President, Rupatunga. Srikant and team race against time to prevent a deadly attack on the two premiers.

3.name: The Peace Problem
3.overview: Explosions send tremors across the Northeast, shaking Prime Minister Basu’s peace agenda. As Srikant and Kulkarni step into fragile negotiations with wary Naga leaders, enemies within and beyond the borders lurk in the shadows, armed with deadly intent.

3.name: It's Personal
3.overview: Recovering from a deadly ambush, Srikant traces the trail to an elusive Rukma, unaware that his pursuit has already drawn the gaze of Meera and her powerful backers abroad. As the hunt turns violent, lives are lost, allegiances tested, and Srikant is pulled deeper and deeper into a dangerous game.

3.name: Wanted Man
3.overview: As a smear campaign engulfs his family, Srikant faces crumbling trust at home and rising threats outside. With no end in sight and his family caught in the storm, he makes a drastic choice that changes everything. Meanwhile, Rukma struggles with a responsibility he cannot escape.

3.name: Don’t Worry Be Happy
3.overview: As Srikant and his family flee deeper into the Northeast, Yatish and Zoya close in with their team. In Kohima, Rukma forces young Bobby into a deadly mission, turning the Prime Minister’s peace rally into the stage for his most dangerous strike yet.

3.name: Crossing The Line
3.overview: Under fire after the Kohima blast, PM Basu authorises a high-risk strike across the border. Rukma and Meera forge a treacherous alliance in Myanmar to set their dangerous plan in motion. Srikant gets a lead from a source that spirals into chaos.

3.name: With Friends Like You...
3.overview: Fallout from the failed Myanmar strike rattles PM Basu’s leadership in Delhi. Srikant uncovers Rukma’s link to Meera. As hidden moles and betrayals surface, Zoya intercepts a plot against Srikant’s family. The battle between truth and deception reaches its breaking point.

3.name: Endgame
3.overview: As PM Basu gets ready for war, Srikant plunges into hostile territory where traps and betrayals wait at every turn. With Rukma closing in for revenge and Meera slipping further from reach, shifting allegiances and hidden agendas push Srikant toward a brutal reckoning that could change everything.

1.name: Shonan
1.overview: An introverted old man (Old Sodhi) has come to visit his sister (Urmila) and her family, Subhash (Urmila’s son) and Amar (Subhash’s son) in Singapore. In an intervention by his older sister, Old Sodhi is catapulted into his past, the war of ’42, the past he was running away from. He narrates the controversial outcome of the Battle of Singapore and fate of the soldiers of the British Indian Army.

1.name: POW
1.overview: After surrendering, the fate of the soldiers depended on the mercy of the Japanese Army. The Indian soldiers transformed when Netaji gave the call to form the Indian National Army. Maya, an aspiring photographer, is driven to join this freedom army. Sodhi and Arshad realise that India is their motherland and that they have to fight to free her from British raj.

1.name: Chalo Dilli
1.overview: Maya and Rasammah enroll in the women’s regiment. Rajan and many other civilians also enroll in the INA. Rigorous training sessions begin for all the recruits. In 1996, Amar reaches Burma with Old Sodhi and they meet Rani (Amar’s Burmese friend). Circumstances lead to Old Sodhi shooting a Burmese soldier which paves way for a chain reaction of dangerous events.

1.name: Harakiri
1.overview: Maya and Sodhi along with the INA soldiers do not give hope even after their trains are bombed by planes. Old Sodhi finds himself in Rangoon that leads to an array of past events - the struggles of the Indian soldiers and the rains that destroyed everything. Under such a situation, the Japanese were ordered to retreat.

1.name: Maya
1.overview: There is an attack on the advanced base camp by the British Air Force but that doesn't deter the soldiers from marching ahead to stop the British from advancing. Sodhi orders all the wounded to retreat along with the Rani Jhansi Regiment. Old Sodhi injures his leg in the jungle and is unable to walk any further. Amar leaves with Rani to get help but are stopped on the tracks by a loud blast.

1.name: Kaagaz Ke Phool
1.overview: When a set of R&AW officials are asked to create an audit report of Himmat Singh’s "miscellaneous" expenses, a nineteen-year-old theory finally sees a glimmer of light.

1.name: Guide
1.overview: The 26/11 terror attack moves the nation and one link leads to the next, guiding Himmat and team closer to their target.

1.name: Mughal-E-Azam
1.overview: Shipping business tycoon, Hafiz Ali shows the aftermath of a betrayal. The nineteen-year-old saga begins to set the stage for a mammoth reveal.

1.name: Hum Kisi Se Kam Nahin
1.overview: Four assets and four tasks. Himmat’s team is challenged to test their mettle and see if they are ready for the storm coming their way.

1.name: Chaudvin Ka Chand
1.overview: Farooq’s long wait comes to an end and he's face-to-face with Hafiz. Baku is added to the Special Ops map and new players are revealed.

1.name: Qurbani
1.overview: Farooq's just a few feet away from the mastermind behind 2001 Parliament attack and yet again it’s a touch and go situation for Himmat. Time for a setback. Time for a sacrifice.

1.name: Shatranj Ke Khiladi
1.overview: Hafiz smells a mole and Himmat finds a pawn. Mind games help Farooq to survive another day.

1.name: Sholay
1.overview: Showdown! The country is under an imminent attack and time is running out. Finally, Himmat comes face to face with his nemesis.

2.name: Friday
2.overview: AI scientist Dr Bhargav's abduction from a tech summit and a senior R&AW officer's killing in Delhi push Himmat Singh to realise the beginning of a silent war.

2.name: Saturday
2.overview: Probing Chaddha and Banerjee, Himmat learns about Shekhawat's mission. Subramanyam pressures Himmat to grab a bank defaulter. Farooq goes to Athens to locate another AI scientist.

2.name: Sunday
2.overview: Avinash finds a critical lead in Budapest. Himmat learns that the attacks are part of a covert cyber war by China and a larger digital offensive designed to destabilise India.

2.name: Monday
2.overview: Avinash and Juhi head to Dominica to trace Jignesh Dholakia, who Subramanyam wants arrested at any cost. Meanwhile, Himmat's daughter, Pari, finds long-buried secrets.

2.name: Tuesday
2.overview: As the web tightens, Himmat suspects a mole within, which leads him to the Collector. Meanwhile, Abbas is tasked with digging into Subramanyam.

2.name: Wednesday
2.overview: Himmat pieces together the identity of Sudheer Awasthi, who is pulling the strings of the imminent cyber warfare. Later, he finds the mole leaking internal information.

2.name: Thursday
2.overview: With the clock ticking and the nation hanging by a thread, Himmat and his core squad brace themselves before Sudheer's final phase goes live with the help of Dr Bhargav.

1.name: Gram Panchayat Phulera
1.overview: An unwilling Abhishek Tripathi reaches Phulera to join as panchayat secretary of the village panchayat office. However, his first day at work turns out to be far worse than what he imagined.

1.name: Bhootha Ped
1.overview: As frequent power cuts hamper Abhishek's CAT preparation, he decides to take the matter in his own hands. Little did he know what he's up against.

1.name: Chakke Wali Kursi
1.overview: To make his life easier Abhishek buys a new comfortable chair, which has "wheels". In the process, he unknowingly ends up disrupting the panchayat office's power balance.

1.name: Hamara Neta Kaisa Ho?
1.overview: Under severe pressure to implement a government scheme, Abhishek pushes Pradhan Ji to make an extremely unpopular move. Will Pradhan Ji bow?

1.name: Computer Nahi Monitor
1.overview: Bored with his mundane life, Abhishek decides to have a little bit of fun. But sometimes with great fun comes grave consequence.

1.name: Bahot Hua Samman
1.overview: To focus on his studies, Abhishek decides to put aside his ego. But for how long?

1.name: Ladka Tez Hai Lekin..
1.overview: Finally, the much-awaited CAT exam is around the corner. As Abhishek juggles between his work and studies, Pradhan Ji sees him as a potential groom for his daughter. Is he the right choice?

1.name: Jab Jaago Tabhi Savera
1.overview: Demotivated by his performance in CAT, Abhishek tries to come at peace with his reality. However, motivation comes to him in the most unexpected way.

2.name: Naach
2.overview: Abhishek tries to save a deal derailed by an overenthusiastic Manju Devi. Prahlad and Vikas struggle with their doubts about Abhishek and Rinki.

2.name: Bol Chaal Band
2.overview: Due to lagging village development work, a political opposition starts to emerge against Pradhan Ji. Abhishek's loyalty gets tested.

2.name: Kranti
2.overview: Abhishek gives pace to the village development work. But not without hindrance.

2.name: Tension
2.overview: On a slow office day Abhishek and Vikas find themselves in an unusual situation. It's a big day for Pradhan's family.

2.name: Jaise Ko Taisa
2.overview: Political opposition against Pradhan's family takes its final shape. Abhishek picks a side, loud and clear.

2.name: Aukaat
2.overview: A desperate Pradhan Ji makes an attempt to full-fill his biggest election promise. Abhishek gets a reality check, but in a harsh way.

2.name: Dost Yaar
2.overview: Abhishek questions his importance in Pradhan's team. Pradhan Ji and Manju Devi have their own dilemmas.

2.name: Parivaar
2.overview: Afraid of losing the perception battle to his political opponent Pradhan Ji makes a tough call. An upset Abhishek tries to emotionally detach himself from the people around.

3.name: Rangbaazi
3.overview: Pradhan's desperate attempt to prevent Abhishek's impending transfer intensifies the conflict between the Pradhan gang and the MLA. Prahlad finds it difficult to make peace with his new reality.

3.name: Gaddha
3.overview: Abhishek returns with the resolve of staying away from the village politics. Fearing the loss of public reputation, Pradhan and Manju Devi need Abhishek's help to handle a rebel.

3.name: Ghar Ya Eent-Patthar?
3.overview: After Bhushan senses an opportunity to attack Pradhan, Abhishek jumps into damage control mode. Prahlad doesn't like the way Pradhan uses Abhishek for political benefit.

3.name: Atma Manthan
3.overview: The final blow to Pradhan's reputation comes after he gets accused of partiality in a welfare scheme implementation. Meanwhile to topple Pradhan's rule, Bhushan allies with the MLA.

3.name: Shanti Samjhauta
3.overview: Manju Devi reluctantly agrees to Bhushan's proposal of entering into a peace agreement with the MLA. Abhishek too gives his nod as it's impossible to get the road built without MLA's support.

3.name: Chingaari
3.overview: To fix their dented image, the Pradhan gang sets a trap to capitalize on a lethal mistake committed by the MLA. Amidst all the political chaos an unexpected news brings joy to the Pradhan gang.

3.name: Shola
3.overview: Fully aware of his actions, MLA not only walks into the trap but also raises the stakes. Pradhan gang needs to walk the talk or it's all over.

3.name: Hamla
3.overview: Finally, Pradhan rallies the whole Phulera behind him to fight one last battle for glory. Abhishek finds himself too deep into the murky waters of village politics and loses his objectivity.

4.name: Case-Mukadma
4.overview: Abhishek fears the police case for slapping Bhushan could ruin his career. Drunk and frustrated, he vents and tries to apologise, hoping Bhushan will drop the case. But Bhushan has other plans because he wants Abhishek’s help to clear his name in the Pradhan shooting. The situation escalates when the MLA also gets involved in the deal.

4.name: Zakhm
4.overview: Pradhan, a survivor of an "assassination" attempt, tries to leverage sympathy as he kicks off his election campaign. His team organises a public event where he cleans a dirty village spot despite being wounded. Meanwhile, Bhushan’s camp makes a pre-emptive strike to steal Pradhan’s thunder and gain the upper hand.

4.name: Vachan
4.overview: After noticing a crack in Bhushan’s camp, Pradhan sees an opportunity to weaken his rival. Following his instructions, his team tries to break the unity of Bhushan’s camp by targeting one of his key loyalists. But the plan does not go as smoothly as hoped. Loyalties run deep, and winning him over proves more difficult than expected.

4.name: Shakti Pradarshan
4.overview: While Pradhan and Manju Devi prepare for a grand nomination, Bhushan and the MLA hatch a plan to humiliate Pradhan's family in front of the villagers. Acting on a secret tip, a team of government officials pays a surprise visit to members of Pradhan’s camp.

4.name: Ashirvaad
4.overview: A few days before the election, Manju Devi's father visits Phulera to bless his daughter. During a door-to-door campaign, a physical altercation breaks out between rival camps after Kranti Devi insults Khushbu, Vikas’s pregnant wife, deeply offending both Prahlad and Vikas.

4.name: Sanjeevani
4.overview: Jealous of Bhushan gaining strong support in the village, Pradhan’s camp grows anxious. A temporary reprieve comes when the local MP, the MLA’s superior, offers a chance to solve their problems. However, this opportunity comes with a twist, creating a moral dilemma among the camp members, especially Prahlad.

4.name: Dramabaaz
4.overview: Just before election day, the local electricity transformer malfunctions, causing a power outage across the village. Pradhan’s camp scrambles to get it repaired but faces a dilemma when they learn where the electrician is from. Meanwhile, Bhushan’s camp prepares to deliver the final blow to Pradhan’s campaign.

4.name: Dabdaba
4.overview: As Abhishek plans his next move after receiving his CAT results, Pradhan’s family anxiously awaits the election outcome. The advance order of sweets becomes both a topic of conversation and a subtle display of confidence. While both factions try to project strength before the villagers, the MLA keeps a sharp eye on Phulera’s political future.

1.name: Tehri
1.overview: A sweet and sour tiff between mother-son projects the disappointments that both have against each other. The mother worries that her son is jobless and dislikes her son fussing about the food not being served. Stay tuned to know how this family goes about their uniqueness.

1.name: Hum Do Humare Do
1.overview: Both the brothers fight over the volume of the television. Aman requests his mother to convince Annu to make a drawing for his practical exam, starting another argument.

1.name: Itwaar
1.overview: On a not-so-good Sunday morning, Annu's mother wakes up to the alarm ringing. With the arrival of Sunday, most middle class families plan to make it special. Watch to know more about how special is their Sunday!

1.name: Batti Aa Gayi
1.overview: Aman enquires about Annu who hasn't returned home till late. Annu's father is relaxed while waiting for him. Annu returns to only demand for a scooty, making up excuses for being late.

1.name: Tyohaar
1.overview: It's Raksha Bandhan. Shanti falls sick but has to work all day. Annu shares his exam results with Aman, so he suggests him to run away. Shanti falls unconscious on hearing about Annu's exam results.

1.name: Bridges
1.overview: Inspector Hathi Ram Chaudhary is going through his dead beat job when he lands up a big investigation. Three men and a woman have been arrested for the attempt to murder a big prime time journalist Sanjeev Mehra, and Hathi Ram is asked to build a case. Meanwhile, for Mehra, this news couldn’t have come at a worse time for he struggles with problems at work and a boss who wants to fire him.

1.name: Lost and Found
1.overview: Hathi Ram and Ansari use every technique in the book to interrogate the four suspects. Finally they manage to break one of them and his statement points to a certain ‘Master ji’ from Chitrakoot. Meanwhile pressure mounts on Sanjeev Mehra at the work front.

1.name: A history of violence
1.overview: Hathi Ram reaches Chitrakoot and meets Tyagi's family and school teacher. He comes to know of the beginning of Tyagi's criminal record, and the people Tyagi worked for. Meanwhile Ansari conducts a parallel investigation in Punjab and finds out about Tope Singh's dark past. Sanjeev Mehra pulls off a coup on his television show, surprising friends and foes alike.

1.name: Sleepless in Seelampur
1.overview: Hathi Ram gets sucked further into the case, but the investigation hits a dead end with the mysterious death of a key suspect. Sanjeev Mehra starts forming a plan to cash in on his renewed popularity. A procedureal screw up gets blown up and lands Hathi Ram in serious trouble with the bosses.

1.name: Of fathers and sons
1.overview: Hathi Ram, suspended from his job, struggles to keep himself away from the case while dealing with rising issues at home. Sanjeev Mehra makes a dubious populist move that does not go well with Sara and creates a rift in their budding romance. CBI starts investigating the case and comes up with a shocking theory.

1.name: The past is prologue
1.overview: Hathi Ram travels into the past of Kabir and Cheeni, and that makes him further convinced that the CBI's 'terrorism theory' is fabricated. Hathi Ram's son lands into serious trouble with the bad guys and he is forced to step in and take action.

1.name: Badlands
1.overview: Hathi Ram travels to Chitrakoot to pick up the missing threads from where he last left them. Further details emerge on Tyagi's mysterious 'Masterji' and Tyagi's close emotional bond with him. Hathi Ram tails the dangerous Gwala Gujjar, Master ji's brother, and almost gets caught in the act.

1.name: Black Widow
1.overview: Following Tyagi's political links, Hathi Ram comes across a mysterious woman who turns out to be the missing link between Tyagi and Tope Singh's story. Hathi Ram pieces together clues that lead him to a startling discovery concerning Master ji.

1.name: Swarg ka Dwaar
1.overview: On the run from Gwala's dangerous men, Hathi Ram manages to piece together the entire jigsaw puzzle. Sanjeev's pride at his takeover of the business is bursted by Hathi Ram's shocking revelations. Tyagi discovers the truth about Master ji and that leads him to fulfilling his childhood prophecy. Hathi Ram is grudgingly handed back his badge by the Police Department.

1.name: The Things That Men Do
1.overview: Rishi and Saloni, two filmmakers travel to Manali to shoot a friend’s wedding. Rishi accidentally records the murder of a ‘dancing girl’ by the groom’s father and struggles with his conscience. As he tries to find out what happened, DSP Ghosh, a cop from West Bengal arrives in Manali, who is looking out for the same ‘dancing girl’ in a murder case.

1.name: Is This For Real?
1.overview: Rishi makes a horrific discovery in the doghouse next to the resort. Saloni tries to get him to focus on the work but Rinku and his cousins are onto Rishi. He must come up with a Plan B. DSP Ghosh, senses a cover-up, heads to the resort.

1.name: For Cash Only
