1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh wishes to wear Amma’s favourite saree to her friend Seema’s wedding. While giving the saree to Rajesh, Amma tells her to not let any damage come to it. However, a distracted Rajesh burns the saree while ironing it.

1.name: Kamlesh gets Amma’s saree repaired - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh fears telling Amma that she had burnt her favourite saree. Much to Rajesh’s relief, Kamlesh gets the saree repaired. Meanwhile, the commissioner orders Happu to apprehend the thief who stole his chain.

1.name: Kamlesh loses Amma’s saree - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu ki Ultan Paltan, Kamlesh loses Amma’s saree. When Amma asks for her saree back, Rajesh lies to distract her. Beni suggests a way for Happu and Rajesh to save themselves from Amma’s anger.

1.name: Helping Rajesh lands Beni in trouble - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Beni steals Rajesh’s necklace which Amma is wearing, but gets caught by the commissioner. To help Rajesh, Hrithik stops the laundryman from coming to their house. Assuming Beni to be the real thief, the commissioner gets Happu to beat him up.

1.name: Rajesh confesses to having burnt Amma’s saree - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Malaika learns that Kat and Kamlesh had left Amma’s saree in the movie theatre. In the police station, Beni tells the commissioner why he stole the necklace. Later, Rajesh confesses before Amma to having burnt her saree.

1.name: Amma and Rajesh enter into a poetic war - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Beni listens to Amma recite a poetry and falsely praises her. Amma discredits Rajesh’s understanding of the poetry and Rajesh complaints about her to Happu. Later, Amma and Rajesh argue with each other through the use of poetry.

1.name: Happu tries his hand at poetry - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu ki Ultan Paltan, Happu tries his hand at poetry but fails to impress the commissioner. Beni promises to introduce Amma and Rajesh to his friend who is a publisher. The idea of getting their poetries published in a book grips Amma and Rajesh, while it worries Happu.

1.name: Amma finds Pitaji’s diary - Happu ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, the poetic war between Amma and Rajesh continues. Kat and Kamlesh’s antics irritate Malaika. Sorting through some old items, Amma and Happu find Pitaji’s diary. The contents of it come as a surprise to Amma.

1.name: Will Amma take Beni’s hint? - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma and Rajesh ask Beni to invite his publisher friend for a ‘mushaira’ session, where they both vow to outdo each other. Beni tries to discourage Amma’s poetic aspirations.

1.name: The ‘mushaira’ begins - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma and Rajesh refuse to give up on the idea of getting their poems published. Beni welcomes his publisher friend Hararat Bukhari to the ‘mushaira’, and the session begins with Chamchi reciting her poetry, followed by Hrithik and Malaika.

1.name: Amma and Rajesh’s dreams crash - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma and Rajesh fail to impress Hararat Bukhari with their poetries. Later in the night, Happu tries to spend some quality time with Rajesh, but is interrupted by his kids. During a ‘puja’, Amma hints at Rajesh being blessed with the boon of motherhood.

1.name: Is Rajesh pregnant? - Happu ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh calls Happu at work and tells him that she is pregnant. She tries to hide the news from Amma, but Amma learns the truth from Chamchi and chides the couple for adding to their already large brood.

1.name: Amma wins an exciting prize - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, a priest visits Amma and foretells that she will go abroad soon. She is overjoyed, but Rajesh bursts her bubble and what Amma says next hurts her. Later, Amma wins a contest and receives an exciting prize.

1.name: Rajesh’s ultimatum to Happu - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma is excited for her upcoming London trip and promises to return with lots of gifts for all. Rajesh pesters Happu to send her for a trip abroad as well. Fed up with Amma’s taunts, she gives an ultimatum to Happu.

1.name: Happu plans a party - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh tells Amma that she will also be going to London. They ask Kamlesh and Kat to teach them English. Happu and Beni plan a get-together with their friends in their absence. Amma tells Happu to pay INR 20,000 as taxes for her travel and stay.

1.name: Amma and Rajesh learn Western etiquettes - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Kamlesh teaches English to Amma and Rajesh. Imagining Kamlesh to be a British official named Colonel Peterson, Malaika thrashes him. Kat teaches Amma and Rajesh to eat food with knives and forks. Later, they flaunt their western outfits.

1.name: Amma’s dreams crash - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh and Amma pack for their London trip. The trip gets cancelled because of a news delivered by Nargis. Soon after, Happu’s friends arrive for the party, which lands him in trouble.

1.name: Happu and Beni’s friendship troubles Rajesh - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, while Happu is at Beni’s house, everyone back home awaits him for dinner. Later, an angry Rajesh taunts Beni and Happu’s friendship. Undaunted, Happu lies to Rajesh and visits Beni again at night.

1.name: Amma’s suggestion - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, when Rajesh calls Happu, he lies to her about being busy with an important case. Rajesh discovers Happu’s lie which leads to an argument between the two. Amma suggests Rajesh to become Happu’s friend so he stops visiting Beni for company.

1.name: Rajesh becomes Happu’s friend - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh promises Happu that she will be a good friend to him. She and Happu join Beni for some drinks, but they leave when Beni and Happu get into an argument. The next morning, Rajesh’s brazen and overfriendly behaviour before the family disturbs Happu.

1.name: Rajesh breaks Happu and Beni's bond - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu fights with Beni on Rajesh's instigation. Beni gets upset when he sees Happu having drinks with Rajesh at night. Happu overhears Amma and Rajesh's conversation and learns that they had deliberately created a rift between him and Beni.

1.name: Rajesh’s plan backfires - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu pacifies Beni and tells him about Amma and Rajesh’s ploy. To teach Rajesh a lesson, Happu teases her friend Karishma. Later, an upset Rajesh complains about Happu to Amma.

1.name: Rajesh teaches Happu a lesson - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh overhears Beni and Happu’s conversation. Her ploy to get back at Happu endangers his job. Happu apologises to Rajesh for his mistake and promises to spend more time with family.

1.name: Happu’s uncle tells him a secret - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma stops Rajesh from giving away an old basket. Happu’s uncle from Agra pays him a visit at the police station and tells him a secret. Meanwhile, Kamlesh tells Amma to become a brand ambassador of an NGO supporting orphans.

1.name: Happu devastated - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Chamchi comes across a letter which makes her think she is an orphan. Beni consoles Happu who is upset after learning about being an orphan. Happu and Rajesh’s loving behaviour towards her leaves Amma in doubt.

1.name: Happu is depressed - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Hrithik and Ranbir take advantage of a vulnerable Chamchi. Beni gives a bottle of alcohol to Happu to alleviate his sorrows. The commissioner sympathises with Happu and shares his own unfortunate story. Happu wishes to meet his biological parents.

1.name: Amma reveals a secret - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, under a misconception, Happu assumes Tiwari, a vegetable seller, to be his biological father. Malaika teaches Hrithik and Ranbir a lesson. Later, Amma tells Happu the secret about the basket.

1.name: Happu’s family welcomes Gunjan - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, the commissioner agrees to let his niece, Gunjan, stay with Happu’s family to experience the joys of family life. When Gunjan arrives, Amma and Rajesh learn why she is averse to marriage. During dinner, Rajesh and Amma end up quarrelling before Gunjan.

1.name: Amma and Rajesh quarrel before Gunjan - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu advises Amma and Rajesh to not quarrel before Gunjan. The next day, Amma and Rajesh pretend to be caring towards each other. Later, Gunjan gets happy when she sees them quarrelling and tells Happu about it.

1.name: Happu sings false praises of his family - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Beni and Happu end up fighting when the former complains about the latter’s children. Tired of Amma and Rajesh’s conflicts, Happu once again tries to reason with them. Later, he sings false praises of his family before Gunjan.

1.name: Gunjan agrees to get married - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, the commissioner tells Happu that Gunjan has refused to marry upon witnessing the fights at his home. Later, Gunjan changes her mind on seeing Amma and Rajesh’s loving behaviour. Moreover, Happu and Beni resolve their differences.

1.name: Happu gets frightened on seeing ghosts - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu teases Rajesh for getting scared of a mouse. To teach Happu a lesson, the kids and Kamlesh come up with a plan. At night, the light goes out and Happu gets frightened on seeing the ghosts.

1.name: Amma’s suggestion to Happu - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh fights with Happu for not giving time to the family. Amma gives a suggestion to Happu. Kamlesh tells Happu that due to Kat’s low attendance, he has been called to the college. Being busy with work, Happu refuses to go to the college.

1.name: Happu’s leave request denied - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu’s kids complain about him not spending time with the family. The commissioner turns down Happu’s leave request. Amma comes up with an idea to get Happu some time off from work.

1.name: Happu gets suspended - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, due to Amma and Rajesh, the commissioner suspends Happu from duty for seven days. Happu plays with his kids and spends some quality time with Rajesh. Happu openly romancing Rajesh irks Amma.

1.name: Happu irritates everyone - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, on Beni’s suggestion, Happu narrates a story to his children to mingle with them. Happu gets angry when the children fall asleep. Irritated with Happu’s antics, everyone complaints about him to Amma.

1.name: The commissioner remains stubborn - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma and Rajesh request the commissioner to cancel Happu’s suspension, but he refuses to budge. With Hrithik’s idea, everyone teaches Happu a lesson. Later, the commissioner suspends Happu for one more week.

1.name: Rajesh’s demand for a maid - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh tells Happu to find a maid for her to help in the household chores. Happu asks Beni and Manohar to help him find one. When Happu returns home without a maid, he is faced with everyone’s ire.

1.name: Rajesh gets a maid - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh hires a maid named Dimple to help her around the house. Dimple impresses everyone with her cooking. Rajesh suggests Karishma to hire a maid as well. A homeless Kamlesh finds shelter at Beni’s house.

1.name: Dimple threatens Happu - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Dimple considers Kamlesh to be a servant when she sees him washing clothes at Beni’s house. The next morning, Happu and Rajesh chide Dimple for waking up late. Further, Dimple threatens to send Happu to jail on charges of molestation.

1.name: Dimple’s increasing demands - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, under Dimple’s threats, Happu, Amma and Rajesh take care of the household chores. Beni manipulates Kamlesh into doing errands for him. Kamlesh mocks Happu who is washing clothes. Dimple’s increasing demands trouble everyone.

1.name: A shocking revelation - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu shares his woes with Beni. Later, Beni confronts Dimple and tries to scare her with his tactics. Soon after, Happu’s friend arrives and reveals that Dimple is his wife and he did everything to take revenge from Happu.

1.name: Hrithik lies to the Principal - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Hrithik and Ranbir decide to teach Kamlesh a lesson for taunting them. Later, Hrithik lies to his school Principal about Happu meeting with an accident to escape punishment. The Principal meets Happu and tells him about Hrithik’s lie.

1.name: What happened to Hrithik? - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, hearing the Principal’s complaints against Hrithik, Happu and Rajesh decide to give him a good hiding. Rajesh gets worried when Hrithik and Ranbir do not return from school. Ranbir brings Hrithik home and gives a bad news to the family concerning him.

1.name: Hrithik’s memory loss saddens everyone - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu blames Kamlesh for Hrithik’s memory loss and thrashes him. Despite the doctor’s efforts, Hrithik is unable to gain his memory back and his condition worries everyone in the family. Amma sings a lullaby for Hrithik in the hope that he recovers.

1.name: Chamchi becomes suspicious of Hrithik - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma’s fails to help Hrithik get his memory back. Happu starts blaming himself for Hrithik’s condition. Meanwhile, Chamchi suspects that Hrithik is pretending to have lost his memory and vows to prove it.

1.name: Hrithik’s lie exposed - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, to bring back Hrithik's memory, Rajesh gives an advice to Happu. In order to cure Hrithik, the commissioner agrees to get slapped by Happu. Chamchi overhears Hrithik and Ranbir’s conversation and exposes Hrithik's pretence.

1.name: The priest's prediction - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Fakirchand complains to Happu that Hrithik has beaten his son Bansuri. Happu punishes Hrithik, but Hrithik feels that Happu has done wrong by punishing him. The priest makes a prediction about Amma, which makes her very happy.

1.name: Did Amma kill Kamlesh? - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu advises Rajesh and Amma to be alert of the thieves. Amma mistakes Kamlesh to be a thief and attacks him. Amma worries that she may have killed Kamlesh when the latter pretends to die.

1.name: Amma and Rajesh hide Kamlesh’s corpse - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma gets terrified on thinking about getting punished for killing Kamlesh. Further, Rajesh and Amma hide Kamlesh's corpse in the cupboard. Later, Happu asks Amma about Babuji's walking stick, and Amma tells him that it is kept in the cupboard.

1.name: Happu to save Amma from punishment - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma confesses to killing Kamlesh before Happu, and he promises to save her from punishment. Kamlesh’s father arrives at Happu’s house looking for Kamlesh. Whereas, the commissioner decides to stay at Happu's house.

1.name: Amma saved from going to jail - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, a hungry Kamlesh goes into the kitchen but Amma mistakes him for a ghost and gets scared. Meanwhile, Kamlesh’s father threatens Happu. Happu’s family tries to dispose of Kamlesh’s body. To save his life, Kamlesh puts an end to his pretence.

1.name: Happu ends up hurting Amma - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma begins to feel that Happu does not love her. Nargis tells Amma of a way through which she could test the depth of Happu’s love. Whereas, Rajesh chides Happu for hurting Amma.

1.name: Amma gets herself kidnapped - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, in need of money, Beni pretends to kidnap Amma on her request. Then, he calls Happu and asks for ransom. The news of Amma’s kidnapping leaves everyone worried.

1.name: Beni threatens Happu - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, the commissioner gives an advice to Happu. Beni threatens to kill Amma when Happu fails to pay him the ransom. Kamlesh clicks pictures of everyone in the house on Amma’s request and gets scared on seeing one of the pictures.

1.name: Beni and Kamlesh get jailed - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu arrives at the place suggested by Beni with the ransom. Malaika catches Kamlesh and Beni red-handed. Since Amma has lost her voice, she is unable to reveal the truth to the family members. Happu locks Beni and Kamlesh in jail and thrashes them.

1.name: The truth finally comes out - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, the doctor informs that Amma has lost her voice permanently. An incident restores Amma’s voice and she confesses to getting herself kidnapped. A guilty Happu profusely apologises to Beni and helps him financially.

1.name: Malaika instigates Kat against Kamlesh - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu ki Ultan Paltan, Malaika complains to Rajesh that Kamlesh is a bad influence on Kat. She then comes up with an idea to keep Kat away from Kamlesh. Later, she instigates Kat against Kamlesh, and Kat gets angry at him.

1.name: Amma ousts Kamlesh from the house - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu ki Ultan Paltan, Chamchi tells Amma that Kamlesh’s father had badmouthed Kat before them. On Amma’s behest, Malaika kicks Kamlesh out of the house. Later, when Kamlesh tries to sneak in through the bedroom window, Kat pushes him from the ladder on Malaika’s instigation.

1.name: Rajesh confesses the truth - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh tells Happu why she orchestrated the events that led to a fight between Kat and Kamlesh. Kat tells Happu that she aspires to be an air hostess and not a doctor. Rajesh confesses her wrongdoings before Kat.

1.name: Happu’s family demands for gifts - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu’s family demands presents from him on ‘Dussehra’. Gulab Singh, an acquaintance of the commissioner, arrives at the police station to file a complaint for his missing dog. Whereas, Kat and Kamlesh rehearse for a play.

1.name: Gulab Singh gets attracted to Rajesh - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Gulab Singh visits Beni’s house and leers at Rajesh. He is left stunned on learning that Rajesh is Happu’s wife. Happu gets angry when he hears Rajesh praising Gulab Singh. The next day, Gulab Singh brings presents for everyone in Happu’s family.

1.name: Gulab Singh gives a love letter to Rajesh - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh gets Gulab Singh’s love letter along with his gift, which makes Happu angry. Meanwhile, the priest tells Amma that she will face something catastrophic in her life. Later, Gulab Singh plots to create suspicion in Rajesh’s mind against Happu.

1.name: Gulab Singh accepts Malaika’s challenge - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, by telling Rajesh about Gulab Singh’s ploy, he clarifies her misunderstanding. On Malaika’s provocation, Gulab Singh agrees to fight a boxing match with Happu. Happu fears losing at Gulab Singh’s hands but Malaika assures him that she will train him.

1.name: The boxing match begins - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Malaika wakes Happu early in the morning to make him exercise. Happu’s family tries to motivate him to win the match. Later, the boxing match between Happu and Gulab Singh begins.

1.name: Happu defeats Gulab Singh - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Gulab Singh's beating leaves Happu breathless. With his family’s encouragement, Happu succeeds in defeating Gulab Singh. Further, Happu gets trapped in the fight between Amma and Rajesh over their rights at home.

1.name: Amma gets the house’s ownership - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu stops Rajesh from leaving the house. The next day, Beni reads Pitaji’s will and declares that Amma is the rightful owner of the house. Later, Beni reveals a secret about the will to Happu and Rajesh overhears their conversation.

1.name: Happu’s house gets divided - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh is declared the owner of the house as per Pitaji’s new will, but Amma refuses to accept it. Beni suggests that the house be divided to solve Amma and Rajesh’s conflict. Happu and the children follow through on Beni’s suggestion.

1.name: Amma and Rajesh’s feud continues - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, moved by the children’s plight, Amma and Rajesh allow them to use their sections of the house. Later, Happu tries to reason with Amma and Rajesh but they refuse to end their feud.

1.name: Happu to keep a fast for Rajesh - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, due to the recent upheavals, Happu vents his anger on the family members. He also gets into an argument with Beni when the latter calls Amma selfish. Later, with Beni’s suggestion, he unites the family and decides to keep a fast for Rajesh.

1.name: Rajesh finds Amma’s mother-in-law’s letters - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma taunts Rajesh for not being an obedient daughter-in-law. Further, Rajesh finds letters written by Amma's mother-in-law Savitri, in which she has criticised Amma. Amma tells Rajesh to prepare for a ‘puja’ for her mother-in-law's death anniversary.

1.name: Rajesh acts like Amma’s mother-in-law - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, during the ‘puja’, Rajesh starts speaking like Amma's mother-in-law, Savitri. Amma feels that Savitri’s soul has possessed Rajesh and becomes scared of her. Meanwhile, Kat tries a trick to change Malaika's angry nature.

1.name: Amma learns about Rajesh’s pretence - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh orders Amma to prepare breakfast. Kamlesh is left surprised by Malaika's generosity. Pitaji tells Amma a secret related to Savitri's letters. When Amma realises that Rajesh is pretending to be possessed, she resolves to teach her a lesson.

1.name: Amma’s false story - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma’s false story scares Rajesh. She tells Happu that Amma is a murderer and is about to kill her. To save themselves, Happu and Rajesh try to escape from the house with their children.

1.name: Happu fasts for Rajesh on ‘Karwa Chauth’ - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma taunts Happu for keeping the ‘Karwa Chauth’ fast for Rajesh. Everyone celebrates ‘Karwa Chauth’ together. Hrithik insists on getting firecrackers for ‘Diwali’. Later, Happu and Rajesh bicker over their jobs and Kamlesh shares a good news with Kat.

1.name: Happu’s hurtful words upset Rajesh - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu criticises the breakfast prepared by Rajesh. In a fit of rage, he says that he regrets marrying her. The commissioner reprimands Happu before Beni. Kamlesh’s uncle, Bittu offers to hire Kat as an air hostess for his airline.

1.name: Rajesh becomes an inspector - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, the commissioner exposes Happu’s lies before Amma and Rajesh. Later, he suspends Happu and gives his job to Rajesh to teach him a lesson. Over a few drinks, Happu shares his woes with Beni, and gets irritated when Kamlesh and Kat interrupt him.

1.name: Happu struggles with the household chores - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu blames Rajesh for his woes. The next morning, Amma tells Happu to takeover Rajesh’s household duties. When Happu calls Rajesh for assistance, she dismisses him and tells him to manage on his own. Beni mocks Happu when he sees him washing clothes.

1.name: KD Pathak threatens Rajesh - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu gets lunch for Rajesh at the police station. The next morning, a smuggler named KD Pathak visits Rajesh and tells her to release the trucks she had seized. He threatens her with dire consequences when she refuses to relent.

1.name: KD Pathak kidnaps Happu - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, KD Pathak gets Happu kidnapped to force Rajesh into doing his bidding. Along with the commissioner and Manohar, Rajesh arrests KD Pathak and frees Happu. After patching up their differences, Rajesh and Happu celebrate ‘Diwali’ with their family.

1.name: Rajesh’s behaviour worries Happu - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh gets embarrassed before Amma and the kids due to Happu. Rajesh’s disinterest in him bothers Happu and he confides in Amma. Meanwhile, Kamlesh overhears Malaika and Kat’s conversation and decides to use the knowledge to impress the latter.

1.name: Happu poses as his twin Pappu - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma tells Happu to pose as his fictional twin brother Pappu to impress Rajesh. The next morning, Happu tells Rajesh that in his absence, Pappu will handle his household chores. Happu undergoes a makeover and arrives at the house as Pappu.

1.name: Rajesh impressed with Pappu - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh becomes impressed with Pappu. Kamlesh’s new look displeases Kat. Rajesh praises Pappu in front of Happu, making the latter angry. Further, Rajesh and the children rejoice at their plan to fool Happu.

1.name: Rajesh’s infidelity saddens Happu - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, seeing Rajesh’s growing attachment towards Pappu, Happu thinks that she doesn’t love him at all. Meanwhile, Kat doesn’t like Kamlesh’s new look. Believing Rajesh to be unfaithful towards him, Happu gets sad.

1.name: Happu tests Rajesh’s love - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma tells Happu to test Rajesh’s love. Further, Rajesh agrees to elope with Pappu and her children help her with the same. Eventually, Happu reveals the truth about Pappu to everyone.

1.name: Rajesh’s cousin to pay her a visit - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh is unhappy with the news of Adveer’s impending visit to Kanpur. Later, she learns about the arrival of her cousin, Laila. Beni decides to become a partner in Kat and Kamlesh’s new business. Rajesh plots to stop Adveer from coming to Kanpur.

1.name: Amma sees Happu in Laila’s embrace - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu brings Laila home. To get some tea, Laila goes to the kitchen at night and takes Happu along. Amma sees Laila hugging Happu and misunderstands the situation. The next day, Amma inaugurates Beni, Kat and Kamlesh's new hotel.

1.name: Kat tells Rajesh about Laila's behaviour - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma tells Laila to maintain distance from Happu. The commissioner tells Happu his secret. Later, Happu takes Laila to Beni's restaurant for dinner. Laila's behaviour surprises Kat and she tells Rajesh the whole truth.

1.name: Laila, the theif - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh catches Happu red-handed. After Laila leaves the house, the family members learn about the theft and the real Laila makes an entry. Happu narrates the incident to Beni. Later, a nightmare leaves Rajesh scared.

1.name: Rajesh tells Amma about her nightmare - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma hides a truth about her past from Happu. Rajesh tells Amma about her nightmare. At night, a drunk Happu falls over a pile of garbage. Later, the commissioner suspends Happu indefinitely.

1.name: Happu is left upset after losing his job - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu’s family feel embarrassed on seeing a news about him on TV. Rajesh gets terrified on spotting a moneylender outside the house. Happu goes to Beni’s house and drowns his sorrows in alcohol. His condition leaves Amma and Rajesh worried.

1.name: Amma resumes her old job - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Hrithik, Ranbir and Chamchi think of a way to get Happu his job back. Rajesh looks for a job to cover the household expenses. Amma resumes her former profession to take care of the family, and Beni learns the truth about it.

1.name: Happu learns the truth about Amma - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Ranbir, Hrithik and Chamchi curse the commissioner at the police station. The commissioner agrees to hire Happu back if he succeeds in nabbing a pickpocket. Happu agrees to the commissioner’s condition but gets shocked on learning the pickpocket’s name.

1.name: Rajesh ousts Happu from the house - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu is unable to arrest Amma. The commissioner revokes Happu’s suspension. Later, Rajesh ousts Happu from the house after a fight. Beni refuses to accommodate Happu at his house due to Amma’s threat.

1.name: Rajesh invites the commissioner for a party - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu starts staying in a tent outside the house. Rajesh speaks about the delicious food she had cooked to make him jealous. Later, she invites the commissioner for her faux birthday party and tells him to not get Happu along.

1.name: Happu estranged from his family - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu gets upset on seeing everyone enjoying themselves at Rajesh’s faux birthday party. Hiding from everyone, Amma gives ‘roti’ to Happu. The next day, Happu’s ill health worries Kamlesh.

1.name: Happu and Rajesh resolve their differences - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu feigns illness to get back into the house, but gets caught by Rajesh. He badmouths Rajesh before Beni and Kamlesh, unaware that Rajesh is overhearing their conversation. Later, Rajesh and Happu patch up because of Amma.

1.name: Happu buys a gold necklace for Rajesh - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh demands a gold necklace from Happu. Happu gets INR 1.5 lakhs in a property case. Further, he employs a homeless Kamlesh as a security guard at his house. Later, he buys a gold necklace for Rajesh from the money he got.

1.name: Happu gives the necklace to Amma - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu gives the necklace he bought for Rajesh to Amma. Due to this reason, Rajesh gets insulted before her friends and gets angry at Happu. Happu goes to sleep at Beni’s house at night and tells him the reason behind Rajesh’s anger.

1.name: Happu promises to get a necklace for Rajesh - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma gets happy on wearing the necklace and dances with Happu. To pacify Rajesh, Happu promises to get her a necklace like Amma’s. However, when the goldsmith’s artisan refuses to make another one, Happu comes up with an idea to fulfil his promise.

1.name: Happu commits theft for Rajesh - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Kamlesh and Pitaji see Happu stealing Amma’s necklace, which he later presents to Rajesh. Amma informs that her necklace was stolen. Rajesh discerns that Happu was the one who stole it. She flaunts it before Amma to make her jealous.

1.name: Happu to steal the necklace once again - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Pitaji tells the name of the thief to Amma. Happu tells Amma the reason he stole the necklace. She tells him to steal it back from Rajesh. Happu decides to steal at night but unbeknownst to him, his kids lay out a trap for the thief.

1.name: Happu and Rajesh reminisce about the past - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, unaware that the thief is Happu, the children beat him up. The next day, Happu sees a lipstick stain on his handkerchief and chides Rajesh for it. Rajesh reminisces about the past. Later, Happu regales Beni with the stories of his and Rajesh’s past.

1.name: Happu and Rajesh’s plan to watch a movie fails - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu and Rajesh plan to go for a movie and Chamchi tells Amma about it. Due to Amma and the kids, Rajesh is unable to go to the movie theatre. Meanwhile, Happu, who is waiting for Rajesh, gets angry when she does not turn up.

1.name: Happu tells Rajesh about Amma and the kids’ act - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu learns about the act staged by Amma and the kids. Inadvertently, he ends up telling Rajesh about the act as well. Later, Amma and the kids apologise to the couple and they get to spend some quality time together.

1.name: Happu gets in trouble trying to romance Rajesh - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, the children watch the news of a theft incident on TV. Happu secretly comes to meet Rajesh to relive their memories. Mistaking him for a thief, Amma and the children beat him up. Regretting their mistake, they promise to not trouble the couple anymore.

1.name: Rajesh and Happu spend quality time together - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma slips and gets injured. At Amma’s behest, the children do not alert Rajesh and Happu about her injury when they return from their outing. Eventually, Happu and Rajesh learn the truth and get emotional on seeing Amma and kids' love towards them.

1.name: Hrithik’s report card infuriates Happu - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu ki Ultan Paltan, Happu gets angry on seeing Hrithik’s report card. He blames Rajesh for spoiling him. Rajesh agrees to help Happu reform Hrithik. Later, Pitaji wishes Amma on her birthday.

1.name: Hrithik records a video of Amma dancing - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu scolds Hrithik who is playing cricket. Later, Amma sees Rajesh dancing at her birthday party and gives her an earful. At night, while Amma is dancing with Pitaji, Hrithik records the scene. The next day, he uses the video to blackmail Amma.

1.name: Hrithik blackmails Amma - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma chides Chamchi and slaps Beni on being blackmailed to do so by Hrithik. Rajesh calls Happu and tells him about Amma’s changed behaviour. Hrithik refuses to delete the video despite Amma’s request and continues to do as he pleases.

1.name: Amma’s behaviour upsets Chamchi - Happu ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Chamchi gets upset with Amma’s changed behaviour towards her. Amma regrets her actions and apologises to Beni but also slaps him again. Later, she gets Hrithik’s favourite food prepared, which angers other family members.

1.name: Rajesh puts forth a condition in front of Amma - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Hrithik gets delighted as Amma beats Happu. Rajesh and Happu come to know that Hrithik is the one who has Amma's dance video and he is blackmailing her. Amma apologies to Rajesh who then puts forth a condition before Amma to forgive her.

1.name: Amma finds a suitable groom for Kat - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, a priest predicts Kat’s future and advises Amma to get her married soon. The news saddens Kamlesh but he pretends to be happy before Kat. However, his pretence leaves Kat heartbroken. Further, Amma finds a suitable match for Kat.

1.name: Rajesh selects a prospective groom for Kat - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh chooses a collector’s son as a match for Kat. She and Amma insist on getting Kat married to the boy of their choosing. Their squabble over the matter annoys Happu. Later, Kamlesh professes his feelings to Kat through the story of his novel.

1.name: Kat’s question upsets Kamlesh - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma and Rajesh taunt each other during breakfast. The commissioner jokes with Happu at the police station. A question asked by Kat upsets Kamlesh and leaves him in tears. Later, he faints near Beni’s house.

1.name: Prospective grooms come to meet Kat - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Kamlesh comes to Happu’s house to help with the chores. Collector Rajveer Singh and his son Bunty come to meet Kat. Seeing Bunty and Kat talking upsets Kamlesh. Before Bunty and his father could leave, the commissioner arrives with his son.

1.name: Kat and Bittu’s alliance doesn’t get fixed - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajveer and Bunty leave Happu’s house in a huff. Amma agrees to not fix Kat’s alliance with Bittu. The commissioner threatens Happu when he turns down the alliance with his son. Later, a court order leaves the commissioner shocked.

1.name: Happu confides in Beni about his problem - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu confides in Beni about his health condition. Meanwhile, Karishma gives an idea to Rajesh to solve her problem. Later, Beni takes Happu to a hakim for treatment. Happu gets shocked on seeing Commissioner Resham Pal there as well.

1.name: Rajesh tells Happu that she is pregnant - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, the hakim gives some medicines to Happu for his condition. Later, Happu jumps with joy when Rajesh tells him that she is pregnant again. Beni senses something is fishy when Happu shares this news with him.

1.name: Happu doubts Rajesh’s character - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma takes care of Rajesh. Meanwhile, Happu doubts Rajesh’s character as he feels she is carrying someone else’s child. Later, Amma and the children think of names for the baby. Their conversation saddens Happu.

1.name: Happu and Beni get into a tussle - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu questions Rajesh about her pregnancy. A conversation with Hrithik convinces Happu that Rajesh is pregnant with Beni’s child. While Happu and Beni get into a tussle, Amma prepares for Rajesh’s baby shower.

1.name: Happu gets happy when the truth unfolds - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu pacifies Beni and shares his plight with him. During the baby shower, Happu tells Amma that he is not the father of Rajesh’s child. Later, he gets delighted when the truth unfolds.

1.name: Happu buys a car - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, everyone blackens their faces to convince Happu to buy a car. Happu returns home and on learning that he has bought a car, everyone leaps with joy. Later, Malaika dislikes a dress gifted by Kamlesh to Kat.

1.name: Happu’s love for his car - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu forbids Amma and Rajesh from taking the car to the market as he fears them causing damage to it. Karishma runs into Amma and Rajesh and the duo requests her to drop them to their home. Later, the family members get upset due to Happu.

1.name: Happu’s car gets damaged - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh promises Beni that she will get him married to Vimlesh in the new year. After the new year celebrations, Happu’s kids and Kamlesh secretly take the car out for a drive. When the car gets a dent, they try to keep Happu from learning about it.

1.name: Kamlesh suggests an idea - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Ranbir and Chamchi tell Rajesh about the damage to the car. A mechanic takes the car away for repair. Kamlesh suggests an idea to keep Happu in the dark about it. Kamlesh's uncle Kripal Singh files a missing complaint for his car at the police station.

1.name: Happu’s car gets sold - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu learns that his car got damaged. Recalling a past instance, he forgives the kids. After the mechanic returns the car, Makwana buys it from Happu and sells it to another person. The person’s identity leaves Happu shocked.

1.name: Happu’s childhood incident - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu beats Kamlesh on Malaika’s provocation. Karishma tells Rajesh about the antics of their friends’ philandering husbands, making Rajesh angry. Amma tells Chamchi about the incident when Happu had lost his memory.

1.name: Rajesh becomes suspicious of Happu - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, a woman tries to get close to Happu at the police station. Due to a misunderstanding, Rajesh suspects Happu and fights with him. While Happu clears her misunderstanding, Rajesh later finds a strand of woman’s hair on his sweater.

1.name: Happu loses his memory - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu runs to escape from an angry Rajesh. He loses his memory after falling from the stairs. He addresses himself as Micchu Phupha and mistakes the others for servants and berates them. Later, Amma blames Rajesh for Happu’s condition.

1.name: Happu pretends to be Micchu Phupha - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu tells everyone to leave the house. Further, he tells Beni why he is pretending to be Micchu Phupha. Continuing with the charade, he behaves inappropriately with Rajesh. Meanwhile, Kat and Kamlesh come up with an idea to get Happu’s memory back.

1.name: Amma puts on an act - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Kat and Kamlesh’s plan to help Happu regain his memory backfires. Rajesh learns about Happu’s pretence and tells Amma about it. Amma puts on an act to force Happu to come clean.

1.name: Happu upset on not getting the carrot pickle - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu’s family, on Makar Sankranti, indulge themselves in kite flying. Happu refuses to have dinner when he doesn’t get the pickle made out of black carrot and goes to Beni’s house instead. To appease Happu, Amma and Rajesh decide to make the pickle.

1.name: Rajesh and Amma argue over making the pickle - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh and Amma argue over making a pickle of black carrots for Happu. Malaika gives a suggestion to Happu to resolve their differences. Further, Amma and Rajesh begin with the preparations for making the pickle. Malaika blackmails Kat using a picture.

1.name: Amma and Rajesh plan to spoil the other’s pickle - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma and Rajesh plan to spoil each other’s pickle. Later, Amma and Rajesh both prepare the pickle and leave it in the sunlight. Meanwhile, Hrithik and Chamchi learn that Malaika has been blackmailing Kat.

1.name: Amma and Rajesh keep a watch over their pickles - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Chamchi and Hrithik blackmail Kamlesh by showing him the photograph. On their behest, Kamlesh comes to spoil Amma and Rajesh’s pickles but Happu and Beni beat him up. Later, Amma and Rajesh brave the cold to watch over their pickles.

1.name: Amma and Rajesh regret making the pickle - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma and Rajesh bring Happu home from the police station using threats. Chamchi blindfolds him and makes him taste the pickles made by them. Stuck in a tight spot, Happu puts up an act which makes Amma and Rajesh regret making the pickle.

1.name: Amma and Rajesh fight over onions - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma chides Rajesh for making onion pakoras as they are expensive. An upset Rajesh vents out her anger at Happu. Having overheard their conversation, Chamchi tells Amma about it. Fed up with Amma and Rajesh’s quarrels, Happu gives Beni an advice.

1.name: Rajesh accepts Amma’s challenge - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh accepts Amma’s challenge of managing the household expenses on a budget. Happu invites the commissioner for a meal and the latter makes a request. Hrithik gets upset on not getting his favourite food, but Rajesh finds a way to fulfil his wish.

1.name: Rajesh’s idea to manage the household expenses - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu asks Rajesh for money to pay for the commissioner’s feast. On Rajesh’s behest, Beni fills the bottle with cheap liquor. When the commissioner comes home, Happu serves him the liquor. Beni fears that his actions will come to light.

1.name: The commissioner falls sick - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, the commissioner falls sick upon drinking the cheap liquor. Rajesh gives Happu a suggestion while Amma plans to make the commissioner drink the cheap liquor again. The next day, Happu apologises to the commissioner and invites him again for a treat.

1.name: Amma teaches Rajesh budget management - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma swaps the liquor bottle. The commissioner again falls sick upon drinking cheap liquor. Amma gives him a lesson and he promises to never consume alcohol. Amma tells Rajesh her reason behind swapping the bottle and Rajesh realises her mistake.

1.name: Rajesh’s brother Cheetar to visit her - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu enquires with the kids about their studies. Rajesh’s brother Cheetar tells her about him coming to meet her. When Amma objects to his visit, Happu manages to convince her. Later, the commissioner shares his woes with Happu.

1.name: Happu flatters Cheetar - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Rajesh does not pay heed to Amma and prepares food of Cheetar’s choice. Cheetar is given a grand welcome but his sense of humour displeases Amma. Later, Happu and Beni flatter Cheetar for selfish purposes.

1.name: Happu is annoyed due to Cheetar - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Cheetar brings a pack of cards and bothers Rajesh and Happu. The next morning, Happu is forced to go in the woods to relieve himself because of Cheetar. For this, the commissioner fines Happu. Later, Happu is infuriated with Rajesh.

1.name: Is Cheetar eyeing Amma's trunk? - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma doubts Cheetar’s intentions when he questions her about the trunk. Happu, too, grows suspicious of Cheetar. Cheetar asks Happu for INR 20 lakhs. Mistaking him to be a terrorist, Makwana and the commissioner thrash Kamlesh.

1.name: Cheetar gets exposed - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Amma agrees to give Happu a sum of INR 20 lakhs. Happu and others talk to Cheetar about how to get promoted. Just as Cheetar walks away with the money, everyone learns that he is a fraud. Later, Amma makes a revelation.

1.name: Hrithik announces his decision of becoming an actor - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu chides Hrithik for bunking school and going for a movie instead. Hrithik informs him that he wants to be an actor. Pitaji tells Amma that he too aspired to be an actor. The commissioner’s son runs way from home to become an actor.

1.name: Happu threatens to send Hrithik to a hostel - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Hrithik’s principal comes home to complain about him. Worried for Hrithik, Happu shares his concerns with Beni. Happu threatens to send Hrithik to a hostel to make him give up the idea of becoming an actor. Further, Hrithik blackmails Kat and Kamlesh.

1.name: The family falls prey to Hrithik’s plan - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Kamlesh and Kat pose as Action Yadav and Pappu Singh and propose to star Happu’s family in their film. They keep forth the condition that Hrithik will have to act in the movie, but he deliberately refuses. Hrithik appreciates Kamlesh and Kat’s acting.

1.name: Action and Pappu explain everybody’s characters - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu takes Hrithik to a movie, after which he agrees to work in the film. Action Yadav and Pappu Singh explain to everyone their characters in the film. Further, at night, everybody practices their dialogues.

1.name: Malaika exposes Kamlesh and Kat - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Malaika tells Kat her suspicions about Action and Pappu. Happu and others begin their act before some people from the neighbourhood. Malaika exposes Kamlesh and Kat before everyone. Happu chides Hrithik for pulling off such a stunt.

1.name: Happu consults Baba Tillakkad Nath - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu gets fed up with Amma and Rajesh’s fights. Chamchi prays for peace in the house. On the commissioner’s suggestion, Happu takes his problems to Baba Tillakkad Nath. When Happu uses the baba’s way to solve his problems, Beni gets furious with him.

1.name: Tillakkad Nath helps Happu and Beni - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, peace returns to the house because of Chamchi. However, Happu believes that Tillakkad Nath is responsible for it. Tillakkad Nath gives Beni a way to obtain Vimlesh. He also shows Happu a difficult way through which he could become the commissioner.

1.name: Happu burns the commissioner’s hair - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, following Tillakkad Nath’s instructions, Beni makes moustache on a sleeping Amma’s face, and Happu helps him with it. Further, with Beni’s help, Happu too manages to shave the commissioner’s head and burn his hair. Soon, Happu receives a good news.

1.name: Rajesh’s plan to overcome Happu’s superstition - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu as a commissioner begins to bully everyone at the police station. To make him overcome his superstition, Rajesh comes up with a plan. Happu believes that Amma and Rajesh have been possessed by spirits. Rajesh calls Baba Bhabhutanand at home.

1.name: Tilakkad Nath's fraud gets exposed - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu's family pretend to be ghosts to scare Happu and Beni. They both visit Tilakkad Nath to get help and eventually his fraud gets exposed before Happu. Later, Commissioner Reshampal learns about the people who had gotten his head shaved.

1.name: Happu gets furious over extravagant expenses - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu reprimands his family for their extravagant expenses. Karishma tells Amma and Rajesh about a scheme in which people can get their gold doubled. Happu’s family begins to think of ways to earn money.

1.name: Amma gives her necklace to invest in the scheme - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, to invest in the scheme, Amma gives Vipul her gold bangles. The next day, commissioner asks Happu to capture a gang that cheats people with a promise to double the gold. Further, Amma gives Vipul her necklace as well.

1.name: People get conned by the fake company - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu tells Amma and Rajesh about the company that cheats people by promising them to double their gold. Karishma gives a bad news to Amma and Rajesh. The minister holds the commissioner responsible for the fraud, demotes him and promotes Happu.

1.name: Amma and Rajesh hide the truth from Happu - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
1.overview: In this full episode of Happu Ki Ultan Paltan, Happu is pleased to become the commissioner and arrives home. Amma and Rajesh hide from him the fact that they have fallen prey to a fraud. Further, to cheer up a dejected Rajesh, Happu showers her with compliments.

1.name: Amma gets her necklace back - Happu Ki Ultan Paltan

1.name: All the Lies Come to the Fore
1.overview: The hotel manager accidentally activates the fire alarm. Everyone comes out and their lies are exposed. Later, Rajesh waits for Happu in a garden. Meanwhile, Happu sits with Beni to drink.

1.name: Rajesh Fights with Happu
1.overview: Angry on seeing Happu drinking alcohol with Beni, Rajesh gets into a fight with Happu. Amma suggests an idea to reconcile Rajesh and Happu. Later, Hrithik gives a letter to Happu.

1.name: The Commissioner Seeks Happu's Help
1.overview: Happu and Rajesh reconcile when they go on a dinner date. Later, the commissioner seeks help from Happu's family for his sister-in-law Rusha's marriage alliance and introduces them to her.

1.name: Kat Agrees to Help Rusha
1.overview: Kat agrees to help break Rusha’s alliance. Happu greets the suitor’s family. Beni shares his idea with Kat and Rusha. He assumes a disguise and tells a false story to Happu and the Commissioner.

1.name: Happu and Resham Pal Are Scared
1.overview: Chamchi blackmails Hrithik and Ranbir. Kamlesh, disguised as Kalpana Shaitani, appears in front of Happu and Resham Pal. Luchcha Shaitani reveals a fact that scares Happu and Resham Pal.

1.name: Kat Slaps Praful
1.overview: Rusha, along with Kat, visits Praful. Kat slaps Praful, and Resham Pal apprises Happu of Kat's actions. Happu asks Kat for an explanation. Surprisingly, Kat behaves strangely and slaps Manohar.

1.name: Happu's Plan Gets Foiled
1.overview: Happu asks Rusha and Praful to spend time together. Kat arrives there and slaps Praful. The commissioner gets upset with Happu due to Kat's actions. Later, Kat refers to herself as Kalpana Shaitani.

1.name: The Hotel Bill Shocks Happu
1.overview: Rusha's marriage alliance breaks up. Manohar apprises Resham Pal of Rusha and Kat's plan. Resham Pal apologises to Rusha. Later, Resham Pal and Happu are shocked to see the hotel bill.

1.name: Rajesh Moves to Her Maternal Home
1.overview: Rajesh moves to her maternal house after an argument with Happu. Later, Happu does not allow Kamlesh to stay and Kat comes up with an idea. Resham Pal's wife asks Happu for his help.

1.name: Amma Meets a Woman in a Temple
1.overview: Kat brings Kamlesh, disguised as Kamli, home. Happu's kids request him to get Rajesh back. Amma and Nargis meet a woman in a temple, who pretends to be in misery. Nargis gives Amma a piece of advice.

1.name: Amma Lands in Trouble
1.overview: Amma brings Chandni home. Happu complains to Amma about Chandni. Later, Amma tells Chandni to leave the house, but she threatens Amma and demands INR two lakhs.

1.name: Happu Gets Rid of Chandni
1.overview: Amma tells Happu about Chandni’s threat. Malaika learns that Kamlesh is posing as Kamli. Later, Kamlesh apologises to Happu, while Happu gets rid of Chandni due to Beni’s idea.

1.name: Dumar Fails to Send the Mangoes
1.overview: Rajesh tells Dumar to send mangoes to the house before Atbir. Later, Amma and Rajesh argue about ordering mangoes. When Dumar fails to send the mangoes, Rajesh gives a task to Kamlesh.

1.name: Atbir Delivers the Mangoes
1.overview: A disguised Kamlesh brings mangoes and states that Dumar has sent them. The kids criticise the mangoes. Later, Atbir sends some mangoes and Rajesh employs a trick to prevent Amma from eating them.

1.name: Amma Yearns to Eat Mangoes
1.overview: Rajesh deprives Amma of mangoes. Later, the commissioner threatens to transfer Happu, who fails to provide two boxes of mangoes to him. Meanwhile, Rajesh tempts Amma by eating a mango in front of her.

1.name: Happu Steals the Mangoes
1.overview: Rajesh refuses to give Happu two boxes of mangoes for the commissioner. At night, Happu tries to steal the mangoes from Rajesh’s room. Chamchi and Kamlesh arrive as well to steal the mangoes.

1.name: Amma Relishes the Mangoes
1.overview: Amma learns that she is not diabetic and discerns Rajesh’s ploy. Later, she puts on an act with the doctor. Rajesh apologises to Amma for her mistake and feeds her the mangoes.

1.name: The Commissioner’s Accusation on Happu
1.overview: When Dumar is arrested for possessing fake certificates, Happu refuses to get him released. Later, Happu gets into trouble when the commissioner accuses him of getting the job with a fake degree.

1.name: Happu Worries about the Exams
1.overview: Happu worries about the exams and confides in Beni. Later, Happu forcefully feeds the commissioner his favourite sweet. Miffed, the commissioner threatens to ask tough questions during the exams.

1.name: Happu Bribes Manohar
1.overview: Happu bribes Manohar and seeks his help to pass the exam. Beni tells Amma and Rajesh why Happu is worried. Later, Happu’s trick to pass the exam falls through.

1.name: Kamlesh Gets Caught Stealing
1.overview: At Happu’s behest, Kamlesh goes to the commissioner’s house to steal the question paper but gets caught. As Happu fears losing his job, Hrithik and Ranbir suggest some tricks to him to pass the exam.

1.name: The Commissioner’s Wife’s Revelation
1.overview: The commissioner catches Happu cheating during the exam. The commissioner’s wife makes a revelation, which Happu uses to save his job. Later, Rajesh punishes Happu for not helping Dumar.

1.name: Manohar Calls Rajesh Unlucky
1.overview: Rajesh wakes up Happu. Later, Amma burns her tongue and begins to lisp. When Happu’s day at the police station goes bad, Manohar comments that Rajesh’s face is unlucky for him.

1.name: Happu Incurs a Loss of INR Five Hundred
1.overview: Happu sees Rajesh’s face upon waking up. At Rajesh’s behest, the kids apologise to Happu, while Kat connects with Kamlesh through a video call. Later, Happu incurs a loss of INR five hundred.

1.name: The Commissioner Suspends Happu
1.overview: The commissioner suspends Happu for 15 days. This leads Happu to believe that Rajesh’s face is unlucky for him. Meanwhile, Kamlesh decides that Kat is unlucky for him and doesn’t meet her.

1.name: Rajesh Hides Her Face
1.overview: Rajesh overhears Happu telling Amma that her face is unlucky for him. Meanwhile, Malaika thrashes Kamlesh for calling Kat unlucky. The events lead Rajesh to hide her face from Happu.

1.name: Happu Realises His Mistake
1.overview: Despite not seeing Rajesh’s face, Happu loses his job and gets beaten up. Rajesh decides to leave the house, while Happu realises his mistake. Later, Amma shares a piece of good news with Happu.

1.name: Happu and Kamlesh Kill a Serpent
1.overview: Amma tells Happu that he is going to be in trouble. Inadvertently, Happu and Kamlesh end up killing a shape-shifting serpent. Later, Happu gets scared when the serpent’s mate comes seeking revenge.

1.name: Happu and Kamlesh Seek Help
1.overview: Happu’s kids try to scare him with a fake snake. Kamlesh gets scared due to the shape-shifting serpent and confides in Happu. At the police station, Happu and Kamlesh seek help from a snake charmer.

1.name: Happu Develops a Misunderstanding
1.overview: Rajesh and Kat burn their tongues. The snake charmer reveals the identity of the serpent. Happu misunderstands Rajesh and the kids, while the snake charmer gives a ‘been’ to Happu and Kamlesh.

1.name: Happu Gets Slapped by the Commissioner
1.overview: The commissioner slaps Happu when he plays the ‘been’. Happu assumes that Amma is the serpent, but as his misunderstanding resolves, he tells the truth to everyone. Later, the serpent gets caught.

1.name: The Snake Charmer Gets Exposed
1.overview: Happu sees the serpent once again. The snake charmer suggests Happu to perform a yagna. Rajesh becomes suspicious of the snake charmer and exposes him through her plan.

1.name: Rajesh Dreams of Happu Going Bald
1.overview: A bad dream prompts Rajesh to declare that she will divorce Happu if he ever goes bald. Meanwhile, Pitaji tells Amma about a rule of ‘Mrityalok’, and she decides to prevent Happu from going bald.

1.name: Happu Suffers from Hair Fall
1.overview: Happu gets nervous as he suffers from hair fall and seeks Beni’s help. Kamlesh suffers from hair fall as well and worries about Kat ending their friendship. Later, he dons a cap and goes to meet Kat.

1.name: Amma Shares a Remedy for Hair Fall
1.overview: Pitaji tells Amma that Happu is suffering from hair fall. Later, Amma shares a remedy with Happu and Hrithik overhears their conversation. Meanwhile, Chamchi and Ranbir extort money from Kamlesh.

1.name: Rajesh Learns about Happu’s Hair Fall
1.overview: Happu and Kamlesh fight to obtain the cow dung. Beni applies the cow dung on Happu’s hair and Rajesh overhears them. Kat learns about Kamlesh’s hair fall, while something troubles Amma and Rajesh.

1.name: Why Is Happu Suffering from Hair Fall?
1.overview: Happu’s family ousts him from the house as he suffers from hair fall. Happu and Kamlesh visit the doctor and learn the reason behind their condition. Later, Kamlesh thrashes Janeman Jalebiwala.

1.name: The Commissioner Suspects Happu
1.overview: Rajesh has a bad dream, while Kamlesh hides black money behind Happu’s house. The commissioner suspects that Happu has black money. Happu shares his problem with Beni, who gives him an idea.

1.name: An IT Officer Raids Happu’s House
1.overview: Along with Manohar and the commissioner, the IT officer raids Happu’s house. Rajesh is interrogated when some jewellery is found in the kitchen. The officer also finds a lot of money during the raid.

1.name: Happu’s Troubles Multiply
1.overview: Happu and Rajesh argue, while money is found from the kids’ room. Happu’s woes multiply when the commissioner gets his hands on Amma’s money and jewellery. Kamlesh tries to retrieve the black money.

1.name: A Trunk Is Found in Happu’s House
1.overview: A trunk is found in Happu’s house during the raid. Happu gets angry at Rajesh and inadvertently reveals a startling truth. Later, Happu seeks help from Beni.

1.name: Happu Evades Arrest
1.overview: The income tax officer, Inder, finds the black money buried in Happu’s garden. Later, Manohar arrives to arrest Happu. However, Happu evades arrest because of Pitaji.

1.name: Amma to Tell the Importance of 15th August
1.overview: Happu and his kids plan on how to spend the 15th August holiday. Amma decides to explain to them the significance of 15th August. She convinces the children to obey her by luring them with money.

1.name: The Family Members Become Amma's Slaves
1.overview: Amma appears as Colonel Katori and makes the family members her slaves. She turns the house into a central jail. When Beni shares an idea with Amma on how to celebrate 15th August, she beats him up.

1.name: Colonel Katori's Atrocities
1.overview: Colonel Katori wakes up Happu, Rajesh and the kids early in the morning. She orders Happu and the kids to clean the house and Rajesh to cook a meal. Beni tells Happu a trick to step out of the house.

1.name: Colonel Katori Enslaves Beni
1.overview: Colonel Katori gets her slaves to starve. Happu and Rajesh try to step out of the house with Beni's help. However, Colonel Katori catches them and enslaves Beni to punish him.

1.name: Happu's Family Honours Independence Day
1.overview: Reshampal visits Happu, and Colonel Katori enslaves him. Amma's attempt to explain the meaning of independence to the family is successful. Later, everyone celebrates Independence Day together.

1.name: Happu’s Lie Infuriates Rajesh
1.overview: Happu tells Rajesh about his friend, Kavita. In retaliation, Rajesh tells him about her friend, Rahul. Later, Kamlesh comes up with a business idea while Rajesh gets angry at Happu’s lie.

1.name: Rajesh Meets Her Friend
1.overview: Rajesh meets her friend, Rahul, and invites him for a meal at her house. Happu tells Beni that Rajesh has gone somewhere in anger. When Rajesh returns home in a cheerful mood, Happu feels jealous.

1.name: Rajesh and Rahul Recall the Past
1.overview: Amma and the kids leave the house for some work. At the police station, Happu worries about Rahul’s arrival in the absence of his family members. Later, Rajesh and Rahul reminisce about the past.

1.name: Happu Feels Jealous of Rahul
1.overview: When Happu returns home, Rajesh introduces him to Rahul. Rahul impresses Amma and Happu’s kids with expensive gifts. Happu feels jealous of Rahul and Manohar gives him an idea.

1.name: Rajesh Gives a Fitting Reply to Rahul
1.overview: Happu and Manohar’s plan backfires. Amma discerns Rahul’s intentions and ousts him from the house after reprimanding him. Later, Rajesh gives a fitting reply to Rahul when he offers to marry her.

1.name: Amma’s Alcohol Addiction
1.overview: On seeing Amma’s liquor bill, Happu tells Rajesh that Amma has an alcohol addiction. Later, Amma promises Happu that she will stop drinking alcohol, while the commissioner gives a task to Happu.

1.name: A Trick to Curb Amma’s Addiction
1.overview: Amma is unable to restrain herself and consumes alcohol. Happu seeks an idea from Rajesh to curb Amma’s addiction. Later, Beni tells Amma about Happu’s bad habit.

1.name: Pitaji Gives an Advice to Amma
1.overview: Amma gets worried on seeing Happu gambling. Pitaji gives an advice to Amma. The commissioner sees a photo in which Happu is gambling and suspends him. Later, Amma scolds Rajesh for shopping.

1.name: Rajesh Shares Her Woes with Amma
1.overview: Rajesh tells Amma that the family members developed bad habits in order to curb her addiction. The commissioner gives a final warning to Happu on seeing him gambling. Later, Amma confides in Pitaji.

1.name: Beni Shares His Plight with Happu
1.overview: The kids give up their bad habits on Amma’s insistence. Pitaji overhears Beni sharing his plight with Happu and tells Amma. Later, Happu and Amma talk to Rajesh about Beni and Vimlesh’s alliance.

1.name: Happu Secretly Meets a Girl
1.overview: Rajesh fights with Happu over a trivial matter and Happu believes that no one loves him. Rajesh gets upset on learning about her friend Joginder’s plight. Meanwhile, Happu secretly meets a girl.

1.name: Rajesh Learns about Happu’s Affair
1.overview: Rajesh shares her worry with Amma. The duo sees Happu meeting Rusha and fears that he will abandon their family for her. Later, Beni gives an idea to Amma.

1.name: Happu's Family Tries to Please Him
1.overview: Happu arrives home and everyone tries to please him. Happu learns the reason behind the family's sudden care towards him and tells the truth to Beni. Later, Happu continues his pretence.

1.name: Happu's Rules for the Family
1.overview: Rajesh narrates the incident of last night to Amma. Amma and Rajesh overhear Happu and Rusa's dangerous plan. Amma confronts Happu and he makes some rules for the family. Rajesh asks him for a chance.

1.name: Happu Accepts Rajesh’s Conditions
1.overview: Rajesh accepts Happu’s rules. Later, Rajesh and the commissioner learn the truth about Happu’s act. Rajesh teaches a lesson to Happu and asks him to accept her conditions to earn her forgiveness.

1.name: Kat Wishes to Go to London
1.overview: Kat wishes to pursue modelling in London. To elevate her standing amongst her friends, Rajesh demands that Kat be sent to London. However, Happu refuses to give in to her demands.

1.name: Happu Refuses to Send Kat to London
1.overview: Amma convinces Happu to send Kat to London. Kamlesh gets a bad dream after learning about Kat’s impending trip. Later, Happu learns about the fee amount and refuses to send Kat to London.

1.name: Happu Tries to Raise Money
1.overview: Kamlesh tries to stop Kat from going to London with his trick. Happu seeks the commissioner’s help to get a loan, but he refuses. Both Amma and Rajesh wish to accompany Kat and get into a fight.

1.name: Hrithik and Chamchi Take Revenge
1.overview: Hrithik and Chamchi avenge their insult. Kamlesh advises Kat to become a ‘swadeshi’ and not go to London. Happu gets upset when he is unable to raise the money for Kat’s fees.

1.name: Amma Decides to Sell the House
1.overview: Amma decides to sell off the house for Kat's trip to London. Kamlesh gets beaten up while trying to save Happu's house from being sold. Kat suddenly changes her mind and Kamlesh comes with a news.

1.name: Beni’s Plight Moves Amma
1.overview: Hrithik, Ranbir, and Chamchi strike a deal with Beni. They overhear Rajesh’s conversation with Vimlesh and tell Beni about it. Moved by Beni’s plight, Amma urges Rajesh to get him married to Vimlesh.

1.name: Beni Misbehaves with the Commissioner
1.overview: Beni misbehaves with the commissioner. Happu tells Beni how to impress Rajesh’s father, Gabbar Singh. Gabbar Singh visits Happu’s house, where the commissioner arrives to complain about Beni.

1.name: Beni Tries to Commit Suicide
1.overview: Amma stops Gabbar Singh from leaving. Instead of impressing Gabbar Singh, Beni annoys him. Later, Rajesh takes a decision to stop Beni from committing suicide.

1.name: Beni Gets Married to Vimlesh
1.overview: Beni and Vimlesh get married. Before the couple’s wedding night, Rajesh gives an advice to Vimlesh, while Happu helps an anxious Beni. Later, Vimlesh plays a prank on Beni and scares him.

1.name: Beni Spends the Night Outside His House
1.overview: Happu and Rajesh reminisce about their wedding night. The next morning, Happu rebukes Beni on seeing him sleeping outside his house. Later, Beni and Vimlesh spend some quality time together.

1.name: Vimlesh Insists on Going for a Honeymoon
1.overview: Vimlesh tells Beni to take her abroad for their honeymoon. Happu’s kids tell Amma about their wish to visit Switzerland. Later, Beni asks Happu for an idea to avoid going on a honeymoon.

1.name: Beni’s Mother’s Wish
1.overview: Beni lies to Vimlesh and refuses to take her on a honeymoon. Happu and Beni decide to foil Rajesh’s trick upon getting some information from the kids. Nargis reveals Beni’s mother’s wish.

1.name: Beni Puts On an Act
1.overview: Happu agrees to take Rajesh to Switzerland for their honeymoon. Later, Beni sprains his back. The doctor lies to Vimlesh and dashes her hopes to go on a honeymoon.

1.name: The Commissioner Grants Leave to Happu
1.overview: At Rajesh’s request, the commissioner grants leave to Happu for 10 days. The pandit predicts that Amma will travel abroad. Hrithik, Ranbir and Chamchi give a solution to Vimlesh to cure Beni’s sprain.

1.name: Beni and Vimlesh’s Honeymoon
1.overview: Amma and the children too demand to go to Switzerland with Happu. Later, Amma expresses a wish. Beni explains to Vimlesh how helpless he is and just then, they receive a piece of good news.

1.name: Rajesh Demands a Gift from Happu
1.overview: Vimlesh tells Rajesh about Beni’s gift, leading Rajesh to demand a gift from Happu. Hrithik, Chamchi and Ranbir find a way to get their demands fulfilled. Meanwhile, the commissioner punishes Happu.

1.name: Kat’s Demand
1.overview: Happu brings slippers for Rajesh. Amma and Vimlesh tell Rajesh to demand an expensive gift from Happu. On getting blackmailed from Chamchi, Hrithik and Ranbir, Kat makes a demand from Kamlesh.

1.name: Vimlesh Expresses Her Wish to Beni
1.overview: Kamlesh fulfils Kat’s demand. Hrithik, Ranbir and Chamchi convey their next demand to Kat. Happu buys a pashmina shawl for Rajesh, who shows it to Vimlesh and Amma. Vimlesh expresses her wish to Beni.

1.name: Rajesh’s Secret Trick
1.overview: Rajesh demands a diamond necklace from Happu. She shares her secret to get gifts from husbands with Amma and Vimlesh, and Happu overhears her. Amma complains to Pitaji for never giving her gifts.

1.name: Happu and Beni Rein in Their Wives’ Demands
1.overview: Vimlesh demands a diamond necklace from Beni. Kat blackmails Hrithik, Ranbir and Chamchi. Later, Happu and Beni try a trick to rein in their wives’ demands with Manohar's help.

1.name: Happu Gives His House on Rent
1.overview: The commissioner tells Happu about his leave. Kat tells Happu to give their house on rent to earn extra money and Rajesh agrees with her. Happu’s family’s plan gets foiled due to Beni.

1.name: Happu’s Family Stays at the Police Station
1.overview: Happu’s family goes to stay at the police station. Manohar nabs a thief but Happu refuses to imprison him. Happu’s family sleeps in the jail and Rajesh tells Happu to spend quality moments with her.

1.name: Happu’s Family in the Lock-Up
1.overview: The commissioner returns when his leaves get cancelled. On learning about this, Happu gets worried. To save his job, he locks up his family in the jail and lies to the commissioner.

1.name: The Tenants Refuse to Vacate Their House
1.overview: Happu and Beni’s tenants refuse to vacate their house. Happu’s tenant, Pramod, puts forth a condition before offering refuge to Happu in his own house. Meanwhile, Kamlesh learns that Kat is in jail.

1.name: Happu Tells the Truth to the Commissioner
1.overview: Kamlesh works on his plan to get Kat out of the jail. The commissioner puts a criminal, Shakaal, in the lock up with Happu’s family. Happu confesses the truth to commissioner, who makes a revelation.

1.name: The Negative Effect on Happu’s Kids
1.overview: Happu takes his kids to witness Ram Leela. On seeing the kids’ behaviour, Amma tells Happu to lead them on the right path. Rajesh worries for the kids, while Kat seeks the commissioner’s help.

1.name: The Commissioner Regrets Helping Kat
1.overview: Happu and Beni try a trick to get the kids on the right path. The commissioner suffers the consequences of helping Kat. Happu’s kids tell him to give up honesty for a life of luxury.

1.name: Happu Gets Arrested for Stealing
1.overview: To bring the kids on the right path, Happu robs Beni’s house. The CID officer arrests Happu for stealing. Later, Rajesh seeks Beni’s help, and he talks to Manohar.

1.name: Beni Fails to Get Happu Released from Jail
1.overview: Beni and Manohar get into trouble while trying to free Happu from the jail. Kat tells the commissioner about Happu’s arrest. The commissioner once again gets into trouble while helping Kat.

1.name: Happu's Kids Learn a Lesson
1.overview: Happu Singh, a family man, works hard as a police constable. However, all his efforts turn out to be futile as his life is constantly riddled with difficulties, often leading to a comedy of errors.

1.name: Tekamal’s Prediction about Kat
1.overview: Rajesh vents her anger at everyone. Astrologer Tekamal makes a shocking prediction about Rajesh. Kamlesh angers Tekamal with his antics and to take revenge on him, Tekamal gives a suggestion to Kat.

1.name: Rajesh’s Terror
1.overview: Happu tells the commissioner and Beni about Tekamal’s prediction. Later, Happu, Beni and Amma become fearful of Rajesh. When Kat makes an effort to stay away from Kamlesh, the latter threatens her.

1.name: A Fearful Happu Runs Away from Rajesh
1.overview: At Amma’s behest, the kids hide all the sharp tools. When Rajesh finds the knife missing from the kitchen, she gets angry. Later, Happu spots the gun in Rajesh’s hands and runs to the police station.

1.name: Happu Fears Rajesh and Makes a Plan
1.overview: Happu fears Rajesh’s anger and makes a plan. However, his plan gets foiled due to Beni. Later, Happu overhears Rajesh talking to Joginder and develops a misunderstanding.

1.name: Rajesh Divulges the Truth
1.overview: Happu tells the commissioner about Rajesh's plan to kill everyone. Along with Happu, the commissioner arrives to arrest Rajesh. Later, Rajesh tells everyone about the plan she devised with the pandit.

1.name: Happu Tells Rajesh a False Story
