1.overview: Rajesh's health improves when she takes the soup from Kamlesh's cart. She and Happu hide from Reshampal and Kansi Chacha but eventually get exposed. Later, Rajesh decides not to travel to Thailand.

1.name: Reshampal Asks Happu for Help
1.overview: Reshampal asks Happu to let his sister Reshma stay at the latter's place for a few days. Hrithik promises to speak the truth to Alia. Happu tells the family about Reshma's arrival, and a curse ensues.

1.name: The Family Gets Woried about Reshma
1.overview: Happu brings Reshma home and forbids her from talking to the boys. Hritik exposes Ranbir in front of a girl. Reshma's habit of fleeing the house worries her family. Kamlesh collides with Reshma.

1.name: Reshma Threatens Kamlesh to Marry Her
1.overview: Reshma runs into Kamlesh and falls in love with him. Rajesh learns that Reshma has eloped with Kamlesh and informs Happu about it. Later, Reshma threatens Kamlesh to marry her.

1.name: Vimlesh Becomes Reshma
1.overview: Happu asks Manohar to find Reshma and bring her home. The commissioner brings Reshma's suitor and his family to Happu's house. Later, Rajesh introduces Vimlesh as Reshma, and Vimlesh slaps the boy.

1.name: Kamlesh Escapes from Reshma
1.overview: The commissioner tries to take Vimlesh along after mistaking her for Reshma, but Happu stops him. Kamlesh escapes from Reshma, and the commissioner learns the truth. Later, Reshma flees again.

1.name: A Rule Mandating a Fine for Expressing Anger
1.overview: Rajesh asks Happu to take her to Nainital, but he refuses. Masterji falls victim to Hrithik's rage and complains about him to his family. Rajesh puts a fine on everyone who gets angry in the house.

1.name: Happu Keeps Paying the Fine
1.overview: Rajesh reveals her plan in front of the children and Amma. Everyone supports her, and Happu continues to pay the fine. Happu informs this to Beni. Later, Kamlesh tries to make Kat angry.

1.name: Happu Struggles to Keep His Temper in Control
1.overview: Happu struggles to keep his temper in control. Dr. Udaas gives an injection to quell Happu's temper. At the same time, Kat controls her wrath after seeing Kamlesh with Suhani.

1.name: Happu Doesn't Get Angry
1.overview: Happu doesn't get angry at anything. At the same time, Kamlesh enrages Kat. Dr Gupta gives Rajesh medication to drive Happu mad, but Vimlesh suffers the consequences.

1.name: Happu Teaches the Family a Lesson
1.overview: Rajesh gives Happu milk laced with medicine, which makes him angry at everything. Beni discovers Rajesh's ploy and informs Happu about it. To teach the family a lesson, Happu puts on an act.

1.name: Happu’s Family Plays Holi
1.overview: Kat gets a marriage proposal from Canada. She tells Kamlesh about it and he gets sad. Later, an inebriated Happu misbehaves with someone. The next day, Happu and his family play Holi.

1.name: Happu and Beni Face a Water Cut on Holi
1.overview: Mishra, a water department official, takes revenge on Happu and Beni. As per their complaint, Resham Pal scolds Mishra, but he faces a water cut in his house too. Happu decides to take Manohar's help.

1.name: Happu's Family Yearns for Water
1.overview: Manohar is punished for helping Happu. Beni suspects that someone is keeping Mishra updated. Happu's family yearns for water. Amma asks Happu to apologise to Mishra.

1.name: The Electricity of Beni and Happu's House Gets Cut
1.overview: Due to Kamlesh, the electricity of Happu and Beni’s house goes away. A prospective groom comes to see Kat, but the alliance doesn’t come to fruition. Rajesh and Vimlesh make a request to Mishra.

1.name: Happu Teaches Mishra a Lesson
1.overview: Happu and Manohar thrash Mishra, which worsens the matters. Later, Happu teaches Mishra a lesson by abducting his sister-in-law. Mishra gets Happu's electricity and water back and apologises to him.

1.name: Happu Hires a Badminton Coach for His Kids
1.overview: Happu's kids fail in PT. Rajesh decides to lose weight. Happu hires a coach to teach badminton to his kids. Coach Janardhan comes to Happu's house and falls for Rajesh.

1.overview: Kansi Chacha informs Rajesh that he is coming to meet her. To help Happu, Beni asks Kansi Chacha to return home. Amma learns that Kansi Chacha is well and that Rajesh deceived her.

1.overview: Happu's kids fail in PT. Rajesh decides to lose weight. Happu hires a coach to teach badminton to his kids. Coach Janardhan comes to Happu's house and falls for Rajesh.

1.name: Rajesh Asks Permission to Play Badminton
1.overview: Janardan suggests Rajesh play badminton to lose weight. Kamlesh lies to Kat and Malaika about him being a big sportsman. Later, Rajesh asks Amma for permission to play badminton.

1.name: Amma Objects to Rajesh's Dress
1.overview: Happu shares his doubt about Janardan with Beni. Rajesh wears a sports dress and plays badminton, which Amma objects to. Later, Rajesh asks Vimlesh to play badminton too.

1.name: Janardan Quits Coaching Rajesh
1.overview: Rajesh complains to Janardan about Happu. Vimlesh too decides to play badminton. Kat learns of Kamlesh's lie. Janardan quits coaching because of Happu’s accusations. Happu appeases Rajesh.

1.name: Happu Proves to Be a Coward
1.overview: Masterji praises Hrithik's bravery while Rajesh taunts Amma. Amma decides to take revenge on Rajesh. To prove his bravery, Happu goes to arrest Mintu but ends up getting beaten up.

1.name: Hritik Gets Exposed in front of Ranbir
1.overview: Masterji praises Rajesh for Hritik's bravery. Vimlesh also praises Beni's bravery. Hritik gets exposed in front of Ranbir. Later, Happu puts on an act to prove himself brave.

1.name: Happu Is Assigned to Find Pandey Sultan
1.overview: Everyone talks about Happu's bravery. Beni gets enraged at Happu for not giving him the credit. Reshampal assigns Happu the task of arresting Bandit Pandey Sultan, leaving him terrified.

1.name: Pandey Sultan Threatens Happu's Life
1.overview: Threatening Pandey Sultan lands Happu in trouble. Happu tells Reshampal and the family members that his video is fake. Ritika’s lie is exposed as well. Later, Pandey Sultan calls Happu.

1.name: Pandey Sultan Is Caught
1.overview: Happu apologises to Pandey Sultan in front of the media. Pandey Sultan arrives at Happu's house and puts a condition in exchange for forgiving him. Happu's children catch Pandey Sultan.

1.overview: The family celebrates Happu's baby shower, and he suffers from stomachache. Dr Gupta reveals that he isn't pregnant and exposes lab assistant Rakesh. The Herbalist talks about Happu's bloated stomach.

1.name: Masterji Threatens Happu's Children
1.overview: Rajesh challenges Amma to become her teacher. Masterji threatens Happu's children to humiliate them on Teachers' Day. Happu gets an opportunity to be the chief guest at the school.

1.name: Happu's Children are Afraid of Facing Embarrassment
1.overview: Happu shares a news with his children, and they get scared due to the fear of embarrassment. Later, Happu tries to pacify an upset Rajesh. Amma threatens Happu to comply with her demands.

1.name: Kamlesh Kidnaps Masterji
1.overview: Happu asks Rajesh to make spicy Gulab Jamun. Kamlesh kidnaps Masterji, which causes more problems for Happu's children. Masterji's wife files a police complaint about his disappearance.

1.name: Happu Learns about the Children's Mischief
1.overview: Manohar shows Happu footage of Masterji's kidnapping, and he identifies the kidnapper. The children make a plan to hide Masterji. Happu learns about their mischief, and Masterji threatens him.

1.name: Reshampal Saves Happu's Children
1.overview: Reshampal learns that Happu's children have kidnapped Masterji. He saves Happu and his children from going to jail. Rajesh regards Amma as her Guru. The family celebrates the Janmashtami festival.

1.name: Preeti's Advice to Rajesh and Vimlesh
1.overview: Preeti gives some advice to Rajesh and Vimlesh. Later, they both convince their husbands to take them for a movie and lie to Amma. Kat takes Kamlesh’s help to make Malaika behave like a girl.

1.name: A Disguised Kamlesh Meets Malaika
1.overview: Rajesh and Vimlesh leave home after lying to the kids. Kamlesh, disguised as poet Pappu Cheerharan, meets Malaika. Happu lies to Reshampal, who catches him and Beni while changing the clothes in jail.

1.name: The Family Members Fool Amma
1.overview: Happu and Beni return with their wives but lie to Amma. Later, Amma makes a plan for a family outing but the family members end up fooling her. Malaika goes to meet the poet Pappu.

1.name: Pitaji Tells Amma about Happu and Rajesh's Lie
1.overview: Happu and Rajesh return home and lie to Amma. Pitaji tells Amma that Happu and Rajesh are fooling her. Malaika falls in love with the poet. Happu, Beni, Rajesh, and Vimlesh plan to watch a movie.

1.name: Amma Catches Her Son and His Wife Red-Handed
1.overview: Amma's son and daughter-in-law deceive her and go for a movie, but she catches them at the cinema hall. Malaika suffers heartbreak in her love life and beats up Kamlesh on learning the truth.

1.name: Manohar Gives Amma and Rajesh Good News
1.overview: The family mocks Happu for not getting a promotion. Happu gives his resignation letter to Reshampal, who then receives an order from the minister. Manohar shares some good news with Amma and Rajesh.

1.name: Happu Brags about His Position
1.overview: The family welcomes Commissioner Happu, who brags about his position to Beni. Happu's children also take advantage of his position. Kat slaps a boy, who then threatens to seek revenge on her.

1.name: A Vegetable Seller Gives Rajesh Bad News
1.overview: Rajesh brags about being the commissioner's wife and belittles Kamlesh. Happu makes Reshmpal do his bidding. Later, Reshampal receives good news, and a vegetable seller gives Rajesh some bad news.

1.name: Happu Reveals the Reason for His Suspension
1.overview: Happu tells his family why he got suspended. The kids practice begging. Beni seeks revenge for his insult from Happu. At night, a thief breaks into Rajesh and Happu's room.

1.name: Lord Ganesha's Blessings Resolve Happu's Issues
1.overview: Rajesh cries as her belongings are stolen. Reshampal sets a condition for Happu to get his job back. Amma brings Lord Ganesha into the house to ward off the trouble, and the family receives good news.

1.name: Kamlesh Interviews Happu
1.overview: Happu apprehends Shakal and brings him to the police station. Later, Hrithik requests Chamchi to help him to become friends with Sweety. Kamlesh secures a job as a news reporter and interviews Happu.

1.name: Happu Credits His Success to Amma
1.overview: Happu credits his success to Amma, which makes Rajesh upset. Manohar suggests a plan to Happu to resolve Rajesh's discontent. In school, Happu's children threaten Masterji.

1.name: Amma Makes Rajesh Feel Jealous
1.overview: Amma makes Rajesh feel jealous. An enraged Rajesh ousts Kamlesh from the house, and he seeks shelter with Beni. According to his plan, Happu frees Shakal from jail but ends up in trouble.

1.name: Happu Alleviates Rajesh and Beni's Displeasure
1.overview: Happu conducts another interview, alleviating Rajesh and Beni's displeasure. Masterji threatens to fail Happu's children. Rajesh tells Amma about Happu's interview, making her jealous.

1.name: Happu Makes Amma and Rajesh Happy
1.overview: Happu's efforts to please Amma upset Rajesh again. He then catches Shakal. Although Happu manages to please Amma and Rajesh through the interview, the children are displeased with him.

1.name: Happu Gets Kidnapped
1.overview: Masterji sees Happu getting kidnapped and informs his children about it. Kamlesh seeks help from Kat. Happu's doppelganger Muttu Swami, also known as Babu, tells his plan to Happu and threatens him.

1.name: Happu's Doppelganger Takes His Place
1.overview: Muttu Swami comes as Happu to live at the latter's house. Rajesh mistakes him for Happu. Kamlesh asks him to sign the character certificate but due to his behaviour, Kat and Kamlesh get suspicious.

1.name: Muttu Swami Tries to Kill Reshampal
1.overview: Beni suspects Happu’s behaviour. Muttu Swami’s attempt to kill Reshampal goes unsuccessful. Rajesh plans to woo Happu. The real Happu asks for a favour from Gudiya Rani.

1.name: The Children Grow Suspicious of Happu's Behaviour
1.overview: Mutthu Swami's plot to kill Reshmapal fails once again. Rajesh follows Amma's advice to bring Happu back home. The children become suspicious of Happu's behaviour and decide to test him.

1.name: Happu's Doppelganger Is Arrested
1.overview: The family tries to uncover the truth about Happu's doppelganger. The real Happu comes home and the family is shocked to see him. Amma identifies the real Happu, and Happu's doppelganger is arrested.

1.name: A Dog Bites Happu
1.overview: Happu refuses to have a dog at home. Later, Reshampal shares a plan with Manohar and Happu to catch Shakal. On the way, a dog bites Happu, and he starts behaving strangely.

1.name: Happu Becomes a Dog
1.overview: Frightened by Happu's dog-like behaviour, Amma and Rajesh rush him to the doctor for an injection. Happu bites Beni, and Ranbir brings a dog belt to wrap around Happu's neck.

1.name: Reshampal Takes Advantage of Happu's Condition
1.overview: Rajesh beats up Happu for his misbehaviour. Reshampal learns about Happu's condition, and he takes advantage of it. Happu finds Shakal and reveals the secret of him becoming a dog.

1.name: Happu Gets a Fake Injection
1.overview: Happu arrests Shakal, and Reshampal talks about his job transfer. Masterji tells Amma that the principal has summoned Happu. The doctor informs Happu's family about the fake injection incident.

1.name: The Family Cures Happu's Condition
1.overview: Happu behaves like a dog in the children's principal's office. Kamlesh's plan to cure Happu backfires. Later, following Dr Udaas's advice, the family cures Happu's condition.

1.name: A Bet between Amma and Nargisariya
1.overview: Dreaded criminal Dassu Dandiya escapes from jail and tells Reshampal tells Happu about it. The children steal a chemical from school to fix a broken family vase. Amma and Nargisiya start a bet.

1.name: Dassu Dandiya Threatens Happu
1.overview: Rajesh asks Happu to participate in a Dandiya competition. Dassu Dandiya threatens Happu. Due to the kids' antics, the Dandiya sticks to Happu's hand. Reshampal summons Happu to the police station.

1.name: Dassu Wants to Kill Happu
1.overview: Dassu Dandiya’s threats scare Happu. Rajesh compels Happu to practise ‘dandiya’, and later, Dassu sees Happu practising ‘dandiya’. Thereafter, a pundit predicts that Happu’s life is in danger.

1.name: Happu Gets Scared of Dandiya
1.overview: Dassu and his men beat up Happu with 'dandiya' sticks which makes Happu fearful of 'dandiya'. Dr. Udas advises Happu's family, and they attempt to help him overcome his fear.

1.name: Happu's Family Plays Dandiya
1.overview: Hrithik tells the family about his plan to help Happu overcome his fear. Dassu tries to beat up Happu, but Hapu beats him instead. The family plays Dandiya at home as the competition gets cancelled.

1.name: Happu Vows to Become Lord Ram
1.overview: Happu vows to become Lord Ram in the Ramleela, organised by the police department. Kamlesh gets the job of becoming the statue of Ravana. Rajesh insists on going on a trip to Himachal with Happu.

1.name: Beni Gets the Role of Lord Rama
1.overview: Hrithik asks Masterji to play the role of Lord Rama in Ramleela. Amma convinces Happu to retake his oath by lying to him. Due to a misunderstanding, Reshampal assigns the role of Lord Rama to Beni.

1.name: Happu Asks Beni to Give Him the Role of Lord Rama
1.overview: Rajesh's desire to visit Himachal gets shattered. Reshampal informs Happu that Beni will play Lord Rama's character. Happu asks Beni to give him the role of Lord Rama and Vimlesh overhears them.

1.name: Happu Plans against Beni
1.overview: Beni refuses to give Happu the character of Lord Ram. Masterji gives Ritik the character of Laxman to play in school ‘Ramleela’. Later, Happu devises a plan to get the character of Lord Ram from Beni.

1.name: Amma Organises Ram Leela at Home
1.overview: Happu Singh, a family man, works hard as a police constable. However, all his efforts turn out to be futile as his life is constantly riddled with difficulties, often leading to a comedy of errors.

1.name: Happu Vows to Observe 'Karva Chauth' Fast
1.overview: Happu vows to observe 'Karva Chauth' fast for Rajesh. Kat, Malaika, and Kamlesh start the 'Khao-Piyo' catering service. Due to Happu, even Beni observes a fast for Vimlesh.

1.name: Amma Learns that Happu Is Observing a Fast
1.overview: Rajesh is delighted as Happu observes a fast for her. Reshampal informs Happu and Manohar that the minister wants to have lunch with them. Amma learns that Happu and Beni are observing a fast.

1.name: Amma's Plan to Break Happu's Fast
1.overview: The Minister arrives at the police station for lunch, and Happu continues to fast. But Beni breaks his fast. Amma asks money from Malaika, Kat and Kamlesh. Amma devises a plan to break Happu's fast.

1.name: Amma's Attempt to Break Happu's Fast Fails
1.overview: Amma's attempt to break Happu's fast fails. With Kat's help, Vimlesh tests Beni. Later, Amma and Rajesh challenge each other. Amma prepares 'Chole Bhature' for Happu.

1.name: Happu Completes the 'Karva Chauth' Fast
1.overview: A dispute arises over the division of profits among Kat, Kamalesh, and Malaika. Happu faints due to fasting. Rajesh realises her mistake, but Happu completes his 'Karva Chauth' fast for her.

1.name: Happu Defies the Government's Orders
1.overview: Happu's family plans a Diwali celebration. Reshampal informs Happu about the government's order not to burst firecrackers. Happu grants permission to his children to burn firecrackers before Diwali.

1.name: Happu Confesses to His Crime
1.overview: Happu uncovers that Hrithik's fired rocket had burned Reshampal's wife's hair. Reshampal gets involved in apprehending the culprit, and Happu confesses to his crime. Reshampal punishes Happu.

1.name: Will Beni Take Happu's Blame on Himself?
1.overview: Rajesh shares the news of Happu's arrest with Amma. Later, the duo asks Beni to take the blame on himself to save Happu, and Beni informs it to Kamlesh. Kat shows Kamlesh the 'diyas' made by her.

1.name: Happu Disguises Himself as Hapundari
1.overview: Beni gets imprisoned while attempting to free Happu from jail. Rajesh and Vimlesh drive them out of jail. Happu poses as Hapundari to avoid being arrested, and Reshampal falls in love with her.

1.name: Happu's Family Celebrates Diwali without Firecrackers
1.overview: Reshampal falls in love with Hapundari. The kids blackmail Reshampal to save Happu and Beni from being arrested. Happu's family celebrates Diwali without firecrackers and Reshampal makes a revelation.

1.name: Everyone Is Scared of a Lady Killer
1.overview: At night, a lady killer murders a man. Reshampal assigns the task of capturing that killer to Happu. Meanwhile, the kids frighten Kamlesh with the name of the lady killer. Happu gives Rajesh a gift.

1.name: Kamlesh Tells Amma about the Lady Killer
1.overview: Rajesh wakes up scared from a dream. Kamlesh follows Rajesh, who goes out of the house and witnesses a murder. He decides to go to Happu's house and informs Amma that Rajesh is the lady killer.

1.name: Happu Learns that Rajesh is the Lady Killer
1.overview: Amma and Kamlesh inform Happu that Rajesh is the lady killer. Upon learning a secret from Gabbar about Rajesh, Happu suspects Rajesh's split personality. Amma prevents Kamlesh from leaving the house.

1.name: The Family Is Frightened of Rajesh
1.overview: At night, Happu and Kamlesh follow Rajesh and witness a murder. Chamchi informs Ranbir about Rajesh being the lady killer. Later, the family, frightened by Rajesh, seeks help from the doctor.

1.name: Manohar Informs about the Lady Killer Being Caught
1.overview: The family tries to rekindle the motherly love within Rajesh. Happu tries a trick and she attempts to kill Happu. Manohar informs about the lady killer being caught, and Rajesh tells the truth.

1.name: Happu's Plan for His Mother and Wife's Happiness
1.overview: Rajesh and Amma start fighting while trying to resolve Hrithik and Chamchi's argument. Happu aggravates the situation by siding with Rajesh against Amma and vice versa. He advises Manohar.

1.name: Amma and Rajesh to Teach Happu a Lesson
1.overview: Amma and Rajesh realise Happu's plan. Watching Kumar's acting, they come up with a plan, and seek Kumar's help to teach Happu a lesson. The children also join them in their plan.

1.name: Changu Dev Maharaj Appears in Front of Kamlesh
1.overview: Witnessing Amma transformed into Rajesh and vice versa, everyone is shocked. Happu decides to go to the temple of Changu Dev Maharaj with Beni. Changu Dev Maharaj appears in front of Kamlesh.

1.name: Happu Meets Changu Dev
1.overview: Rajesh and Amma rejoice over the success of their plan. Happu meets Changu Dev, who tells him about his curse. Happu speaks negatively about Amma to Rajesh and criticises Rajesh in front of Amma.

1.name: Happu Discovers Changu Dev's Ploy
1.overview: Happu discovers Changu Dev's ploy. Later, he suggests sending Amma to an old age home and decides to divorce Rajesh, leaving them shocked. Rajesh apologises to Happu, who then beats up Changu Dev.

1.name: Kat Worries about Gaining Weight
1.overview: Rajesh calls Happu during the encounter. Happu decides on the home menu, and Kate worries about her weight. Later, Happu and Rajesh are troubled about cooking the children's favourite vegetables.

1.name: Happu's Kids Refuse to Eat Food
1.overview: Reshampal discovers that Manohar is working for Happu instead of being at the police station. Kat prepares her diet plan with Kamlesh. The kids refuse to eat potato-pea curry, which enrages Happu.

1.name: Happu Steals Buns from the Bakery
1.overview: Jitu refuses to give Happu the buns from his bakery, showing how close his relationship is with Reshampal. Happu goes to Reshampal for help, but doesn't get any. Later, he steals the buns with Beni.

1.name: The Kids Refuse to Eat Burgers
1.overview: Rajesh makes burgers from the buns stolen by Happu, but the kids refuse to eat them. Kamlesh eats sweet while jogging with Kat. When shooting Shakal, Happu asks Manohar to deliver mutton to his house.

1.name: Happu Realises His Mistake
1.overview: The children request Happu to make Lasagna pasta, leading to a misunderstanding. When the food is not served on time, Amma's health deteriorates. Happu realises his mistake and apologises to Rajesh.

1.name: Rajesh Worries about the Cold Wave News
1.overview: On hearing the news of a cold wave, Rajesh asks Happu to get a heater and Kamlesh seeks space at Kat's house. Happu is upset due to a shortage of heaters. Amma highlights the benefits of cold weather.

1.name: Happu Plans a Trip to Lucknow with Rajesh
1.overview: Shakal promises to provide heaters to Happu and Reshampal in exchange for his bail. Kamlesh helps Happu with household chores to stay in his house. Later, Happu plans a trip to Lucknow with Rajesh.

1.name: Happu Goes to Get the Heater from Kalpana
1.overview: The doctor arrives to see Amma and demands a heater. Happu and Beni go to get it from Kalpana. Master asks for a heater in exchange for passing Hrithik and Ranbir. Happu and Reshampal learn a truth.

1.name: Amma's Way to Stay Safe from Heatwaves
1.overview: Happu and Beni tell their wives about Kalpana's condition. Amma suggests a way to stay safe from heatwaves. Happu blackmails Kamlesh and asks him to do a task, putting Kamlesh in trouble.

1.name: Shakal Sends a Heater to Shakal's House
1.overview: Happu and Beni go to the jungle to bring Kamlesh, who goes to gather firewood. Reshampal takes the firewood from Happu. Happu curses Shakal and he sends him a heater. A piece of news shocks everyone.

1.name: Happu Expresses His Anger
1.overview: Happu scolds the kids and Rajesh. Later, he lashes out unnecessarily at Beni and beats up Reshampal's brother-in-law. Rajesh sings a song to pacify him. Soon, Happu beats up the paan vendor.

1.name: The Family Devises a Plan to Control Happu's Anger
1.overview: The family devises a plan to control Happu's anger. Masterji completes the children's duties. Pitaji takes pride in Happu's anger, and Happu resolves never to reduce his anger.

1.name: Can Mukti Anand Calm Happu's Anger?
1.overview: Ranbir pretends to point a gun at Hrithik in front of Happu. However, Happu takes pride in Ranbir's anger. Reshampal seeks the help of Guru Mukti Anand to control Happu's anger.

1.name: Happu's Children Kill Masterji
1.overview: The children inform Happu that they have killed Masterji. Beni refuses to help Happu. Masterji's wife complains about his disappearance, and Reshampal asks Happu to find him.

1.name: Happu Faces Punishment for Getting Angry
1.overview: Masterji's ghost scares Happu and Reshampal arrests Happu's kids for Masterji's murder. Happu realises the impact of teaching wrong lessons to his kids, and the family tells him about their act.

1.name: Happu Keeps an Eye on His Children
1.overview: Amma and the kids plan a party for Happu on his birthday. Upon hearing the news, Happu keeps an eye on his kids and informs Rajesh about Hrithik's actions. Kat tells Kamlesh about getting a job.

1.name: Happu and Rajesh Blame Each Other
1.overview: Rajesh notices a whiskey bottle with Hrithik and Ranbir. Kat informs Rajesh that she wants to stay away from the family to work. Later, Happu and Rajesh blame each other for the children's misconduct.

1.name: Happu and Rajesh Worry about Children
1.overview: Happu and Rajesh worry about the children. Kat seeks a favour from Kamlesh, but Rajesh catches Kat's lie. Happu and Rajesh seek help from Beni and Vimlesh to keep an eye on the children.

1.name: Happu Learns about His Children's Actions
1.overview: Happu, Beni and Rajesh try to teach the children. Beni sees Chamchi accepting a flower from a boy. Manohar sees Hrithik, and Ranbir playing cards. Later, they both inform Happu about his children.

1.name: Happu Gets a Birthday Surprise
1.overview: Happu is unhappy about not providing a proper upbringing to the children. He beats up the boys who give a flower to Chamchi and offer alcohol to Hrithik. The children give Happu a birthday surprise.

1.name: Happu's Plan to Surprise the Children
1.overview: The children get upset with Happu, and he comes up with a plan to resolve their grievances. Amma informs the children about Happu's plan. Happu requests Manohar to bring a Santa Claus costume for him.

1.name: Kamlesh Becomes a Thief to Fulfil Kat's Wishes
1.overview: Happu's kids prepare their wishlist. Kat hands her wishlist to Kamlesh, who then steals a stranger's chain to fulfil her wishes. Happu asks a tailor to stitch a Santa Claus dress.

1.name: Kamlesh Performs a Theft at Beni's House
1.overview: The kids make a Christmas tree. Kamlesh, disguised as Santa, performs a theft at Beni's house. Resham Pal asks Happu to find the thief. Manohar gives Happu a suggestion to arrange Santa's dress.

1.name: Happu Fails to Get a Santa Claus Costume
1.overview: Happu buys gifts for the children for Christmas but fails to get a Santa Claus costume. Amma informs the children about this, and they get upset. At night, a dream leaves Happu scared.

1.name: Happu Becomes the Santa for His Children
1.overview: Happu's children feel sad when they don't find gifts near the Christmas tree. Kamlesh gives gifts to Kat. When Happu fails to get Santa's costume, he devises a plan and gives gifts to the children.

1.name: Happu and Beni's Plan for the New Year
1.overview: Happu's family prepares to celebrate the New Year at home. Later, Beni suggests Happu to go to a club for the New Year's party. Kat promises to help Kamlesh find a job.

1.name: Happu and Beni's Photos Are Printed in the Newspaper
1.overview: Happu and Beni return home late after the party. Kat asks Happu to help Kamlesh secure a job in the police force. Happu and Beni's photos are printed in the newspaper. Gabbar informs Amma about this.

1.name: Amma Punishes Happu and Beni
1.overview: When Happu's lie is exposed, the family becomes upset with him. Vimlesh, enraged at Beni, ousts him from the house, and Rajesh beats up Happu. Amma punishes Happu and Beni.

1.name: Happu and Beni Get Punished
1.overview: Due to his punishment, Happu fails to reject any demands from his family. Reshampal promotes Manohar, and Happu asks Reshampal to fulfil his promise. Even Beni has to suffer the punishment.

1.name: Happu Apologises for His Mistake
1.overview: Amma and Rajesh argue, and they decide to send each other to their respective maternal homes. Reshampal fires Manohar and gives his position to Kamlesh. Happu apologises to Rajesh and Amma.

1.name: Beni Loses Happu's Father's Old Case
1.overview: Beni loses an old case related to Happu's father. The court orders Happu to deposit INR 2 crore. Later, Beni suggests a trick to Happu's family to avoid depositing the money.

1.name: Happu's Family Pretends to Be Poor
1.overview: Manohar is made the observer of Happu's case. Happu's family pretends to be poor. Happu asks a man for a bribe and Resham Pal suspends him. Beni gives a news to Happu.

1.name: Happu Hides His Black Money
1.overview: Happu buries his black money in a pit to hide it, but Manohar sees it. Reshampal arrives to seize Happu's black money. Later, everyone gets startled on finding the money and jewellery missing.

1.name: Beni Ousts Happu's Family from His House
1.overview: Everyone rejoices as the kids bring money and jewellery in front of Happu. Beni ousts Happu’s family, and the kids work on the streets. Manohar records a video of them. Gabbar arrives to meet Rajesh.

1.name: Beni Shares Good News
1.overview: Happu falls into Reshampal's trap and is arrested. Meanwhile, Beni shares good news with Happu's family. The family members apologise to Pitaji and celebrate Makar Sankranti.

1.name: Happu Becomes ACP
1.overview: Due to a lack of progress in the job, Happu loses faith in God. Rajesh arranges 'Bhajan' in the house for Happu's progress. Happu becomes ACP but gives credit to himself instead of giving it to God.

1.name: Happu Becomes Arrogant on Becoming the ACP
1.overview: Happu becomes arrogant on becoming the ACP and doesn’t take Beni along to the party. On his way to the party, Happu meets a boy, Keshav. Later, Happu’s behaviour upsets Rajesh.

1.name: An Egoistic Happu Talks Rudely with His Family
1.overview: Reshampal recommends his nephew to Happu for a job. Beni talks to Rajesh about Happu's egoistic nature. Later, Happu talks rudely to his family members, which upsets Rajesh.

1.name: Happu's Children Bring Keshav Home
1.overview: Happu punishes Manohar. Rajesh prays to Lord Krishna to give wisdom to Happu. Happu's children meet Keshav, and they bring him home. Rajesh hires Keshav for work.

1.name: Keshav Wins Everyone's Hearts
1.overview: Keshav resolves the problems of Happu's family and wins their hearts. Amma's health deteriorates, but Happu ignores her. Rajesh prays to Lord Krishna to prevent Happu from displaying arrogance.

1.name: Happu Asks Kamlesh to Leave the House
1.overview: Hapu warns Kamlesh to leave his house within two days. Kamlesh shares this information with Kat. Gabbar seeks financial help from Happu to expand his business, but Hapu humiliates him.

1.name: Keshav Tries to Reason with Happu
1.overview: Rajesh tells Keshav about Happu's actions and he tries to reason with Happu. Later, Rajesh prays to God to teach Happu a lesson. Kat gives Kamlesh a suggestion to stay in her house.

1.name: Happu Ousts Amma from the House
1.overview: Kamlesh fails to please Happu. Keshav gives Kat a suggestion to ensure that Happu is unable to oust Kamlesh from the house. Later, Happu ousts Amma from the house and Beni takes her to his house.

1.name: Happu Ousts Kamlesh From the House
1.overview: Amma narrates Beni a story, and it reminds her of Happu. Kamlesh unknowingly makes a mistake and Happu ousts him from the house. Rajesh asks Amma to come back home, but she refuses.

1.name: Kat Marries Kamlesh and Brings Him Home
1.overview: Rajesh tries to convince Amma to return home. On Keshav's advice, Kat marries Kamlesh and brings him to her house. Later, Amma asks Happu to accept their relationship.

1.name: Happu Doesn't Go to Rajesh's House
1.overview: Happu tells Kamlesh the rules of the house. Later, he makes up a story about having important work and doesn't go to Rajesh's house. Rajesh finds out Happu lied to her by reading a newspaper article.

1.name: Kat Tries to Make Breakfast for Kamlesh
1.overview: Kat tries to make tea and parathas for Kamlesh. The Paan shop owner humiliates Beni in front of Happu. At the police station, Happu tells Reshampal and Manohar about his party with the minister.

1.name: Happu Gets Defamed by a News Article
1.overview: Happu does a favour for Shakal's sister Guddi, and she thanks him by kissing him. Gabbar requests Happu to inaugurate his shop. Later, Happu gets defamed by a news article in the newspaper.

1.name: Happu Worries about His Defamation
1.overview: Happu resolves to prove himself innocent. He goes to seek Guddi's help but ends up getting defamed. Gabbar cancels his plan to let Happu inaugurate his shop. Upset, Happu then goes to Beni.

1.name: Happu Learns the Consequences of His Bad Attitude
1.overview: Happu learns the consequences of his bad attitude and seeks forgiveness from God for his mistake. Guddi clarifies the matter in a media interview. The family also forgives Happu for his actions.

1.name: The Kids Give Happu a Challenge
1.overview: At night, Happu dresses up as a ghost and scares the kids and Rajesh. The kids challenge Happu to spend a night in the crematorium. Reshampal asks Bhalla to hold onto his INR 50 lakhs of black money.

1.name: Happu Is Possessed by Bhalla's Spirit
1.overview: Happu and Beni spend the night with Bhalla in jail instead of the crematorium. Happu is possessed by Bhalla's spirit. Manohar hides the truth about Bhalla's death from Reshampal.

1.name: Happu Flirts with Vimlesh
1.overview: Happu flirts with Vimlesh and Beni gets into an argument with Happu. Manohar feels scared when Bhalla dies and lies to Reshampal about Bhalla. Meanwhile, Kamlesh gets a job.

1.name: Pitaji Suspects that Happu Is Possessed
1.overview: Pitaji suspects that Happu is possessed. Happu asks Vimlesh to run away with him. Beni and Vimlesh complain to Amma and Rajesh about Happu. Amma informs Rajesh about Pitaji's suspicion.

1.name: Happu Is Free of Bhalla's Spirit
1.overview: The family members learn that Bhalla has possessed Happu. They follow Keshav's advice, and Bhalla leaves Happu's body. Reshampal and Manohar are surprised to see Bhalla alive.

1.name: Rajesh and Vimlesh's Valentine's Day Wishes
1.overview: Rajesh and Vimlesh share their Valentine's Day wishes with their husbands. Kat tells Kamlesh to find a job. Hritik and Ranbir see Chamchi talking to a boy in school.

1.name: Beni Couldn't Take Vimlesh to Dinner
1.overview: Happu books a table for dinner with Rajesh. However, Beni is unable to book a table due to a lack of money. Later, on Valentine's night, Benny returns home drunk, which upsets Vimlesh.

1.name: Beni Gets a Good Job Opportunity
1.overview: Rajesh gets upset with Happu for not lending money to Beni. Later, Beni seeks help from a prominent lawyer, who offers him a job opportunity in Chennai. Beni and Vimlesh prepare to shift to Chennai.

1.name: Amma's Act to Prevent Beni from Leaving
1.overview: Happu considers Manohar his friend and spends time with him. Amma pretends to be sick to stop Beni from leaving, but Beni realises her act. Later, Amma refuses to let Beni go away.

1.name: Happu Plans to Prevent Beni from Going to Chennai
1.overview: Vimlesh packs his belongings for his trip to Chennai. Happu plans to prevent Beni from going to Chennai. When Vimlesh and Beni bid goodbye to everyone, Sundaram Nayar accuses Beni of being dishonest.

1.name: Ranbir Brags about Being the Son of an ACP
1.overview: Happu discourages Malaika from joining the police force. Kamlesh gets a job interview call. Ranbir brags about being the son of an ACP, and Chamchi complains to Happu about him.

1.name: Ranbir Is Not Happu's Son
1.overview: A man tells Ranbir that he is not Happu's son. An upset Ranbir shares this news with his family, and Happu decides to find out the truth. Ranbir accuses Happu and Rajesh of discriminating against him.

1.name: Happu is Unaware of Ranbir's Favourite Colour
1.overview: Happu tells Manohar to find the person who told Ranbir the truth. Later, he brings clothes of their favourite colours for the kids. Happu not knowing his favourite colour upsets the Ranbir.

1.name: Ranbir's Name Is Struck Off from School
1.overview: Ranbir's name is struck off from school for unpaid fees. Kamlesh wears a stolen shirt for an interview but gets into trouble. Happu beats up the man who tells the truth to Ranbir.

1.name: Ranbir Discovers the Truth
1.overview: Ranbir leaves the house. Keshav convinces him to return home, and later, Ranbir learns the truth. After receiving her exam results, Malaika bids goodbye to everyone and leaves for training.

1.name: Rajesh and Happu's Argument
1.overview: Rajesh and Happu have an argument. Chamchi strikes a deal with Ranbir. Rajesh gets upset with Happu over him not knowing her likes-dislikes. Chamchi plans to go for a movie with Sanket.

1.name: Happu Upsets Rajesh by Pleasing Amma
1.overview: Happu is able to read Amma's mind and pleases Amma by scolding Rajesh who, in turn, gets angry. Happu apologises to Rajesh on Amma's behalf. Later, Happu catches Ranbir's lie.

1.name: The Family Teaches Happu a Lesson
1.overview: Rajesh prevents Ranbir and Chamchi from fighting with each other and tells them the truth. The family teaches Happu a lesson by pretending to plot to kill him. Happu tries to pacify an upset Rajesh.

1.name: Happu Becomes a Police Inspector Again
1.overview: Malaika informs Rajesh over the phone that she has completed her training. While Kat gets a job, Keshav bids farewell to Happu's family. Happu becomes a police inspector again after being demoted.

1.name: Malaika Becomes an IPS Officer
1.overview: Malaika comes home as an IPS officer. Later, Malaika saves Reshampal from the escaped criminal Maglu, and Reshampal feels proud of her. The family hosts a party for Malaika who becomes an IPS officer.

1.name: Happu Argues with Malaika over a Case
1.overview: At the police station, Kusum complains to Malaika about a street poet. Malaika summons the poet to the police station, where he explains his side of the story. Happu argues with Malaika over the case.

1.name: Malaika Seeks Vimlesh's Help
1.overview: Rajesh tries to resolve the argument between Happu and Malaika. Happu attempts to learn Urdu to solve the case of the poet. Meanwhile, Malaika seeks help from Vimlesh to solve the case.

1.name: Malaika Resolves the Case of the Poet
1.overview: Beni feels that Vimlesh is betraying him. Malaika resolves the case of the poet on the way, and Reshampal praises her. Later, she clears Beni's misunderstanding by telling him the truth.

1.name: Malaika Threatens to Demote Happu
1.overview: Happu refuses to fulfil the family's demands and becomes angry at their unnecessary expenses. Later, he demands a bribe from an ice cream vendor. Malaika threatens to demote Happu to discipline him.

1.name: The Money Is Stolen from Happu's Safe
1.overview: Happu suspects Ranbir to have stolen money from the safe. Pran files a complaint against Pappu Nath, and Malaika assigns this case to Happu. Later, someone again steals money from Happu's safe.

1.name: Happu Frisks Rajesh on Suspicion of Theft
1.overview: Happu calls Pran's wife Anju to the police station. He then frisks Rajesh on suspicion of theft. Rajesh complains to Amma about Happu. Pran comes to the police station to complain about Pappu.

1.name: Happu Suspects Amma of Stealing
1.overview: Despite keeping watch over Happu's safe, money is stolen from it. Happu suspects Amma and asks Rajesh to frisk her. To resolve Pran's case, Happu asks Pran to divorce Anju as a solution.

1.name: Malaika Catches the Thief
1.overview: Malaika catches a thief stealing money at night. The ice-cream vendor tells Happu the reason for seeking revenge. As Pran's case is solved, Happu is saved from demotion and apologises to the family.

1.name: The Minister's Son Develops Animosity towards Malaika
1.overview: The minister's son, Bantu, develops animosity towards Malaika. Ranbir plans to celebrate Holi with Simran at school. To take revenge on Malaika, Bantu applies colours to Rajesh and Amma and flees.

1.name: Happu's Family Becomes Desperate for Water
1.overview: Due to Bantu, Happu's family becomes desperate for water. Happu's children plead with Masterji to keep the school open on Holi. Rajesh suspects a conspiracy behind the water shortage at home.

1.name: Amma and Rajesh Bathe in Alcohol
1.overview: Beni arranges for water, but Bantu spills it. Unable to find water, Amma and Rajesh bathe in alcohol, but Bantu again applies colour to them. Ranbir tricks Simran into calling her to school on Holi.

1.name: Malaika Catches Hold of Bantu and Beats Him
1.overview: Beni arranges water for Amma and Rajesh. Happu's children convince Masterji to keep the school open on Holi. Later, Malaika beats Bantu who was trying to smear colour on Amma and Rajesh.

1.name: Happu's Family Enjoy the Colours of Holi
1.overview: Malaika forgives Bantu when he apologises to her. She later solves the case and celebrates Holi with her family. At school, Masterji catches Hrithik, Ranbir and Chamchi playing Holi with Simreet.

1.name: Rajesh's Plan for Amma's Birthday
1.overview: Rajesh plans something for Amma's birthday and stops her from going shopping. Tinku goes to the police station to complain about his neighbour. Amma is surprised to see Rajesh in the jewellery shop.

1.name: Rajesh and Vimlesh Lie to Amma
1.overview: Rajesh and Vimlesh return from the bazaar and lie to Amma. After seeing Jang Bahadur, Tinku's neighbour, Happu feels that he is not capable of hitting Tinku. Happu seeks Beni's help for his problem.

1.name: Amma Complains to Happu about Rajesh
1.overview: Amma complains to Happu that Rajesh has cut down her expenses, and Happu talks to her. Tinku again comes to lodge a police complaint against Jung Bahadur. Beni talks to Malaika about Happu.

1.name: Happu Interrogates Jung Bahadur's Mother
1.overview: Reshampal and Malaika stop Happu from interrogating Jung Bahadur strictly. After hearing Rajesh, Amma devises a plan. Happu sees Jung Bahadur running in the bazaar and interrogates his mother.

1.name: Malaika Solves Jang Bahadur's Case
1.overview: Amma follows Rajesh and Vimlesh. Malaika tells Happu that Jang Bahadur hates the red colour, and that's why he was beating Tinku. Tinku tells Amma that Rajesh has gone shopping for her.

1.name: Amma and Rajesh Get into a Fight
1.overview: Amma and Rajesh get into a fight, but Happu helps them reconcile. Later, a man comes to the police station to complain against his landlord, and Happu suggests a solution to his problem.

1.name: Happu's Plan Backfires on Him
1.overview: As Amma and Rajesh get into an argument again, Happu comes up with a plan. However, Happu's strategy backfires on him. In the police station, Malaika warns Happu upon seeing his anger towards Manohar.

1.name: Happu Is fed Up of Rajesh and Amma's Fight
1.overview: Amma and Rajesh argue again. Malaika rebukes Happu for talking rudely to the complainant at the police station. Later, Rajesh and Amma vent their anger on Happu, leaving him frustrated.

1.name: Masterji Vents His Anger at Happu
1.overview: Amma and Rajesh reconcile for the sake of Happu. Masterji gets angry with Chamchi and Ranbir's actions and calls Happu to school to vent his anger. Beni tells Happu the solution to his problem.

1.name: Happu's Advice to All the Husbands
1.overview: Happu instigates Amma and Rajesh against each other. Malaika solves the case between the landlord and the tenant. Rajesh and Amma vent their anger at Happu and Happu gives advice to all the husbands.

1.name: Amma and Rajesh's Plan to Become Famous
1.overview: Amma and Rajesh plan to become famous after seeing Vimal and Beni making videos. In the police station, a man complains about Hakikat Khureshi, a resident of his colony, whose dreams turn true.

1.name: Hakikat's Dream Comes True
1.overview: When Happu's children arrive late to school, Masterji asks them to call their parents. Hakikat has a dream about Happu, and Happu gets worried as his dream comes true. The children lie to Masterji.

1.name: Rajesh Makes a Video of Her Murder
1.overview: Rajesh decides to make a video of her murder at Amma's hands and Ranbir and Chamchi come up with an idea. Hakikat tells Happu a riddle. Happu is shocked to see Amma attacking Rajesh with a knife.

1.name: Happu's Sleep Is Disturbed by Hakikat's Dreams
1.overview: Happu, troubled by Hakikat's dreams, decides not to let Hakikat sleep. However, Hakikat falls asleep in the police station and dreams about Happu again. Happu is scared to see Rajesh attacking Amma.

1.name: Happu Is Free of Hakikat's Dreams
1.overview: Malaika suspends Manohar for torturing Hakikat. Thereafter, Hakikat sees another dream about Happu. Amma and Rajesh concoct a drama of Happu's murder. Later, Happu is free of Hakikat's dreams.

1.name: Masterji's Plan to Get a Home Loan
1.overview: Following Vimlesh's advice, Rajesh sets a rule for Happu. Singer Pintu lodges a complaint against his music teacher, Pakhawaj. Masterji tells Chamchi and Ranbir his plan to get a home loan.

1.name: Happu Gets Pintu Beaten Up
1.overview: Masterji uses Happu's name in front of the bank officials for the loan, but Happu does not answer his call. Happu gets Pintu beaten up by Manohar to bring pain in his voice and tells Beni his problem.

1.name: Happu Becomes Pinkia for Pintu
1.overview: Happu once again fails to answer Masterji's call. Amma teaches the kids about Rama Navami. Happu devises a plan to inflict pain in Pintu's voice, and he becomes Pinkia to call Pintu.

1.name: Happu's Trick Lands Him in Trouble
1.overview: Happu's trick to solve Pintu's case lands him in trouble. Masterji threatens to fail Chamchi and Ranbir in the exams if he does not get the loan. Later, Rajesh refuses to help Happu.

1.name: Pintu Sings a Heart-Wrenching Song
1.overview: Amma meets Pintu in the guise of Pinkiya to help Happu, but Pintu falls for her. Happu is forced to tell Pintu the truth, which breaks his heart. Later, Pintu sings a heart-wrenching song.

1.name: Happu Gets a Sensitive Case
1.overview: Malaika instructs Happu to solve the case sensitively. Later, Happu comes across a case of a woman attempting suicide. At school, Shreya talks to Hrithik, Ranbir and Chamchi about her problem.

1.name: Hapus Befriends Pari
1.overview: Amma is surprised to see Happu's growing love for Rajesh. Pari again thinks of committing suicide. Happu, disguised as Hapus, befriends Pari. Amma plans a doubt in Rajesh's mind about Happu.

1.name: Rajesh Grows Suspicious of Happu
1.overview: Rajesh detects the scent of perfume on Happu's body and grows suspicious. She asks Beni to spy on Happu. Hrithik overhears Happu talking to Pari and relays the information to Chamki and Ranbir.

1.name: Rajesh Learns about Happu's Actions
1.overview: Happu goes to watch a movie with Pari, and Beni takes their photo. Rajesh and Amma are surprised to learn about Happu's affair. Rajesh also informs the children about Happu's actions.

1.name: Rajesh Confronts Pari and Happu
1.overview: Happu brings a bangle for Rajesh, but she doesn't talk to him nicely. Later, she catches Happu with Pari and confronts them. Pari reveals the truth in front of everyone, and they feel proud of Happu.

1.name: KK to Trap Malaika In His Plan
1.overview: The Commissioner informs Malaika and Happu about JK's gang. JK's son, KK, decides to trap Malaika in his plan. Amma reveals her desire to Rajesh. KK deliberately gets himself arrested.

1.name: KK Flirts with Malaika
1.overview: The children ask Happu to increase their pocket money. Malaika sees KK's wounds, and KK flirts with her. Later, Amma meets a person named Sunny in the market, and they become friends.

1.name: Pitaji Assigns Happu a Task
1.overview: Rajesh tells Happu that Amma is having an affair. Amma informs Pitaji about Sunny. Pitaji assigns Happu the task of keeping Sunny away from Amma. Happu asks Chamchi to keep an eye on Amma.

1.name: Malaika's Wish to Get Married
1.overview: Chamchi informs the family about Amma and Sunny's romance. KK, who is in custody, flirts with Malaika. Malaika tells Rajesh that she wants to get married. At Pitaji's behest, Manohar slaps Happu.

1.name: Malaika Arrests JK
1.overview: Amma tells the truth to Sunny and ends their friendship. Malaika’s plan to nab JK succeeds and Reshampal praises her. Later, Amma pacifies an angry Pitaji.

1.name: Happu Is Happy with Astrologer Pintu's Prediction
1.overview: Manohar doesn't get a half-day leave from the police station. Babbu complains to Happu about astrologer Pintu. Rajesh starts her cooking channel. Happu is pleased with astrologer Pintu's prediction.

1.name: Chef Pintu Tells Happu the Way to Success
1.overview: Happu makes a promise to Rajesh. Chef Pintu tells Happu that he is not getting success because of Rajesh and offers a solution. Happu tells Beni about Chef Pintu, and Vimlesh overhears them.

1.name: Rajesh Parts Ways with Happu
1.overview: Happu urges Rajesh to part ways with him. Upset Rajesh leaves the house and goes to stay with Vimlesh. A criminal, Kamalkant, escapes from jail, and Reshampal threatens to suspend Happu and Manohar.

1.name: Happu's Bad Days Start
1.overview: Happu's fortune takes a turn for the worse and he gets suspended. Rajesh creates a video for her cooking channel, which becomes famous. Amma comes up with an idea to make Happu realise his mistake.

1.name: Amma Persuades Rajesh to Return Home
1.overview: An Astrologer reveals the truth about Pintu to Happu. Chef Ranjeev offers Rajesh to work with him, but she declines. Happu apologises to Rajesh, and Amma persuades Rajesh to return home.

1.name: Rajesh Mocks Happu for Getting Older
1.overview: As Happu's back aches, Rajesh playfully mocks him about getting older. Reshampal arrests Pappu, who is adept at wooing women. Masterji asks Chamchi and Ranbir to bring Happu to school.

1.name: Beni and Happu Tell the Doctor about Their Problem
1.overview: Rajesh and Vimlesh's friend, Urja, mistakes Happu for Rajesh's father-in-law. Chamchi and Ranbir reach school without Happu and lie to the teacher. Beni and Happu go to the doctor with their problem.

1.name: Pappu Gives Happu a Fitness Tip
1.overview: Happu is shocked to learn about Pappu's age. Amma tells Rajesh a secret. Chamchi and Ranbir threaten the ice cream seller to dress up as Happu and come to the school. Pappu gives Happu a fitness tip.

1.name: Happu Starts Following a Diet Plan
1.overview: In the bazaar, the bangle vendor mistakes Beni for Vimlesh's father and Beni gets angry. Happu eats boiled food and pleases Rajesh with Pappu's help. Later, Happu tells Beni about Pappu.

1.name: Malaika Advises Happu and Beni to Stay Fit
1.overview: Rajesh and Vimalesh realise that their husbands are trying to make them happy by learning poetries from Pappu. They teach their husbands a lesson. Malaika advises Happu and Beni to stay fit.

1.name: Whose Maternal Family Is More Powerful?
1.overview: On seeing Happu working in the kitchen, Amma argues with Rajesh. Later, Rajesh and Amma challenge each other to see whose maternal family is powerful. Elsewhere, Chamchi and Ranbir lie to Masterji.

1.name: Rajesh Tells Gabbar about Her Challenge to Amma
1.overview: Gabbar, who comes to Rajesh's house, flaunts his bravery. Happu fails to solve Gyanchakshu's dispute with his landlord. Rajesh tells Gabbar about her challenge to Amma. Tinku arrives at Amma's house.

1.name: Gabbar Is Scared by Tinku's Strength
1.overview: Gabbar, scared by Tinku's strength, asks Rajesh to avoid arranging a fight with him. Reshampal pressures Happu to resolve the Gyanchakshu case and Happu puts his landlord in jail.

1.name: Happu Apprehends Tinku in a False Case
1.overview: Rajesh's attempt to stop the rivalry between Gabbar and Tinku fails. Later, as per Beni's plan, Happu apprehends Tinku in a false case. Amma visits the police station to secure Tinku's release.

1.name: Gabbar Wins the Fight Due to Happu's Plan
1.overview: Vimlesh tells Happu about Rajesh's threat to go to her maternal home. A fight erupts between Tinku and Gabbar. Gabbar wins the fight due to Happu's plan. Amma learns about Happu and Rajesh's plot.

1.name: Ranbir Is Punished for Writing a Love Letter
1.overview: Happu punishes Ranbir after reading his love letter. Beni shares a secret with Ranbir and Chamchi. Reshampal puts a tantric behind bars. Ranbir decides to summon Bhaddi’s spirit to question her.

1.name: Bhaddi's Spirit Possesses Vimlesh
1.overview: Manohar explains to Happu how to punish Buddha Baba in jail. Chamchi and Ranbir summon Bhaddi's spirit, which later possesses Vimlesh. A frightened Beni then informs Happu about it.

1.name: Happu and Beni Are Frightened by Bhaddi's Spirit
1.overview: Happu and Beni, frightened by Bhaddi's spirit, inform Rajesh about her. Bhaddi starts haunting Happu, and Amma suggests a solution to get rid of her. Later, Bhaddi plots to kill Rajesh.

1.name: Bhaddi's Spirit Wants to Marry Happu
1.overview: Beni saves Rajesh’s life. At the police station, Happu tries to revive Ujaad Buddhi Baba who had fainted due to Happu’s torture. Later, Bhaddi’s spirit asks Happu to kill Rajesh and marry her.

1.name: Rajesh Saves Happu From Bhaddi
1.overview: Chamchi informs the family that Ranbir has summoned Bhaddi's spirit. Bhaddi's spirit tries to marry Happu forcibly. Rajesh confronts Bhaddi and saves Happu from her.

1.name: Rajesh Gets Irked with Happu Due to the Heat
1.overview: Rajesh, annoyed by the heat, argues with Happu over shutting down the air conditioner to save it from damage. Masterji faints due to the heat. Subhash comes to Happu with his complaint.

1.name: Hindrances in Happu and Rajesh's Romance
1.overview: Rajesh invites Vimlesh over for some buttermilk. Irritated by the heat, Ammaji and the kids stop Happu and Rajesh from getting romantic. Beni and Vimlesh also join them in their room to enjoy the AC.

1.name: Happu Tries to Arrange the AC
1.overview: Happu arranges for AC from the dealer Santram and informs Rajesh. The minister's PA calls Santram for the same. Ranbir and Chamchi try to postpone the exam. Rajesh scolds Happu for not arranging AC.

1.name: Happu and Rajesh Try to Romance
1.overview: Happu tries to appease Rajesh. They try to get romantic, but Amma interrupts them. Happu asks Santaram about an AC. Later, he takes another packet of medicine from Baba and informs Beni about it.

1.name: Happu Shatters Rajesh's Hopes
1.overview: Happu and Rajesh's romance gets disturbed due to Vimalesh. Happu receives an AC from Santaram by framing him in a false case. When Rajesh tries to be romantic, Happu tells her about Baba's medicine.

1.name: Happu Plans to Celebrate Father's Day
1.overview: Happu tells Beni that he plans to celebrate Father's Day and confides his feelings in Rajesh. Amma tells Happu about Khanna's death. Happu and Malaika argue while Sneha gets her work done by Ranbir.

1.name: Is Happu Khanna's Son?
1.overview: Pitaji tells Amma that Khanna has told him that Happu is his son. Rajesh hears Amma's words. Later, Happu gets upset about the children's behaviour. Rajesh tells Happu that he is Khanna's son.

1.name: Happu Is Saddened by the Truth about His Father
1.overview: Malaika slaps a man. Happu argues with Amma after learning the truth about his father. Ranbir confesses his feelings to Sneha. Chamchi asks Rajesh for permission to go camping.

1.name: Happu Saves Chamchi
1.overview: Happu asks Malaika to apologise to the minister's brother-in-law. Amma tells Pitaji that Happu is their own son. Happu saves Chamchi in the jungle. Ranbir tells Malaika the reason for his sorrow.

1.name: Happu's Children Realise Their Mistake
1.overview: At Happu's insistence, Sneha apologises to Ranbir. Later, she also saves Malaika's job. Pitaji's misunderstanding is cleared. Happu's children apologise to him, and they all celebrate Father's Day.

1.name: A Man Curses Happu
1.overview: Amma decides to contest the elections at Modern Colony, but Rajesh stops her. A man curses Happu for not filing his complaint. Rajesh informs everyone about her decision to contest the elections.

1.name: Happu Permits Rajesh to Contest the Election
1.overview: Rajesh gets Happu's permission to contest the election. Happu's friend visits the police station. Rajesh tells the club's women about her decision. Ranbir decides to pass exams through hard work.

1.name: Rajesh Learns About Happu's Mischief
1.overview: Happu and Beni urinate in a public place and a video of it goes viral. Happu gets injured again. KK insists that Happu accompany him to the casino. Soon, Malaika shows Rajesh the video of Happu.

1.name: KK Traps Happu In His Plan
1.overview: Rajesh argues with Happu about his viral video. As advised by Happu, Chamchi and Ranbir buy exam papers. Later, KK comes to meet Happu and once again traps him in his plan.

1.name: Rajesh Learns About the Conspiracy against Her
1.overview: Malaika informs Rajesh about Chamchi and Ranbir buying exam papers. KK takes Happu to see a courtesan dance and Rajesh watches the video. Later, Rajesh discovers Mrs Khandelwal's conspiracy.

1.name: Happu Decides to Earn Money through Corruption
1.overview: Happu's family complains that he doesn't fulfil their wishes. He decides to earn money through corruption. A man files a complaint about his scooter being stolen, and Happu demands a bribe from him.

1.name: Happu Makes His Family Happy Using Bribe Money
1.overview: Happu brings gifts for Amma and Rajesh, which makes Malaika suspicious. At school, Ranbir and Chamchi belittle Aarav by giving a burger party. Happu solves the case by deceiving the complainant.

1.name: Malaika Learns about Happu's Corruption
1.overview: Happu takes a bribe from a man who brings a thief to the police station. Malaika learns about Happu's actions and keeps an eye on him. A man informs Happu that a senior officer is coming to meet him.

1.name: Happu and Manohar Get Punished for Taking a Bribe
1.overview: The anti-corruption department officer Balveer threatens Happu and Manohar. They seek help from Reshampal and Balveer punishes them. In school, Ranbir and Chamchi flaunt their wealth.

1.name: Happu Promises Never to Take a Bribe Again
1.overview: Happu makes his own children poor and feeds them, but his wrongdoing is revealed. Happu, Beni and Manohar are arrested for corruption. Happu apologises and promises never to take a bribe again.

1.name: The Theft of an Umbrella and Raincoat in the Rain
1.overview: Happu wears Rajesh's grandfather's raincoat. Manohar informs him about the theft of an umbrella and raincoat. The commissioner wears Happu's raincoat and goes out and Rajesh calls Happu home.

1.name: Amma Learns about Rajesh's Treasure
1.overview: Reshampal experiences memory loss, and Happu's raincoat is stolen. Beni gives 5,000 rupees to Chamchi and Ranbir for safekeeping. Amma overhears Rajesh and Gabbar discussing the treasure.

1.name: Rajesh Learns about the Raincoat Theft
1.overview: Happu gets upset when Amma tells him Rajesh's secret. Chamchi and Ranbir start their work with Beni's money, and Beni demands his money back. Happu tells Rajesh about the theft of the raincoat.

1.name: Happu's Plan to Catch the Umbrella Thief Fails
1.overview: Beni doesn't tell Vimlesh that he gave money to Chamchi and Ranbir. Vimlesh suspects Beni and threatens to leave home. When Happu's plan to catch the umbrella thief fails, he seeks help from Malaika.

1.name: The Umbrella Thief Is Caught
1.overview: Chamchi and Ranbir return Beni's money. Due to Malaika, the umbrella thief is caught. Gabbar finds a letter from his father's coat. At the police station, the umbrella thief tells everyone his story.

1.name: Rajesh and Vimlesh's Photoshoot in the Lock-up
1.overview: Manohar gives Happu a bad news. Rajesh and Vimlesh do a photoshoot in the police station to increase their likes on social media. The new DCP Chaman Chatvar arrives, and Happu lies to him.

1.name: Rajesh and Vimlesh Get Stuck in Jail
1.overview: Happu gets scared on learning that DCP Chaman hates lies. Furthermore, Happu fails to bail Rajesh and Vimlesh out. Later at night, Amma and the kids secretly go to meet Rajesh and Vimlesh in jail.

1.name: Happu Tells Rajesh a Plan to Get Out of Jail
1.overview: While trying to release Rajesh and Vimlesh, Malaika gets suspended. During the rehearsal of the play, Chamchi misses Rajesh and starts crying for real. Happu tells Rajesh a plan to get out of jail.

1.name: Rajesh Tells Chaman a Fake Story
1.overview: As per Happu's instructions, Rajesh praises Chaman. Beni visits Vimlesh in jail and gets into trouble. Chaman takes Rajesh out and the latter tells him a fake story about becoming a thief.

1.name: Happu Gets Rajesh and Vimlesh Released
1.overview: Chaman wishes to marry Rajesh. Happu tricks Chaman to get Rajesh and Vimlesh released from jail and brings them home, delighting everyone. When Chaman learns about Happu's lie, he asks him to resign.

1.name: A Threat from an Unknown Person
1.overview: Beni gives Happu good news about one of his cases. Sanju teases Chamchi and Ranbir. Everyone is scared due to a threat from an unknown person, and the police receives many complaints about it.

1.name: Happu Receives a Threat from an Unknown Person
1.overview: Rajesh insists on going to Goa with Happu. Happu receives a threat from an unknown person. Reshampal tells Manohar that he also received a threat. Dabbu files a missing complaint for his wife.

1.name: Malaika Vows to Catch the Anonymous Person
1.overview: Chamchi and Ranbir talk ill about Masterji. Malaika vows to catch the anonymous person threatening them and asks Happu to give that person a befitting reply. Meanwhile, Amma talks to Kulbhushan.

1.name: Will Malaika Be Able to Find the Unknown Person?
1.overview: Under Malaika's pressure, Happu responds to the new threat from the unknown person. Masterji expels Chamchi and Ranbir from school. At night, Malaika waits to catch the unknown person.

1.name: Malaika Arrests Chabra
1.overview: Masterji gets irked on seeing Chamchi and Ranbir in school. Malaika responds to the threat from an unknown person and someone kidnaps her. Later, she catches Chabra and he reveals his conspiracy.

1.name: Happu Gets a Chance to Go to Bangkok
1.overview: Happu speaks ill about Bangkok in front of Rajesh. Meanwhile, Malaika gets injured during an encounter. Later, Resham Pal decides to send Happu and Manohar to Bangkok to attend a program.

1.name: Happu Needs to Get an NOC to Go to Bangkok
1.overview: Chaurasia comes with a complaint about the tenant and tries to bribe Happu. Amma and Rajesh argue over taking care of Malaika. Reshampal asks Happu to get an NOC from Rajesh for going to Bangkok.

1.name: Rajesh Is Delighted as Happu Supports Her
1.overview: Chamchi and Ranbir ask Masterji to pay for their school trip. During Amma and Rajesh's argument, Happu supports Rajesh, delighting her. Chaurasia tells Happu to take action against his tenant.

1.name: Happu Gets into Trouble Pleasing Amma
1.overview: Reshampal asks Happu to get an NOC from Amma to go to Bangkok. To please Amma, Happu ends up upsetting Rajesh. Chamchi and Ranbir get upset as they fail to collect money for the trip.

1.name: Will Happu Go to Bangkok?
1.overview: When Amma and Rajesh learn the truth from Manohar's wife, they realise Happu is deceiving them. They agree to let Happu go to Bangkok if he meets their condition. Reshampal gives Happu some news.

1.name: Kanpur's Milkmen Go on a Strike because of Happu
1.overview: Amma pleases Rajesh by praising her tea. Happu slaps Kanpur Milk Union Leader Bhainsa Kumar over a small issue. Angered by this, Bhainsa Kumar announces a strike of the milkmen.

1.name: Everything Goes Haywire Without Milk
1.overview: Masterji gets angry at Chamchi and Ranbir after he is served tea without milk. Happu and Benny go to get milk, but the milkman refuses them. Rajesh gives tea without milk to Amma, leaving her irked.

1.name: Malaika's Plan to Bring Milk
1.overview: Happu promises Rajesh that he will bring milk. The minister tells Happu not to apologise to Bhainsa Kumar. Annoyed by not getting tea, Amma scolds Chamchi. Malaika tells Happu her plan to get milk.

1.name: Happu Makes Beni the Scapegoat
1.overview: Malaika's plan to get milk falls through. Annoyed about not having tea, Amma attempts to commit suicide. Happu steals goat's milk with Beni, and when they get caught, Happu blames Beni.

1.name: Amma Ends the Milk Strike
1.overview: Amma ends the strike by apologising to Bhainsa Kumar. Due to the milkman, Bantu, the minister, gets a promotion and he gives Happu a new order. Happu gets into trouble by raising his hand on Bantu.

1.name: Happu Is Accused of Petticoat Theft
1.overview: A few incidents of petticoat theft occur in the city. Manohar tells Happu a secret and seeks his help. Later, a man accuses Happu of stealing petticoats and the police searches Happu's house.

1.name: Happu Is Arrested for Stealing Petticoats
1.overview: Happu is arrested for petticoat theft, which brings disgrace to the family. He tells the police that Manohar is the thief, but Manohar lands him in trouble. Later, Happu asks Beni to defend his case.

1.name: Beni Fails to Get Happu Released from Jail
1.overview: The prosecution presents witnesses against Happu. Beni asks the judge for two days' extension. Happu scolds Beni for being unable to get him released. Later, Happu's family is hurt by their insult.

1.name: Manohar Confesses His Crime
1.overview: In court, Beni argues in defence of Happu, but the prosecution lawyer proves him wrong. Manohar comes to court and confesses his crime. The prosecution lawyer then proves that Manohar is lying.

1.name: Happu Is Punished in the Petticoat Theft Case
1.overview: Pitaji is an eyewitness to Happu's innocence. He gives his testimony in the court set up at home, but the judge declares Happu guilty and sentences him. Everyone sees Manohar with a petticoat.

1.name: Reshampal Chooses Rajesh for the Dance Performance
1.overview: Reshampal asks Happu to arrange a classical dancer for the Independence Day program. Happu speaks with the courtesan Masakkali. After watching Rajesh's dance, Reshampal asks her to perform.

1.name: Masakkali Blackmails Happu
1.overview: Masakkali blackmails Happu who breaks his promise, and he seeks Beni's advice. Rajesh makes Amma jealous by talking about her classical dance. Happu asks Rajesh to remove her name from the programme.

1.name: Rajesh's Sprained Ankle
1.overview: Rajesh misses the chance to dance in the programme because of her sprained ankle. Masakkali blackmails Happu for money. Happu then requests Reshampal to let Masakkali perform instead.

1.name: Vimlesh Sees Happu and Beni Meeting Masakkali
1.overview: Reshampal shares a secret with Rajesh, and Rajesh believes that Happu deliberately made him fall. Vimlesh catches Happu and Beni meeting Masakkali. Amma vows to fix Rajesh's leg.

1.name: Happu's Disguise as Hapiya Devi at the Event
1.overview: Beni fools Masakkali. During the Independence Day event, Happu's disguise as Hapiya Devi is exposed, and the minister becomes upset. Chamchi manages the situation and calms the minister down.

1.name: Rajesh and Vimlesh Try To Lift Senti's Spirits
1.overview: Malaika tells Amma why Rajesh is upset. On Happu's suggestion, Rajesh and Vimlesh invite Senti home for Raksha Bandhan to lift his spirits. Happu sends Rakhi to jail for breaking Manohar's nose.

1.name: Happu and Beni Cook Food with Amma
1.overview: When Rajesh and Vimlesh don't return from the market, Amma complains to Happu. Happu and Beni cook food with Amma. Later, Rajesh gets excited about Senti's arrival, which irritates Happu.

1.name: Rajesh Celebrates Raksha Bandhan with Senti
1.overview: Rajesh and Vimlesh tie a rakhi to Senti, but Amma's questions make Senti sad. In jail, Rakhi ties a rakhi to Happu and makes him her brother. Amma requests the children to gather some information.

1.name: Beni's Words Make Senti Cry
1.overview: Rajesh and Vimlesh tell Senti to forget the past. Happu's words enrage Manohar. Senti plays carrom with the children and Happu joins the game. Senti starts crying after hearing Beni's words.

1.name: Happu Asks Gulbiya to Marry Senti
1.overview: Rajesh scolds Happu for making Senti cry. Happu helps Rakhi escape from jail. Later, Happu asks Gulbiya to marry Senti, and Senti starts liking Gulbiya.

1.name: Vimlesh Is Amazed by Beni's Hidden Talent
1.overview: Amma lies to Rajesh, saying that Happu plays the flute very well. Happu sends away Bansidhar, the flautist who comes to the police station. Vimlesh is amazed to discover Beni's hidden talent.

1.name: Happu Tries to Learn the Flute
1.overview: Happu tries to learn the flute from Beni, but they end up arguing. Ranbir and Chamchi play a trick to get roles in the play. Happu helps Bansidhar and asks him to teach him the flute.

1.name: Happu Puts on an Act to Avoid Playing the Flute
1.overview: Bansidhar sends away Happu, who comes to learn the flute. Soon, Happu pretends to be injured to avoid playing the flute on Janmashtami. Amma threatens to harm herself to force Happu to play the flute.

1.name: Happu Asks Bansidhar to Play the Flute
1.overview: Chamchi and Ranbir’s attempt to participate in the Janmashtami play fails. Happu asks Bansidhar to play the flute at the Janmashtami event and lies to Rajesh.

1.name: Happu Is Exposed During the Janmashtami Puja
1.overview: Bansidhar refuses to play the flute at Happu's event. During the Janmashtami celebration, Happu pretends to play the flute, but his deception is exposed. Amma blames herself for lying to everyone.

1.name: Happu's Family Doesn't Respect Him
1.overview: Happu's family doesn't respect him. The teacher threatens to fail Chamchi and Ranbir. Reshampal advises Happu to improve his reputation in his family, and Happu seeks help from Beni.

1.name: Happu Gains Respect in Everyone's Eyes
1.overview: Happu gains respect in everyone's eyes with Beni's help. Rajesh gets permission from Amma to start a tiffin service. Chamchi and Ranbir try to scare Masterji by showing that Happu knows a minister.

1.name: Happu Faces Trouble Due to the Act about a Minister
1.overview: Beni pretends to be a minister and speaks to Happu's family, arousing Malaika's suspicion about Happu. When Rajesh asks Happu to have the minister inaugurate her tiffin service, he faces a dilemma.

1.name: Beni's Pretence Levels Up Happu's Issues
1.overview: Beni talks to Rajesh on the phone posing as a minister and his wife and levels up his issues. Chamchi and Ranbir get Masterji to talk to the minister and wish him Happy Teacher's Day.

1.name: A Minister Comes to Inaugurate Rajesh's Tiffin Service
1.overview: Malaika saves the minister from falling. Beni disguises as a minister and inaugurates Rajesh's tiffin service. Soon, Malaika brings the real minister and Happu and Beni's pretence is exposed.

1.name: Happu Gives His Family’s Gold Coin to the Jeweller
1.overview: Happu gives his family’s gold coin to the jeweller for cleaning. Amma upsets Rajesh by refusing to give her a Ganesh Chaturthi gift. Actor Pappu Kumar tries to flirt with Malaika.

1.name: Happu's Gold Coin Is Stolen
1.overview: Happu’s gold coin gets stolen in the robbery at the jeweller’s house. Chamchi and Ranbir delight Masterji with some news. Amma reconciles with Rajesh. Happu goes to a church, where the thief arrives.

1.name: The Thief's Condition to Return Happu's Gold Coin
1.overview: Darling thief sets a condition to return Happu's gold coin. Happu calls the thief’s girlfriend’s father, Daulatram, to the police station to talk to him. Pappu Kumar provokes Malaika by showing off.

1.name: Happu Blackmails Reshampal for Money
1.overview: Reshampal tells Happu about his problem. Happu comes up with a plan to get his coin back from the thief and blackmails Reshampal for money. Rajesh tricks Amma into giving him money.

1.name: Darling Returns Happu's Coin
1.overview: Reshampal agrees to help Darling, and Darling returns the coin to Happu. Malaika tells Masterji the solution to his problem. Later, Happu's family celebrates Ganesh Festival together.

1.name: Rajesh's Deteriorating Memory
1.overview: Rajesh forgets where she kept Happu's file and Malaika's items. Doctor KB treats Reshampal at the station with his remedies. Happu asks KB for medicine to improve Rajesh's poor memory.

1.name: The Powder Enhances Rajesh's Memory
1.overview: Rajesh takes the powder brought by Happu to improve her memory. When the powder helps her recall an old incident, she asks Happu to apologise to Gabbar. She brings up old issues and argues with Amma.

1.name: Gabbar Does Not Forgive Happu
1.overview: Rajesh fights with Beni and Vimlesh by reminding them of old issues. Chamchi and Ranbir take advantage of Masterji’s memory loss. Happu calls Gabbar to apologise, but Gabbar threatens to seek revenge.

1.name: Rajesh Recalls an Event from Her Past Life
1.overview: Gabbar takes revenge on Beni and Happu. Happu gets Rajesh drunk, but she recalls an event from her past life. Meanwhile, Chamchi and Ranbir convince Masterji to pass them in school.

1.name: Rajesh Makes Everyone Emotional with Her Words
1.overview: Everyone hides, fearing Rajesh's taunts. Malaika asks Rajesh to list her complaints and Rajesh makes everyone emotional with her words. Masterji learns that a fake report card has been created by him.

1.name: Amma's Liquor Expense Angers Rajesh
1.overview: Rajesh finds out how much Amma spends on liquor and argues with Happu. Malaika suggests Vimlesh a trick to force Beni to work. Later, Happu brings cheap liquor for Amma.

1.name: Happu Decides to Turn Honest
1.overview: After Amma tells Happu about an incident related to Pitaji, he decides to turn honest. Vimlesh and Malaika execute their plan. Beni meets Manmauji and finds a way to earn money.

1.name: Beni Becomes a Thief for Quick Money
1.overview: Actress Madhurani visits the police to report a theft. Beni gives Madhurani's saree to Manmauji for money and brings gifts for Vimlesh and Amma. Chamchi and Ranbir plan to give the exam honestly.

1.name: Beni and Vimlesh Change after Getting Rich
1.overview: Reshampal orders Happu to find Madhurani's clothes. After a fight with Rajesh, Amma goes to stay with Beni. When Beni and Vimlesh become rich, Happu suspects them due to the changes in them.

1.name: Beni Confesses to His Crime
1.overview: Happu sees Beni stealing clothes from Madhurani's house, but Beni manages to trick him. Later, at Malaika's suggestion, Beni surrenders. Madhurani forgives Beni and asks him for a favour.

1.name: Gulabiya Plants a Doubt in Rajesh and Vimlesh's Minds
1.overview: Malaika's family talks to her about her marriage. Gulabiya overhears Rajesh and Vimlesh and plants doubts in their minds about their husbands. Later, Beni and Happu talk about their illnesses.

1.name: Happu and Beni Worry about Their Health
1.overview: Rajesh and Vimlesh discuss their struggle to woo their husbands. Ranbir takes Chamchi's help to befriend Natasha. Beni and Happu worry about their health after overhearing Dr. Udas.

1.name: Happu and Beni Consider Their Wives Cheaters
1.overview: Dr. Udas advises Happu and Beni to overcome their Vitamin D deficiency. Due to a misunderstanding, Amma instills doubt in Happu's mind about Rajesh. Something makes Beni suspect Vimlesh of cheating.

1.name: Happu and Beni Chase Their Wives
1.overview: Happu and Beni's misunderstanding for their wives levels up. Ranbir, disguised as Inga, goes out with Natasha. Happu and Beni follow their wives to the theatre and see them with someone.

1.name: Happu and Beni Tell Their Wives the Truth
1.overview: Chamchi exposes Ranbir in front of Natasha. Happu and Beni thrash Rajesh and Vimlesh's detectives and reveal the truth to their wives. Amma tells Malaika about Aryan's decision.

1.name: Amma Wishes to Go to Vaishnodevi with Her Family
1.overview: Amma voices her desire to go to Vaishnodevi with the family, and Happu promises to fulfil it. Chamchi and Ranbir tell Masterji about it. To get leave, Happu asks Malaika to lie to Reshampal.

1.name: Happu Fights with a Railway Employee
1.overview: Malaika lies to Reshampal to go to Jammu. Happu goes for the ticket and fights with a railway employee. Rajesh asks Happu to take a ticket for Gabbar also. The railway employee teaches Happu a lesson.

1.name: Indian Railways Service Blacklists Happu
1.overview: Indian Railways Service blacklists Happu. Later, Happu talks to Rajesh about not taking Gabbar with him to Katra. Angered by this, Rajesh prepares to leave the house, and Vimlesh supports her.

1.name: Lightning Strikes Beni Who Leaves for Vaishno Devi
1.overview: After Happu gets blacklisted, Beni decides to take everyone to Vaishno Devi. Happu doesn't get a flight ticket. Later, lightning strikes Beni, and Malaika talks about taking everyone along.

1.name: Happu Cries Because No One Could Visit Vaishnodevi
1.overview: Happu tries to help Malaika, but she falls down the stairs. Amma is sad about not going to Vaishnodevi, and Happu cries. Later, Happu's family gets the tickets and everyone is happy.

1.name: Beni and Happu Forget Vimlesh's Birthday
1.overview: Beni and Happu forget Vimlesh's birthday and try to avoid the family's anger with a plan. Chamchi discovers the truth and informs the family. Psychologist Santosh goes to lodge a police complaint.

1.name: Happu Sees a Girl Playing the Guitar at Night
1.overview: Rajesh and Vimlesh teach their husbands a lesson. At night, Happu sees a girl playing the guitar outside the window. The next day, at the police station, Happu tells Santosh how to solve his problem.

1.name: A Ghost Haunts Happu and Beni
1.overview: A ghost named Chandni seeks justice from Happu and Beni. While watching a film with their wives, they get scared seeing Chandni. At Ranbir's behest, Manohar disguises as a ghost to scare Masterji.

1.name: Happu Finds a Ghost Clinging to His Back
1.overview: Happu and Beni refuse to help Chandni get justice, leading her spirit to cling to Happu's back, threatening him. When they tell their family about Chandni, no one believes them.

1.name: Happu and Beni Get Rid of Chandni
1.overview: Masterji catches Chamchi and Ranbir lying. Happu and Beni, desperate to rid themselves of Chandni, prepare to consume poison. Malaika intervenes just in time, and the family makes a revelation.

1.name: Emily Traps Happu
1.overview: A woman named Emily Chaddha traps Happu. Rajesh observes a fast for Happu and praises his loyalty. Happu shares his issues with Beni, and later Vimlesh tests Beni's loyalty.

1.name: Emily Blackmails Happu
1.overview: Emily blackmails Happu and forces him to get her lover Jackson released from jail. Amma asks Vimlesh to test Beni's loyalty again. A troubled Happu goes to Reshampal to seek his help.

1.name: Reshampal Calls Madanlal to Help Happu
