1.overview: Amma spends time with her friend Matadin. Pinkesh, who comes to the police station with a complaint against Ranbir, asks Happu to arrest him. Beni takes an unconscious Amma to the hospital.

1.name: Amma Becomes Pregnant
1.overview: Rajesh and Beni break the news to Happu about Amma’s pregnancy, while Pinkesh informs the kids. Later, Rajesh orders another test, but Amma's pregnancy is confirmed!

1.name: Amma’s Pregnancy News Spreads through Town
1.overview: Amma’s family struggles to accept her pregnancy. The news soon hits the papers and spreads across town, and later, Matadeen shocks everyone by offering to give Amma’s child his name.

1.name: Amma's Pregnancy Earns Her Popularity
1.overview: Amma’s family hosts her baby shower, while a leading company names her brand ambassador. Pressured by the minister, the commissioner apologises to Happu and urges him to return to work.

1.name: Happu Is Shocked as Men Claim to be Pregnant
1.overview: Some men come to the police station and shock Happu by telling him that they are pregnant. Later, Malaika and the children expose Pinkesh’s plan, and Amma’s pregnancy turns out to be false.

1.name: An Angry Rajesh Walks Away from Home
1.overview: Rajesh complains to Happu about the children’s misbehaviour, sparking a fight. Upset, she leaves home to stay at Beni’s. The next day, with nothing of hers around, the kids begin to miss Rajesh.

1.name: Happu Finds a Way to Bring Rajesh Home
1.overview: Rajesh tries to belittle Happu in front of the vegetable seller Sanno. Manohar suggests a trick to Happu to bring Rajesh home. Later, Happu asks Sanno for a favour in exchange for helping her.

1.name: Rajesh Takes Revenge on Happu
1.overview: Happu flaunts Sanno as his lover to make Rajesh jealous, but she strikes back. Later, a woman files a report against Gabbar for harassment, and Happu throws him behind bars!

1.name: Happu Does Not Release Gabbar from Jail
1.overview: Beni informs Rajesh of Gabbar’s arrest, and she scolds Happu at the station. Though Beni secures Gabbar’s bail, Happu traps her in another charge and sends her back to jail.

1.name: Rajesh and Happu Reconcile
1.overview: Rajesh fails to free Gabbar from jail and makes peace with Happu. Later, Malaika reveals the truth about the girl’s complaint against Gabbar, leading to his release and return home.

1.name: Happu’s Family Demands a Trip to Manali
1.overview: The family pressures Happu to take them on a Manali trip. As he schemes to escape the expense, the Commissioner approves his leave. A ferocious monkey named Shaakal spreads terror across the city.

1.name: Happu Puts on an Act to Escape the Manali Trip
1.overview: To escape the expense of Manali, Happu pulls off a pretence with Beni’s help. Later, Happu behaves like a monkey to frighten Chamchi, leaving the family in shock and amusement.

1.name: The Family Discovers Happu’s Act
1.overview: Malika uncovers Happu’s act to avoid Manali and alerts Amma and Rajesh. Meanwhile, on the Minister’s orders, the Commissioner instructs the forest officials not to arrest Shakal.

1.name: Rajesh and the Kids Teach Happu a Lesson
1.overview: Rajesh lies to Happu, claiming the monkey Shakal bit her and starts behaving like one. Fooled by Rajesh and their kids’ act, Happu calls Beni for help, only to be cornered by them all.

1.name: Happu Saves a Woman from a Few Goons
1.overview: Happu shares his Valentine’s Day plan with Rajesh and later rescues a woman from eve-teasers. Rajesh finds the saree Pitaji once gifted Amma, leading to the revelation of a shocking secret.

1.name: Valentine’s Day Brings Trouble for Happu
1.overview: The Commissioner reveals a truth to Happu and pressures him to dine with Netaji’s sister on Valentine’s Day. Beni advises Happu, who is in a dilemma, to keep it hidden from Rajesh.

1.name: Rajesh Stops Happu from Going on a Mission
1.overview: Suspicious of Happu, Rajesh forbids him from going on a mission on Valentine’s Day. Worried, Happu seeks Beni’s help and spins a new lie, while Malaika’s advice lands Chamchi in trouble.

1.name: Hate at First Sight
1.overview: Frantically trying to save the business, publishing house Paperink onboards renowned novelist Abhimanyu. What happens when in-house editor Asmita meets him?

1.name: The Second Coming
1.overview: A shattered Noyonika Sengupta ends her long sabbatical to return to work as a junior lawyer after her famous husband Rajiv Sengupta is jailed in a sex and corruption scandal.

1.name: Scenes from a Marriage
1.overview: Noyonika takes up the case of a friend’s son accused of murder. She faces criticism from Malini at work. When Sharad Jhadav spills Rajiv's old secrets, she confronts him.

1.name: Winds of Change
1.overview: At work, Noyonika faces pressure but finds a friend in Sana. She learns about Rajiv's illegal dealings and gets upset with her mother-in-law for taking her kids to meet him in jail.

1.name: Dirty Little Lies
1.overview: When opposition lawyer, Shivani Bahl drags Noyonika's personal life to court, she needs to publicly disclose some scandalous truths to get justice. How will Noyonika handle it all?

1.name: Family Secrets
1.overview: A high-profile couple comes under the police radar for their maid's death. Trying to save them, Noyonika straddles legal boundaries. Meanwhile, Rajiv gets a chance at freedom.

1.name: Lifeline
1.overview: A case of a soon-to-be mother and her at-risk unborn child takes Noyonika and Vishal out of town. Back home, the girls tell Rajiv about the packages the family has been receiving.

1.name: Trial by Media
1.overview: Noyonika gears up to fight against Daksh Rathod. Ilyas has a suggestion for Rajiv. When Rajiv’s lawyer leaves him high and dry, Noyonika finds a solution.

1.name: Cloak & Dagger
1.overview: Noyonika fights tooth and nail for Rajiv with Vishal's help as she struggles with her feelings for the two men. In the end, Rajiv's decision leaves her feeling betrayed again.

2.name: Hush Hush
2.overview: Noyonika faces a tough choice when a young masseuse accuses a revered public figure of sexual assault, caught between the truth and her husband Rajiv's rising political career.

2.name: Social Dilemma
2.overview: Noyonika defends influencer Shanaya in an attempted murder trial. Just as Shanaya's bail is revoked, Ananya reveals a shocking truth, flipping the case upside down.

2.name: Bad Marriages, Bad Parents
2.overview: While Noyonika's parenting is tested, she's blindsided by a sharp opposing lawyer in a case against a builder. At work, as alliances shift, Malini feels her position is threatened.

2.name: Split Them Up
2.overview: Rajiv's campaign suffers when Narayani gains sympathy. As Malini's offer tests Noyonika's loyalty, the firm defends two lovers in a murder case, where one needs to be sacrificed.

2.name: Sins of the Father
2.overview: Noyonika uncovers a conspiracy behind the builder case. After a shocking raid shakes her family, Noyonika confronts Narayani and makes a bold move that could change everything.

2.name: We Always Want What We Can't Have
2.overview: As Noyonika wins the builder case and Rajiv's campaign soars, a secret from the past destroys their marriage. Betrayed but empowered, she chooses truth, closure and a new beginning.

1.name: Egregious
1.overview: Tyagi seeks key support in his campaign for bar president. Harvard grad Anaya Shroff struggles to find her footing… and a desk.

1.name: Darwaza
1.overview: Ananya looks to assist a mysterious advocate in his cases. Trouble brews for Tyagi's nomination when someone complains about his bold signboard.

1.name: Dignity
1.overview: When a monkey causes a stir on the court premises, the lawyers are moved to strike, leading to a strain on Ananya and her first case.

1.name: Aukaat
1.overview: Sujata tries to drop her “foyer lawyer” status with a new client — a foul-mouthed parrot. When a big-shot lawyer arrives, Tyagi and Bagai hatch a plan.

1.name: Touch
1.overview: Ananya and Sujata scramble to help an inmate fulfill her dream to start a family. Tyagi has an emotional talk with his father, a retired judge.

1.name: Biradari
1.overview: Tyagi and his campaign land in hot water after police and lawyers clash. Ananya and Sujata contend with a fierce woman in the race.

1.name: Kutai
1.overview: Phorey or Tyagi? The election results are finally in — but the twists aren't over yet. Ananya turns counselor for a young woman’s case.

1.name: Law vs Justice
1.overview: Tyagi weighs an important decision that will change the course of his career. PP Sahab and Ananya are pulled into a landmark case.

1.name: Meet The Ba***ds
1.overview: Aasmaan's debut film scores big, earning him a contract at a star-studded bash. At an actors' roundtable, he throws shade at nepo-baby Karishma Talvar.

1.name: ⁠⁠Movie Mafia
1.overview: Aasmaan meets Freddy and later signs a commercial to fund his father's surgery. Ajay disapproves of the male lead cast opposite his daughter.

1.name: Barbaad Mohabbat
1.overview: Parvaiz fanboys over Aasmaan and Karishma's new intimacy coach. A video of the leads goes viral for the wrong reasons. Freddy seeks Ajay's help.

1.name: Bullshit Party
1.overview: Avtar's hit song catches Karan Johar's attention. Ajay objects to the film's intimate scenes. Karishma's birthday party brings a huge surprise.

1.name: My Hero
1.overview: Jaraj shows Freddy an incriminating video of Aasmaan and pitches a plan. After falling out with Parvaiz, Aasmaan receives upsetting news.

1.name: The Filmfirst Awards
1.overview: Avtar turns away an unexpected guest. At a glamorous awards show, Aasmaan faces a pleasant surprise — but soon finds himself in trouble.

1.name: Picture Ka Title Hoga…
1.overview: As Aasmaan and Karishma try to elope with Parvaiz's help, Ajay chases after them. A shocking revelation threatens to upend Aasmaan's world.

1.name: Bambai
1.overview: Welcome to Dhadakpur, a one-of-a-kind Crime-Free village. Jha family is eager for their daughter, Roshni, to get married. Her choice of groom demands a never-seen- before bike as dowry. In spite of all odds, the Jha family is determined. The bike arrives amisdst celebration in the day but disaster strikes at night! The bike is stolen! Only 8 days left for the wedding!

1.name: Chor Nahi Chikaar
1.overview: Banwari discovers the bike has been stolen! Bhugol and Teepu cook up a story casting suspicion on Amavas. The Sarpanch reaches Dhadakpur with good news. Banwari and Roshni question the prime suspect. Sparks fly between the two ex-lovers as they reminisce about their past. Roshni and Banwari return with no leads. Only 7 days left for wedding!

1.name: Oh Mere Jija Ji
1.overview: Amavas decides to fulfill his duty of being a good ex-lover. Kuber arrives in Dhadakpur to check out his beloved bike. Banwari enlists Pandit and Bhugol's help to ensure Kuber is left in a tizzy. Madan discovers Jha family's secret. Banwari decides to do the unthinkable. Only 6 days left for the wedding!

1.name: Kanoon Ke Haath
1.overview: ASI Mithlesh suspects something is amiss in Dhadakpur. He awakens from his slumber when he discovers it has something to do with his old nemesis Banwari. Amavas puts forth his plan at the village meeting. Madan is nabbed and taken to the police station. Amavas and Bhugol set off on a journey to save Dhadakpur's pride and Roshni's wedding. Only 5 days left for the wedding!

1.name: Piyo Magar Pyaar Se
1.overview: Sarpanch questions Pushpalata about the rumours he's heard . Relatives arrive for the wedding festivities. Roshni begins to have doubts. Durlabh instigates Kuber to verify if the bike has truly been bought. Amavas shares his vulnerable side with Bhugol as they gulp down a few drinks and pass out while the second hand bike stands ready to be collected. Only 4 days left for the wedding!

1.name: Ullu Mat Bolna
1.overview: Bhugol and Amavas have to perform at a special birthday party to pay for the bike. Roshni confronts Kuber. Madan finally gets his dream job but is in a moral dilemma. Frustrated Banwari reaches the cop station. Pushpalata announces a strict punishment at the village meeting. Teepu helps Nirmal with the cash for her treatment. Only 3 days left for the wedding!

1.name: Ulta Chor Kotwal Ko Dante
1.overview: Mithlesh sets out to find the thief with renewed vigor. Amavas and Bhugol escape from Parmanu's clutches. Amavas is not impressed with Kuber. Pushpalata considers resigning. Mithlesh's investigation leads him to a suspect but just then Teepu reveals important evidence. Roshni's dilemma builds. Only 2 day left for the wedding!

1.name: Bhootpurv Premi
1.overview: Nirmal is at the cusp of getting her treatment. Banwari struggles with the wedding arrangements because of the boycott. A crucial eye witness confesses to Mithlesh. Amavas confronts Bhugol about Kuber. An action packed scuffle threatens the arrival of the bike. The wedding party is on the way. Few hours before the wedding!

1.name: Atmanirbhar
1.overview: The day of reckoning. Nirmal speaks to Pushpalata about the boycott. Kuber arrives with the wedding party at the Jha household but there is no sign of the bike. The wedding is in jeopardy! Mithlesh nabs the thief- but there is a bigger mastermind at play. Dhadakpur learns an important lesson that has a lasting impact. Bhugol manages to finally fulfill his dream!

1.name: Episode 1
1.overview: Officer Yug tries solving a cold case with the support of senior cop Vamika. But in a twist of fate, a defunct walkie-talkie springs to life at 11:11 PM, connecting Yug to a past Officer Shaurya.

1.name: Episode 2
1.overview: Aditi's abduction and murder case takes a chilling turn. Amidst flashbacks of suspects and an evil nurse, the plot thickens. The connection with Officer Shaurya at 11:11 PM hints at altering the past.

1.name: Episode 3
1.overview: While Vamika pushes the Nurse for a confession on the case, the team together are assigned to solve the "Tie and Die" killings. Will Yug be able to blur the lines of past & present to serve justice?

1.name: Episode 4
1.overview: Vamika receives a call from Yug when speaking to the victim's daughter, confirming that he is a survivor of the Tie and Die serial killing case. In '90, Shaurya captures the suspected killer based on Yug's tip.

1.name: Episode 5
1.overview: In 1990, Palak, a dancer set to meet Shaurya, travels alone, only to encounter a driver named Brahmdutt.  In 2016, Yug awaits updates on Palak’s murder case from Shaurya, only to be kept hanging.

1.name: Episode 6
1.overview: In 1990, a child gets abused by his mother, unravelling patterns of the 'Tie and Die' killer’s method. In 2016, Vamika's search leads her to a hospital room only to find Brahmdutt's son, Birju. A trail of attacks follows.

1.name: Episode 7
1.overview: Set in '98, Shaurya looks into a complex murder case involving gangsters. Meanwhile, Vamika deals with familial pressures at a wedding. In 2016, Yug uncovers worrying details about Shaurya's past.

1.name: Episode 8
1.overview: In 2016, tensions escalate as Yug tries to solve old cases while Vamika deals with office politics and familial pressures. A high-profile kidnapping shakes the team, sparking a race against time.

1.name: Chauhano Ki Shaan
1.overview: Shanvika, the arrogant daughter of the elite Chauhan family. Kuldeep, a poor but brilliant young man. A broken bicycle leads to a meaningful exchange between the two.

1.name: Humse Dosti Karoge?
1.overview: Nakul and his cronies try to snatch Kuldeep's new bicycle from him, leading to a fight. Shanvika interferes, and she poses a question to Kuldeep.

1.name: Aapki Pehchan Hai Kya?
1.overview: Kuldeep's disinterest in her proposal makes Shanvika angry. She vows to outscore him academically, setting the stage for competition.

1.name: Namak Harami Mat Karna
1.overview:
Shanvika misbehaves with Inspector Dushyant Singh when she declares

she'll rank first in her class. Her "hard work" bears fruit, and Kuldeep goes missing. Where did he go?

1.name: Ishq Hua Hai!
1.overview: Shanvika and Kuldeep's romance blossoms. However, one day, Pushkar and his men bust their blissful moment, leading to tension between the families.

1.name: Galti Hamari Nahi Thi
1.overview: Shanvika's declaration leads to Kuldeep's family being humiliated in public. They flee for life after Pushkar sets fire to their house, but Simmi's tragic step shatters them.

1.name: Saaye Mai Dhoop
1.overview: Kuldeep starts driving a rickshaw for a living. Prerna, a passenger preparing for the UPSC exams, inspires him to reflect on his dreams and look forward to a bright future.

1.name: Namak Haram
1.overview: Family pressures Shanvika into marrying Dushyant reluctantly. Kuldeep focuses on studies but faces devastation after a fateful call.

1.name: Tu Hoga Kamyaab
1.overview: Shanvika's rejection of Dushyant on their wedding night sparks turmoil. Kuldeep grapples with inner conflicts as Prerna guides him to harness his anger constructively.

1.name: Chaman Mein Deedawar
1.overview: Kuldeep's life hangs in the balance as he faces his UPSC final interview and his mother's coma. The UPSC results bring a shocking revelation, especially those in Sitaarpur.

1.name: Mera Lakshya Kuch Aur Hai
1.overview: Kuldeep's political return sparks chaos when he proposes building a bridge in a Chauhan area. Daddu proposes an easy way for him to do it.

1.name: Astitwa ki Ladai
1.overview: Under Kuldeep's orders, all boating operations are sealed, paving the way for the bridge project. During his and Mala's wedding, tensions escalate with the arrival of the Chauhans.

1.name: Bhoot, Bhavishya, Vartaman
1.overview: The Chauhans are infuriated seeing Dushyant guarding Kuldeep. Mala speaks to her new husband about their future. The Chauhan's face losses when their businesses are raided.

1.name: Woh Badla Lene Hi Aaya Hai
1.overview: Dushyant warns Shanvika of Kuldeep's desire for revenge but she refuses to engage. Fed up with Kuldeep's high handed behaviour, the Chauhans hire Gauri to kill him.

1.name: Kuch Bachna Nahi Chahiye
1.overview: Gauri, on the run from the police, is abducted by unknown men. He urgently contacts Angad to meet the Chauhans at their hideout. Meanwhile, Kuldeep raids the Chauhan's house

1.name: Ghar Ka Malik Bhag Chala
1.overview: The Chauhan brothers surrender, which creates a sensation. In prison, Manohar wonders about his past actions. Meanwhile, Kuldeep throws a party and invites Dushyant and Shanvika

1.name: Ab Apna Rasta Badal Lo
1.overview: Dushyant decides to resign, but Kuldeep refuses and makes an offer. Gendalal warns Kuldeep about Daddu, who has a different plan for Chauhan's son in law.

1.name: Sab Kuch Khatam Ho Gaya
1.overview: Daddu instructs SP Mishra to apprehend Pushkar, but he flees. Shanvika consoles a troubled Dushyant. Kuldeep meets his childhood friend Pintu, who advises him.

1.name: Ab Humari Baari
1.overview: Kuldeep finally learns why Shanvika lied about their relationship. Tragedy strikes yet again, and Shanvika has no choice but to pick up the pieces of her shattered life.

2.name: Naye Dushman ya Naye Dost?
2.overview: Shanvika performs her husband Dushyant's last rites as Sitaarpur watches. On her journey home, she is ambushed, forcing her into a gun fight. Who is her new enemy?

2.name: Kunwar ki Ummid, Shanvika ki Chaal
2.overview: Kuldeep spirals into guilt over Shanvika despite Mala and Daddu's efforts to help him. Tensions rise as a looming threat pushes Shanvika to make a strategic move.

2.name: Bas Ek Mulakaat
2.overview: Multiple attacks on Shanvika heighten tensions across Sitaarpur. As she prepares herself for the battles ahead, a shocking revelation shakes her trust.

2.name: Kuldeep ka Prayashchit
2.overview: Angad finds himself trapped in Shanvika's scheme, while Kuldeep's guilt drives him toward a risky move. As political conspiracies deepen, Shanvika finally agrees to meet Kuldeep.

2.name: Pyaar ka Nostalgia
2.overview: Shanvika confronts Kuldeep, gun in hand, yet her pain overpowers her anger. They exchange their losses, leading Kuldeep to agree to join her dangerous quest for justice.

2.name: Pushkar ki Jaan ko Khatra hai
2.overview: Chaos erupts as Pushkar faces danger in the hospital, but Shanvika intervenes to rescue him. Angad shoots a corrupt doctor unaware that he is under surveillance.

2.name: Raajneeti par Pyaar Bhaari
2.overview: Kunwar assures Shanvika of his support but grows furious over Pushkar's disappearance, suspecting Daddu. Shanvika and Kuldeep clash when she admits ordering Dr Vinay's murder.

2.name: Shanvika ka Naya Rakshak
2.overview: Shanvika is ambushed but saved by a masked shooter, leaving Daddu shaken. Suspicious, Daddu asks Singh to bring Mala home and keep a close watch on Kuldeep.

2.name: Transfer yaa Saazish?
2.overview: Obsessed with Kuldeep, Mala opposes Daddu's plan to kill him and pledges to ruin Shanvika. Subsequently, Daddu discloses Kuldeep's unexpected transfer order, shocking Kuldeep.

2.name: Nani ki Seekh, Pyaar ki Jeet
2.overview: Daddu celebrates his political move and plots Shanvika's death after Kuldeep's transfer. A powerful flashback inspires Kuldeep to move in a way that leaves Daddu stunned.

2.name: Imaandari ka Sabut
2.overview: Saadhu and Kundan commit a crime, triggering a chain reaction that shakes Sitaarpur. Shanvika quietly turns the fallout to her advantage by letting Kunwar take the credit.

2.name: Varchasva ki Ladai!
2.overview: Poornima's death sparks an all-out war as Daddu Prasad commands the annihilation of Kunwar's family. Amid the turmoil, Shanvika and Pushkar secretly scheme for their rise.

2.name: Deewaron Ke Bhi Aakhein Hoti Hain
2.overview: Prerna and Pushkar grow closer, unaware of the danger ahead. As panic spreads over the police murders, Daddu uses Angad to trap Shanvika, but Kuldeep foils the plan.

2.name: Kaptaan Mara Gaya!
2.overview: As Angad is hidden away for safety, Kuldeep manipulates Daddu's suspicions. Daddu then orders Saadhu and Kundan to kill Shanvika or pay with their lives.

2.name: 2 Prime Suspects!
2.overview: Public outrage over SP Mishra's murder prompts the Chief Minister to transfer the case to the Intelligence Agency. Shockingly, Shanvika and Kuldeep emerge as key suspects.

2.name: Gheera!
2.overview: Constable Divya's interrogation exposes SP Mishra's corruption. Suspicion grows around Kuldeep as Pradeep disappears, only to resurface under arrest for his covert role.

2.name: Baazi Palat Gayi!
2.overview: During Intelligence Agency’s probing, Angad reveals how Daddu Prasad planned murders to protect his power. Shanvika emerges as a formidable force in Sitaarpur’s political field.

2.name: Alert!
2.overview: The Intelligence Agency exposes Daddu Prasad’s political scheme and arrests him amid public outrage. While love and victory bring Kuldeep and Shanvika closer, Pintu is abducted.

2.name: Uttaradhikari Mil Gaya!
2.overview: As Pintu’s kidnapping haunts Kuldeep, Sitaarpur is sealed, criminals rounded up, and pressure mounts. While Daddu plots his comeback, Mala’s vengeance is finally exposed.

2.name: Satta Ka Safar!
2.overview: Kuldeep learns Pintu’s murder was meant to break him. He urges Shanvika to get into politics. She asserts control by striking a business deal. Kunwar assures her a minister’s post.

2.name: Siyasi Zameen
2.overview: Kunwar proposes Shanvika's candidature to the Chief Minister, shifting political equations. Meanwhile, Kuldeep mentors Shanvika, stirring old feelings and Mala's insecurity.

2.name: Ticket Mil Gaya
2.overview: Shanvika's political rise rattles Daddu and Kunwar. Celebrations begin at the Chauhan Mansion as Shanvika's ticket is announced, while masked men abduct Kuldeep's family.

2.name: Maut ka Badla Maut!
2.overview: Ranjan's death drives Chatki to seek revenge against Kunwar. Meanwhile, Daddu Prasad returns to politics after securing bail, raising the stakes for all.

2.name: Shaam 5:00 Baje
2.overview: A coded call helps Kuldeep escape captivity, exposing a conspiracy linked to Ramlal's camp. Shanvika's campaign sweeps the polls, defeating Daddu by a huge margin.

2.name: Result!
2.overview: Shanvika celebrates her political success, but Kuldeep loses his father, Gendalal, to a brutal murder. Seeking revenge, Kuldeep attacks Daddu and ends up in jail.

2.name: Badalte Raste!
2.overview: Mala confesses to her father of plotting Kuldeep's father’s murder. After Daddu Prasad’s statement, Kuldeep is reinstated as the DM. Shanvika assumes her new role as a minister.

2.name: Samuhik Vivah!
2.overview: Bansal runs a human trafficking racket under a mass marriage scheme. Kuldeep learns of Pushkar's release. Returning to Sitaarpur, Pushkar ruthlessly reclaims his control.

2.name: Sangathan!
2.overview: Kuldeep orders strict action against illegal arms after Pushkar's return. He asks Daddu and Rantej to unite with Bansal and Rathod. The battle for Sitaarpur grows deadly than ever.

2.name: Aslaah
2.overview: Kuldeep intensifies his crackdown on Pushkar by ordering strict legal action against illegal arms. At Bansal's office, Pushkar reviews the progress of their criminal network.

2.name: Pyaar Nahi toh Dosti hi Sahi
2.overview: Kuldeep is cleared by the court and is determined to take on the Chauhan family. As Pushkar and Prerna grow closer, Kuldeep and Mala choose to begin their bond as friends.

2.name: Tender
2.overview: A ₹1,000 crore tender fuels a political power struggle in Sitaarpur. Pushkar's unexpected marriage alters the dynamics amidst secret alliances and concealed conspiracies.

2.name: Humein Chinta hai Tumhari
2.overview: A cancelled government tender deepens the rift between Shanvika and Kuldeep. Pushkar stirs up a public spectacle, pushing Sitaarpur toward deeper political conflict.

2.name: Samuhik Vivah ka Sach
2.overview: A mass marriage scheme exposes a shocking trafficking racket. As Kuldeep closes in on the culprits, his investigation puts influential leaders and Shanvika in the spotlight.

2.name: Sach ki Talaash aur Satta ki Jung
2.overview: Set on uncovering the mass marriage scandal, Kuldeep gets attacked. Shanvika focuses on strengthening her public image. Kuldeep faces a tense confrontation with MLA Trilochan.

2.name: Badla ya Usool!
2.overview: Shanvika's political empire is at stake. Bansal and Rathore worry about getting exposed. Kuldeep begins the hunt for the truth and shakes the foundations of Sitaarpur's politics.

2.name: Saboot Nikalo
2.overview: Shanvika and her family worry about their political image after Kuldeep shows proof of the conspiracy. While Bansal and Rathore try to erase it, Kuldeep vows to expose the guilty.

2.name: Mala aur Do Kaand!
2.overview: Preeti uncovers a major secret involving Mala and Sadhu, but this puts her life in danger. While Daddu begins to suspect Kuldeep, Shanvika's enemies continue to plot against her.

2.name: Mastermind!
2.overview: Sitaarpur's mass wedding racket is exposed, implicating Home Minister Vishal Tikariya. As Mala is suspected of Pintu's and Kuldeep's dad's murders, Preeti's life is threatened.

2.name: Personal Ambition
2.overview: Prerna joins hands with Rantej to undermine Shanvika's political rise. As Pushkar suspects a traitor within, a hidden informant threatens to expose their conspiracy.

2.name: Bohot Hua Natak!
2.overview: Kuldeep refuses to frame Shanvika despite his hatred, choosing to fight her on his own terms. As he ends his fake marriage with Mala, Shanvika fears for his safety.

2.name: Guest Room
2.overview: Mala confronts Kuldeep, refusing to let go of him or their marriage. As her possessiveness grows, Kuldeep moves to the guest room while Preeti urges him to resolve the situation.

2.name: Charitra Hanan
2.overview: Rumours about Kuldeep and Shanvika threaten her reputation and family honour. Suspecting Daddu's involvement, she fights back while Kuldeep tries to evade Mala's traps.

2.name: Confession
2.overview: Sadhu's confession reveals Mala's role in Pintu's and Gendalal's murders. As power, revenge and betrayal collide, the evidence takes on a mysterious purpose.

2.name: Divorce
2.overview: Sitaarpur inaugurates its first cancer hospital as Mala signs the divorce papers. Kuldeep doubts her intentions, but a deadly confrontation changes everything.

2.name: Naya Daavedaar
2.overview: Tushar faces brutal interrogation over Sadhu's disappearance as Rantej suspects him of betrayal. Criminal Vishal Tikariya escapes and returns to Sitaarpur seeking revenge.

2.name: Duvidha
2.overview: Kuldeep risks his life for Shanvika after Vishal Tikariya abducts her. Daddu Prasad decides to launch Mala into politics. Sadhu and Kundan’s secrets become increasingly dangerous.

2.name: Faraar
2.overview: Shanvika finally chooses to fight for her love and publicly announces her decision, creating a storm within her family. Daddu, Mala, and their allies begin plotting against them.

2.name: Purane Pyaar ki Nayi Taseer!
2.overview: Shattered by her family’s denial, Shanvika leaves her home and goes to Kuldeep. Pushkar warns Kuldeep. Shanvika and Kuldeep announce their engagement, triggering furious reactions.

2.name: Aaj ka Suraj!
2.overview: Kuldeep and Shanvika head to the temple. As Pushkar is lured into a trap, Rantej's men cover the area. Pushkar gets shot and a desperate Shanvika urges Kuldeep to save her uncle.

2.name: Pyaar ya Vaar!
2.overview: After surviving the ambush, Pushkar urges Kuldeep and Shanvika to get married. Kuldeep visits his old home to seek blessings while Shanvika goes to her mother before the wedding.

1.name: City of Joy
1.overview: When a kidnapping forces politician Barun Roy to take action against Bagha, a dangerous don, he hires the best man for the job — Officer Saptarshi Sinha.

1.name: Gurudakshina
1.overview: Steely cop Arjun Maitra takes over Bagha's case. Opposition leader Nibedita Basak demands justice for Saptarshi's fate. Barun has an offer for Sagor.

1.name: Jay-Veeru
1.overview: As Nibedita visits a figure from her past, Arjun receives unsettling intel from a mysterious informant. The authorities want Arjun out of their way.

1.name: Rakshabandhan
1.overview: Arjun receives a promotion while Sagor gets ready to make his political debut. An enraged Ranjit commits an unthinkable crime.

1.name: City of Bhoy
1.overview: A grief-stricken Sagor goes on a brutal rampage. Arjun is reinstated as the head of the SIT to put an end to Sagor's crimes.

1.name: The Mole
1.overview: Sagor's incriminating “insurance” video is brought into play. Ranjit goes to meet Sagor. Arjun learns the shocking identity of the mole within the SIT.

1.name: Lanka Dahan
1.overview: Arjun learns more about the mole within his force. As Ranjit devises an escape plan with an unexpected ally, will Arjun be able to stop him?

1.name: Gumshuda
1.overview: Sixteen-year-old Suman Arora goes missing on the night of her radio performance, along with her younger brother Sahil. As panic grips their family, Sub-Inspector Jayprakash Jatav takes charge of the case. With rain washing out evidence and leads collapsing, the search intensifies-until a discovery in the Ridge forest changes everything.

1.name: Jaanwar
1.overview: As Suman and Sahil's murder shakes Delhi, JP uncovers critical clues about the car in which the kids were kidnapped. With mounting pressure to hand over the case, he races against time to act on the leads. In Bombay, a botched ransom ends in a child's death, sending Babu and Rajjo fleeing toward Delhi.

1.name: Dhoomketu
1.overview: An engraved murder weapon and two unidentified fingerprints give JP his first concrete lead. With only 48 hours to prove progress, he races to identify the sword's owner-and the men who carried out the crime.

1.name: Rahu-Ketu
1.overview: The discovery of another body confirms the murders are part of a larger pattern. When a key witness comes forward and identifies the two men responsible, JP finally has names. The investigation shifts from identification to a manhunt.

1.name: Tilchatta
1.overview: As the killers split up and attempt to disappear, JP tracks one trail to Sonipat while new links point toward Mumbai. Political pressure threatens to sideline him, but a fresh lead forces a difficult choice-follow orders, or follow the case beyond Delhi.

1.name: Daitya
1.overview: JP follows Babu's trail to Bombay and uncovers disturbing truths about his past. When Babu kills again and prepares to flee the city, JP pushes forward despite direct orders to stand down. The chase escalates into a high-stakes pursuit across states.

1.name: Muttonwale Bauji ka Beta
1.overview: Agra becomes the final battleground as JP tracks Babu and Rajjo to the same city. With the pressure mounting and exits closing fast, it becomes a race against time. Will the killers outrun the law once more?

1.name: Hum Yahin Hain
1.overview: The truth of what happened the day of the crime finally comes to light. In the present, the case reaches its final stage, leaving a grieving family-and a shaken city-to reckon with the aftermath.

1.name: Kaun Banenge Rulers?
1.overview: As the contestants enter the Tower, the game begins with Ashneer’s twist, they must confront the fate of either the luxurious penthouse or the struggle of the basement.

1.name: Basement Ka Torture Shuru
1.overview: While basement contestants struggle for water, comfort, and survival, the penthouse contestants enjoy luxury and ease. Two worlds, one tower who will handle the pressure and who will crack under it?

1.name: Barf Ne Lagai Aag!
1.overview: In Rise and Fall, the Rulers set a tough challenge for the Workers. If the Workers win, they can add money to their Prize Pot but if they fail they risk to lose their earnings to the Rulers.

1.name: Dhoka, Drama, Hungama!
1.overview: Drama peaks as the rulers appoint a Lift Operator to decide nominations in the Lift of Judgement. Tensions rise, loyalties are questioned, and every decision carries high stakes. The game turns unpredictable, and no worker is safe.

1.name: Aarush Vs Arbaz
1.overview: One Ruler will get a chance to save themselves from the Fall by becoming the Ultimate Ruler while the Workers have a golden opportunity to earn money. Tough negotiations are made, and hard words exchanged and tempers reach their boiling point.

1.name: Pawan Ka Chakravyuh
1.overview: The workers hold the power to decide the ultimate Ruler contendership. In the high-stakes Chakravyuh, strategy, skills, and team chemistry will decide which Ruler rises to Power. Alliances, decisions, and team work will determine the fate of the Rulers.

1.name: Kaun Girega Basement Mein?
1.overview: The Rulers battle to survive in the Penthouse, while the Workers compete for their chance to rise. In the high-stakes Eggspress delivery Challenge, where balance, speed, and trust will determine who amongst the Workers will rise and who amongst the Rulers will fall.

1.name: Powerplay Weekend
1.overview: In Powerplay Weekend, Ashneer takes charge with full-on drama, entertainment, and showdown of greed and ego.

1.name: Kaun Hoga Eliminate?
1.overview: In the Powerplay Weekend, A bold twist shakes as the Ruler has to make a decision from Ashneer's den. Clashing opinions and rising tempers spark drama in the Powerplay Weekend. Drama, tension, and entertainment peak as one Worker faces elimination.

1.name: Dhanashree Ko Mila Dhoka!
1.overview: At the pool party, the Ultimate Ruler faces a final decision. Loyalty and friendship come under question as people start to put themselves first before the group and The Rulers face a mental test test to win the title of the Ultimate Ruler.

1.name: Jab Pawanji Met Dhanashree
1.overview: While Pawan deepens his bond with Dhanashree, The Ultimate Ruler gets a power to directly choose one Worker to rise to the Penthouse. Workers must prove themselves with a pitch. Emotions run high as fears come to light in the battle for power.

1.name: Akriti Ne Palta Game
1.overview: The Basketball challenge takes the spotlight. The Ruler has no escape they are bound to fall into the Basement. A game changing move flips the direction of the game. Drama intensifies as the tables turn in a shocking way.

1.name: Arjun Bana Target
1.overview: One Worker is targeted for nomination in the Lift of Judgement. The Workers face nominations, but the power to save one is in the Rulers hands. Drama, betrayal, and tension rise as nomination looms over the Workers.

1.name: Takhta Palat Duur Nahi
1.overview: The Workers have an opportunity to decrease the defecit between theirs and the Ruler's Prize Pot. They face the Sewage Tank Challenge, with the Rulers setting the level of difficulty. It's a race against time for the Workers to inch closer towards the Takta Palat. One wrong move, one miscalculated strategy can change their Rise to the coveted Penthouse.

1.name: Kiku Ne Bajayi Band
1.overview: Pent-up emotions come to the fore as Ashneer gives a reality check to the Rulers and Workers on the Powerplay Weekend.

1.name: Trustee Ka Beta
1.overview: Powerplay Weekend brings an unpredictable twist with heated clashes, accusations, and emotions running high. Workers pitch to save themselves from elimination but the final decision is in Rulers hands. The Workers have the opportunity to rise as the Ruler but the power to rise a worker is in Rulers hands.

1.name: Arbaz Cancels Aarush
1.overview: Each Worker has put a price tag to themselves in the form of a golden briefcase and is ready to Rise and the Rulers have a chance to increase their Prize Pot amount. The Rulers have to make a tough decision, choose a higher priced Worker and further increase the gap between the two sides or choose a Worker who would be a useful ally.

1.name: Don't Tell Me Shut Up!
1.overview: The Rulers get a chance to cancel decisions made by the Ultimate Ruler and save Workers from harsh handicaps, but there is a price involved. And as the reign of the Ultimate Ruler in power comes to an end the Workers get a chance at revenge to choose the next candidates to take on the mantle of the Ultimate Ruler.

1.name: Comedy Khatam Ladai Chalu
1.overview: Betrayal is in the air as the Workers face the heat of nominations. And tempers flare within the Rulers as the Ultimate Ruler is given a power to influence the outcome of the nominations.

1.name: Gira, Gira Kaun Gira?
1.overview: The Ultimate Ruler must choose two Rulers to decide another’s fate. Their decision ignites chaos, shakes alliances, and stirs deep emotions. As tensions rise, one Ruler faces the Fall and is sent straight to the Basement.

1.name: Kya Hoga Takhta Palat?
1.overview: In the Brick Factory Challenge, tension rises as Workers get a chance to earn all the money from the Rulers prize spot. If they fail, the Rulers will claim money from the Workers prize spot. The Rulers will choose the challenge level. Teamwork and coordination will decide the outcome.

1.name: Ashneer Ne Kiya Roast
1.overview: Ashneer takes charge of the Red Room and questions the decisions that the Rulers and the Workers have made throughout the week. Every contestant is put up on the stand as their individual gameplay and alliances come into question.

1.name: Double Dhamaka
1.overview: The Rulers and the Workers face the heat as the audience reveal statements made by the contestants for each other. And tensions rise amongst the Rulers as a twist in nominations is introduced.

1.name: Manisha Ke Wild Decisions
1.overview: With the entry of a new contender the gameplay of the Rulers and Workers is disrupted. To enter the game the wildcard has to make some game changing decisions which force a change of strategies for both the Rulers and the Workers.

1.name: Time for Takhta Palat?
1.overview: Once again the Workers have an opportunity to stage a coup by winning the Prize Pot Challenge. The Rulers have to take the risk of betting on the difficulty level of the task. It is a make or break moment for both sides. One side hoping to retain their hold on the Penthouse while the other hoping to win the Challenge and become the new Rulers.

1.name: Kiku Physically Unfit!
1.overview: Personal grudges emerge as the Workers and the Rulers are asked to nominate fellow Workers in the Lift of Judgement. The nomination sparks intense arguments and make clear the divide between various contestants.

1.name: Chal Be Chamchey
1.overview: The Rulers have to face a challenge to become the Ultimate Ruler, but before they can take on the challenge, they have to face the Workers who have been given the power to eliminate the Rulers they deem unworthy to become the Ultimate Ruler. As pitches are given to retain the contendership for the challenge a fight breaks out between a Worker and a Ruler.

1.name: Pitch Nahi Karungi!
1.overview: In the Red Room, the Ultimate Ruler holds the power to decide the weakest Ruler and send them to the basement. Rulers must pitch to survive, as the decision lies in the hands of the Ultimate Ruler.

1.name: Walkout!!
1.overview: The Powerplay Weekend heats up as Ashneer gets the Rulers and the Workers call out the dual-faced nature of their fellow contestants. Words are exchanged and rivals almost come to blows. While a question from the audience insights a war of words which sees a contestant stage a walkout.

1.name: Dhokha
1.overview: Powerplay Weekend is charged with drama, tension, betrayal, and emotions. Nominated Workers make their final pitches as Rulers decide who faces elimination. Friendships and trust are tested. The twist of ranking each other unanimously shakes the Tower.

1.name: Dosti Tooti
1.overview: Family members continue to visit the Workers and the Rulers, boosting their confidence and spreading laughter and joy amongst the rest even though their visit is timed by the clock. But there is sourness in the air as two Rulers struggle to maintain their bond of friendship.

1.name: Finale Ki Race Shuru
1.overview: The Workers get a golden chance to rise to the Penthouse, but some will be blocked. The Rulers and Workers will decide which worker will face the block. The Bridge Bungee challenge will decide their fate. Strength and strategy will decide who rises to the Penthouse.

1.name: Rani Ki Khuli Kahani
1.overview: ‎The Workers face nomination for elimination in the Lift of Judgement. ‎Tension rises as they have to nominate those who don't deserve to be in the finale week. Heated arguments and clashes erupt. ‎The Rulers also have to nominate one Worker.

1.name: Aditya Ne Liya Badla
1.overview: The Rulers for the last time have the oppurtunity to win the Ultimate Ruler title and earn themselves a ticket to the finale week. But the road to the ticket isn't easy as they have to first block their fellow Rulers who they deem as unworthy of becoming the candiadate for the title. Accusations are are raised and things heat up as a Worker decides to exact their revenge against a Ruler.

1.name: The Mega Fall
1.overview: The Red Room intensifies as the Rulers face a Mega Fall. ‎Each Ruler must pitch to the Ultimate Ruler to save their place in the Penthouse. ‎But it’s the Ultimate Ruler’s decision who stays and who falls. ‎Clashes, arguments, and high-voltage drama take over the Tower.

1.name: Kaun Hai Dhokebaaz?
1.overview: With the Worker's prize pot dissolved, both the Rulers and the Workers are given a chance to increase the winning amount. To increase the the amount the Workers have to correctly answer the questions put forth by the Rulers. Each correct answer will open a locker containing a different amount which will add to their total amount.

1.name: Ticket To Go Home
1.overview: ‎Ashneer enters the Red Room and revisits last week’s storm, questioning every move of the Rulers and Workers. He introduces the 'Ticket to Go Home', where they must choose who doesn’t deserve to stay in the game. ‎This twist ignites intense clashes, accusations, and heated debates. ‎The Powerplay Weekend turns into a fiery showdown filled with drama and entertainment.

1.name: Most Hated Contestant
1.overview: ‎On the last Powerplay Weekend of Rise & Fall the ‎Rulers and Workers fire sharp anonymous questions at each other. Sharp words are exchanged and ‎a double Elimination keeps the Workers guessing their fate.

1.name: Rise Pe Hua Rage
1.overview: As the finale week begins, it's a do-or-die scenario for the remaining Workers in the basement. They are given a challenge which will secure one Worker's position not only in the Penthouse but also in the Finale. As the challenge progresses a fellow Worker is called out for cheating.

1.name: Sawaal Pe Hua Bawaal
1.overview: ‎The members of the Press continue their onslaught of tough questions aimed at both, the Workers and the Rulers. And a siren signals the countdown towards the closing of the basement and the Workers get a chance to secure their place in the finale as the fifth finalist.

1.name: Aakhri Finalist
1.overview: ‎The Jamnapaar cast put forth a challenge to the Workers, where Workers take on dares to add money to the Rulers prize pot. ‎As the final Basement shutdown begins, two Workers will be eliminated and one will rise as the last Ruler and the sixth Finalists. ‎It’s the final chance to prove themselves, but the decision lies completely in the hands of the Rulers.

1.name: Grand Finale
1.overview: ‎The Tower stands tall for the most awaited Grand Finale of Rise and Fall. ‎Ex-contestants return to relive their journeys in a night filled with nostalgia, music, and celebration. ‎Celebrity guests set the stage ablaze as emotions run high. ‎All eyes await the moment when the Ultimate Winner of Rise and Fall Season 1 is crowned.

2.name: Let The Games Begin
2.overview: Host Virender Sehwag makes his reality debut as fifteen contenders from television, politics, and digital media enter the Tower. The grand premiere kicks off with an audience valuation twist, dividing the contestants into luxury Penthouse Rulers and hard-labor Basement Workers. As the initial hierarchy is established, the Workers prepare for their first shifts to build the collective prize pot, while early tensions and tactical alliances immediately surface.

2.name: Kiski Palti Kismat
2.overview: Following the grand premiere where contestants were initially segregated into Rulers (residing in the luxury Penthouse) and Workers/Hustlers (stuck in the gruelling conditions of the Basement), Episode 2 centers on the first major power shift and survival challenge.

2.name: Lafda Loading
2.overview: The game of power heats up in Episode 3 of Rise and Fall, as the Rulers throw down a difficult challenge for the Workers. With the Prize Pot at stake, the pressure has never been higher. The rules are simple but the outcome could change everything: if the Workers succeed, they get to add money to the growing Prize Pot. But if they fail, not only do they lose their chance to earn, they also risk their hard-earned amount being snatched away by the Rulers.

2.name: Hurt Kar Diya
2.overview: Tensions escalate between the Penthouse and the Basement. A disagreement between Gautam and Priyanka turns personal, altering their dynamic amidst high-stakes decisions.

2.name: Leech Hai Ye Khoon Choosta Hai
2.overview: The Workers face a demanding Prize Pot Challenge, where every decision could impact their hard-earned pot. Tensions explode when Manish and Tej Pratap Yadav lock horns over a crucial moment, while pressure mounts across the Basement. With the stakes rising and every cracker counting, will the Workers manage to increase their prize pot?

2.name: Majdoor Pe Atyachar Karenge
2.overview: Friction reaches a boiling point as the disparity between Penthouse luxuries and Basement hardships triggers an outright rebellion. With the Rulers imposing stricter demands to protect their privileges, the Workers push back against the constant exploitation, setting off major clashes that threaten to dismantle established alliances and reshape the power ladder.

2.name: Do Bhai Dono Tabahi
2.overview: The tension reaches a boiling point after the grueling fireworks task leaves the Workers lagging far behind the Rulers in the Prize Pot. An attempt by the Penthouse to extend an olive branch through food sharing backfires, igniting intense clashes in the Basement. With blame shifting across both floors, alliances are tested, and the game takes a high-stakes turn as the first round of nominations puts the Workers on the firing line.

1.name: Sanjay
1.overview: When diplomatic talks between the feuding Pandavas and Kauravas fall apart, the messenger Sanjay must deliver difficult news — war is near.

1.name: Vishwaroop
1.overview: As the battle begins, Lord Krishn reveals the wisdom of the Bhagavad Gita through divine radiance as he guides a torn Arjun towards fulfilling his duty.

1.name: Bhishm
1.overview: In the story of Bhishm, Krishn recalls the abduction of Princess Amba. But her transformation into Shikhandi will lead to death on the battlefield.

1.name: Dronacharya
1.overview: Dronacharya rises to the role of commander of the Kauravas. But when his plan to stop Yudhishthir's coronation fails, he makes a deadly vow.

1.name: Abhimanyu
1.overview: Abhimanyu, the Pandava prince, steps onto the battlefield to combat Dronacharya's complex assault. But tragedy occurs at the hands of the Kauravas.

1.name: Jayadrath
1.overview: The grieving Pandavas cast blame for their loss. When Jayadrath is mentioned, Draupadi has disturbing memories. Enraged, Arjun prepares to fight.

1.name: Arjun
1.overview: With Krishn's cosmic aid, Arjun seeks revenge from Jayadrath, while attempting to counter an age-old curse.

1.name: Ghatotkach
1.overview: A nighttime battle rages, led by Ghatotkach, Bheem's half-demon son. For the Kauravas, one choice remains — a weapon reserved to fight Arjun.

1.name: Yudhisthir
1.overview: After an injury sidelines him, honorable Yudhishthir returns to a fateful crossroads — must he uphold truth or surrender to falsehood?

1.name: Kripacharya
1.overview: Kripacharya hosts a unique duel between Ashwatthama and Karn to determine the next commander, but rage and violence soon follow.

1.name: Kunti
1.overview: As he prepares to take on leadership, Karn reflects on his relationship with his birth mother, Kunti, and his vow to defeat Arjun.

1.name: Dushasan
1.overview: Haunted by Draupadi's humiliation, Bheem sets out to target Dushasan in a brutal attack for revenge.

1.name: Karn
1.overview: To defeat Arjun, Karn requests the skilled rider Shalya to take him into battle. But he soon faces the charioteer's ridicule and an old curse.

1.name: Duryodhan
1.overview: Duryodhan flees the battlefield after Shalya's death, finding a hideout within Lake Dwaipayana as the Pandavas search for him.

1.name: Bheem
1.overview: Bheem and Duryodhan finally face each other in war, while Krishn and Lord Balaram argue over incidents of unlawful fighting on both sides.

1.name: Ashwatthama
1.overview: Driven by wrath, Ashwatthama leads a devastating massacre. But when his vengeance threatens the world, Krishn steps in to stop him.

1.name: Stree Parv
1.overview: A grief-stricken Gandhari meets Krishn — and leaves him with an ominous curse. The Pandava women mourn their losses in Kurukshetra.

1.name: Krishn
1.overview: After Yudhishthir's coronation, Krishn leaves for Dwarka, carrying reminders of Gandhari's words as one family collapses and another rises.

1.name: Customs vs Popat
1.overview: Amid mounting pressure to curb smuggling at Mumbai airport, officer Prakash Kumar takes charge and ends Arjun Meena's suspension so he can lead the team.

1.name: Bada Choudhary
1.overview: Arjun forms his A-Team with formerly suspended officers Mitali and Ravinder, as Prakash tasks them with taking down the Bada Choudhary syndicate.

1.name: The Priya Story
1.overview: Caught smuggling gold by Arjun, flight attendant Priya goes undercover for him. The World Customs Conference offers a chance to trap the smugglers.

1.name: Operation Longshot
1.overview: The customs team mounts a large-scale sting to intercept gold smugglers converging on Mumbai. Bada Choudhary senses something is wrong.

1.name: Hum Coin Hain
1.overview: Prakash is sent to Bangkok, where he meets an unexpected visitor. The search of a suspect's home leads the officers to a troubling incident.

1.name: Darr Ka Dhandha
1.overview: The Choudhary syndicate strikes back with violence and intimidation against the customs officers. Ravinder's reckless move drags him deeper into trouble.

1.name: Kahani Khatam
1.overview: Arjun gets crucial information from Srikant Saxena. As the syndicate tries one final gold smuggling run, can the officers stop them before it's too late?

1.name: Arrival
1.overview: Sudha sweeps Chander off his feet, but they choose to stay friends. Now, he runs a hilltop café with Preeti by his side.

1.name: Stay
1.overview: While living with Chander, Sudha grows closer to him, but an opportunity in Mumbai may reshape their future. Preeti reveals her plans to expand the café.

1.name: Choice
1.overview: Sudha grapples with a difficult choice between her career and love life, as Chander opens up about his plans for the future.

1.name: Trip
1.overview: Rahil plants seeds of doubt in Preeti's mind, leading her to question Chander about his past. Sudha and Chander take a major step in their relationship.

1.name: Surprise
1.overview: When his mother arrives unexpectedly, Chander scrambles to hide his relationship. Meanwhile, Rahil and Chander look back on how far they've come.

1.name: Truth
1.overview: Preeti and Chander receive a surprising offer for the café. A conversation with her mother leaves Sudha reflecting on an important choice.

1.name: Distance
1.overview: While vacationing at a homestay, Sudha and Chander scout locations for the café, but a decision creates tension. Mark gives Chander a ring for Preeti.

1.name: Arrival
1.overview: A surprise guest unsettles Preeti, while Chander finds his past unexpectedly colliding with the present.

1.name: Episode 1
1.overview: When Kuku goes missing, Rajni enlists her eccentric neighbors to help find him. But her search soon reveals a frustrating truth about her marriage.

1.name: Episode 2
1.overview: As Rajni struggles to tell Kuku her decision, the couples across Chumbak Colony reassess their own relationships.

1.name: Episode 3
1.overview: Split over the decision to divorce, Rajni and Kuku seek legal counsel. Dharmendra's unconventional work causes a stir at his daughter's school.

1.name: Episode 4
1.overview: Rajni and Kuku come to an agreement in court. While the men reflect on their marriages, a Bollywood-themed ladies' night goes awry.

1.name: Episode 5
1.overview: The husbands rush to free their wives from jail as Micky scrambles to hide his affair. Kuku's account of a mystery woman puts Rajni on alert.

1.name: Episode 6
1.overview: Kuku's memory of the elusive woman sparks questions across the colony. Nari organizes a memorial for his beloved pet python.

1.name: Episode 7
1.overview: Rajni's connection with singer Ronit has her friends playing cupid. Priyanka and Adi deal with their son Ruhaan's trouble at school.

1.name: Episode 8
1.overview: The colony scrambles to find Ruhaan after he runs away from home. But Priyanka and Adi soon face a major surprise.

1.name: Episode 9
1.overview: Ronit tries to help Kuku and Rajni. Kiran and Hutoxi gather evidence against Micky, while the colony stages a mock trial for Ruhaan's legal notice.

1.name: Episode 10
1.overview: Accusations fly during the mock trial. But when Ruhaan insults his mother's career, Adi steps up to defend Priyanka.

1.name: Episode 11
1.overview: The women plan a trap to expose Micky, while Nari's plan accidentally targets the wrong people. Freddy's confession stuns Hutoxi.

1.name: Episode 12
1.overview: Nari's truth-pill scheme spirals out of control, putting the women's plan at risk. Alicia joins the plot as Micky grows suspicious.

1.name: Episode 13
1.overview: Dharmendra strikes an unusual bargain with Kiran over a film role. Rajni and Ronit take their relationship in a new direction.

1.name: Episode 14
1.overview: Alicia's betrayal drives a wedge between the friends across Chumbak Colony. Freddy hides a life-changing opportunity from Gulshan.

1.name: Episode 15
1.overview: Kuku's choking incident briefly reunites the feuding colony, but old fights soon resurface. A break-in at Adi's home turns dangerous.

1.name: Episode 16
1.overview: The residents attempt to mend their fractured friendships. But uncertainty looms over Chumbak Colony, leaving their future in doubt.

1.name: Pilot
1.overview: It takes a team of people to help answer the famous question, "911, what's your emergency?" Detective Athena Grant works as a member of the police force, handling cases that require her sharp mind and expertise, while also trying to juggle her own family drama. Bobby Nash and his team of firefighters help execute the daring rescues that often come along with these life-threatening situations. Meanwhile, Abby Clark spends her days taking and fielding emergency calls at the 911 call center, but co

1.name: Let Go
1.overview: A night at an amusement park takes a deadly turn when a roller coaster malfunction leaves lives hanging in the balance. Abby reaches out to Buck; Athena and Hen respond to an unusual home invasion.

1.name: Next of Kin
1.overview: Bobby and his team respond to an emergency at a children's birthday party that leaves lives hanging in the balance. The crew jumps into action after one of their own is involved in a devastating accident. Athena tries to cope with a tragedy that hits way too close to home and Abby is confronted with a life-changing decision for her mother and makes a connection with Buck.

1.name: Worst Day Ever
1.overview: In the aftermath of a deadly plane crash, Bobby and team race to help the survivors, while Athena deals with panic and chaos at the airport. Bobby confronts his past demons; Athena is out for revenge against a group of teen bullies; and Abby delivers an important message from a 9-1-1 caller.

1.name: Point of Origin
1.overview: The crew races to an emergency when disaster strikes at an Indian wedding. Abby enlists the help of Buck to try and find her mother and, for the first time, meets Athena face-to-face. Meanwhile, Bobby has a difficult time confronting his past and Hen struggles to make the right decision.

1.name: Heartbreaker
1.overview: On Valentine's Day, a surprise marriage proposal goes awry with dangerous consequences. Athena attempts to help a desperate woman and unintentionally joins the Lonely Hearts Club. Bobby and Chimney pull holiday duty and learn about the "Casanova Fracture" and Abby and Buck go on their first official date.

1.name: Full Moon (Creepy AF)
1.overview: A full moon keeps the crew busy with some of the craziest calls yet, as Athena investigates a potential home invasion and "faces off" against a rabid criminal. Meanwhile, Abby helps investigate the murder of a caller, Bobby and Buck have their hands full at a yoga studio for pregnant women and Hen's past may become her future.

1.name: Karma's A Bitch
1.overview: What goes around comes around for an unremorseful widower, an arrogant fitness club owner and an unsuspecting thief. Meanwhile, Bobby gets a surprising phone call from his doctor after donating at Chimney's blood drive, and Athena confronts Michael after having a heart-to-heart with their kids.

1.name: Trapped
1.overview: The first responders race to help a homeless man crushed in a garbage truck, a mother and son in a crashed elevator and extreme hoarders entombed in their house. Meanwhile, Athena jumps into to the dating pool, as Buck and Abby's relationship is tested by her ailing mother.

1.name: A Whole New You
1.overview: The first responders take calls to help an unusual domestic disturbance, a "death" at a psychic's and a horrific motorcycle crash. Meanwhile, Bobby dips his toe into the dating pool, Abby takes a walk down memory lane, Buck is confronted by his past actions and Athena tries to start her new life.

1.name: Tara's Sinister Plan
1.overview: Jack's sinister plan to kidnap Karan puts the family in danger, as Tara helps him evade the guards. Daya exposes Jack and Tara while police rescue Karan.

1.name: Chapter One: The Handless Maiden
1.overview: After a cult in Montana mysteriously burns to the ground, a girl named Minnow Bly emerges from the woods. A violent encounter results in her being sent to juvenile detention, where her only hope for release comes from a forensic psychologist who offers freedom in exchange for her secrets.

1.name: Chapter Two: Love Bomb
1.overview: Minnow begins to tell her story to Dr. Wilson, about the formation of the cult, the power of the Prophet, their sudden disappearance into the woods twelve years ago, and truth about who cut off her hands.

1.name: Chapter Three: The Iron Slippers
1.overview: Minnow starts taking classes and panics when she is tasked to try reading, uncovering a gruesome memory from her past surrounding the birth of her baby sister.

1.name: Chapter Four: God's Eyes
1.overview: Trying to make sense of her new world, Minnow turns to her roommate Angel for answers. Dr. Wilson meanwhile delves into the Prophet's past and discovers the disturbing origin of the Kevinian god, "Charlie”.

1.name: Chapter Five: St. Chad's Day
1.overview: With Angel as her guide, Minnow experiences Valentine's Day for the first time, revealing the story of her own forbidden love in the woods. But as her friendship with Angel continues to deepen she's given a violent reminder of how dangerous the world around her can be.

1.name: Chapter Six: We're All Made of Stars
1.overview: Minnow reveals how her love for Jude threw her beliefs into chaos and made her question everything she knew, including the Prophet himself. Meanwhile, Wilson investigates this boy Minnow fell for, wondering if he's complicit in The Prophet's death. And in the process, uncovers a horrifying secret.

1.name: Chapter Seven: Phantom Pain
1.overview: Minnow searches for a new belief system that can answer the questions that burn inside her and finally reveals the heartbreaking truth of how she lost her hands.

1.name: Chapter Eight: Wedding Day
1.overview: The loss of her hands was only the beginning: the Prophet has something even more twisted in store for Minnow Bly.

1.name: Chapter Nine: Storming the Castle
1.overview: Minnow must decide if she's still the same girl who fell in love with Jude in the woods while the police's investigation into The Prophet's death escalates, zeroing in on her as the main suspect.

1.name: Chapter Ten: Subject - Minnow Bly
1.overview: As the murder investigation comes to a head, Minnow faces her parole hearing and learns her fate, telling Dr. Wilson the end of her story –– how the Prophet died and what really happened to her sister.

1.name: Proofs for the Existence of God
1.overview: A typical day at St. Thomas parish sees Ray being thrown out of a city council meeting for over-zealously arguing to save the church's soup kitchen from extinction. In the confessional, Ray ignores Church policy when counseling a distraught young woman who wonders whether she'll be damned to Hell if she has an abortion. As a result, Ray lands in an impossible, political, painfully public moral quagmire. When Ray is called to break up a fight at the parish school, he reaches out to a desperate te

1.name: Song of Songs
1.overview: When Father Ray goes to battle for the church soup kitchen and invites a local politician to dine with the homeless on J.A.'s wedding day, his intentions for inclusion and human compassion are noble, but his timing couldn't be worse; and nuptial plans go horribly awry when J.A.'s check to the party hall bounces, forcing him to hold the reception at St. Thomas -- with a few more guests than expected.

1.name: Mixed Blessings
1.overview: Father Ray struggles to fulfill the last wishes of a deceased parishioner while her widowed husband, a lapsed Catholic who despises Ray, vehemently objects. Meanwhile, good fortune gives way to greed when a winning lottery ticket is anonymously left in the weekly collection plate.

1.name: Parents and Children
1.overview: Ray and Leo are painfully and angrily divided when Rachel (Tamara Mello) asks them for advice on whether or not to continue her pregnancy.

1.name: Roman Catholic Holiday
1.overview: Even a priest needs a break from time to time, and when Father Ray takes a day off from his duties at St. Thomas he finds divine inspiration at a pick-up basketball game; while Leo deeply ponders his purpose in life.

1.name: Spirit and Substance
1.overview: Distracted by Father Leo's absence, Father Ray finds it mysteriously difficult to get in touch with God; while his old flame (Wendy Gazelle) returns to plan St. Thomas' Halloween bash.

1.name: Calling
1.overview: Sibling rivalry is taken to extremes when Father Ray grudgingly opens his home to his estranged parolee brother. Meanwhile, Eric teaches an arrogant young seminarian a lesson in tolerance, and Mo gets her first opportunity to preach.

1.name: Speaking in Tongues
1.overview: Father Ray attempts to save the life of a young man who has been hospitalized for speaking in foreign tongues and seeing spiritual visions. Meanwhile, Rachel is approached by a teenage girl (Kimberly McCullough) for advice about premarital sex and Eric develops feelings for a young musician with a checkered past.

1.name: A Bloody Miracle
1.overview: Father Ray tries to end the violence between two warring gangs and is shocked to learn why a teenage girl is caught in the literal and figurative crossfire. Meanwhile, Mo helps Sidney reconsider his motivation for leaving his wife, and an unexpected and very welcome guest miraculously returns to St. Thomas.

1.name: House of Rage
1.overview: Father Ray facilitates the inevitable dissolution of a broken marriage in a family besieged by alcoholism, violence and bitterness. Meanwhile, the staff at St. Thomas discovers that gifts sometimes do come in large packages when an elderly couple leaves their home to the Church.

1.name: Hodie Christus Natus Est
1.overview: Father Ray declares St. Thomas a sanctuary to a family of Salvadoran refugees on Christmas Eve and lands himself in the most unexpected of places to find a priest on a holy holiday. Meanwhile, the staff cannot agree on who will perform the Christmas homily.

1.name: Signs and Words
1.overview: The St. Thomas staff is taken to task when the Bishop sends Father Ray some very unwelcome assistance in the form of Father Martin. Meanwhile, a young black parishioner raises serious questions about whether he is welcome in the Catholic church.

1.name: A Nun's Story
1.overview: When Mo is shaken by the sudden death of Sister Sebastian and confronted with Father Martin's plan to make staffing changes at St. Thomas, she strongly reconsiders her desire to remain a nun.

1.name: Kindred Spirits
1.overview: Father Ray's heroic instincts are aroused when Justine (Jennifer Beals) is accosted by a mentally disabled parishioner her first day on the job as St. Thomas' new Director of Education. Meanwhile, Justine gets involved in a power play between Martin and Ray over the fate of the soup kitchen.

1.name: The Coldest Night of the Year
Holy Words
1.overview: Ray and woman Rabbi try to bring a Catholic and a Jewish family together in a mixed faith wedding ceremony.

1.name: Sex, God and Reality
1.overview: Justine and Father Ray must contend with a contend with a condom epidemic at school, and Rachel falls for an ex-convict volunteer worker.

1.name: HIV Priests
1.overview: Father Ray receives a call from his friend Father Jesse who informs him that he has contracted AIDS.

1.name: Sleeping Dogs
1.overview: Father Leo faces accusation of sexual abuse.

1.name: Sisters
1.overview: Rena's date with Yui is interrupted by a mysterious person from her past.

1.name: Declaration
1.overview: As Empress, Yui is forced to choose who she will protect. More strangers appear seeking the Regalia.

1.name: Sincerity
1.overview: Alecto is confronted by a new potential threat. Yui visits the festival, while Rena prepares a surprise for Yui.

1.name: Feigned Confidence
1.overview: Yui and Rena's relationship is tested when they encounter a visitor from Rimgarde.

1.name: Counterattack
1.overview: Yui has devised a plan to deal with the threat from Abel, and along with Rena, they must find the strength to see it through.

1.name: Divine Machinations
1.overview: Yui, Rena, Tia, and Sara are summoned to another country by an unknown Regalia. Meanwhile, Johann grows restless.

1.name: The Past
1.overview: The girls find themselves wandering the ruins of Rimgarde, when they suddenly come across Kei.

1.name: Returning Home
1.overview: Johann forces a showdown while Tia and Rena leave their Regalia to search for Kei.

1.name: Succession
1.overview: Ingrid takes up temporary residence with Yui, giving them a chance to talk about the time Ingrid met Yui's mother.

1.name: Isolation
1.overview: Tia and Sara discover someone from their past amongst Johann's dolls. Later, Yui proposes a bold plan of action!

1.name: Prison
1.overview: Rena and Yui are reunited, while Sara, Tia, Kei, and Ingrid fight off Johann's Regalia Gear.

1.name: Reclamation
1.overview: Ingrid, Kei, Tia, and Sara continue to fight, managing to free Noa. Will Yui and Rena return in time?

1.name: Family
1.overview: Yui and all of her friends face off with Johann for a decisive battle.

1.name: Knight
1.overview: Cecily Campbell is the head of the Campbell house and a member of the 'Knight Guards' responsible for protecting the Independent Trade City of Housman. When Cecily's sword is broken in a confrontation with a former knight she must search for a blacksmith to repair it. Unfortunately the only person skilled enough is Luke Ainsworth, who also happens to be the one who saved her life during the earlier fight. However, before he can even start his task Luke must once again save Cecily's life when a l

1.name: Devil's Contract
1.overview: After the attack on the caravan, ominous rumors spread across the land. Meanwhile, Cecily finally talks Luke into making her a sword, only to find she may not be able to afford his fees.

1.name: Demon Sword
1.overview: Aria reveals her true form to Cecily, Luke, and Lisa. Later, the girls spend some time exploring the city, but their fun is cut short when a horde of possessed prisoners rampages violently through the streets.

1.name: Vow
1.overview: Despite her misgivings Cecily is ordered to use Aria to lure out the mysterious man in black. However, when things go wrong and the situation gets out of hand Cecily must once again ask Luke for help so that she can protect her new friend.

1.name: Ties
1.overview: Luke won't tell Cecily much about his relationship with Lisa, but Cecily isn't afraid to share her thoughts on the matter. The result: Lisa goes shopping with the girls - and Luke's paying!

1.name: Princess
1.overview: Cecily and Aria fall under attack by three women, each with a Demon Sword more powerful than the last! As the fight rages, Luke receives a visitor who is connected to the trio of assailants - Charlotte.

1.name: Family
1.overview: Charlotte and the others are forced to work as maids in exchange for staying in the Campbell house and unfortunately for her Cecily gets roped in as well. However, whilst living and working together Cecily begins to learn more about her new friends and Charlotte in particular. Meanwhile Aria talks to Evadne about what it means to be a Demon Sword.

1.name: Departure
1.overview: Hoping to find favor in the eyes of the Empire which has forsaken Charlotte, Doris leads a mission to claim the Demon Swords and abduct Luke. Cecily must stop them before it's too late.

1.name: Remnants
1.overview: Cecily joins Luke as he visits the grave of a friend, offering the young knight a glimpse into the turmoil of the blacksmith's past. Meanwhile, Lisa stays behind to repair a dagger belonging to a girl named Elsa.

1.name: Victim of Love
1.overview: When the man in black attacks, Cecily and Aria are stunned to learn the reasons why Demon Swords exist - but the most shocking revelations involve the truth behind Luke and Lisa's relationship.

1.name: Truth
1.overview: Following the revelation that Lisa is a demon, Cecily begins to avoid both her and Luke. However, she soon realises how foolishly she has been acting when she is invited to attend a conference concerning Valbanil and the Sacred Sword, which Luke and Siegfried also attend. Unfortunately, the revelations at the conference only serve to fuel Siegfried's anger and he decides it is time to put his plans into motion.

1.name: Blacksmith
1.overview: After his humiliation during the conference Siegfried finally snaps and dispatches a horde of demons to destroy the City of Housman. While Cecily and Aria join the Knight Guards in dealing with the demons, Luke decides it is time to settle things with Siegfried. However, even Luke may not be strong enough to stand against Siegfried's Demon Sword of Darkness, at least not without help.

1.name: The Stone's Awakening
1.overview: Alma Tandoji, seventeen, keeps others at a distance due to a past incident. One night, Ruri Aiba appears at his door. She pleads with Alma to battle against the Dark Stone, creatures that can only be defeated by the power of the Sacred Seven within Alma.

1.name: A Bond in the Color of Ruri
1.overview: Ruri is the new Chairperson of Almas academy, and calls him to her office to ask him again to join the battle against the Dark Stone. Meanwhile, a plane departs from a US military base, secretly carrying an extremely explosive material.

1.name: The Crazy Knight
1.overview: Ruri returns from London after buying a fine grade gemstone for Alma to use. During trip a routine trip home, she and her convoy is attacked by Knight, the one who caused the Darkstone incidents. Kenmi reveals his reasons of his research on the Sacred Seven and information on his history on Knight.

1.name: School Fair of Hell
1.overview: Ruri and Alma participate for the school fair. However, things turn worse when a few of Knight's Darkstone snakes cause problems. Wakana converses with Ruri to know her a little more.

1.name: The Heart's Mirror
1.overview: Tandoji and the Geology Club went to a camp. There, Kagami and Tandoji found a darkstone and informed Ruri about it. They managed to defeat it without the geology club members knowing.

1.name: One More Night
1.overview: Ruri invites Alma to eat lunch with her. Alma feels very annoyed by Ruri. Knight kidnapped Ruri to get a serum that will help him control the darkstone in him.

1.name: The True Lightstone and Darkstone
1.overview: Naito has escaped with Ruri, but the transmitter Kenmi placed reveals the possible location of Naitos hideout. Alma catches up to Kagami, who asks him to investigate the site. Alma searches for Ruri and runs into Naito, whos been waiting for him!

1.name: Show Me Your Devotion
1.overview: Ruri is unable to trust Kenmi due to Naitos words. She asks Kagami to investigate Kenmi Laboratory. Meanwhile, Oni-gawara is still split in two and to be fixed, needs a stone from Kamakura that has the manifestation of the true heart of a boy and girl.

1.name: Will Like a Rolling Stone
1.overview: Almas relationship with Ruri causes him to be teased by his classmates, a sign that they have started to warm up to him. Gradually, Alma is finding his place at the academy. Almas still hesitant but Wakana is elated that people see him for who he is.

1.name: Aoi's Memory
1.overview: Theres been a change to Ruris sister, Aoi. Five years ago, as Ruris family, their butler Kagami and his son spend a fun-filled Christmas week together, Ruri and Aoi have a fight. While small in scale, it changes the destiny of the two girls.

1.name: Blade Sharpened
1.overview: Ruri was taken in to custody by Kenmi. Alma, Kagami and the entire Aiba Foundation declared war against Kenmi Group and rescued Ruri. Knight and Fei plans to use the vaccine on Zero to retain his mind and control over his Darkstone powers.

1.name: Sacred Seven
1.overview: Kenmi's laughter echoes through the forest. Hes absorbed Number 0s energy and plans to consume Alma, who holds a purer power of the Sacred Seven. To stop Kenmi's ambition, Naito attacks. Their last battle surrounding the Sacred Seven has begun.

1.name: Defined by Grace
1.overview:
Hear Emily Thomes story, and how Christians can effectively reach out to the LGBTQ community with the only true message of freedom, the gospel of Jesus Christ.

“Or do you not know that the unrighteous will not inherit the kingdom of God?” (1 Corinthians 6:9) This verse convicted Emily Thomes of her sin, including the sin of homosexuality, prompting her to turn to Christ for salvation, joyfully forsaking her sin and pursuing obedience to her Creator and Lord.

1.overview:
Discover compassionate and profoundly helpful insights from God’s Word to heal from abuse, expose abuse, and prevent abuse.

One in three girls and one in five boys will be victims of child sexual abuse. Millions have continued to suffer the effects long after it has ended, never speaking of “the secret.” How can we help abuse survivors rise their silent pain? How can we empower our children to say “no” to abuse? Is there hope and healing?

Discover compassionate and profoundly helpful insights

1.name: How to Talk to Our Children & Teens About the Sexual Revolution
1.overview:
With humor and passion, popular author & podcaster Heidi St. John reminds us that bold lies must be countered with bold truth.

Bold lies can only be countered with bold truth. Even preschoolers are now brazenly taught to accept and encourage alternative lifestyles and gender transformation as good and normal. 1.overview: Today, words like “headship” and “submission,” “leader” and “helper” are imbued with negative connotations. Are these biblical truths and directives old-fashioned, antiquated notions of patriarchy? Or are they still truths we are called to cling to, even in our modern context?

1.name: Redeeming Broken Sexuality
1.overview:
Our sexuality is beautiful, and there’s freedom from shame by the cross of Christ. Discover practical application for this profound truth in Phylicia’s presentation filmed at an Answers for Women Conference.

What happens when the first time a young girl learns about sex is from an erotic novel? She discovers sex within the context of shame . . . and sometimes develops a sexual addiction. That’s the story of Phylicia Masonheimer, who shares how God redeemed her sexuality through the truth found

1.name: The Lie of Pornography
1.overview:
Is it possible for a woman caught in the grip of pornography to return to God’s sacred design for sexuality? Find practical teaching and application in this presentation.

While some might say, “What is the big deal with viewing a little porn here or there?”, pornography and sexual sin has devastating effects on the church, the family, our children, and on society as a whole.
