1.overview:
Are we male and female? Is gender on a spectrum? Can a man become a woman or a woman a man? What does God’s Word have to say about the gender revolution of our day? God knows all and His Word is not silent!

Beginning in Genesis, we see God’s “perfect” design for humanity. Sadly, this design was upended with the fall and now individuals often chaff and rebel against the Creator’s amazing design. Discover practical truths from God’s Word on this hot-button cultural issue.

1.name: Why Genesis Matters for a Biblical Worldview of Sexuality
1.overview:
Sexuality is grounded in God’s original design of male and female and the unique one-flesh union of marriage between one man and one woman. Without the foundation of a literal Genesis, we’re lost.

Our culture’s views on sexuality are creating a swirling hurricane, dragging individuals and families to and fro with every new wave of thinking. How do we know how we should think about these hot-button issues? We plant our feet firmly on God's Word, beginning in Genesis.

1.overview:
We need to lovingly show that, regardless of feelings, the choice to embrace any sexual lifestyle other than God’s design for marriage is sin, and as with any sin, the only hope for deliverance is the redeeming work of God’s grace offered through his Son Jesus Christ.

In this illustrated presentation from the popular Answers for Women: Sacred conference, Dr. Georgia Purdom addresses one of our culture’s most controversial “hot-button” questions, Are People Born Gay? She shows from both the Bibl

1.name: Petra
1.overview: Enter the remains of Petra and Hegra, cities whose old inscriptions and new discoveries suggest were once ruled by women.

1.name: Templars
1.overview: Were the Knights Templar faithful servants of Christ or hedonistic heretics? We travel to Jerusalem to find out.

1.name: Oracles
1.overview: Were ancient Greek oracles really soothsayers or were they predicting under the influence of tectonic phenomena?

1.name: Egypt
1.overview: See the Pyramids, the Valley of the Kings, and more as we visit Egypt's sacred sites and reveal their hidden secrets.

1.name: Chaco Canyon
1.overview: See if external forces doomed the people of Chaco Canyon or if they were the authors of their own misfortune.

1.name: I'm Possessed!
1.overview: A series of mysterious attacks leave several young women drained of their energy. Meanwhile, Matoi and Yuma work the shrine with no idea of the danger looming over them.

1.name: I Clad Myself In A God
1.overview: An invisible apparition is following Matoi wherever she goes, even to school. When photos of her other form land on the internet, other parties descend on her location.

1.name: God's Playing Dumb
1.overview: Luciela somehow works her way into the shrine and becomes Matoi and Yuma’s new tutor. Meanwhile, a sinister force takes over a human vessel and prepares another attack.

1.name: Her Resolution and My Reason
1.overview: Clarus burns for revenge against the “Creed Killer,” and she needs Matoi to lure him out. In exchange, she tells Matoi more about her powers and the nature of their enemy.

1.name: A Special Kind of Ordinary
1.overview: Matoi and Yuma take Clarus shopping, but the jovial atmosphere is broken when two little gods are released from inside Yuma and quickly scurry away.

1.name: I'm Sorry
1.overview: Yuma’s frightened tanuki god, Kai, is not nearly as excited as she is about combat, but he and Yuma might be their only hope when a fight against a cute Night turns deadly.

1.name: The Sea, the Hot Springs, and Sometimes Evil Spirits
1.overview: The whole gang ends up at the beach as a day for relaxation. When everyone goes to sleep, chaos ensues.

1.name: A Small Wish
1.overview: Tension arises with Matoi as she becomes uncertain of herself. Meanwhile, Tezuka is suddenly attacked.

1.name: Thank You
1.overview: After an attack by a Night, Shingo and Matoi end up trapped alone together, and Matoi’s transformation is starting to disappear. Is Shingo going to discover her identity?

1.name: The Open Gate
1.overview: At last, it’s time for Matoi to learn about her mother’s past. Meanwhile, Ludos launches another attack on the exorcists, but his orders may not be coming from who he expects.

1.name: I'm Heading Out!
1.overview: Matoi prepares to save the world by saying goodbye to the people she cares about. Meanwhile, Shingo realizes he might lose Matoi to the same calamity that took his wife.

1.name: Being Ordinary's the Best
1.overview: The girls ascend to the highest dimension and try to seal the gate. Matoi only holds one wish in her heart: to be ordinary.

1.name: Vincent
1.overview: At an Irish wedding in Tenerife, Father Vincent arrives to officiate it, unaware that his life is about to unravel.

1.name: Cormac
1.overview: As Cormac deals with a recent trauma, he develops a secret affair with one of the other wedding guests.

1.name: Sandra
1.overview: Sandra begins to suspect something is up with Jerry as she searches for meaning in her life.

1.name: Ava
1.overview: Ava is stressed as her English boyfriend Felix will soon be arriving in Tenerife and she hasn't yet told him about her recent diagnosis of herpes

1.name: Elodie
1.overview: Elodie juggles the personal issues of her host family, an issue with her mum back home and an interaction with an older wedding guest that leaves her shaken

1.name: The Wedding
1.overview: As the happy couple takes their vows, all the secrets of the previous week bubble up to the surface.

1.name: To the Abandoned Sacred Beasts
1.overview: The Northern Union of Patria and the Southern Confederation of Patria. They fought a long civil war, which finally came to an end when the North used a forbidden technology. They created Incarnates, beings with godlike powers, and this quickly turned the tables in the war. The Incarnates brought victory to the North and they were regarded as heroes, but their tremendous power became a double-edged sword, as it slowly made them lose their minds. Because of this, the Incarnate squad captain, Hank,

1.name: The Dragon's Daughter
1.overview: Schaal’s father, William, ran an orphanage on the outskirts of Livletwood Village, where Schaal lived a modest life with her father and the orphans. Because of the Civil War, prices on various goods increased, causing Schaal and her family to try to become more self-sufficient. Then one day, military intelligence visits William. William is told that has a unique skill. To make sure that Schaal and the other children have a secure future, William decides to go to war. After the Civil War ended, W

1.name: The Minotaur's Fortress
1.overview: Schaal decides to go on a journey with Hank, the man who killed her father. Their next destination was Roguehill, a town with a giant fortress. A monster lived in the fortress, which meant that the war still continued in this town. Hank was then greeted by Liza, a woman in charge of supporting Hank. According to Liza, the one who created the fortress was the Incarnate, Minotaur. Hank then heads to the fortress to fulfill his oath. On his way to the rather warped, overgrown, and “complete” fortre

1.name: March of the Behemoth
1.overview: Hank and Schaal head to the border on a steam locomotive. The steel bridge that goes over the border's valley is the largest in the continent. It connects the North and the South and is called the bridge of peace that would support the generations to come. However, it seems that the Incarnate Behemoth, formerly Arthur Allston, is slowly marching towards that bridge. Hank was called to stop him. Will Hank be able to stop the Incarnate Behemoth, even though he seems invincible against a barrage of

1.name: Gargoyle's Judgement
1.overview: The City of Steam, Whitechurch. Hank and his party head there in order to find Cain Madhouse, the man who unleashed the Beasts into this world. According to Liza's intel, he appears to be killing random people in the slums there. Hank and Schaal go to investigate why these murders are happening, when another body shows up. After seeing the claw marks on the newest body, Hank determines that it wasn't the work of Cain. A witness appears before them and tells them that he saw a demon statue murder

1.name: The King of the Beasts
1.overview: Hank's nemesis, Cain Madhouse, finally appears before them. The sudden appearance leaves Hank in shock and Schaal is taken. In order to get Schaal back, Hank accepts Cain's invitation to a party, even though he knows that it's a trap. There are many wealthy people among the crowd at the party. Eventually, Cain appears before them and the crowd applauds. Cain sees Hank in the crowd and begins to laugh ominously. What was the truth behind this?

1.name: The Trigger of Memories
1.overview: After the incident at Whitechurch that Cain Madhouse had instigated, Hank disappeared. The speech that Cain made at the banquet that evening would eventually rattle Patria to its core, causing a rebellion. The country seemed to be marching towards another war. One month later, Schaal appeared back at her hometown of Rivuletwood Village.

1.name: Songstress of Sleep
1.overview: The North Patria Union tries to quickly exterminate all of the Incarnates before the impending war. The captain of the Coup de Grace, Claude, had appeared in the port town of Port Gulf. Schaal is also there and happens to hear a beautiful singing voice. She heads toward the cave that the voice is coming from and encounters the Incarnate Siren, otherwise known as Beatrice, and her friend Charles.

1.name: The Hound of Hell's Gate
1.overview: After losing control at Whitechurch, Hank fears his powers as a Beast. The ghosts of all the comrades he had slain so far come back to haunt him. And then, his former subordinate, the Incarnate Garm, shows up before him. Garm and Hank battle it out in the snow when the Incarnate Extermination Squad, Coup de Grace, also shows up!

1.name: Two Oaths
1.overview: Despite having each other's backs during the civil war, now Hank and Roy face off with each other. The Incarnates Werewolf and Garm have an intense battle, but because the Coup de Grace interfered, Hank ended up going over a cliff. Hank continues to have hallucinations of all of his fallen comrades, when he's met with a familiar face...

1.name: The Start of Troubles Ahead
1.overview: New Patria built a huge fortress in Bold Creek. The northern army is sent in to take the fortress down. Claude and his Incarnate extermination squad, Coup de Grace join up with them to help. Hank goes with them, wearing a northern army uniform in order to blend in. After hearing what Colonel Martin Wall had to say about the current situation, Hank deduces that the enemy that they're facing is the Incarnate Centaurus, otherwise known as Miles Byron. Hank encounters Miles, who hadn't changed since

1.name: Those Who Seek
1.overview: The Incarnates Hank and Miles face off with each other on the battlefield. They exchange words and blows, but their battle comes to a rather unexpected conclusion. Then, Cain appears in front of Hank. What is the ambition of the man who shot Elaine and unleashed the Incarnates upon the world?

1.name: Missing
1.overview: In the mushy, romantic world of newlywed Saurabh and Shweta, an unspoken fear reigns. When Shweta suddenly disappears one day, the fear takes roots.

1.name: Finding Vikram
1.overview: Chandrayaan-2's failure sparks national disappointment. Contact with the Vikram lander is lost, causing anxiety for programmer Arjun and doubt for mission coordinator Yamini.

1.name: Man vs Machine
1.overview: The Failure Analysis Committee probes Chandrayaan-2's failure. Although Yamini defends her team, Arjun faces scrutiny. Meanwhile, Ramaiah reluctantly agrees to be the ISRO chief.

1.name: Science Finds a Way
1.overview: Chandrayaan-3 faces setbacks from budget cuts and political pressure, causing compromises. Yamini and Ramaiah clash, testing his leadership.

1.name: Make in India
1.overview: The COVID-19 pandemic disrupts Chandrayaan-3. A failed launch threatens the mission, but Mohanty plays defence for the ISRO team.

1.name: Where the Mind is Without Fear
1.overview: The launch is smooth, but the Moon race intensifies with Russia's Luna-25. As the ISRO team faces pressure, Arjun seeks solace in the memories of his father.

1.name: Gunaah
1.overview: Promoted as the youngest DCP of the Mumbai Crime Branch, Rita Ferreira must battle a patriarchal mindset at work, her own impostor syndrome, and a returning addiction, all while she gets drawn to a murder investigation that hits far too close to home.

1.name: Raaz
1.overview: Succeeding in covering her secret, Rita begins making headway in the case, uncovering an unsettling trail of killings that are connected by a pattern that's hard to ignore.

1.name: Janm
1.overview: Her relationship with Aditya in tatters, Rita gets mired in her investigation with the discovery of another murder bearing the same signature, guilt now blurring the line between duty and conscience.

1.name: Daga
1.overview: As the city grapples with two murders within a week, Vikram zeroes in on a suspect, but Rita refuses to follow his lead and pushes her investigation into overdrive, turning the case into a race against time.

1.name: Talaash
1.overview: Eager to close the case early, Deshpande backs Vikram's theory and lets him jump the gun - sidelining Rita, whose grip on the case slips even as her instincts pull her toward astounding new clues.

1.name: Jad
1.overview: Another murder comes to light, leaving the department humiliated. Before Deshpande can lean on Rita again, her substance addiction is exposed to the world, pushing her to the brink of suspension.

1.name: Yaad
1.overview: A tantalizing chase brings DCP Rita Ferreira and the killer on a head-on collision course, but to defeat the killer, she must first confront the haunting memory she's long buried.

1.name: Welcome to Margrave
1.overview: Reacher is wrongly accused of murder while visiting the small town of Margrave, GA.

1.name: First Dance
1.overview: When more victims are discovered, Reacher attempts to get answers but is set up. Roscoe receives a threatening message.

1.name: Spoonful
1.overview: Reacher and Finlay’s investigation into the missing Spivey leads them into a confrontation with Kliner Sr. Roscoe learns unsettling news about Reacher.

1.name: In a Tree
1.overview: As the danger increases, Reacher and Roscoe grow closer and they make plans to meet with their contact from Homeland Security.

1.name: No Apologies
1.overview: As the mystery deepens, Reacher teams up with an old colleague and Finlay makes a shocking discovery.

1.name: Papier
1.overview: As the town is rocked by another murder, Reacher heads to New York and learns the truth about the illegal business in Margrave while Roscoe faces danger in the woods.

1.name: Reacher Said Nothing
1.overview: Reacher springs a trap and then gets trapped himself.

1.name: Pie
1.overview: Reacher leads a rescue mission at the warehouse that ends in a showdown.

1.name: Stick or Twist
1.overview: Harry Da Souza is called upon to make a problem disappear.

1.name: Jigsaw Puzzle
1.overview: Harry must deal with the aftermath of the Harrigan family meeting.

1.name: Plan B
1.overview: Richie makes his move, putting the Harrigans on high alert.

1.name: Rat Trap
1.overview: Conrad comes to Jan for a favor. Kevin makes a confession to Harry.

1.name: Funeral for a Friend
1.overview: Kevin and Harry assess scenarios in a search for insurance and an exit strategy.

1.name: Antwerp Blues
1.overview: Conrad twists the knife as Maeve gives Eddie a lesson in the art of chess.

1.name: The Crossroads
1.overview: O'Hara points out the elephant in the room. Harry takes extreme measures.

1.name: Helter Skelter
1.overview: Maeve extends an olive branch. Richie contemplates a new affiliation.

1.name: Beggars Banquet
1.overview: Tattersall gets Alice's tootsies tapping. Kevin confronts his past.

1.name: The Beast in Me
1.overview: Kevin takes care of a problem. Maeve spills the tea.

1.name: Long Day's Journey Into Night
1.overview: The Matthews’ family road trip takes a horrifying turn when they are detoured to a small pastoral town from which they cannot leave. When their family RV crashes, Sheriff Boyd Stevens and other residents rush to save them before the sun goes down.

1.name: The Way Things Are Now
1.overview: At Colony House, Tabitha and Julie grapple with their new nightmarish reality. Out in the forest, Jim, Boyd and Kristi struggle to treat Ethan’s injuries. Tragedy strikes from an unexpected source as a new threat arises among the residents of the town.

1.name: Choosing Day
1.overview: The Matthews family must choose which of the two settlements they will join. Meanwhile, Jade comes to terms with his situation and Boyd is faced with an impossible decision that strikes at the very heart of life in the town.

1.name: A Rock and a Farway
1.overview: Julie finds comfort in her new friends. Jim and Tabitha deal with their struggling marriage. Ethan ventures off into the forest with Victor. Father Khatri urges Boyd to embrace his role as leader. Sara receives another horrifying directive.

1.name: Silhouettes
1.overview: Jim, Tabitha and Ethan begin asking questions about where they are in the hopes it may lead them home. Ellis and Fatima show Julie the lighter side of life in town. Jade struggles to make sense of their situation. Boyd seeks guidance.

1.name: Book 74
1.overview: Boyd’s plan to head off into the forest provokes an unexpected response from Kenny. Jade enlists Jim’s help with an experiment. Tabitha makes a chilling discovery that sends her down a unique path searching for answers.

1.name: All Good Things
1.overview: Father Khatri tells Boyd why he believes Sara may be useful. Jim and Tabitha find comfort in each other. Colony House celebrates the one-year anniversary of Fatima’s arrival with a party that goes terribly wrong.

1.name: Broken Windows, Open Doors
1.overview: In the wake of another death, Boyd questions his decision to leave. Kenny steps up and embraces his new role. Jim rallies the town around his idea to build a radio tower. Fatima urges Ellis to make amends with his father before it’s too late.

1.name: Into the Woods
1.overview: Boyd and Sara journey deeper into the forest than Boyd has ever gone, encountering new and terrifying mysteries. Jim’s confidence in the radio tower begins to wane. An unexpected tragedy causes Donna to unravel. Kenny and Kristi share a moment.

1.name: Oh, the Places We'll Go
1.overview: Boyd draws strength from an unlikely source. Jim’s radio tower yields consequences which rock him to his very core. The hole that Tabitha has been digging leads her somewhere, and to someone, she could never have expected.

1.name: The Name of the Game
1.overview: When a Supe kills the love of his life, A/V salesman Hughie Campbell teams up with Billy Butcher, a vigilante hell-bent on punishing corrupt Supes — and Hughie’s life will never be the same again.

1.name: Cherry
1.overview: The Boys get themselves a Superhero, Starlight gets payback, Homelander gets naughty, and a Senator gets naughtier.

1.name: Get Some
1.overview: It’s the race of the century. A-Train versus Shockwave, vying for the title of World’s Fastest Man. Meanwhile, the Boys are reunited and it feels so good.

1.name: The Female of the Species
1.overview: On a very special episode of The Boys… an hour of guts, gutterballs, airplane hijackings, madness, ghosts, and one very intriguing Female. Oh, and lots of heart — both in the sentimental sense, and in the gory literal sense.

1.name: Good for the Soul
1.overview: The Boys head to the “Believe” Expo to follow a promising lead in their ongoing war against the Supes. There might — MIGHT — be a homicidal infant, but you’ll have to see for yourself.

1.name: The Innocents
1.overview: SUPER IN AMERICA (2019). Vought Studios. Genre: Reality. Starring: Homelander, Queen Maeve, Black Noir, The Deep, A-Train, Starlight, Tara Reid, Billy Zane.

1.name: The Self-Preservation Society
1.overview: Never trust a washed-up Supe — the Boys learn this lesson the hard way. Meanwhile, Homelander digs into his past, Starlight discovers that love hurts, and if you’re ever in Sandusky, Ohio and a girl asks if she can touch your gills, say NO.

1.name: You Found Me
1.overview: Season Finale Time! Questions answered! Secrets revealed! Conflicts… conflicted! Characters exploded! And so much more!

1.name: The Heirs of the Dragon
1.overview: Viserys hosts a tournament to celebrate the birth of his second child. Rhaenyra welcomes her uncle Daemon back to the Red Keep.

1.name: The Rogue Prince
1.overview: Princess Rhaenyra dives deep into the prophecies about House Targaryen while confronting a realm that resists the idea of a woman on the Iron Throne, and Prince Daemon, embittered over being passed over as the heir to Westeros, prepares to go to war.

1.name: Second of His Name
1.overview: Daemon and the Sea Snake battle the Crabfeeder. The realm celebrates Aegon's second nameday. Rhaenyra faces the prospect of marriage.

1.name: King of the Narrow Sea
1.overview: Daemon returns to court after the successful completion of the battle. Princess Rhaenyra must deal with potential suitors in order to keep her line of succession.

1.name: We Light the Way
1.overview: Daemon visits his wife in the Vale. Viserys and Rhaenyra broker agreements with the Valeryons. Alicent seeks the truth about the princess.

1.name: The Princess and the Queen
1.overview: Ten years later. Rhaenyra navigates Alicent's continued speculation about her children, while Daemon and Laena weigh an offer in Pentos.

1.name: Driftmark
1.overview: As the families gather on Driftmark for a funeral, Viserys calls for an end to infighting and Alicent demands justice.

1.name: The Lord of the Tides
1.overview: Six years later. With the Driftmark succession suddenly critical, Rhaenyra attempts to strike a bargain with Rhaenys.

1.name: The Green Council
1.overview: While Alicent enlists Cole and Aemond to track down Aegon, Otto gathers the great houses of Westeros to affirm their allegiance.

1.name: The Black Queen
1.overview: Mourning a tragic death, Rhaenyra tries to hold the kingdom together and Daemon prepares for war.

1.name: Pilot
1.overview: A "closer" for one of New York City's most successful law firms decides to hire an aloof genius who has passed the bar but never went to law school as his associate.

1.name: Errors and Omissions
1.overview: Mike has an ethical dilemma when Louis forces him to make a decision that could hurt his relationship with Harvey. Elsewhere, Harvey's past comes back to haunt him during a case.

1.name: Inside Track
1.overview: Jessica hopes Harvey's promotion will reign him in, but when a crisis arises with the first client he brought into the firm, Harvey goes rogue trying to fix it.

1.name: Dirty Little Secrets
1.overview: Harvey and Jessica's relationship is tested when Harvey defends someone from her past. Also, Louis assigns Mike his first solo case, a pro bono that has him itching for a win.

1.name: Bail Out
1.overview: Mike's life becomes complicated when an old friend reappears and needs his help. Harvey must decide between closing a multi-million dollar deal and helping his trusted driver defend himself against a law suit.

1.name: Tricks of the Trade
1.overview: Harvey and Mike work to save a woman wrongly accused of insider trading. Mike helps Rachel study for the LSAT, only to find out she is on the brink of discovering his closely guarded secret.

1.name: Play the Man
1.overview: Mike takes on Louis' protégé during a mock trial, but his conflict with Rachel could hurt his chances of winning. Elsewhere, Harvey works on a merger between two hotel chains, but his past with the opposing counsel complicates matters.

1.name: Identity Crisis
1.overview: Mike is tasked with reigning in a modern day Robin Hood whose illicit deeds are putting a client's business at risk. Also, Louis must resolve his differences with Harvey to win a case. Amanda Crew and Bruce Altman guest star.

1.name: Undefeated
1.overview: Harvey meets his match in a cocky opposing counsel in a class action lawsuit, and Mike unknowingly helps frame Rachel as a traitor to the firm.

1.name: Shelf Life
1.overview: Harvey must fire an accountant for falsifying his credentials, but Mike finds a more sinister motive for his termination and becomes concerned about his own employment. Meanwhile, Louis thinks he's found his future wife.

1.name: Rules of the Game
1.overview: Harvey's former mentor turns to him for help when his office comes under investigation. Meanwhile, Jenny suspects Mike may be occupied with more than just his job.

1.name: Dog Fight
1.overview: Harvey's efforts to free an innocent man hit a wall when he goes against the new district attorney, who seems more focused on the integrity of the system than justice.

1.name: Seven Days a Week and Twice on Sunday
1.overview: Attorney Ted Black and partner Stuart Lane are about to merge with a firm run by Ted's ex. Associates Rick and Erica vie for positions in the firm, but when the merger hits a snag, Ted, a former prosecutor, must step into a role he holds in contempt.

1.name: Old Man Hanrahan
1.overview: Ted needs Amanda's help with a new prosecutor in Lester's murder trial. Erica squares off against Rick to stop him from poaching a client. Stuart and Samantha argue over Rick's position.

1.name: He Knew
1.overview: Ted and Kevin deal with a bombshell about Lester's motive for killing his producing partner. Erica and Leah try to fulfill an unorthodox request for a celebrity client. In the past, Ted drags his old friend Stuart into his mob case.

1.name: Batman Returns
1.overview: Ted and Erica take on Samantha to save Lester's movie, but the battle may hurt his murder trial. Rick enlists Stuart's help when a difficult actor is arrested. In the past, the danger of going against a mob boss sends Ted to an old friend.

1.name: You're on Your Own
1.overview: Ted and Amanda attempt to thwart the prosecutor from having Lester's wife testify. Kevin, Rick and Erica discover a problem with Lester's story.

1.name: Dester
1.overview: Erica and Kevin keep a secret from Ted that could hinder his murder trial. With the case slipping away, Ted turns to an unlikely source to save Lester.

1.name: Good Times
1.overview: The death of a beloved client brings Ted and Rick back together. Kevin helps Erica with a family matter. Stuart and Samantha clash over a distasteful client. Leah considers leaving the law. In the past, Ted gets news that could derail his career as a prosecutor.

1.name: Acapulco
1.overview: In the past, Ted's mob trial case takes a bad turn, forcing him to turn to old friend Harvey Specter. Erica and Leah's clash over personal time gets the attention of the firm's new head of HR. Stuart calls in a favor from Rick to discredit a witness.

1.name: Bat Signal
1.overview: Ted and Harvey team up to right a wrong from their past and put a monster behind bars. Stuart confronts the possibility he may have unwittingly helped a client commit a crime.

1.name: Slugfest
1.overview: Law students Ted and Stuart’s friendship is tested when they face off in a mock trial. In the present, Stuart faces a crisis as his doubts about his client mount.

1.name: Tearin' Up My Heart
1.overview: Ted must deliver on a request from client Patton Oswalt. Amanda turns to Erica for help defending a teen star accused of attacking her dad. Stuart’s accident sends him into a spiral. In the past, Ted and Eddie come to L.A. for Stuart’s bachelor party.

1.name: Angry Sylvester
1.overview: Erica and Ted disagree when she tries to sign a high-profile client against his wishes. Stuart meets an unexpected adversary at anger management. Rick works to secure Dylan Pryor’s dream role.

1.name: Freedom
1.overview: The relationships at the two firms are complicated as Ted and Samantha join forces to take down Rosalyn's former boss. Erica and Rick work against each other as they finalize Dylan Pryor's deal. Stuart recruits Kevin for a special task in New York.

1.name: Episode 1
1.overview: A prodigy who has been languishing at the bottom because of unfortunate circumstances grabs hold of a chance at a new start in life.

1.name: Episode 2
1.overview: Daisuke makes a decision to live as a lawyer as he struggles with his first case. Kai sees Daisuke’s “emotional dependence” and makes Daisuke resolve to let go of his past.

1.name: Episode 3
1.overview: Daisuke is disgruntled because Kai treats him like a child, and ends up being tricked by Kanie, succeeds in getting his first client, and starts to earn Kai’s trust.

1.name: Episode 4
1.overview: Chika’s ex-husband files a lawsuit, a case that shows a glimpse of Chika’s weakness. In this episode, Kai saves Chika, and a love triangle with Daisuke, Makoto and Sari starts in earnest.

1.name: Episode 5
1.overview: Yusei gets arrested. Daisuke is swayed by seeing Yusei again. In this episode, Kai helps Daisuke settle his past with Yusei.

1.name: Episode 6
1.overview: Kai and Kanie go head-to-head. Meanwhile, Daisuke’s resume fraud is almost exposed, but he gets a fake resume from a hacker.

1.name: Episode 7
1.overview: A formidable lawyer who has never lost a case faces off against Kai.

1.name: Episode 8
1.overview: Daisuke goes all out as the lawyer for a man who is also faking his background.

1.name: Episode 9
1.overview: Chika finds out about Daisuke’s resume fraud. She demands an explanation from Kai, but he has no time for that after finding out that his former teacher has engaged in misconduct.

1.name: Episode 10
1.overview: Kai takes action to protect a person who was falsely convicted and imprisoned because of Kai.

1.name: Episode 11
1.overview: Kai takes action to protect a person who was falsely convicted and imprisoned because of Kai.

1.name: What determines the destiny is not a chance, but a choice.
1.overview: A struggling young man heads to a hotel to run a shady errand -- and stumbles into a job interview with an eminent attorney forced to hire a protégé.

1.name: If you get a chance to cast the dice, just do it. Once you do it, you get at least one step forward.
1.overview: Park Myeong-hwan files a lawsuit against Choi Gang-seok. Go Yeon-u is assigned a pro bono sexual harassment and wrongful termination case.

1.name: There is always a dark side behind the mask of truth. And that is why...
1.overview: Yeon-u sets out to make things right on two fronts: the hostage situation he put Cheol-sun in, and the damage he caused to the sexual harassment case.

1.name: Just because the truth is coming out, it does not necessary mean that you will win.
1.overview: A divorce case reunites Gang-seok with an old flame. Blackmailed by Chae Geun-sik, Yeon-u must convince a hip-hop artist to become a Kang & Ham client.

1.name: To capture a hyena, carrion has to be used as bait.
1.overview: A class-action suit's defense lawyer challenges Gang-seok to a duel in court. In Kang & Ham's mock trial, Yeon-u is pitted against a three-time champ.

1.name: Is a sheath truly unnecessary for a knife called justice?
1.overview: Yeon-u suspects Gang-seok is hiding something from his past and investigates, and later helps an accountant accused of forging his academic credentials.

1.name: Justice is giving back everyone what they rightfully deserve.
1.overview: Gang-seok is torn between his loyalty toward his mentor and protecting himself. Yeon-u notices an oddity on Kang & Ham paystubs processed by Namyoung.

1.name: You can't go back in time and start over again, but you can still aim for a new ending starting from now.
1.overview: Gang-seok defends a man he wrongfully imprisoned as a public prosecutor. Painful memories surface when Yeon-u is assigned to a hit-and-run case.

1.name: You can prove your worth by showing the kind of risk you are willing to take.
1.overview: Gang-seok tries to prove his theory on who actually murdered Kim Min-ju. Yeon-u learns a detail that Park Jun-gyu failed to mention before.

1.name: If you wish to swallow a demon, you must swallow its horns too.
1.overview: Rumors of Ham Gi-taek's imminent return rattle Kang & Ham's staff. Yeon-u gets his first solo case: a young woman claiming her book idea was stolen.

1.name: If you have blind faith about your ideals, you'll be betrayed by the reality.
1.overview: Gang-seok tries to end a nurses strike at Haram Sanatorium, but when Gi-taek interferes, Yeon-u gets caught in the middle of their power struggle.

1.name: The moment you fly up with wings called lies, you will not be landing.
1.overview: A lawsuit against a car manufacturer over a fatal accident reunites Gang-seok with David Kim. Yeon-u introduces Kim Ji-na to his grandmother.

1.name: The best way to keep a secret is not telling it to anyone.
1.overview: When David Kim offers to settle out of court if Gang-seok is disbarred, Yeon-u gives Ha-yeon an idea to measure Gang-seok's chances of winning in court.

1.name: When you lose your destination, look back on the path that you've walked thus far.
1.overview: Kang & Ham's partners vote on whether to allow the case against Gang-seok to go to trial. But first, Yeon-u presents testimony he gathered from CEO Seo.

1.name: Life will not tell you where the destination is.
1.overview: When the truth comes out, Yeon-u takes responsibility for his actions. But he has one more card left to play in a bid to protect Gang-seok and the firm.

1.name: Episode 1
1.overview: Dismissed from the Faculty of Law and facing financial hardship, Adam Mansour accepts a job offer with his drug dealing friend, Marwan. When exposed to a dangerous situation, chance leads Adam to meet the famous lawyer Zein Thabet.

1.name: Episode 2
1.overview: Adam works on his first case with Zein at the El-Messiri Zeidan law firm. The case concerns Mai, an employee harassed in the workplace by her manager. During the case, a revelation leaves them facing a critical dilemma.

1.name: Episode 3
1.overview: Zein and Adam succeed in turning things around to their advantage and win the case. Later, Adam faces difficulties at work from within the office, especially from Qadri.

1.name: Episode 4
1.overview: While Adam is busy working with Zein on a case involving a young inventor, Qadri threatens Adam with the result of a counterfeit drug test, forcing Adam to work with him on his case.

1.name: Episode 5
1.overview: Zein tries to save a yacht manufacturer from an inevitable misfortune, so he challenges a new candidate to run the company; and while Adam supports Zein, Qadri tries to spoil his plans.

1.name: Episode 6
1.overview: Farida assigns Zein to a case involving Rifaat, her ex-husband, who faces a problem that could land him in prison. Adam feels that Qadri may know his secret and later, asks Laila to help him with one of the cases.

1.name: Episode 7
1.overview: Involved in a car accident, Zein and his driver face charges from the driver of the other vehicle for occupational damages. Later, Adam works on a case involving a woman who owns a fashion gallery.

1.name: Episode 8
1.overview: When Zein defends a stockbroking company whose employee has caused them to be held accountable, Adam sympathises with the employee. Later, Laila discovers Adam was sitting exams on behalf of other students at the Faculty of Law.

1.name: Episode9
1.overview: Adam participates in a mock trial at Masiri Zidan law firm to train new lawyers, and Zein confronts his ex-girlfriend, lawyer Ghada, during a deal. Later, when Adam asks Shireen to help him carry out the mock trial, Laila becomes jealous.

1.name: Episode 10
1.overview: A client falls in a meeting with Kadry inside the office, and for the first time Zain and Adam resort to uniting and cooperating with Kadry to win the case

1.name: Episode 11
1.overview: Amgad challenges Zain in a case, and Laila's falling into a crisis that leads to the end of her work in the office, and she thinks that's because of Adam

1.name: Episode 12
1.overview: Adam is assigned to search for a person who works in the accounting company that handles the office, and who does not have a university degree

1.name: Episode 13
1.overview: Zain hides a secret in his past, Adam tries to find out about his work as a former prosecutor and his resignation in mysterious circumstances.

1.name: Episode 14
1.overview: Zain decided to help the accused who was the reason for her imprisonment and prove her innocence.

1.name: Episode 15
1.overview: Farida reveals the secret of Adam and his failure to obtain a university degree, and gives an order to Zain to fire Adam immediately. Would he do that?

1.name: Episode 16
1.overview: Adam enters into a relationship with Laila and wants to tell her the truth about his secret, but Zain prevents him, which affects this relationship negatively.

1.name: Episode 17
1.overview: Adam evades confronting Laila, Zain challenges Sharif and warns him not to interfere in his cases, and Sharif poses a great threat to Farida's position.

1.name: Episode 18
1.overview: An old case appears that represents a danger to Zain, so he tries to solve it without Sharif's knowledge

1.name: Episode 19
1.overview: Zain and Farida get into a big predicament, especially with Sherif, because of the report in which Zain is accused of hiding it.

1.name: Episode 20
1.overview: Farida comes to Zain with a new assistant, And Zain wins a new case in a different way, also Adam discovers the one who betrayed them to Sharif and Farida.

1.name: Episode 21
1.overview: Amgad vows that he will win the case against Zain in court, and Zain asks Camelia to sacrifice herself and testify to the crime she did to protect him years ago

1.name: Episode 22
1.overview: Farida plans against Sharif with the help of Zain to take his position in the office

1.name: Episode 23
1.overview: Adam's grandmother goes to visit him in the company and meets Laila. Qadri conspires with Sharif and he becomes a partner in the company

1.name: Episode 24
1.overview: The company’s employees go to console Adam, and Sharif wins the vote in front of Farida and takes her position in the administration with the help of Qadri

1.name: Episode 25
1.overview: Zain goes to reconcile Adam at his house, and Adam returns with him to the office at night, and they find Qadri in Zain's office

1.name: Episode 26
1.overview: Zain takes on a new case which a lawyer is bargaining with him. Qadri tries to appoint a new lawyer, but Farida and Zain stand in front of this decision

1.name: Episode 27
1.overview: Sherihan and Sharif are trying to open a new office and they are trying to include Qadri and the lawyers of El-Mesiri office and even Zain himself

1.name: Episode 28
1.overview: Laila's father appears, and it turns out that he is a great lawyer and an opponent of Al-Masiri's office, so that Zain takes advantage of this.

1.name: Episode 29
1.overview: Ghada makes Zein and Farida an offer on a case, but the offer shocks Zein. As Adam and Laila work alongside Zein, Nahla's behaviour takes centre stage.

1.name: Episode 30
1.overview: Unhappy with the decision to make Noah part-owner, Zein goes up against Farida. Adam and Qadri offer Zein their full support, using all possible means to win.

1.name: The Alderman
1.overview: Jessica starts her new job in the mayor's office. It's a new world, and a whole new power struggle.

1.name: The Superintendent
1.overview: Jessica's reputation in the press puts the police contract in jeopardy.

1.name: The Union Leader
1.overview: Jessica goes head to head with McGann, who doesn't like her challenging his alderman appointee.

1.name: The Deputy Mayor
1.overview: With Bobby out, the Deputy Mayor pushes his own agenda. Jessica digs into a murder from North Park.

1.name: The Former City Attorney
1.overview: Keri's past comes back to haunt her. Yoli and Derrick give a CEO the Chicago tour.

1.name: The Donor
1.overview: Construction starts on North Park. Jessica finds new financial backers for Bobby's campaign.

1.name: The Immigration Lawyer
1.overview: Jessica tries to square a debt. Nick reels from McGann's bombshell. Yoli deals with personal news.

1.name: The Political Wife
1.overview: Keri goes on a trip with Stephanie. Angela helps her neighbors. Jessica deals with Yoli's problem.

1.name: The Rival
1.overview: Angela leads a tent city outside City Hall; Keri thinks about her future, and McGann finds Nick.

1.name: The Fixer
1.overview: Jessica is split between her personal and professional life. Keri comes to a decision about her future.

1.name: Episode 1
1.overview: Rob Schrab returns to Prime Time (teamed with MC Griffin) with the non-stop action/adventure show, Suits.

1.name: Episode 2
1.overview: In the second episode of The Suits, Amy gets a look at the team's headquarters.

1.name: Episode 3
1.overview: The Suits suit up for more.

1.name: Episode 4
1.overview: The final episode of The Suits.

1.name: I'm Not Going to Like Something Like Love
1.overview: Im Jin-ju and her two friends, Lee Eun-jeong and Hwang Han-ju, recount the events that knitted them together into a makeshift family.

1.name: If He's a Director, Shouldn't He Have a Girlfriend? The Thing is He Has No Luck^^
1.overview: A new man enters Han-ju's life, while a fried chicken emergency keeps her on high alert. Jin-ju takes an enlightening tour of JBC Station.

1.name: Are You on the Side of the Man I Like?
1.overview: Son Beom-su and Jin-ju strike an exciting deal, Eun-jeong starts a new gig, and Han-ju no longer has to hustle alone.

1.name: Are You Going to Transfer? What a Philanthropist!
1.overview: A booze-filled night causes Beom-su's and Jin-ju's lives to tangle, while a potential subject for a new documentary piques Eun-jeong's interest.

1.name: It's Not Going to Be Easy, But It's Going to Be a Lot of Fun. Good Luck to Us
1.overview: Jin-ju and her friends set off to party but settle on a great new restaurant instead. Beom-su prepares to convince JBC to pick up their new series.

1.name: You're Growing on Me. You're Growing on Me...
1.overview: In the face of a major crisis, Jin-ju reacts by sitting perfectly still while Han-ju confronts it head-on ... by giving them exactly what they want.

1.name: Can I Kiss You? Only Kiss!
1.overview: Every love story begins with a confession -- which, as it turns out, is hard to write. As Jin-ju overcomes her writer's block, Beom-su develops a crush.

1.name: I Don't Know How I Used to Be...
1.overview: Jin-ju and Beom-su debate a choice between two production companies. Han-ju and Chu Jae-hun's dinner is interrupted by an unwelcome visitor.

1.name: Why Are You Hesitating, Are You Excited, By Any Chance?
1.overview: Beom-su grows anxious as an eager young co-worker hijacks his production staff. Eun-jeong becomes increasingly aware of Hong-dae's absence.

1.name: Is Something Making You Jealous?
1.overview: Jin-ju's past and present come to light as gossip spreads rapidly among writers. A foulmouthed director tries Eun-jeong's patience.

1.name: There's Something I Need to Figure Out... My Heart That Likes the Writer
1.overview: Rumors create a rift in Beom-su and Jin-ju's relationship. Eun-jeong's brother, Lee Hyo-bong, advises her to seek treatment.

1.name: Love Is The Best Thing In The World
1.overview: Beom-su confesses his feelings, but it unwittingly turns into a heated debate. Eun-jeong's vision of Hong-dae takes a violent turn.

1.name: Why Are You Getting Out of There...?
1.overview: A mortifying incident puts a strain on one relationship but brings another closer together. Meanwhile, the production moves forward, although bumpily.

1.name: Do You Want Me to Hug You? It's Hard For You...
1.overview: Beom-su, Jin-ju, Han-ju and Jae-hun take a short trip to cool off. Eun-jeong heads to an orphanage, where she meets a fellow patron.

1.name: Today I Should Be a Little Disappointed
1.overview: When an accident moves up the production schedule by several months, Beom-su gets pulled into endless meetings, causing Jin-ju to grow upset.

1.name: Maintain This Temperature and Stay by My Side
1.overview: Jin-ju sits down to write satisfying endings for her characters. Likewise, her friends and family find closure and welcome new adventures.

1.name: Chapter One: The Vanishing of Will Byers
1.overview: On his way home from a friend's house, young Will sees something terrifying. Nearby, a sinister secret lurks in the depths of a government lab.

1.name: Chapter Two: The Weirdo on Maple Street
1.overview: Lucas, Mike and Dustin try to talk to the girl they found in the woods. Hopper questions an anxious Joyce about an unsettling phone call.

1.name: Chapter Three: Holly, Jolly
1.overview: An increasingly concerned Nancy looks for Barb and finds out what Jonathan's been up to. Joyce is convinced Will is trying to talk to her.

1.name: Chapter Four: The Body
1.overview: Refusing to believe Will is dead, Joyce tries to connect with her son. The boys give Eleven a makeover. Nancy and Jonathan form an unlikely alliance.

1.name: Chapter Five: The Flea and the Acrobat
1.overview: Hopper breaks into the lab while Nancy and Jonathan confront the force that took Will. The boys ask Mr. Clarke how to travel to another dimension.

1.name: Chapter Six: The Monster
1.overview: A frantic Jonathan looks for Nancy in the darkness, but Steve's looking for her, too. Hopper and Joyce uncover the truth about the lab's experiments.

1.name: Chapter Seven: The Bathtub
1.overview: Eleven struggles to reach Will, while Lucas warns that "the bad men are coming." Nancy and Jonathan show the police what Jonathan caught on camera.

1.name: Chapter Eight: The Upside Down
1.overview: Dr. Brenner holds Hopper and Joyce for questioning while the boys wait with Eleven in the gym. Back at Will's, Nancy and Jonathan prepare for battle.

1.name: Uno
1.overview: Jimmy works his magic in the courtroom. Unexpected inspiration leads him to an unconventional pursuit of potential clients.

1.name: Mijo
1.overview: As his troubles escalate to a boiling point, Jimmy finds himself in dire straits. An act of carelessness puts Chuck at risk.

1.name: Nacho
1.overview: Jimmy pulls out all the stops to prove that his dangerous client is innocent, even though it causes some friction with Kim.

1.name: Hero
1.overview: Jimmy devises a bold plan to obtain new clients, but must face consequences when his relationships become strained.

1.name: Alpine Shepherd Boy
1.overview: Alarming news disrupts Jimmy's efforts at drumming up new business, forcing him to make a difficult choice.

1.name: Five-O
1.overview: Mike's tragic past comes back to haunt him, and he's forced to seek help from an unusual source. Jimmy's moral compass is put to the test.

1.name: Bingo
1.overview: Jimmy meets with potential new clients. Then, when given the opportunity to do the right thing, he cashes in a favor from an unlikely ally.

1.name: RICO
1.overview: Jimmy shows Chuck that he's willing to do almost anything to win a case, even if it means getting his hands dirty.

1.name: Pimento
1.overview: Chuck urges Jimmy to accept a harsh truth. Meanwhile, a deal threatens to go off the rails when Mike's ability to complete a job is called into question.

1.name: Marco
1.overview: In the aftermath of recent events, Jimmy seizes an opportunity to reconnect with an old friend. Chuck adjusts to a new way of life.

1.name: Daybreak
1.overview: The Dutton family, owners of the largest ranch in Montana, fight ruthlessly to keep their land from the neighboring Indian reservation and the new chief seeking to reclaim it.

1.name: Kill the Messenger
1.overview: As the dust settles from the shootout, the Duttons deal with the potential repercussions. John calls in a favor and collects on some old debts. Jamie meets with the governor to do damage control.

1.name: No Good Horses
1.overview: The Duttons deal with a painful family anniversary. Kayce saves a young girl from danger. Jamie and Beth plan their respective political careers. Rainwater makes an ominous threat to the Dutton legacy.

1.name: The Long Black Train
1.overview: A secret about John comes to the surface. Beth shows Jenkins a rough night out. Quality time with Tate leads to a close call.

1.name: Coming Home
1.overview: As Kayce feels the heat from tribal police, Jamie works some legal magic. Rip recruits a new cowboy for the ranch, and a beaten-down Jimmy begins to find some respect. John makes a play to keep Kayce and Monica close to home.

1.name: The Remembering
1.overview: John reveals a family secret to Monica, Jamie ramps up his political career, Beth pushes John too far, Kayce and Rip butt heads, and a new partnership threatens Yellowstone.

1.name: A Monster Is Among Us
1.overview: Rip stumbles upon a dangerous and dire situation. A plan is set in motion designed to squeeze John Dutton and threaten his way of life. Monica begins a tough recovery.

1.name: The Unravelling (1)
1.overview: A Sheriff’s investigation turns the heat up on Rip. Jamie makes a bold decision about his future and faces the consequences. With the walls closing in, John discovers which family and allies will stand with him and fight.

1.name: The Unravelling (2)
1.overview: John discovers his true alliances, Rip searches for answers, Jamie's political career is threatened, Beth takes on a new role, and Kayce returns home.

1.name: Pilot
1.overview: A locally born SWAT sergeant, former Marine Daniel “Hondo” Harrelson, is newly tasked to run a specialized tactical unit that is the last stop in law enforcement in Los Angeles.

1.name: Cuchillo
1.overview: Hondo and the SWAT team spread out across Los Angeles in pursuit of four escaped convicts, including a violent criminal Jessica helped bring to justice, before department rival Mumford and his team beat them to the collars. Also, Hondo’s new role as team leader is called into question when Street displays a flagrant disregard for SWAT protocol.

1.name: Pamilya
1.overview: Newcomer Jim Street jeopardizes his spot on Hondo's team when he agrees to do a favor for his incarcerated mother that endangers his SWAT career. Also, the SWAT team searches for the ruthless mastermind behind a drug trafficking ring that forces immigrants to be mules. [also shown as S1:E4]

1.name: Radical
1.overview: After a domestic bomber dies in a Highland Park explosion, the SWAT team races to find the man's partner before more devices detonate. Also, Hondo reaches out to Buck, his former team leader, when he worries he is isolating himself after his recent firing. [also shown as S1:E3]

1.name: Imposters
1.overview: When a series of home invasions are committed by SWAT imposters in an upscale neighborhood, Hondo and the team suspect the burglarized families are all hiding something. Also, when Deacon and Luca are assigned to protect a visiting professional hockey player who is receiving death threats, his penchant for trouble becomes a complication. [also shown as S1:E6]

1.name: Octane
1.overview: Hondo puts aside his misgivings about Jim Street's recklessness and allows the newbie to go undercover as a broker in a luxury car theft ring to bust a ruthless trafficker. Also, Hondo visits Raymont Harris, the teenager recently shot by a former member of the SWAT team, who is dealing with PTSD. [also shown as S1:E5]

1.name: Homecoming
1.overview: When Hondo’s imprisoned childhood friend asks him to protect his son from gang violence, the favor brings SWAT into contact with a new local crime outfit. Also, when Luca’s grandfather, a SWAT legend, passes away, he struggles with his grief and a painful family secret.

1.name: Miracle
1.overview: Hondo and the SWAT team are forced to work over their Christmas vacation when a drug cartel is out for blood after their cache of gold bars is stolen. Also, Jessica draws the attention of Michael Plank, president of the Police Commission, when she approaches him with her ideas on how to improve the SWAT division.

1.name: Blindspots
1.overview: When a misconduct complaint filed against Hondo gets him taken off active duty, Deacon steps up to lead the team in finding a robbery crew that is hitting marijuana dispensaries. Also, when Tan notices a similarity between the current robberies and a case from his time with Hollywood LAPD, he asks for help from an informant with whom he has a complicated history.

1.name: Seizure
1.overview: As the SWAT team goes inside a prison riot to rescue civilian hostages, Hondo suspects the inmates have an ulterior motive behind the uprising. Also, when Deacon’s wife, Annie, stops by headquarters to celebrate Deacon’s 10th anniversary with the SWAT division, her visit takes an unexpected turn.

1.name: K-Town
1.overview: Hondo teams up with an old DEA friend, Special Agent Katrina “K.C.” Walsh, on a task force aimed at unmasking the secret leader of a fentanyl drug smuggling ring. Also, Jessica and Michael Plank, president of the Police Commission, begin implementing her new law enforcement community initiatives.

1.name: Contamination
1.overview: Hondo and the SWAT team join forces with the FBI on a manhunt to find members of a militia group planning a domestic terror attack by weaponizing cyanide. Also, as Jessica’s new police initiatives with Michael Plank, president of the police commission, move forward, she braces herself for the negative impact the plans could have on her relationships within the department.

1.name: Fences
1.overview: Hondo and Jessica’s secret relationship comes to a crossroads when Michael Plank, the president of the police commission, discovers their affair. Also, when Hondo and the team assist with the federal investigation to bring in an undocumented fugitive, they find themselves at the center of a citywide immigration debate.

1.name: Ghosts
1.overview: Hondo and the team go on the hunt for a serial killer who escaped justice two years prior by faking his death. Also, Hondo worries that Buck Spivey, the team’s former leader, is spiraling into depression in the aftermath of being fired from the department.

1.name: Crews
1.overview: The job becomes personal for Hondo when his criminal informant friend is killed while seeking information about a robbery crew that a joint SWAT and FBI task force is trying to capture. Also, when the FBI task force leader acts erratically, Jessica worries the woman’s behavior will endanger the team in the field.

1.name: Payback
1.overview: When a young heiress, Juliette Carlton, is kidnapped for ransom, Hondo and the SWAT team go on a citywide search to bring her home before she is harmed. Also, the team worries that Mumford is moving too fast when he announces he’s getting married for the fourth time.

1.name: Armory
1.overview: As Hondo and SWAT work to de-escalate a hostage situation in which an ex-convict is holding a local family captive, the mission takes a dangerous turn that impacts the team. Also, when Street tires of his complicated romantic entanglements, he agrees to let Chris make over his online dating profile.

1.name: Patrol
1.overview: Hondo confronts his long-held resentment towards his ailing father, Daniel Harrelson, Sr., when he and his sister, Briana, try to convince their dad he’s no longer well enough to live alone. Also, when the SWAT team works as patrol officers for a day, Chris is partnered with Mumford, who intends to make her a surprising offer.

1.name: Source
1.overview: Jim Street debates whether or not his mother, Karen, should live with him upon her prison release after Hondo and Chris warn him against it. Also, Hondo and the team are assigned to protect Irina Zemanova, a high-profile Russian journalist visiting Los Angeles, from being assassinated.

1.name: Vendetta
1.overview: Hondo’s life and career are endangered when his bosses and his godson’s kidnapper, Jae Kim, discover he’s been secretly surveilling Kim with the help of retired DEA agent Katrina Walsh. Also, Street and his newly paroled mother, Karen, both have trouble acclimating to her prison release.

1.name: Hunted
1.overview: Hondo and Deacon must apply all their SWAT training and skills to evade a gang of armed mercenaries hunting them in the Angeles Mountains following an ambush. Also, Chris oversteps in an attempt to help a female SWAT trainee she suspects isn’t being evaluated fairly.

1.name: Hoax
1.overview: A fake 911 call puts Hondo and the SWAT team on the hunt to stop a white supremacy group from executing bombing attacks on local communities. Also, Street’s relationship with his recently paroled mother, Karen, jeopardizes his career, and Jessica is thrown a curveball by her colleague, Michael Plank, president of the police commission. Hondo’s father, returns Daniel Harrelson, Sr. 1st.

1.name: Sacrificial Soldiers
1.overview: Things go awry for Joe and her team during a mission out in the field. Joe is left devastated. Upon her return home, Joe's family life presents it's own challenges. Cruz tries to escape a dangerous situation. Joe must choose an agent.

1.name: The Beating
1.overview: Joe continues her training with Cruz whose methods are questionable. Cruz starts to build a relationship with Aaliyah. Kate gets into a fight during her soccer game. Neal has to deliver difficult news to a patient.

1.name: Bruise Like a Fist
1.overview: Cruz is invited to spend the weekend with Aaliyah and her inner-circle. Joe keeps Kaitlyn informed of Cruz's progress. Kyle comes to Joe desperate for help with an asset.

1.name: The Choice of Failure
1.overview: Cruz is put in a compromising position while out with Aaliyah and friends in the Hamptons, causing Joe and Kaitlyn to doubt her. Kaitlyn and Westfield confront Kyle over what happened at the border, complicating things further for Joe and her team.

1.name: Truth Is the Shrewdest Lie
1.overview: Joe and Neal deal with the aftermath of Kate's accident. Westfield and Kaitlyn deploy Joe's team to subdue a terrorist threat. Cruz's cover may be in jeopardy.

1.name: The Lie Is the Truth
1.overview: Aaliyah bonds with Cruz over a spa day. Bobby, Tex, Two Cups, Randy and Tucker confront a threat at the Safe House. Kaitlyn and Joe are scolded for the San Antonio mission in a debrief.

1.name: Wish the Fight Away
1.overview: While shopping in Manhattan for the wedding, Aaliyah and Cruz get closer. Kate returns home only to say goodbye to her mom once again. Joe guides Cruz through internal struggle and doubt in completing the mission.

1.name: Gone Is the Illusion of Order
1.overview: Unforeseen circumstances leaves the mission in jeopardy. A suspicious Ehsan confronts Cruz before his wedding day. Joe and the team prepare for the worst.

1.name: Pilot
1.overview: 9-year-old Sheldon Cooper is a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science but learns that isn’t always helpful growing up in East Texas, a land where church and football are king.

1.name: Rockets, Communists, and the Dewey Decimal System
1.overview: To appease his worried mother, Sheldon employs the techniques of a self-help book to try and make a friend.

1.name: Poker, Faith, and Eggs
1.overview: When George Sr. is rushed to the emergency room, Connie comes to babysit, and the kids have an adventure getting to the hospital on their own.

1.name: A Therapist, a Comic Book, and a Breakfast Sausage
1.overview: After choking on a breakfast sausage, Sheldon wrestles with his fear of solid foods and discovers comic books for the first time.

1.name: A Solar Calculator, a Game Ball, and a Cheerleader's Bosom
1.overview: Sheldon struggles with newfound popularity after utilizing statistics to help the football team.

1.name: A Patch, a Modem, and a Zantac
1.overview: When a NASA representative visits Sheldon’s school and dismisses his science, Sheldon is set on a mission to prove him wrong.

1.name: A Brisket, Voodoo, and Cannonball Run
1.overview: The kids brainstorm ways to resolve a family feud when Connie refuses to give George Sr. her brisket recipe.

1.name: Cape Canaveral, Schrödinger's Cat, and Cyndi Lauper's Hair
1.overview: While Mary, Connie and Missy have their girls night at the salon, the three Cooper men plan their road trip to see the space launcher, but it doesn't go as well as they plan.

1.name: Spock, Kirk, and Testicular Hernia
1.overview: George Sr. strikes a deal with Sheldon to tutor Georgie when poor grades threaten to keep him from playing football. While Sheldon's tutoring attempts are ultimately unsuccessful, he does learn some skills from his brother.

1.name: An Eagle Feather, a String Bean, and an Eskimo
1.overview: When Sheldon moves to Dallas to attend a school for gifted children, the family struggles to cope with his absence.

1.name: Demons, Sunday School, and Prime Numbers
1.overview: A worried Mary sends Sheldon to Sunday school after she finds him playing Dungeons and Dragons with his friends, Tam and Billy.

1.name: A Computer, a Plastic Pony, and a Case of Beer
1.overview: Sheldon asks for a computer and unknowingly sparks a heated argument between Mary and George Sr. over the family’s finances.

1.name: A Sneeze, Detention, and Sissy Spacek
1.overview: When flu season hits Medford, Sheldon takes extreme measures to remain healthy.

1.name: Potato Salad, a Broomstick, and Dad's Whiskey
1.overview: When Mary takes a job as church secretary, she finds herself becoming Pastor Jeff's marriage counselor. Also, Sheldon and Missy spend their first afternoon home alone.

1.name: Dolomite, Apple Slices, and a Mystery Woman
1.overview: Sheldon makes friends with an upperclassman who introduces him to a new field of science. Also, Mary and George disagree on how to handle Sheldon's blossoming social life.

1.name: Killer Asteroids, Oklahoma, and a Frizzy Hair Machine
1.overview: A disappointing loss at the science fair sends Sheldon’s life in a new direction.

1.name: Jiu-Jitsu, Bubble Wrap, and Yoo-hoo
1.overview: Sheldon is bullied by an unlikely character, and Mary and George disagree on how to handle the situation.

1.name: A Mother, A Child, and a Blue Man's Backside
1.overview: Mary bans Sheldon from reading a mature comic book. Sheldon decides it's time to stop living under Mary's thumb.

1.name: Gluons, Guacamole, and the Color Purple
1.overview: When Sheldon is no longer academically challenged at Medford High, he audits a college class taught by Dr. John Sturgis.

1.name: A Dog, a Squirrel, and a Fish Named Fish
1.overview: A battle erupts between the Coopers and Sparks when the Sparks' new dog terrorizes Sheldon.

1.name: Summer Sausage, a Pocket Poncho, and Tony Danza
1.overview: While Sheldon is busy keeping tabs on Connie’s budding relationship with Dr. Sturgis, George Sr. and Mary attempt to bond with their other children.

1.name: Vanilla Ice Cream, Gentleman Callers, and a Dinette Set
1.overview: When Connie is pursued by two gentlemen callers, Sheldon interferes, forcing her to set some ground rules.

1.name: I Have Called You by Name
1.overview: Two brothers struggle with their tax debts to Rome while a woman in the Red Quarter wrestles with her demons.

1.name: Shabbat
1.overview: Matthew validates Simon's claims with Praetor Quintus, Nicodemus investigates the miracle reported in the Red Quarter, and Mary receives surprise guests at her Shabbat dinner.

1.name: Jesus Loves the Little Children
1.overview: Jesus befriends and teaches the group of children who discover His camp on the outskirts of Capernaum.

1.name: The Rock on Which it is Built
1.overview: With his life and family under threat from Rome, Simon spends one last night fishing in a desperate attempt to square his debts. Andrew spots a familiar face waiting for them on the shores of Galilee.

1.name: The Wedding Gift
1.overview: Nicodemus interrogates John the Baptizer while Jesus and his students make their way to a wedding celebration in Cana. When the wine runs low, Mary asks her son to intervene on behalf of the bridegroom's family.

1.name: Indescribable Compassion
1.overview: After witnessing the healing of a leper on the road to Capernaum, a woman brings her paralytic friend through the crowd to meet Jesus.

1.name: Invitations
1.overview: Matthew struggles to reconcile the miracles he has witnessed with reality. Nicodemus meets with Jesus by night.

1.name: I Am He
1.overview: Jesus and His students complete their preparations and leave Capernaum for Samaria. Jesus meets with a suffering woman at Jacob's Well and announces that He is the Messiah.

1.name: Pilot
1.overview: A charming first encounter quickly turns into something more nefarious when bookstore manager Joe takes a very strong liking to grad student Beck.

1.name: The Last Nice Guy in New York
1.overview: As Beck deals with unwanted advances from her advisor, she brings Joe to Peach's high society soiree. Joe tries to navigate matters with Benji.

1.name: Maybe
1.overview: Beck's continued casual encounters catch Joe off guard, as does a run-in with the police. Both make him realize a key situation must be dealt with.

1.name: The Captain
1.overview: After an awkward evening with Beck, Joe discovers he's not the only one keeping secrets. Peach's antagonistic approach to Joe intensifies.

1.name: Living with the Enemy
1.overview: A video from Annika's past comes back to haunt her. Joe and Peach's simmering tension boils over when Peach introduces Beck to a major literary agent.

1.name: Amour Fou
1.overview: Beck heads to Connecticut with Peach, whose motives are not what they seem. Joe's pursuit of her stirs up old memories – and brings new injuries.

1.name: Everythingship
1.overview: A grieving Beck turns to therapy, which leads Joe to do the same – for different reasons. Joe's plans for Beck's birthday don't go as expected.

1.name: You Got Me, Babe
1.overview: Three months later, life is good for Joe and Beck, respectively. But a series of reconnections may spell trouble for Joe's current relationship.

1.name: Candace
1.overview: So, what exactly happened to Candace? Beck is determined to find out – but to do so, she'll have to take a page straight from Joe's book.

1.name: Bluebeard's Castle
1.overview: Joe juggles problems with Paco and Beck – and now must contend with a private investigator as well. But resolution is coming, one way or another.

1.name: IT'S ABOUT TIME
1.overview: When Mark Grayson finally inherits powers from his superhero father, it’s a dream come true. But there’s more to being a hero than just choosing a name and costume.

1.name: HERE GOES NOTHING
1.overview: With his father out of action, Mark struggles to defend the city against an interdimensional invasion, joining forces with a team of teenage superheroes.

1.name: WHO YOU CALLING UGLY?
1.overview: Mark has to cut a study date short to help save Mount Rushmore from a crazed scientist. Robot deals with Action - Comic as he assembles a new team of world-saving superheroes.

1.name: NEIL ARMSTRONG, EAT YOUR HEART OUT
1.overview: It's two firsts for Mark: a first date and a first trip to another planet. At the same time, Nolan and Debbie revisit their own first vacation together.

1.name: THAT ACTUALLY HURT
1.overview: Feeling confident in his new abilities, Mark risks a team-up with a local villain to take down a crime lord, while simultaneously juggling school and a new relationship.

1.name: YOU LOOK KINDA DEAD
1.overview: Mark joins William and Amber on a campus visit to Upstate University, hoping to discover a new future for himself. Debbie makes her own disturbing discovery.

1.name: WE NEED TO TALK
1.overview: Feeling lost and confused, Mark looks for advice from Eve. At the same time, everyone's looking for him.

1.name: WHERE I REALLY COME FROM
1.overview: Mark must prove he's become the hero he's always wanted to be by stopping an unstoppable force.

1.name: Aang
1.overview: An Airbender comes to grips with his new reality as war erupts. A century later, a pair of Water Tribe siblings make a discovery that changes everything.

1.name: Warriors
1.overview: Aang, Katara and Sokka arrive at a small Island, home to elite warriors named after Avatar Kyoshi. The Fire Nation gets wind of the Avatar's whereabouts.

1.name: Omashu
1.overview: News of a traitor puts the trio at odds in Omashu, where a mechanist and rebels with a charming leader muddle their plans to protect the Earth Kingdom.

1.name: Into the Dark
1.overview: In captivity, Aang meets a king with a taste for games. To find their friend, the siblings must navigate a dark tunnel — and put their differences aside.

1.name: Spirited Away
1.overview: When the group lands in the Spirit World for a rescue mission, they come face to face with dangerous threats, painful memories and a mysterious entity.

1.name: Masks
1.overview: A desperate Aang visits Avatar Roku for help on his journey as the Fire Nation closes in on him. At their fortress, a masked intruder breaks Aang out.

1.name: The North
1.overview: As an attack on the Northern Water Tribe looms, Katara challenges a master Waterbender, Sokka meets a princess, and Aang takes Kuruk's words to heart.

1.name: Legends
1.overview: Zhao leads the Fire Nation into the North with a bold plan to weaken the Water Tribe. When the battle takes a dark turn, Aang enters a powerful state.

1.name: Buried Alive
1.overview: As rescuers race to save 33 trapped miners in northern Chile, an extraordinary discovery transforms a desperate search into a hopeful mission.

1.name: No Way Out
1.overview: Contact with the miners sparks fresh hope, and supplies make their way underground. But just as rescue seems within reach, disaster strikes again.

1.name: Rescue
1.overview: As the miners enter their second month underground, rescuers face the challenge of bringing them back alive amidst overwhelming obstacles.

1.name: Pilot
1.overview: After a fatal shooting, Green Lantern Hal Jordan and new recruit John Stewart set out to prove it was an extraterrestrial event.

1.name: Trust Fall
1.overview: While John's middling errand ultimately proves eventful, Hal makes waves in Rushville – which only inspires him to dig deeper.

1.name: OutKast
1.overview: When his dad misunderstands a contact attempt from the Guardians, John is put forth as the next best option to fulfill the Green Lantern destiny. Then, after a lifetime of preparation, John finally gets his chance to interview for the Guardians.

1.name: The Weenie
1.overview: As the 48-hour deadline nears, John develops a new theory about the Manhunter's location, leading him and Hal to run their next move by Sheriff Kane. Meanwhile, Hal's visit to Sinestro has consequences.

1.name: Lights Out
1.overview: As the Macon family's history unravels, Rushville mobilizes in the face of the escalating threat. As John is placed in an impossible position, Hal risks everything in a final attempt to take down the Manhunter.

1.name: Bad Optics
1.overview: Now in business with his brother Marcus, John is on the verge of landing a major investor for his innovative take on panic rooms when an unexpected phone call pulls him back to Rushville - and everything he worked so hard to leave behind.

1.name: The Jordan Boys' Legacy
1.overview: Finding themselves on another planet, Hal and John must put aside their fractured past to solve a murder. Along their journey, both men are forced to confront the ghosts of their pasts...and the ways their childhoods shaped who they are today.

1.name: Dirt and Stars
1.overview: As John and Hal draw closer to the truth, John comes to an unexpected understanding with Sheriff Kane... just as a chilling new discovery emerges.

1.name: The Pickup
1.overview: Police officer Bhumi goes undercover as a prostitute to bust a drug cartel leader, but when the operation goes awry, she makes an unexpected discovery.

1.name: The Proposal
1.overview: A visit from Bhumi’s estranged husband angers her rebellious sister. Sasya agrees to cooperate in a police interrogation — on one condition.

1.name: The Pawn's Move
1.overview: The team doubts Bhumi’s mettle after Sasya manages to rattle her. Fernandez pushes to keep her as an undercover agent in a plan to nab Sasya’s boss.

1.name: Night Walk
1.overview: After going to dangerous lengths to prove herself, Bhumi is recruited into Fernandez’s department, and begins to prepare for her risky new role.

1.name: It's Time
1.overview: Newly emboldened, Bhumi seduces an unlikely target. Ahead of Nayak’s arrival in Mumbai, Sasya attempts to gain police trust as an informant.

1.name: The Promise
1.overview: With Nayak now in Mumbai, Bhumi is moved to a hotel under police surveillance, but her first encounter with the kingpin takes the team by surprise.

1.name: Devil's Share
1.overview: In the wake of an unexpected complication, Fernandez doubts Sasya’s loyalty. Caught off guard by a suspicious Nayak, Bhumi drops her own bombshell.

1.name: Taqdeer, Tadbeer, Tarkeeb!
1.overview: Brij Bhatti is a cotton exchange worker drowning in debt with a pregnant wife and a directionless brother. With ruthless loan sharks at his door and hope as the only currency, Brij faces a life-changing choice: accept his crushing fate or revolutionise the gambling system, a move with ripple effects unknown to Brij himself.

1.name: Umeed Ka Karkhana
1.overview: Integrity is tested when Matka brings Brij both fortune and a target on his back. With a newborn as his lucky charm, Brij reinvents the game, spreading Matka through Bombay's bustling textile mills. While a journalist begins to investigate the rise of Matka, the enigmatic Gulrukh is drawn to the game's allure. Laljibhai orchestrates a plan to dismantle the rising empire, nearly succeeding.

1.name: Izzat Half, Sangam Full
1.overview: Brij enters Mumbai's elite world through Gulrukh's circles but struggles to find his place among the city's old money. As Matka explodes nationwide, reporter T.P. rallies officials against the "Matka King," while Inspector Eknath begins clandestine surveillance. With Minister Bapat plotting a state-level intervention, greed and ambition begin to corrupt Brij's empire from within.

1.name: Tera Pyaar Triple Paana, Mera Pyaar Kabootar Daana
1.overview: Survival requires innovation as the government launches a rival scheme to dismantle Brij's influence. Forced to think outside the box, Brij expands his reach across India, but success demands a heavy sacrifice. Trust fractures within the inner circle, and an enemy strikes where it hurts most when unbridled greed determines to ruin everything.

1.name: Safed Kapde, Kaale Dil
1.overview: Brij adopts a stark new public persona, turning appearance into strategy. While new alliances form, old foundations reveal deep cracks. The game's toll on his home life forces Brij into taking a heartbreaking decision. As Minister Bapat attempts to corner him, Brij proves he is at his most dangerous when his back is against the wall.

1.name: Lights, Camera, Jodi
1.overview: As media attention reaches a fever pitch, Barkha feels the heavy weight of her husband's notoriety. Amidst grand celebrations, Dagdu suffers a profound personal loss, and Gulrukh seeks independence for her own business. Inspector Eknath begins to question his faith in the system as Matka spills into the homes, careers, and consciences of every citizen in Bombay.

1.name: Do Ikke, Ek Gulaam
1.overview: A wedding celebration leaves Brij's world more fractured than ever. Lacchu pursues dangerous new alliances with outside forces, attempting to pull Brij into a darker game. As the pillars of the Matka world begin to crumble and the inner circle splinters, Brij stands his ground even as the true cost of ambition surfaces in unexpected, violent ways.

1.name: Open aur Close
1.overview: As mill workers go on an indefinite strike, Brij is faced with a decision that will affect the city and the country. Lacchu joins Darab's war for power, while Dagdu's fight for Sulabha fractures the circle. Barkha reclaims her identity, and TP weighs the effect of Matka's involvement in the whole system. As everything that was built stands unprotected, the Matka King must play one last hand.

1.name: Freedom Day
1.overview: Sheriff Becker's plans for the future are thrown off course after his wife meets a hacker with information about the silo.

1.name: Holston's Pick
1.overview: Juliette, an engineer, pieces together what might have led to a co-worker's mysterious death.

1.name: Machines
1.overview: In her hunt for a new sheriff, Mayor Jahns clashes with Bernard. Juliette strikes a deal to keep the generator running.

1.name: Truth
1.overview: Juliette tries gaining the trust of Deputy Marnes as they work to uncover the truth about recent tragedies.

1.name: The Janitor's Boy
1.overview: Sims appoints Billings as chief deputy to keep tabs on Juliette, whose efforts to solve two murders lead to a showdown.

1.name: The Relic
1.overview: During her investigation, Juliette uncovers disturbing secrets about someone she thought she knew.

1.name: The Flamekeepers
1.overview: Bernard seeks Juliette's cooperation as he grows increasingly concerned about the silo's security. Juliette asks her father for a favor.

1.name: Hanna
1.overview: New information causes Juliette to see her family's past differently—and she finally gains access to the silo's biggest secrets.

1.name: The Getaway
1.overview: Racked with guilt, Billings sets off on a personal mission, only to discover a mind-blowing clue from Juliette.

1.name: Outside
1.overview: Juliette's fate seems sealed when certain truths finally come to light.

1.name: Pilot
1.overview: As their paths cross and their life stories intertwine in curious ways, we find that several of them share the same birthday and so much more than anyone would expect.

1.name: The Big Three
1.overview: Toby helps Kate relax in the midst of her fervent quest to lose weight. Beth questions the motives of Randall's biological father, as Randall adjusts to having his dad in his life. Rebecca and Jack begin to feel distant from one another. Kevin faces the consequences of quitting his job.

1.name: Kyle
1.overview: Rebecca makes a surprise visit to Randall's home where she encounters his biological father, William. Kevin anxiously decides to take the plunge and move to New York to pursue a Broadway job, with the expectation that his sister, Kate, will move with him. Toby is determined to get Kate out of Kevin's shadow. Jack and Rebecca take home their babies from the hospital and adjust to the new life of parenthood, while coping with the loss of their other child. Rebecca struggles to connect with their a

1.name: The Pool
1.overview: Rebecca and Jack take Kevin, Kate, and Randall to the community pool on a hot day and quickly realize each child is going through their own struggles. Kevin auditions for his first Broadway play in New York and meets a determined actress who is less than impressed by him. Toby runs into his ex-wife while at a restaurant with Kate, which sends Kate into a spiral of self-doubt. William is mistakenly reported as a loiterer in Randall's predominately white neighborhood, which exposes deep-rooted iss

1.name: The Game Plan
1.overview: Rebecca and Jack get into an argument about starting a family. The family backstory behind the long line of love for the Pittsburgh Steelers is revealed. After accepting his part in the play, Kevin realizes his script is relevant to his own life. Randall and Beth encounter an unexpected turn of events.

1.name: Career Days
1.overview: Kate interviews for a new job that seems just about perfect, although it comes with a catch. Randall doubts his career choice and wonders if he followed the right path.
