1.overview: Under Lady Trieu's care, Angela undergoes an unconventional treatment while Agent Blake chases down a lead. Elsewhere, The Smartest Man in The World delivers a stunning defense of his past actions.

1.name: A God Walks into Abar
1.overview: Angela's mysterious past in Vietnam is at last revealed.

1.name: See How They Fly
1.overview: Everything ends. For real this time.

1.name: Pilot
1.overview: Superman and Lois' return to idyllic Smallville is set to be upended by mysterious strangers.

1.name: Heritage
1.overview: While adjusting to their new lives in Smallville, Lois and Clark make an important decision concerning one of their sons. Meanwhile, tensions begin to rise between Lois and Morgan Edge. Lastly, Lana Lang Cushing invites the Kent family over for a barbecue.

1.name: The Perks of Not Being a Wallflower
1.overview: Clark shares some of his Kryptonian history with Jordan and Jonathan during a family breakfast. Meanwhile, Lois and Chrissy dig deeper to uncover the truth about Morgan Edge.

1.name: Haywire
1.overview: While sitting in the stands at the high school football game, Lois and Chrissy spot fish out of water Morgan Edge conversing with Mayor Dean and Kyle Kushing, and the two see right through this insincere move to try to win over the town. Meanwhile, Clark agrees to help Lois out at a town hall meeting, but things get tense when he finds himself pulled in two different directions. Lastly, Jonathan is having mixed emotions about Jordan's newfound status.

1.name: The Best of Smallville
1.overview: As Smallville celebrates its first Harvest Festival since Martha’s passing, Clark is reminded what his mother meant to him and learns a lesson that will help him move past her death. Meanwhile, Lois makes a breakthrough in the investigation of Morgan Edge. Lastly, Kyle tries to reconnect with Lana, but it seems like he might be falling back into his old ways.

1.name: Broken Trust
1.overview: Clark reconsiders his decision to let Jordan play football. Meanwhile, Lois' continued investigation of Morgan Edge requires her to trust an unexpected ally.

1.name: Man of Steel
1.overview: Clark struggles to help Jordan who is grappling with a new power. Meanwhile, Lois enlists Clark's help which leads to a surprise encounter.

1.name: Holding the Wrench
1.overview: Clark encourages Lois to reach out for help after noticing her reaching a breaking point. Meanwhile, Jonathan finds himself in a dangerous situation. Lastly, Kyle encourages Sarah to audition for the musical revue at school.

1.name: Loyal Subjekts
1.overview: Chrissy and Clark team up to piece together the significance of Smallville to Morgan Edge.

1.name: O Mother, Where Art Thou?
1.overview: Lana reaches out to Lois and Clark when Kyle starts behaving strangely. Meanwhile, Jonathan opens up to Jordan. Lastly, Sarah storms out after accusing her mom of always covering for her dad.

1.name: A Brief Reminiscence In-Between Cataclysmic Events
1.overview: Clark makes a startling discovery about Morgan Edge.

1.name: Through the Valley of Death
1.overview: Lois and John Henry Irons can't seem to agree on the best way to stop Morgan Edge. Meanwhile, Jonathan encourages Jordan to focus on strengthening his powers to help locate their dad. Lastly, an old friend is brought in to help with the search.

1.name: Fail Safe
1.overview: Superman pays a visit to Morgan Edge. Meanwhile, Lois and Chrissy work together on a story. Lastly, Jonathan finds a welcome distraction during a very stressful school day.

1.name: The Eradicator
1.overview: Lois is worried about Jordan as he and Sarah continue to grow closer. Meanwhile, Clark pays Lana a visit. Lastly, Jonathan has been spending more and more time with John Henry.

1.name: Last Sons of Krypton
1.overview: Superman's worst nightmare comes to life and Lois confronts Leslie Larr. Meanwhile, Lana, Kyle and Sarah agree to stay to help General Lane.

1.name: Sleep of the Just
1.overview: While searching for an escaped nightmare in the waking world, Morpheus falls prey to Roderick Burgess, an occultist looking to summon and imprison Death.

1.name: Imperfect Hosts
1.overview: Morpheus begins his quest to find his tools of power — his sand, ruby and helm — by paying a visit to a pair of notoriously dysfunctional brothers.

1.name: Dream a Little Dream of Me
1.overview: Morpheus tracks down the last-known person in possession of his sand — and receives an unexpected lesson on humanity. Ethel pays a visit to her son.

1.name: A Hope in Hell
1.overview: A lead on the whereabouts of his helm compels Morpheus to seek an audience with Lucifer. A confused John receives a helping hand from a good Samaritan.
With Morpheus caught off guard, John settles in at a diner to watch the people around him — and put his theory about truth and lies to a terrifying test.

1.name: The Sound of Her Wings
1.overview: Feeling a bit rudderless, Morpheus shadows his hard-working big sister, who offers him advice and encourages him to reconnect with an old acquaintance.

1.name: The Doll's House
1.overview: Lucienne comes to Morpheus with disturbing news. Rose Walker goes in search of family. Admirers of the Corinthian's work scheme to get his attention.

1.name: Playing House
1.overview: As Morpheus closes in on one of his missing creations, Rose ramps up efforts to locate her brother — and unwittingly makes a friend's dream come true.

1.name: Collectors
1.overview: Odd disturbances shake up The Dreaming, Rose sets out on a road trip with a new friend, and The Corinthian arrives with a guest at a creepy convention.

1.name: Lost Hearts
1.overview: As the Dream vortex grows more powerful and the walls between the realms weaken, Rose must make a difficult choice. Morpheus confronts The Corinthian.

1.name: Dream of a Thousand Cats/Calliope
1.overview: In this two-part story collection, a Siamese cat dreaming of a new world and a writer in desperate need of inspiration cross paths with Morpheus.

1.name: The Day Before
1.overview: On the eve of the worst crisis in human history, Congresswoman Jennifer Brown clashes with the President. Her children Yorick and Hero reach an emotional crossroads. None of them know their lives are about to change forever.

1.name: Would the World Be Kind
1.overview: After a mass casualty event wipes out every creature with a Y chromosome, President Jennifer Brown responds to the crisis. Yorick fears he may be the only survivor. Hero attempts to right a wrong.

1.name: Neil
1.overview: With Jennifer and Yorick reunited, Agent 355 pitches a plan for what comes next. The dead President's daughter, Kimberly, circles Jennifer's secret. Meanwhile, Nora Brady and her daughter Mack say goodbye to home.

1.name: Karen and Benji
1.overview: On Jennifer's orders, Yorick and Agent 355 search for a geneticist who can unravel the mystery of how he survived. Meanwhile, Hero and Sam encounter a dangerous group of women.

1.name: Mann Hunt
1.overview: Yorick and Agent 355 search for Dr. Allison Mann in war-torn Boston. Back in D.C., Jennifer hides the truth about Yorick from her political rivals.

1.name: Weird Al is Dead
1.overview: Yorick, Agent 355 and Dr. Mann hit a snag on their way to San Francisco. As the search for 355 heats up, Jennifer clashes with former cabinet secretary Regina Oliver, who has her eyes on the presidency. Hero is seduced by a charismatic leader, Roxanne, as Sam and Nora grapple with their place in a dangerous group of survivors.

1.name: My Mother Saw a Monkey
1.overview: Kimberly uncovers a secret. 355 and Allison reach an understanding. Yorick stumbles upon a mysterious town where things are not what they seem.

1.name: Ready. Aim. Fire.
1.overview: Tensions at the PriceMax spiral out of control. Hero and Sam pass the point of no return. Nora uncovers dangerous secrets.

1.name: Peppers
1.overview: As tensions at the Pentagon come to a head, Jennifer faces a threat. The Amazons hit the road.

1.name: Victoria
1.overview: As the Amazons close in on Marrisville, Nora reaches a breaking point. Yorick makes a new connection while 355 faces her past.

1.name: Out of the Deep Woods
1.overview: Growing up in a remote forest cabin with his dad, Gus learns lessons about survival and the dangers that lurk beyond the fence to the outside world.

1.name: Sorry About All the Dead People
1.overview: Gus follows a reluctant Big Man into the unknown. Dr. Singh discovers what it will cost to save Rani. Aimee finds a new beginning after the world ends.

1.name: Weird Deer S**t
1.overview: Eager to send Gus on his way, Big Man figures out how to hide him in plain sight. The Singhs attend a neighborhood party that takes an ominous turn.

1.name: Secret Sauce
1.overview: Gus lands under the protection of some new friends as Big Man's past catches up to him. Dr. Singh fears a nosy neighbor will unearth Rani's secret.

1.name: What's in the Freezer?
1.overview: Gus and Big Man pick up a traveling companion who suggests a perilous shortcut. Aimee's sanctuary comes under threat. Time's running out for the Singhs.

1.name: Stranger Danger on a Train
1.overview: In a moment of desperation, Dr. Singh makes a bold promise. A lost memento makes for a bumpy ride to Colorado. The Last Men close in on the Preserve.

1.name: When Pubba Met Birdie
1.overview: Gus's quest to find Birdie and uncover more about her connection to his father leaves him questioning everything he's ever known.

1.name: Big Man
1.overview: His world shaken, Gus runs off and makes a rash decision. Big Man comes to grips with long-ago mistakes. Aimee makes a last stand against General Abbot.

1.name: After Hours
1.overview: In the wake of Carmine Falcone's death, Oz attempts to legitimize himself among Gotham's criminal underworld.

1.name: Inside Man
1.overview: Sofia works to secure her family's strength, while Oz attempts to play both the Falcone and Maroni families to his advantage.

1.name: Bliss
1.overview: Hoping to control the future of Gotham's drug trade, Oz and Sofia must first address the skeletons in their closet. Meanwhile, Victor is torn between his new life and what remains of his old.

1.name: Cent'anni
1.overview: Confronting the events that turned her into "The Hangman" – and led to a decade-long fight to survive in Arkham State Hospital – Sofia makes plans for a more hopeful future.

1.name: Homecoming
1.overview: With his nascent operation at stake, Oz makes a desperate move to turn the tables. Meanwhile, Sofia strives to build a new legacy for herself.

1.name: Gold Summit
1.overview: Despite his enemies' attempts to smoke him out, Oz seeks to expand his reach in the city. Meanwhile, Victor crosses paths with a former adversary.

1.name: Top Hat
1.overview: Oz fights to preserve everything he’s built, while Sofia makes a shocking discovery.

1.name: A Great or Little Thing
1.overview: Truths are laid bare as Oz Cobb nears the end of his journey and his power struggle with Sofia comes to a head.

1.name: The Case of Crystal Palace
1.overview: After coming to the aid of a teen medium with a demonic dilemma, Edwin and Charles head to America to find a missing girl with an unexpected ally.

1.name: The Case of the Dandelion Shrine
1.overview: Trapped in a sleepy Washington town, the detectives take on a local case: helping Crystal's quirky housemate Niko get rid of her paranormal parasites.

1.name: The Case of the Devlin House
1.overview: The group tries to free a family of spirits from a nightmarish loop inside a haunted house, but it triggers an extreme case of déjà vu for one detective.

1.name: The Case of the Lighthouse Leapers
1.overview: The gang looks into a disturbing trend of deaths at a lighthouse. Crystal hears a distinct voice while piecing together clues about the seaside mystery.

1.name: The Case of the Two Dead Dragons
1.overview: While Crystal, Edwin and Charles investigate the tragic murders of two popular jocks, Niko sets up Jenny and her secret admirer on a butcher shop date.

1.name: The Case of the Creeping Forest
1.overview: A crisis forces Crystal to improvise on the job as Monty recruits the boys to locate his missing friend — but the eerie case isn't what it seems.

1.name: The Case of the Very Long Stairway
1.overview: When Edwin gets caught in a frightening situation, Charles relies on his best mate's meticulous notes to find him. A determined Crystal confronts her ex.

1.name: The Case of the Hungry Snake
1.overview: Crystal reckons with the past after memories come rushing back. With Esther's evil scheme underway, the group is forced to face their deadliest foe yet.

1.name: Pilot
1.overview: After Bruce Wayne is murdered, his adopted son forges an unlikely alliance with the children of Batman's enemies when they are all framed for killing the Caped Crusader.

1.name: Scene of the Crime
1.overview: In an attempt to clear their names, Turner, Duela, Cullen, Harper and Carrie head back to the scene of the crime in search of Bruce Wayne's journals. Meanwhile, as Harvey digs into the investigation, he begins to wonder if Turner is innocent after all. Lastly, Stephanie is brought in for questioning after the GCPD suspect she may be helping Turner.

1.name: Under Pressure
1.overview: After their leader is taken down by Carrie, the Mutant Gang retaliates against Gotham by taking hostages at the annual Founder's Gala, forcing Turner, Duela and Harper to come out of hiding to save the people of Gotham. Elsewhere, Cullen infiltrates the GCPD after the team uncovers a possible connection between the Court of Owls and the death of another Wayne family member. Lastly, Harvey makes a big decision about his future.

1.name: Of Butchers and Betrayals
1.overview: After discovering some potential leads in their investigation, Turner and Harper investigate a possible connection between Bruce Wayne's death and the mysterious death of a lawyer. Meanwhile, Carrie and Duela head to a nursing home to question Eunice. At the Belfry, Stephanie opens up to Cullen about her life at home, while Harvey makes an unsettling discovery.

1.name: More Money, More Problems
1.overview: A plan to take down the Court of Owls leads Turner and the team to a notorious mobster family, the McKillens. Meanwhile, Carrie and Stephanie prepare for Gotham Academy's Parents Luncheon, and Harvey seeks help from a psychiatrist.

1.name: A Chill in Gotham
1.overview: As Joe Chill is set to be executed for the murder of Bruce Wayne's parents, he turns to Harvey to make one final request - to speak with Turner. Meanwhile, Stephanie seeks help from her dad Arthur Brown when she has trouble cracking a code, and Carrie is forced to help at the hospital after her secret life of vigilantism lands her in hot water with her mom.

1.name: Bad to Be Good
1.overview: After a series of art heists in Gotham, Turner and the Knights turn their attention to a possible connection to the Court of Owls. Meanwhile, Duela and Carrie seek answers about The Talon from Eunice, and Rebecca turns to Harvey for help after fearing her life is in danger.

1.name: Belly of the Beast
1.overview: A series of cryptic clues leads Turner and Duela to one of The Court's secret meetings. Meanwhile, Stephanie learns her mom's addiction is worse than she thought and turns to her father Arthur for help. Finally, a lapse in time leads Harvey to a startling discovery.

1.name: Dark Knight of the Soul
1.overview: After one of their own is captured by the Court of Owls, the Knights find themselves in a race against the clock.  Stephanie and Harper work together to locate a crucial piece of material that could save their team member.  Elsewhere, Harvey takes steps to protect himself, only to have his worst fear confirmed.

1.name: Poison Pill
1.overview: With one of their own in trouble, the team scrambles to find a solution before it's too late. Elsewhere, Harvey undertakes a risky gambit to get the answers he seeks. Finally, Brody turns to Stephanie after he stumbles upon some information involving his father Lincoln.

1.name: Daddy Issues
1.overview: Duela's birthday reunion with her mom, Jane Doe, unearths some shocking information that will irrevocably change her.  Meanwhile, Stephanie is forced to choose between her family and the Knights, putting her at odds with Harper.  Finally, Harvey finds himself on a collision course with someone from his past.

1.name: City of Owls
1.overview: The team springs into action after uncovering the existence of evidence that could clear their names. Harvey follows a lead that could help him finally piece together what happened the night Bruce Wayne was murdered. After reuniting with her mother, Duela begins to have second thoughts.

1.name: Night of the Owls
1.overview: Faced with their most dangerous rescue yet, the Gotham Knights realize that trusting each other may be the only way to save themselves and the city of Gotham. Meanwhile, Harvey is faced with an impossible decision that could have devastating consequences.

1.name: Off-tune
1.overview: Amid financial struggles, Runa discovers a mysterious box in her bank's record room, changing her life forever.

1.name: Swapped
1.overview: Runa's sudden shift in behaviour shocks everyone. Meanwhile, the real owner of the box frantically searches for it.

1.name: Off-season
1.overview: Runa enjoys a luxury vacation in Cox's Bazar while the goons kidnap other bank employees in search of the box.

1.name: In Deep Water
1.overview: While Runa is away on vacation, her hidden fortune gets stolen in an irony of fate!

1.name: Irony Of Fate
1.overview: The goons and office miscreants relentlessly search for the box, with Runa now being their ultimate prey.

1.name: Pitch Black
1.overview: The Anti-Corruption Commission raids the bank, and Runa confronts Rana, who is in charge of the investigation.

1.name: The Accident
1.overview: As the pressure from the Anti-corruption Commission mounts, Runa plays a trump card that shifts everything.

1.name: The Brown Comeback
1.overview: Ahana Jaiswal’s murder brings a disgraced Rita Brown back, probing family ties under pressure.

1.name: The Wrong Suspect
1.overview: As police chase a suspect, Rita and Arjun spot flaws, probing Ahana’s inner circle.

1.name: Cost of Truth
1.overview: As secrets emerge, Rita faces isolation, questioning how far she will go to uncover the truth.

1.name: Broken Trail
1.overview: With Rita sidelined, Arjun faces pressure. Meanwhile, fresh clues challenge the case’s direction.

1.name: Web of Lies
1.overview: Another death drags Rita in deeper, as hidden ties and betrayals cloud Ahana’s case.

1.name: Dark Obsession
1.overview: As clues span across cities and past crimes, Rita and Arjun hunt a killer shaped by obsession.

1.name: Into the Endgame
1.overview: Nearing the truth, Rita confronts a ruthless mind. Will she survive the final reckoning?

1.name: Pilot
1.overview: When an unassuming high school chemistry teacher discovers he has a rare form of lung cancer, he decides to team up with a former student and create a top of the line crystal meth in a used RV, to provide for his family once he is gone.

1.name: Cat's in the Bag...
1.overview: Walt and Jesse attempt to tie up loose ends. The desperate situation gets more complicated with the flip of a coin. Walt's wife, Skyler, becomes suspicious of Walt's strange behavior.

1.name: ...And the Bag's in the River
1.overview: Walter fights with Jesse over his drug use, causing him to leave Walter alone with their captive, Krazy-8. Meanwhile, Hank has a scared straight moment with Walter Jr. after his aunt discovers he has been smoking pot. Also, Skylar is upset when Walter stays away from home.

1.name: Cancer Man
1.overview: Walter finally tells his family that he has been stricken with cancer. Meanwhile, the DEA believes Albuquerque has a new, big time player to worry about. Meanwhile, a worthy recipient is the target of a depressed Walter's anger, and Jesse makes a surprise visit to his parents home.

1.name: Gray Matter
1.overview: Walter and Skyler attend a former colleague's party. Jesse tries to free himself from the drugs, while Skyler organizes an intervention.

1.name: Crazy Handful of Nothin'
1.overview: The side effects of chemo begin to plague Walt. Meanwhile, the DEA rounds up suspected dealers.

1.name: A No Rough Stuff Type Deal
1.overview: Walter accepts his new identity as a drug dealer after a PTA meeting. Elsewhere, Jesse decides to put his aunt's house on the market and Skyler is the recipient of a baby shower.

1.name: Herr Dr. Tenma
1.overview: Dr. Kenzo Tenma, a leading neurosurgeon at the Dusseldorf Hospital has received massive acclaim for his successful surgery on a famous opera singer. However, he is burdened by guilt. Due to pressure from the director, he had operated on the opera singer on the night that he was supposed to operate on another man. As a result, when the director’s orders him to operate on the mayor, he decides to ignore the order and instead works on saving the life of a young boy, brought to the hospital from the

1.name: Downfall
1.overview: The price for disobeying Dr. Heinemann's orders to operate on the mayor is costly for Dr. Tenma. His career begins to plummet. The boy whom he saved finally awakens, but a horrible incident occurs soon after.

1.name: A Murder
1.overview: Things look brighter for Dr. Tenma, now that Dr. Heinemann is dead. His career takes off, and even Eva tries to win him back. But unfortunately, all that success has drawn the attention of Detective Lunge.

1.name: Night of the Execution
1.overview: Adolf Junkers has information about the serial murders that is vital to the police, but he is afraid to reveal them. Dr. Tenma's care for Adolf Junkers however wins him over. His close relationship with Junkers however leads him to a night of shocking horror.

1.name: The Girl of Heidelberg
1.overview: Nina Fortner, a talented young student in Heidelberg has been having nightmares. She also cannot remember anything about her life before she was 10 years old. She soon suffers from fainting spells in university and starts receiving anonymous emails.

1.name: The Missing
1.overview: Nina finally receives an email informing her to meet the anonymous sender at a specified time and place. Dr. Tenma in his search for the Liebert girl, asks Mauler, an editor for a local publisher, for assistance in his investigations.

1.name: House of Tragedy
1.overview: Tenma and Nina return to the Fortners’ residence to find Mauler and Nina’s parents dead. Two detectives arrive to take them to the station for questioning, but certain things don't look right.

1.name: Pursued
1.overview: Eva tries to threaten Dr. Tenma, unless he gets back with her, she would reveal to the police that the tie that was found at the scene of the crime is his!

1.name: The Girl and the Seasoned Soldier
1.overview: An old mercenary soldier named Hugo is interrogated by Lunge about a student of his, a doctor named Tenma.

1.name: A Past Erased
1.overview: Tenma encounters a burglar named Heckel who claims to have seen the killer. It soon results in Heckel leading Tenma to a couple of murderers.

1.name: 511 Kinderheim
1.overview: Tenma learns that Johan used to be in an orphanage known as Kinderheim 511. And he meets a former East German official named Hartmann who used to work there and an injured boy named Dieter.

1.name: A Little Experiment
1.overview: Dieter is picked up by Hartmann before Tenma could return. And Tenma learns more about the experiments in Kinderheim 511.

1.name: Petra and Schumann
1.overview: In a small village, Dr. Schumann worries over the health of his sick but stubborn old friend, Petra.

1.name: Left Behind
1.overview: Inspector Lunge investigates the murder of a prostitute and suspects a senator named Dr. Boltzmann of involvement. His dedication to his work however takes a toll on his family life. Meanwhile, the vindictive Eva continues to press Lunge to catch Tenma. She also has a new lover, her gardener.

1.name: Be My Baby
1.overview: Dr. Tenma and Nina Fortner's investigations lead them to a powerful man known as 'The Baby', who belongs in an extremist organisation. They soon learn that the organisation has special plans for the Turkish district tomorrow.

1.name: Wolf's Confession
1.overview: Nina escapes the mansion. And Tenma meets with the unrecognizable General Wolf at the mansion later.

1.name: Reunion
1.overview: The extremists plans are put into action, and Tenma decides to postpone his search for Johan and instead heads to the Turkish district to warn the people there. Dieter and Heckel are captured by the skinheads and are left to burn in the fire. And Nina tries to get information about the 'main dish' from 'The Baby'.

1.name: Five Sugars
1.overview: Nina meets with an old friend and boss, Mister Rosso. The delightful old boss however, has a very dark past.

1.name: Monster's Abyss
1.overview: Tenma visits Rudy, a criminal psychologist, who is working on cases involving a murderer named Jurgens.

1.name: Journey to Freiham
1.overview: Tenma and Dieter hitch a ride with an elderly couple on the way to Freiham. Tenma wonders if the couple plan to turn him in.

1.name: Happy Holidays
1.overview: Nina confronts Muller, one of the two detectives responsible for the death of her foster parents, the Fortners. Muller discovers that his protege, Roberto, is actually working for Johan and is now tasked with killing Nina.

1.name: Lunge's Trap
1.overview: Lunge determines that the murder of a wealthy, middle-aged, childless couple does not fit the usual modus operandi of the serial murders and decides to use this opportunity to lure Tenma to a trap. However, before he can arrest him, Lunge is critically wounded by the real criminal. Tenma is able to treat Lunge's injuries.

1.name: Eva's Confession
1.overview: Eva Heinemann is arrested for public drunkenness and hooks up with Roberto, with whom she was with the night before her arrest. Roberto then reveals his link to Johan and Eva confesses that she was actually a witness the night Junkers was killed by Johan.

1.name: Of Men and Dining
1.overview: In exchange for her life, Roberto tells Eva to confront Tenma, who is currently treating a mob boss at a country house. Eva is promptly wounded by Roberto when she is unable to complete her task but is saved by Tenma.

1.name: Thursday's Boy
1.overview: Karl Neumann and Lotte Frank are both students who read latin to Hans Georg Schubert. Lotte attempts to assist Karl in finding out his past while trying to figure out the identity of a boy who reads to Schubert on Thursdays. When they both discover who he is, they find the boy, Edmund Farren, in his dormitory, dead.

1.name: The Secret Woods
1.overview: A man who claims to be the son of a millionaire has committed suicide, and a detective is determined to solve the case.

1.name: Proof
1.overview: Richard's past and present situation is revealed. Johan continues to bond with the Schuwald family and his intention is revealed.

1.name: Just One Case
1.overview: Richard re-investigates his old homicide cases and makes a frightening discovery.

1.name: Execution
1.overview: Robert delves into Johan's past and makes a shocking discovery. Dr. Gillen speaks to Peter Jurgens, a serial murderer about Johan's possible involvement and gets a tragic reply. Johan confronts Robert about Stephen Joos. And Dr. Reichwen receives tragic news from the police.

1.name: Decision
1.overview: Suspecting foul play in Robert's 'accidental' death fall, Dr. Reichwen makes some discoveries in his investigations. But as he later realizes, his investigations may have put him in harms way.

1.name: In Broad Daylight
1.overview: Dr. Tenma and Dr. Reichwen finally meet. Dr. Reichwen intends to proof Dr. Tenma's innocence in the homicides, but Dr. Tenma has other ideas.

1.name: Sanctuary
1.overview: Lotte, Frank and Karl are drifting apart. Lotte meets Nina Fortner and they become friends. Dr. Tenma searches for a perfect spot to shoot Johan.

1.name: A Child's View
1.overview: Dieter learns of a life threatening game that children are playing. Mr. Schuwald decides to donate his whole book collection to the Munich University Library under the suggestion of Karl and Johan.

1.name: At the Edge of Darkness
1.overview: The 'Margot Langer' impostor tries to blackmail Johan. Dr. Tenma helps a young 'doctor' at an illegal clinic

1.name: My Nameless Hero
1.overview: Lunge tries to get into Dr. Tenma's mind by pretending to be him. Dr. Gillen learns something about Johan during an interview with a psychotic killer. Dr. Reichwen tries to warn the Lieberts of Johan's true nature. Dr. Tenma scouts for a perfect sniping location.

1.name: The Monster of Chaos
1.overview: Dr. Reichwein reveals the true nature of Johan to Mr. Schuwald. Dr. Tenma gets ready to assassinate Johan. Lunge concludes that Dr. Tenma will kill Schuwald next. Lotte confronts Nina about Johan.

1.name: A Nameless Monster
1.overview: The episode begins with a fairy tale about a Monster without a name. Nina reads the story from the picture book and has a sense of deja vu. Johan's evil plans for the book donation ceremony is carried out. Dr. Tenma meets a big obstacle in his attempt to kill Johan.

1.name: The Demon in My Eyes
1.overview: Dr. Tenma has a gun pointed at Roberto, but Roberto has the rifle pointed at him. Nina, Dr.Reichwen and Dieter arrive to find the whole library in flames. People are trapped inside and the doors are all locked. Karl reads the report on his mother's life and death. Dr. Tenma tries to rescue those trapped in the building. Johan reveals the monster inside of him to Schuwald.

1.name: The Hell in His Eyes
1.overview: Lunge, from the BKA, learns that Johan may indeed exist. Nina goes into regressive hypnosis to learn more about the picture book and her past. Mr. Schuwald has a message for Dr. Tenma and sends Karl to Dresden to pass it to him.

1.name: Grimmer
1.overview: The episode introduces Grimmer. Grimmer is a freelance journalist doing an in-depth research into the abuses in the orphanages in East Germany. Grimmer meets with Dr. Tenma during their trip to Prague, and they become more acquainted when Tenma is faced with an immigration problem.

1.name: Ghosts of 511
1.overview: Grimmer stubbornly stalks Petrov for his experimental research papers chronicaling the abuses at Kinderheim 511, but he gets a surprise instead.

1.name: The Adventures of the Magnificent Steiner
1.overview: Grimmer has the key that Petrov gave him, and a former Czechoslovakian secret police organization wants it. Caught and tortured, Grimmer tells his abductors about 'the Magnificent Steiner'.

1.name: Detective Suk
1.overview: A new inspector, detective Suk is on the case of Zeman's homicide. During his investigation, he discovers that there is more to Zeman's murder than first assumed. Suk also meets a lady whom he falls head over hills for

1.name: Double Darkness
1.overview: After the death of his seniors, Suk is left to re-investigate case from the very beginning. He gets information from the orphans about a meeting with Grimmer. His intention to arrest Grimmer takes a different turn however when he gets deeper into the investigation. The episode also reveals that there is more to the nameless lady at the bar than she lets on.

1.name: The Monster's Afterimage
1.overview: Suk is put under surveillance by the new commissioner. Together with Grimmer, Suk retrieves the tape and research papers from the deposit box. But their movements is watched by various sides.

1.name: Contact
1.overview: Dr. Tenma learns about Suk's fugitive status from a journalist. And sets out to find him. Meanwhile, Suk and Grimmer goes into hiding, but is quickly found, surrounded and attacked by the STB. The STB's assault comes to a bloody end.

1.name: The Door to Nightmares
1.overview: Nina's experience in Prague is a nightmare for her. Tenma and Grimmer meets with a top man in the Czechoslovakian STB. They are offered a deal which Grimmer refuses to accept.

1.name: The Scariest Thing
1.overview: Johan visits Suk's mother. Tenma and Grimmer learns of his visit. They, including Col. Ranke, listen to Johan's tape. Lunge arrives in Prague for a 'holiday'. His investigation leads him to the sketches of Franz Bonaparta.

1.name: The Cruelest Thing
1.overview: Grimmer and Tenma tries to stop Johan from subjecting Milo, one of the orphans, to one of the most cruel fate.

1.name: The Rose Mansion
1.overview: Lunge investigates the secret behind the Red Rose Mansion. Tenma and Grimmer separate, but Tenma finds himself in trouble.

1.name: The Monster's Love Letter
1.overview: Schubert, with the help of Reichwein, re-explores his past with Karl Neumann's real mother and realizes his link to Johan. As news of Tenma's arrest spreads, various people react with shock and horror, with the exception of Eva Heinemann, who is insistent that Tenma pay dearly for rejecting her. Suk tries to leave the hospital he is in to try to help Tenma, but is stopped by the Prague Police who inform him that Grimmer has sent a note to them exonerating Suk from any involvement of the deaths o

1.name: The Lawyer
1.overview: Former patients of Eisler Memorial Hospital enlist the aid of Alfred Baul, a lawyer, to represent Tenma. Baul in turn asks for the assistance of Fritz Vardemann. Vardemann visits Tenma in prison, and agrees to take on the defense, but is then called to the hospital when his wife goes into labor with their first child. When Baul visits Tenma in prison, Tenma is shocked to see that Baul is Roberto. Roberto then says that Eva Heinemann will be his next target.

1.name: Determination
1.overview: After hearing Roberto's threat against Eva, Tenma decides to confess to all charges against him so he can be placed in the same van transporting a prisoner to a Federal Penetentary as the prisoner is arranging for a jailbreak.

1.name: The Escape
1.overview: Tenma and Milch are on the run with the injured Gustav and Helene. Eva finds her life in danger when she discovers that the attorney she's supposed to meet, Mr.Baul, is none other than Roberto.

1.name: Room 402
1.overview: Dr. Tenma takes Verderman hostage in a desperate search for Eva. And Verderman's dark past is revealed.

1.name: The Neverending Journey
1.overview: Nina and Dieter enters the Red Rose Mansion, but Nina faints from her disturbing experience. And they end up in the care of a puppeteer name Lipsky.

1.name: That Night
1.overview: A flashback to Johan’s and Nina’s past, to the time before the Liebert’s homicides reveals the reason behind Johan’s killing. Police makes a startling discovery at the burnt down mansion. Tenma finally learns where Eva is. And Lunge reveals Lipsky’s true identity.

1.name: I Hate This Job
1.overview: Martin, a hired hand, is hired by General Wolf's ex-associates to ‘take care’ of Eva. But his emotions get in the way of his orders.

1.name: The Man Who Saw the Devil
1.overview: Tenma manages to find Martin. A drunken Eva spots Johan at a party. Martin receives his final orders from his boss but his feelings gets in the way. And Martin gets way over his head when he tries to investigate Johan and his disciple, and the truth about his past is revealed.

1.name: The Man Who Knew Too Much
1.overview: Martin’s attempt to save Eva costs him his life, his last minutes with Tenma reveals a terrible secrets about Martin’s boss, Peter Chapek and the about the experiments.

1.name: The Door to Memories
1.overview: Nina returns to the apartment that she lived in with her mother and Johan and encounters another memory. She then returns to Munich and Dr. Reichwein where she volunteers for hypnosis to find the truth behind these memories. After she nearly kills Dr. Gillen in a hypnotic rage, she leaves Dr. Reichwein's house to try to stop Tenma from killing her brother. Meanwhile, Suk and Vardemann team up to interview former residents of the Mansion of Red Roses to gather information on Franz Bonaparta's rea

1.name: A Pleasant Dinner Table
1.overview: While trying to escape from police in Frankfurt, Tenma is hit by a van. He awakes in the Turkish Quarter of the city, the same one that he saved from The Baby's plot. The man who saved him plans to kill Petr Capek at a convention, but he fails at this task and is shot dead. Nina, in Frankfurt, sees the picture of Petr Capek and it triggers yet another memory.

1.name: Unrelated Murders
1.overview: Egon Weisbach was one of the first investigators in the murder of the Liebert parents. On his last day on the job before retirement, he is escorting a convicted serial murderer but wants to know why he killed someone who did not fit his modus operandi. At the same time, Dr. Gillen is interviewing several murderers wondering why they killed someone who also did not fit their usual targets. Both realize that all these criminals committed murders outside their usual scope at the request of a young

1.name: The Baby's Depression
1.overview: The Baby is killed by a prostitute, and his death sends shockwaves in Petr Capek's organization. Capek becomes paranoid as to who is loyal or not and accidentally kills one of his guards. He makes it to his cottage where Johan is waiting for him.

1.name: Johan's Footprints
1.overview: Capek tries to berate Johan for his actions and tells him that everything should be done according to Capek's plans but Johan simply disagrees and disappears. Capek realizes his hold on his organization is crumbling and has his men pick up Nina in Frankfurt. Eva accosts the young man who was introduced to Johan, Christof Sievernich, demanding answers.

1.name: Welcome Home
1.overview: Capek reveals to Nina that her and her twin brother Johan are the products of a eugenics experiment designed to breed "the perfect children". Tenma has wounded Christof and is driving him and Eva to the hospital while demanding answers on Petr Capek. While Eva makes a phone call at a payphone, Tenma sneaks away.

1.name: I'm Back
1.overview: Nina confronts Johan who presents her with a story on what happened when many people were poisoned at the Mansion of Red Roses. Nina realizes that she was the one who witnessed these deaths, the shock of this revelation nearly drives her to suicide, but she is saved by Tenma. Capek is gunned down by members of his organization when they find out about the guard that Capek killed.

1.name: Ruhenheim
1.overview: With a postcard obtained by Lipsky, Lunge arrives in Ruhenheim. There he meets up with Grimmer, whose research has led him to this town as well. A working-class couple in this town realize they win the lottery and fearing that everyone else wants to kill them, the husband buys an arsenal of weapons.

1.name: The Peaceful House
1.overview: Lunge and Grimmer conclude something terrible is happening in Ruhenheim when random gunshots ring out, people are either murdered or disappearing, and any links out of town is flooded by torrential rain. As Nina recovers in a nearby hospital, Tenma, using a lead from Capek, travels to Prague and meets with Lipsky and determines that Johan is in Ruhenheim.

1.name: The Town Massacre
1.overview: As time passes, more people in Ruhenheim are being shot dead by mysterious people and each other. Both Grimmer and Lunge determine that the owner of a local hotel is Klaus Poppe, also known as Franz Bonaparta. After subduing a man who was giving weapons to everyone in the town, they obtain information that one of the ringleaders is in a second hotel.

1.name: The Wrath of the Magnificent Steiner
1.overview: Tenma runs into Lunge, the latter apologizing for his previous accusations against Tenma. Nina and Dr. Gillen rush to Ruhenheim. After the winning lottery couple is wounded in an attack on Bonaparta's hotel, Grimmer rushes out to the streets to reason with the unknown assailants.

1.name: A Nameless Man
1.overview: Lunge confronts Roberto, one of the ringleaders, in a hotel room. Both are subsequently wounded in the fight. Nina and Gillen arrive in Ruhenheim where they find a house containing drawings of the two twins by Bonaparta. This triggers a final memory and the secret to Johan's madness and motives, his quest for true solitude, as well as forgiveness for his actions. Bonaparta accompanies Tenma on his quest to find and kill Johan.

1.name: Scenery for a Doomsday
1.overview: Bonaparta attempts to shoot Johan dead, but is gunned down by Roberto, who dies of his own injuries soon afterwards. With the massacre now over, authorities rush into the town and attempt to determine what happened. Just as an officer is about to arrest Dr. Tenma, an ambulance worker arrives asking for Tenma's assistance.

1.name: The Real Monster
1.overview: It has been some time since the tragic blood battle, and everyone is working hard to put their lives back to normal. Tenma finally locates a woman he has been searching for, and she reveals some startling information.

1.name: Conspiracy
1.overview: A giant castle in a mysterious world. Two shady Majin, Gomah and Degesu, watch a monitor. The monitor shows Goku and the others having a fierce battle against Majin Buu. Gomah and Degesu head to Earth to execute a certain conspiracy.

1.name: Glorio
1.overview: Goku and his friends have been turned small due to Gomah's scheme. They begin preparing to go to the demon world. Goku collects his Nyoibo and looks forward to a new adventure. Then the mysterious young Majin Glorio appears!

1.name: Daima
1.overview: Goku, Supreme Kai, and Glorio head out to the "Demon Realm" first. Their plane travels through space and a mysterious dimension. They arrive at the entrance to the Demon Realm, the "Third Demon World"!

1.name: Chatty
1.overview: Forced to make their way through the Third Demon World on foot, Goku and his companions stop by a lone drive-in on the way. There they encounter some strange souvenirs and a rather chatty and quirky Majin woman and her husband!

1.name: Panzy
1.overview: The masked Majin who appeared before Goku and his companions is a young girl named Panzy! While Glorio gives her the cold shoulder, Panzy insists on acting as their guide. The group reaches a suspicious castle!

1.name: Lightning
1.overview: After encountering the Gendarmerie, the wardens of the Demon Realm, the four are forced to camp in a cave where they encounter further trouble! The enigmatic Glorio unleashes lightning magic against Goku to resolve the situation!

1.name: Collar
1.overview: Goku and his companions continue their journey. But the Gendarmerie appear and bar their way again, perhaps due to them knowing the location of the Magic Collar around Panzy's neck. Can the bond with her friends save Panzy from peril?!

1.name: Tamagami
1.overview: The fight with a Tamagami begins! The Tamagamis are the undefeated guardians of the Dragon Balls. Seeing Goku fight toe-to-toe with one, Panzy and the others are unable to hide their surprise. As the battle heats up, what will happen?!

1.name: Thieves
1.overview: Rumors of what Goku did in the Third Demon World spread across the Demon Realm. To avoid trouble, Goku wears a disguise at the hotel, but they can't let their guard down in the Third Demon World. Thieves see through his disguise!

1.name: Ocean
1.overview: Goku and his companions arrive at the mystic Second Demon World where a giant ocean spreads as far as the eye can see! The party is amazed at the new world but is immediately attacked by Gendarmerie that have been sent by Gomah!

1.name: Legend
1.overview: Having regrouped with Vegeta and the others, Goku and his companions arrive at a planet that seems familiar. As they move to head out, a suspicious shadow approaches! It's the Legendary Namek who remained alone in the Demon Realm!

1.name: True Strength
1.overview: Vegeta’s battle with the Tamagami is evenly matched, but forced underwater where he's not used to fighting, he finds himself struggling! Vegeta is cornered and sinks to the ocean floor. But then he finally unleashes his true strength!

1.name: Surprise
1.overview: As Goku and his companions head to where Gomah is, engine trouble causes them to land on a certain planet. The place they land happens to be a surprise-filled planet where even Supreme Demon Kings are afraid to tread!

1.name: Taboo
1.overview: To stop Goku's advancement, Gomah commits an unbelievable taboo! Goku and his companions can no longer proceed. Just when it seems their adventure is over, a certain someone reveals their true power!

1.name: Third Eye
1.overview: The Evil Third Eye offers absolute power in the Demon Realm. King Gomah confirms its location and moves to obtain it! Will the Third Eye open on Gomah's forehead?!

1.name: Degesu
1.overview: Goku and his companions finally reach Gomah's palace. But Kadem and the mighty Gendarmerie Force bar their way! Meanwhile, in the palace, Degesu takes action for his own ambitions!

1.name: Gomah
1.overview: Goku and his companions face off with Arinsu. With everything on the line, their battle begins. But all of a sudden, a transformed King Gomah stands before both parties!

1.name: Awakening
1.overview: King Gomah enters the battlefield and an all-out battle ensues! Goku and his companions stuggle against the power of the Third Eye. Just when it seems that all is lost, an amazing new power is awakened within Goku!

1.name: Betrayal
1.overview: The battle continues to go poorly for Goku and his companions. After much hesitation, Glorio puts Arinsu's secret plan into action! As his friends watch in awe, what will Glorio's betrayal set in motion?!

1.name: Maximum
1.overview: Having been restored, Goku finally surpasses his limits! To defeat the mighty Giant Gomah, who keeps regenerating through the power of the Third Eye, everyone puts in their maximum effort in an all-out battle!

1.name: Goku vs. Goku! A Super Battle Begins on Prison Planet!
1.overview: Goku and Vegeta's training with Whis and Beerus is interrupted by the arrival of Future Mai, who tells them that Future Trunks has been captured. A mysterious figure emerges, introducing himself as Fu; he tells Goku, Vegeta and Mai that Future Trunks is trapped on a world called the "Prison Planet", a planet where warriors from alternate timelines and dimensions fight as part of an experiment conducted by Fu. The trio arrive on the planet and meet an alternate version of Goku called "Xeno Goku",

1.name: Goku Goes Berserk! The Evil Saiyan's Rampage!
1.overview: Goku and company are helpless against the evil Saiyan who is shrouded in an overwhelming large, sinister ki! Goku is enveloped by the evil Saiyan’s ki and runs wild, but an unexpected savior comes to the rescue!

1.name: The Mightiest Radiance! Vegito Blue Kaio-ken Explodes!
1.overview: The evil Saiyan Cumber has now revealed his true form, and in order to face off against him, Goku and Vegeta fuse via the Potara! They become the mightiest warrior, Vegito Blue, and even let loose with the Kaio-Ken!! Cumber counters by unleashing an amazing form.

1.name: Rage! Super Fu Appears!
1.overview: Cumber unleashes his fearsome form and runs wild. His power is too much for the Prison Planet to handle, and the chains start to snap one by one. Seeing this throws Fu into a rage, and he unleashes his hidden power.

1.name: The Mightiest Warrior! Super Saiyan 4 Vegetto!!
1.overview: As Goku and company are in a jam, Xeno Goku and Xeno Vegeta come to their aid, having noticed the change in the Prison Planet. To counter Cumber's bottomless power, the two use the Potara to fuse! It's the explosive birth of the mightiest warrior!

1.name: I'll Settle This!! Into Operation! Ultra Instinct!
1.overview: After an endless fierce battle, Ultra Instinct finally goes into operation. Amidst the crumbling Prison Planet, a final battle begins with everything on the line!

1.name: A Peacetime Reward; Who Gets the 100,000,000 Zeni?!
1.overview: Goku is farming with Goten when Mr. Satan tries to give him 100 Million Zeni! Goten and Trunks try to find a gift to Videl.

1.name: To the Promised Resort! Vegeta Takes a Family Trip?!
1.overview: Vegeta and his family go on a family trip while Goku trains. Beerus remembers the Super Saiyan God in his dream.

1.name: Where Does the Dream Pick Up? Find the Super Saiyan God!
1.overview: Beerus and Whis track down the Super Saiyan God. Meanwhile, Bulma and her friends set up her birthday party.

1.name: Bid for the Dragon Balls! Pilaf and Crew's Impossible Mission!
1.overview: The Pilaf Gang end up at Bulma's birthday party to steal the Dragon Balls, but they are sidetracked. Meanwhile, Goku trains on Kaio's planet.

1.name: Showdown on King Kai's World! Goku vs. Beerus the Destroyer!
1.overview: While Goku is training, Beerus shows up at Kaio's planet. Goku suggests that they fight against Kaio's wishes, but Goku is later beaten by Beerus as a Super Saiyan 3.

1.name: Don't Anger the Destroyer! A Heart-Pounding Birthday Party
1.overview: Beerus arrives at Bulma's birthday party, and Vegeta tries his best to keep the God of Destruction under wraps for the time being.

1.name: How Dare You Do That to My Bulma! Vegeta's Metamorphosis of Fury?
1.overview: The Z-Fighters attempt to subdue Beerus after he gets angry, to no avail. Vegeta transforms out of rage after witnessing Bulma get slapped.

1.name: Goku Makes an Entrance! A Last Chance from Lord Beerus?
1.overview: An enraged Vegeta fights Beerus, but is overwhelmed. Later, Beers wins a rock-paper-scissors contest against Oolong, and decides to destroy Earth. Before he can, Goku returns.

1.name: Thanks for Waiting, Lord Beerus! A Super Saiyan God Is Born at Last!
1.overview: After Goku asks Beerus for more time, they summon Shen Long to find out how to achieve the Super Saiyan God form. They perform the ritual and Goku becomes a Super Saiyan God.

1.name: Show Us, Goku! The Power of a Super Saiyan God!
1.overview: After successfully becoming a Super Saiyan God, Goku challenges Beerus to another fight.

1.name: Let's Keep Going, Lord Beerus! The Battle of Gods!
1.overview: The battle between gods continues.

1.name: The Universe Will Shatter? Clash! Destroyer vs. Super Saiyan God!
1.overview: The destructive power of Goku and Beerus' fight puts the entire universe in danger.

1.name: Goku, Surpass Super Saiyan God!
1.overview: Although Goku loses the Super Saiyan God form, he absorbs and retains its power, and continues to fight Beerus.

1.name: This Is All the Power I've Got! A Settlement Between Gods
1.overview: The fight between Goku and Beerus reaches its climactic end.

1.name: Valiant Mr. Satan, Work a Miracle! A Challenge from Outer Space!
1.overview: After the battle with Beerus wraps up, a terrible visitor comes to Satan!?

1.name: Vegeta Becomes a Student?! Win Over Whis!
1.overview: With the battle over, one day Kuririn visits Goku. His unexpected request is…!? Meanwhile, Vegeta tries to convince Whis to make him one of his students by…?

1.name: Pan Is Born! And Goku Goes on a Training Journey?!
1.overview: Some time has passed on Earth. Gohan and Videl’s daughter is finally born!!

1.name: I'm Here, Too! Training Commences on Beerus' World
1.overview: Goku departs Earth and begins training under Whis. The surprising training method is…!?

1.name: Despair Redux! The Return of the Evil Emperor, Frieza!
1.overview: Sorbet is eager to revive Frieza and receives the help of Pilaf and his gang.

1.name: A Warning from Jaco! Frieza and 1,000 Soldiers Close In
1.overview: Jaco travels to Earth to give out a warning of Frieza's arrival.

1.name: The Start of Vengeance! The Frieza Force's Malice Strikes Gohan!
1.overview: Frieza's forces begin their raid on Planet Earth. Goku and Vegeta, oblivious to what is happening on Earth, continue their training under Whis.

1.name: Change! An Unexpected Return! His Name Is Ginyu!!
1.overview: Ginyu switches bodies with Tagoma and wreaks havoc on the Z-Fighters

1.name: Earth! Gohan! Both on the Ropes! Hurry and Get Here, Goku!!
1.overview: Goku and Vegeta hear of Frieza's return and quickly teleport to Earth.

1.name: Clash! Frieza vs. Goku; This Is the Result of My Training!
1.overview: Goku and Frieza go one-on-one. Goku wants to reveal his true power, and so he transforms...

1.name: A Full-Throttle Battle! The Vengeful Golden Frieza
1.overview: Frieza reveals his new evolution and the battle truly begins.

1.name: A Chance Appears in a Tight Spot! Launch a Counteroffensive, Goku!
1.overview: The battle continues as Frieza's weakness begins to make itself obvious.

1.name: The Earth Explodes?! A Decisive Kamehameha!
1.overview: With Goku badly injured, Vegeta steps in to face Frieza. Stronger than ever, Vegeta proves to be a challenge and an enraged Frieza destroys the planet! Protected by Whis, the Z-Fighters are given a chance to save Earth, if they act fast enough.

1.name: The 6th Universe's Destroyer! His Name Is Champa!
1.overview: While training on Beerus' Planet, Goku and Vegeta meet Beerus' twin brother Champa.

1.name: Combat Matches Are a Go! The Captain Is Someone Stronger Than Goku
1.overview: Beerus and Champa decided to hold a tournament between their universes to settle who gets to use the Super Dragon Balls.

1.name: A Run-Through For the Competition! Who Are the Last Two Members?
1.overview: Goku and Vegeta go find the two remaining members for Team Universe 7.

1.name: Off to See Master Zuno! Find Out Where the Super Dragon Balls Are!
1.overview: Jaco and Bulma visit Zuno to learn more about the Super Dragon Balls.

1.name: The Matches Begin! We're All Off to the "Planet with No Name!"
1.overview: The tournament between Universe 6 and Universe 7 begins! The first match is going underway.

1.name: Surprise, 6th Universe! This is Super Saiyan Goku!
1.overview: It's Goku versus Botamo! After Goku's victory, he faces Frost, Universe 6's version of Frieza. Who wins the match...?

1.name: Piccolo vs. Frost! Stake It All on the Special Beam Cannon!
1.overview: The next contestant for Team Universe 7 is Piccolo. Frost is doing what?!

1.name: Turn Your Anger into Strength! Vegeta's Full-Bore Battle
1.overview: Vegeta battles Frost. After a short-lived fight, Vegeta is challenged by Magetta.

1.name: An Unexpectedly Uphill Battle! Vegeta's Great Blast of Fury!
1.overview: Vegeta is struggling during his match with Magetta. What is Magetta doing to Vegeta?!

1.name: Don't Forget Your Saiyan Pride! Vegeta vs. the 6th Universe's Saiyan
1.overview: The next match is between Vegeta and the Saiyan from Universe 6, Cabba. What secret power does Cabba possess?

1.name: The 6th Universe's Mightiest Warrior! Engage the Assassin Hit!
1.overview: The final contestant for Universe 6 is the confident, legendary assassin, Hit. Does Vegeta stand a chance?

1.name: A Developed "Time Skip" Counterstrike? Here Comes Goku's New Move!
1.overview: The battle between Goku and Hit continues, however, Hit proves to be more formidable than anticipated.

1.name: A Decision at Last! Is the Winner Beerus? Or Is it Champa?
1.overview: The winner of the tournament between Universe 6 and 7 is decided!

1.name: Come Forth, Divine Dragon! And Grant My Wish, Peas and Carrots!
1.overview: As the winners of the Tournament Universe 7 are given the Super Dragon Balls and make summon the Dragon for their wish.

1.name: A Chaotic Victory Party! Showdown at Last?! Monaka vs. Goku!
1.overview: The Tournament may be over, but Goku still wants to battle Monaku to see how really strong he is. While Beers and the rest of Dragon Ball Cast try and keep his secret hidden from Goku.

1.name: Goku's Energy Is Out of Control?! The Struggle to Look After Pan
1.overview: Pan is kidnapped thought to be defenseless by her captors, but as it turned out, the plan backfired.

1.name: The Seal of Planet Pot-au-feu; Secrets of the Unleashed Superhuman Water!
1.overview: While Monaka delivers super sweets of the Galaxy to Bulma, Trunks and Goten end up locking themselves in his truck. Finding trouble on a planet Pot-au-feu, Where Vegeta and Jaco have to go and rescue them.

1.name: Vegeta Disappears?! Menace of the Duplicate Vegeta!
1.overview: With Vegeta losing all of his power to the copy of himself that was made from Superhuman Water, it is up to Goten and Trunks to defeat him. Mean while Goku is back at full health and training at Kaio's planet.

1.name: Goku vs. the Duplicate Vegeta! Which One Is Going to Win?
1.overview: The battle between Goku and Duplicate Vegeta Continues. Will Goku defeat the copy in time to save Vegeta?

1.name: SOS from the Future: A Dark New Enemy Appears!
1.overview: In the timeline of Future Trunks, a new enemy appears that requires him to return to the past and get help from the Z-Fighters.

1.name: Hope!! Redux: Awaken in the Present, Trunks
1.overview: Much to everyone's surprise, a war-torn and unconscious Future Trunks arrives in the past after evading Black.

1.name: A Message from the Future - The Incursion of Goku Black!
1.overview: After awakening in the present, Future Trunks mistakes Goku for his evil look-alike Black.

1.name: Goku vs. Black! A Closed-Off Road to the Future
1.overview: Goku Black invades from Trunks' future! Excited to fight a strong opponent, Goku immediately challenges him to one-on-one combat, but Goku Black isn't taking the fight seriously?!

1.name: Feelings That Transcend Time: Trunks and Mai
1.overview: Bulma finds the Time Machine that Cell used to travel to the past and promptly gathers the team to repair it. Future Trunks and Mai discuss their counterparts from alternate timelines.

1.name: Master and Pupil Reunited! Gohan and "Future" Trunks!
1.overview: Piccolo mentions that Gohan decided to abandon his training to become a scholar, which suprised Future Trunks. Piccolo and Kuririn suggest that Future Trunks should meet their timeline's Gohan.

1.name: Uncover Black's Identity! Off to the 10th Universe's World of the Kai's!
1.overview: Goku, Beerus, and Whis arrive in Universe Ten. They meet the Supreme Kai Gowasu and his apprentice Zamasu.

1.name: He Who Is of Saiyan Blood: Trunks's Resolve
1.overview: Vegeta wants to test Future Trunks' power to see how strong his son had become.

1.name: I'd Like to See Goku, You See; A Summons From Grand Zeno!
1.overview: Whis and Beerus are worried over Zen-Oh's request to meet Goku and what it could mean for their universe.

1.name: Rematch with Goku Black! Enter Super Saiyan Rosé
1.overview: Goku and Vegeta appear in the future to fight Goku Black, but they find that he has developed a new power.

1.name: A God with an Invincible Body - The Advent of Zamasu
1.overview: Zamasu appears unexpectedly from the sky. He states that he and Goku Black are "kindred spirits" who want a world without mortals.

1.name: Zamasu and Black - The Duo's Mystery Deepens
1.overview: Defeated, Son Goku, Vegeta and Trunks travel to the present, in order to find a way to defeat Zamasu. We also witness a developing relating to the mystery between Black and Zamasu.

1.name: Protect the Supreme Kai Gowasu - Destroy Zamasu!
1.overview: Goku, Beerus and Whis must save Gowasu from his treacherous apprentice.

1.name: Into the Future Again - Goku Black's True Identity Revealed!
1.overview: Trunks returns to the future, with Goku and his parents accompanying him. There they discover Goku Black still lives, and he explains how he defied space and time to exist.

1.name: Zamasu's Ambition – The Storied "Project 0 Mortals" of Terror
1.overview: Goku, Vegeta and Future Trunks fight Black and Zamasu in the future. Black explains his true identity.

1.name: I Will Defend the World! Trunks' Furious Burst of Super Power!
1.overview: With his new found power, Trunks attempts to hold off Black and Zamasu. Meanwhile, Goku and Vegeta head back to the past to try come up with a new strategy.

1.name: Don't You Disgrace Saiyan Cells! Vegeta's Fierce Battle Commences!
1.overview: Trunks wakes up in a rebel base only to find out that Mai set off on her own in an attempt to take out Black. Will he make it in time to save her?

1.name: Worship Me! Give Praise Unto Me! The Explosive Birth of a Merged Zamasu!
1.overview: As the battle rages on in the future, Bulma and Trunks devise a plan to take down Zamasu, meanwhile, Vegeta shows his new-found strength while taking on Goku Black.

1.name: Final Judgement? The Ultimate Power of an Absolute God
1.overview: The two zamasu fuse and become the ultimate god. Meanwhile Vegeta, Goku and others are stunned and try to somehow defeat the eternal god.

1.name: Showdown! The Miraculous Power of Unyielding Warriors
1.overview: After Goku's attack shakes Zamazu's balance and reveal a weakness in him, he and Vegeta fuse together as they see hope to prevail. Nevertheless, It's Trunks's world and to him it all ultimately comes down.

1.name: With New Hope in His Heart - Farewell, Trunks
1.overview: Zamasu makes one final almighty move to destroy the universe, but Goku brings out a forgotten but all-powerful ally to stop him.

1.name: Come Forth, Shenron! Whose Wish Will Be Granted?
1.overview: Goku decides to summon Shenron to honor a promise, but his friends have things they want to wish for too.

1.name: Goku vs. Arale! An Off-the-Wall Battle Spells the End of the Earth?
1.overview: Goku and the android girl Arale Norimaki meet after many years, in a fun-filled episode where the cast of Dr Slump and DBZ meet.

1.name: A Challenge from Champa! This Time, a Baseball Game!
1.overview: Chanpa returns, and offers a baseball game between him and Beerus.

1.name: Goku Dies! An Assassination That Must Be Executed!
1.overview: Hit gets a contract to kill Goku, and prepares his assassination.

1.name: Will He Strike Back? The Unseen Killing Technique!
1.overview: Goku manages to come back to life, but he seeks a fight with Hit. And who is the client who put Hit to fight Goku?

1.name: Gohan's Plight! The Preposterous Great Saiyaman Film Adaptation?!
1.overview: A film of the Great Saiyaman is to be made, and Gohan is to be in it - to his chagrin, as a stuntman.

1.name: For My Beloved Ones! The Indomitable Great Saiyaman!
1.overview: Barry Kahn's attempts to sabotage Gohan get lethal when the alien parasite Watagash takes control of him.

1.name: Goku and Krillin! Back to the Old Familiar Training Ground!
1.overview: Krillin decides to train with Goku after a police battle goes bad, but can he match up to the Saiyan's level?

1.name: Conquer the Terrifying Foes! Krillin's Fighting Spirit Rebounds!
1.overview: Goku and Krillin fight against their old enemies such as Frieza and Cell in a form of nightmares in a mystical forest Master Roshi sent them to in order to fetch him a special herb.

1.name: Let's Do It, Grand Zeno! The Universes' Best Tournament!!
1.overview: Goku goes and sees Zen-O to get the Tournament of Power going.

1.name: Even the Universes' Gods are Appalled?! The Lose-and-Perish Tournament of Power
1.overview: Goku gets an invitation to the Tournament of Power, an epic tournament between universes.

1.name: The 9th Universe's Kicking Basil vs. the 7th Universe's Majin Buu!!
1.overview: Majin Buu and Basil the Kicker continue to give Zen-Chan a show while they unravel the fight.

1.name: Awaken Your Dormant Fighting Spirit! Gohan's Fight!
1.overview: With Majin Buu and Basil's battle concluded, Gohan is the next warrior of Universe 7 to fight. The rusty warrior's opponent is Universe 9's Lavendar. Lavender, however, has a trick up his sleeve.

1.name: Bergamo the Crusher vs. Goku! Whose Strength Reaches the Wild Blue Yonder?
1.overview: The greatest fighters of Universes 7 and 9, Goku and Bergamo, face off.

1.name: Goku Must Pay; The Warrior of Justice Top Barges In!
1.overview: After Goku won his battle against Bergamo, Toppo from Universe 11 challenges Goku for a fight.

1.name: Field the All-7th-Universe Team! Who are the Mighty Ten?
1.overview: With the Zen-O Exhibition Match concluded and 48 hours until the Tournament of Power, Goku and Gohan search for the 10 warriors needed to complete Universe 7's team.

1.name: Goku the Talent Scout; Recruit Krillin and Android 18
1.overview: Goku and Gohan recruit Krillin to join the Tournament of Power.

1.name: The Universes Go into Action -- Each with Their Own Motives
1.overview: Goku searches for Majin Buu, as the Supreme Kais of each universe hold a secret meeting without Universe 7.

1.name: First Time Exchanging Blows! Android 17 vs. Goku!!
1.overview: Goku travels to an isolated wildlife preserve run by Android 17, and attempts to recruit him for the Tournament of Power.

1.name: Hunt the Poaching Ring! Goku and Android 17's Joint Struggle!
1.overview: Goku helps Android 17 pursue poachers from outer space.

1.name: Gohan and Piccolo Master and Pupil Clash in Max Training!
1.overview: In preparation for the tournament, Piccolo trains Gohan so that he may awaken the power he had long ago.

1.name: A Mysterious Beauty Appears! The Enigma of the Tien Shin-Style Dojo?
1.overview: Goku arrives at the dojo run by Tienshinhan to recruit him for the Tournament of Power.

1.name: Staring Down the Wall to be Overcome; Goku vs. Gohan
1.overview: Gohan tests his powers he rediscovered in an exhibition match against Goku. Gohan forces Goku to transform into Super Sayan God Blue.

1.name: Which Universe Will Win Their Place? The Mighty Warriors Gradually Assemble!
1.overview: The Warriors that are participating in the tournament are gathering while the tournament draws near other universes are gathering their warriors too.

1.name: A State of Emergency! Failure to Reach Ten Members!
1.overview: While each of the Universes prepare for the Tournament of Power in their own ways, Universe 7 gets in a pinch when they learn Majin Buu will be unable to enter the competition.

1.name: You're Our Tenth Warrior! Goku Approaches Frieza!!
1.overview: In a desperate move to keep the roster for the Tournament, Goku decides to revive his archenemy Frieza so he can compete.

1.name: The Evil Emperor Returns! A Reception from Mysterious Assassins?
1.overview: Frieza is resurrected. However, a group of assassins come for him and Goku.

1.name: Most Heinous! Most Evil! Frieza's Rampage!
1.overview: Frieza goes on a rampage against the assassins sent to take him out. But if he takes too long, Universe 7 is disqualified and erased from the Tournament.

1.name: The Time Has Come! To the Null Realm with the Universes on the Line!
1.overview: The Tournament of Power is finally about to begin. Goku and the rest of the team head to the World of Void, site of the battle stage.

1.name: Survive! The Tournament of Power Begins at Last!
1.overview: The 80 warriors assemble in the fighting arena in the World of Void and the curtain rises on the battle for survival.

1.name: Ah, the Uncertainty! A Universe Despairs!
1.overview: The Universe 7 team is hit by a concentrated attack from the other universes.

1.name: Show Them! Krillin's Underlying Strength!
1.overview: The Universes get a taste of what it's like to be erased, after universe 9 is wiped out of existence, Krillin begins showcasing his newly-found powers. Universe 7 loses it's first participant.

1.name: Rampage! A Crazed Warrior's Savagery Awakens!
1.overview: Kale unleashes her berserk Saiyan ability, but endangers her fellow teammates.

1.name: Warriors of Justice Close In! The Pride Troopers!
1.overview: The Pride Troopers of Universe 11 launch an assault on Goku's team.

1.name: The Power of Love Explodes? The 2nd Universe's Witchy Warriors!
1.overview: The Universe 2 lady fighters make their move.

1.name: Gohan, Get Ruthless! Showdown with the 10th Universe!
1.overview: Gohan goes up against Universe 10 warriors.

1.name: A Transcendent Light-Speed Battle Erupts! Goku and Hit's United Front!
1.overview: Hit and Dispo begin to fight at the speed of light. Hit is disadvantaged when Goku comes to help.

1.name: A Valiant Fight! Master Roshi's Blaze of Glory!
1.overview: Master Roshi takes on the fighters of Universe 4.

1.name: Find them Out! Deathmatch with a Furtive Attacker!
1.overview: An unknown sniper with incredible aim launches a stealth attack in the Tournament.

1.name: Revenge "F"! A Cunning Trap Is Set?
1.overview: Frost recalls how Champa promised to pardon his crimes if he humiliated and defeated Universe 7.

1.name: Frieza and Frost! A Mutual Malevolence?
1.overview: As Gohan Struggles, Freeza and Frost appear... together they approach Gohan! What!?

1.name: The Mightiest Enemy Zeroes In on Goku! Launch the Knockout Spirit Bomb Now!
1.overview: The Tournament of Power is now half over, and Jiren finally attacks.  Goku is forced to Super Saiyan Blue to keep pace with the overwhelming power of the 11th Universes most powerful warrior.

1.name: Goku Enkindled! The Awakened One's New Ultra Instinct!
1.overview: After a surprise counter by Jiren, Goku disappears inside the blast of his spirit bomb. Will this be the end for Universe 7?!

1.name: An Extra-Dimensional Ultimate Battle! Hit vs. Jiren!
1.overview: Hit uses his time-skip powers against Jiren and pools all his energy in a final attack to defeat him. Is this the end of Jiren?!

1.name: A Saiyan Oath! Vegeta's Resolve!
1.overview: Vegeta and Cabba stand to face Monna from Universe 4 to show the power of the proud warrior race.

1.name: With Great Joy! The Fighting Freak Saiyans' Battle Rejoined!
1.overview: Exhausted from his battle with jiren, Goku and Caulifla fight.  Goku doesn’t have the strength to transform into a Super Saiyan yet, but he slowly gains his strength back during their fight.

1.name: Bloodcurdling! The Explosive Birth of a New Super Warrior!
1.overview: Kale controls that fierce power and becomes a true legendary Super Saiyan!

1.name: Goku vs. Kefla! Super Saiyan Blue Beaten?
1.overview: Kefla was born from the Potara fusion.  Her power and speed are unbelievable!  Goku has to fight Kefla using his Blue Kiao Ken in the Ultimate Saiyan showdown!

1.name: Signs of a Turnabout! The Autonomous Ultra Instinct Erupts!
1.overview: Goku unleashes stupendous ki.  In his battle with Kafla, he has once more reached Ultra Instinct.  His body unconsciously dodges Kafla's attacks, which triggers her to launch an even fiercer assault.  Then after avoiding her attack, Goku fires a Kamehameha at point-blank range!

1.name: Showdown of Love! The Androids vs. the 2ⁿᵈ Universe!
1.overview: Ribrianne targets Goku right as he's worn out from an intense battle!  But then 17 and 18 appear!  18 takes Goku's place and challenges Ribrianne to one-on-one combat, while 17 takes on Rozie.  Can the two of them prevail against Universe 2's strongest?!

1.name: Accelerating Tragedy - Vanishing Universes
1.overview: Gohan and Piccolo's tough fight!  Gohan and Piccolo struggle against the desperate attacks of Universe 6's final warriors, Saonel and Pirina!  Piccolo therefore thinks up a method of attack their opponents won't expect.

1.name: Unavoidable? The Ferocity of a Stealth Attack!
1.overview: The Tournament of Power Continues and Universe 7 takes on Universe 4.

1.name: A Perfect Survival Strategy! The 3ʳᵈ Universe's Menacing Assassin!
1.overview: Universe 3's Menacing Assassins attack Universe 7.

1.name: All-Out War! The Ultimate Four-Fold Union vs. the 7ᵗʰ Universe's Total Offensive!
1.overview: Universe 7's all-out war begins with the quadruple Merge from Universe 3 named Aniraza. Goku and all his team members take on the new opponent.

1.name: With His Pride on the Line! Vegeta's Challenge to Be the Strongest!
1.overview: With 7 minutes remaining the fight to determine who will survive, Vegeta challenges the strongest warrior Jiren.  What!?

1.name: Body, Soul and Power Unleashed! Goku and Vegeta!
1.overview: Vegeta puts his full power in display against the mighty warrior Jiren of Universe 11, but can he hold his ground against him?

1.name: A Storm-and-Stress Assault! Gohan's Last Stand!
1.overview: Frieza is about to eliminate Dyspo, but Dyspo suddenly shows his true power. Can Universe 7 be able to defeat this warrior with Lightning Speed?

1.name: A Commanding Presence! The Advent of Top the Destroyer!
1.overview: The Battle continues between Toppo and Android 17 but Toppo displays the power of a God of Destruction. Can this obstacle be destroyed?

1.name: Surpass Even a God! Vegeta's Sacrifice Strike!
1.overview: Vegeta displays his full power against Toppo in this high heated Match. Can Vegeta be able to defeat him with his Final Trick?

1.name: The Approaching Wall! A Hopeful Final Barrier!
1.overview: Android 17, Vegeta, Goku and Frieza maximize their struggle to defeat Jiren. Jiren releases his hidden power that surprises everyone. Android 17 shows Jiren his bravery and tries to mentally steer him into defeat. 17, protects Vegeta and Goku from a lethal attack from Jiren.

1.name: To the Noble, Proud End! Vegeta Falls!
1.overview: While Goku tries to master the Ultra Instinct, Vegeta still fights Jiren with everything he's got.

1.name: A Transcendent Limit Break! Autonomous Ultra Instinct Mastered!
1.overview: A super heated battle for survival continues. With Jiren puttin Goku on the ropes even after he awakens ultra instict Goku surrpasses his limits once again by mastering the ultra instict.

1.name: The Greatest Showdown of All Time! The Ultimate Survival Battle!
1.overview: The climactic battle to decide the fate of Universe 7 continues as Goku, now mastering Ultra Instinct, fights Jiren at his full power.

1.name: A Miraculous Conclusion! Farewell Goku! Until We Meet Again!
1.overview: The Tournament of Power reaches its final climactic moment, as Goku, Frieza and 17 have to eliminate Jiren for the survival of Universe 7.

1.name: Prologue to Battle! The Return of Goku!
1.overview: Goku is a legendary warrior and the strongest fighter on the planet, but he's about to encounter a foe from outofthisworld. What brings this new menace to Earth? And what's up with his tail?

1.name: The Enemy Is Goku's Brother?! The Secret of the Mighty Saiyan Warriors!
1.overview: When Raditz abducts Gohan and announces his plans to conquer Earth, Goku and Piccolo are forced into an uneasy alliance. The two rivals don't trust each other, but neither of them can defeat the Saiyan on their own!

1.name: A Life or Death Battle! Goku and Piccolo's Desperate Attack!
1.overview: Despite the fury of their attacks, Goku and Piccolo are unable to land a death blow in their battle against Raditz. Gohan's unexpected outburst manages to weaken the powerful Saiyan, but it may be too little, too late.

1.name: Run in the Afterlife, Goku! The One Million Mile Snake Way!
1.overview: Now that he's dead, Goku must fight to survive in the afterlife, especially during his treacherous trek down Snake Way. Back on Earth, Gohan endures his own punishment as a student in the house of Piccolo!

1.name: Wilderness Survival! A Moonlit Night Awakens Gohan!
1.overview: Piccolo tries to toughen up Gohan with some wilderness survival training, but things get hairy when the young Saiyan sees his first full moon! Meanwhile, Yajirobe summons Earth's strongest fighters to Kami's Lookout.

1.name: The End of Snake Way! King Kai's Bizarre Test!
1.overview: As the deadly Saiyan invaders approach Earth, Gohan makes slow, but steady, progress under the watchful eye of Piccolo, and Goku struggles with the "gravity" of his training under King Kai.

1.name: The Battle with Ten-Times Gravity! Goku's Race Against the Clock!
1.overview: To prove himself worthy of King Kai's training, Goku must test his mettle against a fleetfooted monkey and a powerful cricket that's big on respect. Meanwhile, in the land of the living, Gohan takes a beating from his monstrous master!

1.name: Shenron Appears! The Saiyans Arrive Sooner than Expected!
1.overview: Goku's training under King Kai is finally complete, and he's eager to return to Earth. Master Roshi uses the Dragon Balls to summon Shenron, but will Goku make it back in time to stop the Saiyans?

1.name: Yamcha's Struggle! The Terrible Saibamen!
1.overview: The Saiyans have arrived, Goku isn't even on the planet, and the overmatched ZFighters represent Earth's last line of defense. When Vegeta and Nappa unleash the gruesome Saibamen, Yamcha picks a fight that could be his last!

1.name: Sit Tight, Chiaotzu! Tien's Screaming Tri-Beam!
1.overview: Krillin's furious attack wipes out the Saibamen, but the ZFighters are powerless against the Saiyan warlords. One by one, Earth's defenders suffer devastating injuries or fall in battle. Goku's return is their only hope for survival.

1.name: Will Goku Make It in Time?! Three Hours Until the Battle Resumes!
1.overview: Piccolo hatches a desperate plan to prolong the battle until Goku's arrival. When Vegeta senses an awesome source of power approaching, he orders Nappa to dispose of remaining ZFighters starting with Gohan!

1.name: Farewell, Piccolo! Goku's Furious Counterattack!
1.overview: Goku arrives in time to save Gohan and Krillin, and the resurrected warrior is eager to put the hurt on Nappa. When it becomes clear that Goku is no ordinary fighter, Prince Vegeta steps in to finish the fight himself!

1.name: The Power of the Kaio-Ken! Goku vs. Vegeta!
1.overview: The stage is set for a final showdown between Vegeta and Goku. The Saiyan Prince is stronger, faster, and far more ruthless. Goku's only hope for victory is a technique that may very well destroy him!

1.name: An All-Out Kamehame-Ha! Vegeta's Terrible Transformation!
1.overview: Vegeta can’t handle the fury of Goku’s triple Kaio-Ken technique, so the Saiyan warlord unleashes his inner ape. Weakened by his furious onslaught, Goku’s only hope to defeat the beast is the mighty Spirit Bomb!

1.name: Goku on the Ropes! Pin Your Hopes on the Spirit Bomb!
1.overview: As Goku lies exhausted and vulnerable on the field of battle, Gohan and Krillin take aim at Vegeta’s only weakness: his tail! If they can take the ape out of the fight, they might have a chance to escape with their lives.

1.name: Defeat the Invincible Vegeta! Work a Miracle, Gohan!
1.overview: Krillin and Gohan team up to blast Vegeta with a Spirit Bomb, but the Saiyan prince refuses to die. Things look bad for the Z-Fighters until Yajirobe distracts the enemy long enough for Gohan to undergo a transformation of his own!

1.name: Dawn of a Fierce Battle! The Star of Hope Is Piccolo's Homeland!
1.overview: Vegeta has been defeated, but there’s no time to celebrate. The Z-Fighters must find a way to resurrect the friends who died stopping the Saiyan invasion. Fortunately for the fallen, Krillin has a plan!

1.name: The Ship Resting in Yunzabit! Time to Blast Off for Planet Namek!
1.overview: Preparations for the journey to Namek hit a snag when Bulma accidentally blows up the remaining Saiyan spaceship. Mr. Popo may know of another vessel, so he and Bulma travel to the Earth’s end for a closer look.

1.name: A Powerful New Foe! Frieza, Ruler of the Universe!
1.overview: A bad case of space boredom makes Bulma a pain to share close quarters with, and Vegeta recovers from his injuries only to discover that Frieza has a head start on tracking down the magic Dragon Balls!

1.name: The Rebellion Against Frieza! Vegeta's Burning Ambition!
1.overview: Gohan and Krillin beat up on Frieza’s henchmen, but their spaceship is destroyed in the process. Vegeta is headed for a showdown with Cui, and the shrewd Saiyan is keeping his true power level under wraps!

1.name: Protect the Dragon Balls! The Namekians' All-Out Attack!
1.overview: Goku blasts off in a brand new spaceship specially equipped with a device designed to help increase his strength! On Namek, Krillin and Gohan watch in horror as Frieza’s men slaughter innocent Namekians.

1.name: Dodoria's Terrifying Chase! A Truth Revealed to Vegeta!
