1.overview: Gohan and Krillin risk their lives to rescue a young Namekian, and Vegeta goes on the rampage after learning the truth about the destruction of his home planet!

1.name: Vegeta's Covert Maneuvers! A Tragic Assault on the Namekians!
1.overview: After easily defeating Dodoria, Vegeta begins his violent search for the two remaining Dragon Balls. Meanwhile, Krillin and his new friend Dende set out to warn the eldest Namekian of the horror headed his way!

1.name: Friends Reborn! Zarbon's Hideous Transformation!
1.overview: King Kai telepathically "phones" Goku with a warning to stay as far away from Frieza as possible! Back on Namek, Vegeta is shocked to discover how much a simple transformation can increase Zarbon’s power.

1.name: Power Up, Krillin! Frieza's Mounting Apprehension!
1.overview: The eldest Namekian unlocks the full force of Krillin's dormant power, so the bald brawler can better protect his Dragon Ball. Elsewhere, a Saiyan-related premonition prompts Frieza to call for reinforcements.

1.name: The Scheme Is Shattered! Vegeta Strikes Back at Zarbon!
1.overview: Vegeta lays it on the line in a daring attempt to steal the Dragon Balls right out from under Frieza’s nose. Krillin’s riding high on a Namekian power surge, but he’s about to wander into a dogfight he can’t survive!

1.name: To You, in 2000 Years: The Fall of Shiganshina (1)
1.overview: After one hundred years of peace, humanity is suddenly reminded of the terror of being at the Titans' mercy.

1.name: That Day: The Fall of Shiganshina (2)
1.overview: After the Titans break through the wall, the citizens of Shiganshina must run for their lives. However, those that do make it to safety find a harsh life waiting for them.

1.name: A Dim Light Amid Despair: Humanity's Comeback (1)
1.overview: Eren begins his training with the Cadet Corps, but questions about his painful past overwhelm him. When he struggles with a maneuvering exercise, Bertolt and Reiner offer kindly advice.

1.name: The Night of the Closing Ceremony: Humanity's Comeback (2)
1.overview: Two years pass and the time for the recruits' graduation approaches. Annie proves her skill in a sparring session, Jean dreams of serving alongside the King, and graduation day brings shocking revelations — along with the sudden appearance of an old foe.

1.name: First Battle: The Struggle for Trost (1)
1.overview: Five years have passed since the fall of Wall Maria and Eren faces off against the Colossal Titan after it appears out of nowhere once again, and knocks a strategic hole in the gate of Wall Rose. As Titans swarm the city, the newly graduated Cadets are called in to fight a brutal battle that won't be without casualties.

1.name: The World the Girl Saw: The Struggle for Trost (2)
1.overview: Armin tries to cope with the loss of his friends and allies after Titans massacre his squad. Elsewhere in the city, Mikasa manages to take out several of the monsters, which brings back tragic memories of her past and the first time she met Eren.

1.name: Small Blade: The Struggle for Trost (3)
1.overview: After the retreat bell sounds, many cadets find themselves without enough fuel to scale the wall back to safety. Mikasa begins to lose hope once she hears of the deaths in Armin's squad, but the appearance of a new type of Titan stokes her will to fight.

1.name: I Can Hear His Heartbeat: The Struggle for Trost (4)
1.overview: Armin comes up with a risky plan that pits Titan against Titan as the abandoned cadets attempt to take back their headquarters. Getting into the building might be possible, but getting out alive and refueled will mean facing more of the giants.

1.name: Whereabouts of His Left Arm: The Struggle for Trost (5)
1.overview: A miraculous return is met with anger and fear. Cannons are fixed on Eren as he struggles to remember what happened to him inside the belly of a Titan and how he ended up as humankind's enemy. One question is all that matters: is Eren human or Titan?

1.name: Response: The Struggle for Trost (6)
1.overview: Cadets respond to Eren's terrifying transformation with doubt and fear as he struggles to understand it himself. If Armin can’t talk the commander into using Eren’s newfound powers for the good of humankind, all hope of stopping the Titans might be lost.

1.name: Idol: The Struggle for Trost (7)
1.overview: Plans are made to use Eren's Titan powers to seal the hole in the wall in an attempt reclaim Trost. But with the government's bloodstained history and vocal dissenters in the military ranks, the biggest threat to humankind may not be the Titans.

1.name: Wound: The Struggle for Trost (8)
1.overview: The plan to reclaim Trost falls apart when Eren's newfound powers turn him into a mindless giant. As Titans continue to swarm the city, it's up to Armin and Mikasa to make sure the cadets massacred during the mission haven't died in vain.

1.name: Primal Desire: The Struggle for Trost (9)
1.overview: Jean takes desperate measures to replace his broken Maneuver Gear. Meanwhile, Eren is able to seal the hole in the wall thanks to the help of his fellow cadets, but the cost of humanity's first victory against the Titans will be enormous.

1.name: Can't Look into His Eyes Yet: Eve of the Counterattack (1)
1.overview: A special military tribunal will decide Eren's fate. The Military Police calls for his execution while the Recon Corps argues that he is a powerful resource for humankind, and Mikasa is put on the spot when asked about the events of the Trost mission.

1.name: Special Operations Squad: Eve of the Counterattack (2)
1.overview: The Recon Corps moves Eren to an old abandoned castle where he will continue his training. Hange visits and reveals that she's been putting two captured Titans through a series of tests and trials — experiments that she wants Eren's help with.

1.name: What Needs to Be Done Now: Eve of the Counterattack (3)
1.overview: Everyone is a suspect in the investigation to find out who killed the two test-subject Titans. Meanwhile, the cadets pick which military branch they'll be joining, but after the harrowing events in the Trost attack, many are uncertain which branch to choose.

1.name: Female Titan: The 57th Exterior Scouting Mission (1)
1.overview: As the Recon Corps begins its push toward Shiganshina, they encounter an intelligent Female Titan unlike any they've seen before. When Armin hypothesizes that it's really a human that's been turned into a Titan, he, Jean, and Reiner attempt to stop it.

1.name: Forest of Giant Trees: The 57th Exterior Scouting Mission (2)
1.overview: As the Female Titan continues to tear its way through the Recon Corps, Levi makes a bold decision to split the ranks and send Eren and the supply wagons through a huge forest. Is his strategy genius, or does it spell certain death for the scouts?

1.name: Bite: The 57th Exterior Scouting Mission (3)
1.overview: With the Female Titan still chasing after Levi's squad, Eren considers turning himself into his Titan form, but Levi tells him to choose to be either a monster or a member of the Recon Corps. As Eren remembers what he has learned from the squad, he realizes that the danger and sacrifice they all share is not what binds them — it is trust. Now it is up to Eren to make the decision of who he will trust.

1.name: Erwin Smith: The 57th Exterior Scouting Mission (4)
1.overview: With the help of Levi's squad, the Recon Corps has successfully captured the Female Titan. As Commander Erwin and Captain Levi begin preparations to extract whoever is inside the Titan, will the Recon Corps discover its true identity, or does the Female Titan have one last trick up its sleeve?

1.name: Crushing Blow: The 57th Exterior Scouting Mission (5)
1.overview: After a last act of desperation, the person inside the Female Titan has escaped from the Recon Corps and reverted to their human form. Now, disguised as a member of the Recon Corps and equipped with Maneuver Gear, they finally catch up to their prey — Levi's squad.

1.name: The Defeated: The 57th Exterior Scouting Mission (6)
1.overview: The Female Titan has captured Eren after ripping him out of his Titan body, but Mikasa and Captain Levi give chase. Elsewhere, the Recon Corps begins preparations for the journey back home to the Wall with their numerous dead in tow.

1.name: Smile: Assault on Stohess (1)
1.overview: Following the disastrous results of the 57th Expedition, Eren is to be brought to the King’s palace for a court martial. Armin, desperate to save Eren from certain execution, enlists the help of an old friend to assist with an escape plan.

1.name: Mercy: Assault on Stohess (2)
1.overview: With the identity of the Female Titan now revealed, Eren has reservations about fighting her. Mikasa, Armin, and the rest of the Recon Corps try to fight the Female Titan, hoping to distract her long enough to buy Eren time to come to terms with his feelings.

1.name: Wall: Assault on Stohess (3)
1.overview: Eren, spurred on by his promise to kill every single Titan, unleashes the full power of his Titan form in the fight with the Female Titan. As their bloody battle draws to a close, it seems humanity may finally have a chance at survival. However, with many mysteries still left unsolved, what will await Eren, Mikasa, and Armin?

1.name: Homecoming
1.overview: A figure passes through the gates. It's an older Naruto, who has returned from a long training journey with Jiraiya. Naruto Uzumaki is back!

1.name: The Akatsuki Makes Its Move
1.overview: Naruto and Sakura team up and challenge Kakashi to a survival challenge to show off their progress.

1.name: The Results of Training
1.overview: Naruto’s and Sakura’s combined skills force Kakashi to use his Sharingan right off the bat. Naruto masterfully unleashes his jutsu one after another.

1.name: The Jinchuriki of the Sand
1.overview: Gaara is quick to detect Deidara’s presence, and an aerial battle ensues with Deidara on his giant bird and Gaara atop sand.

1.name: The Kazekage Stands Tall
1.overview: Naruto and Sakura defeat Kakashi in the survival challenge. Tsunade assigns them to a three-man squad led by Kakashi, who tells them they are now his equals.

1.name: Mission Cleared
1.overview: In order to protect his village from Deidara’s explosive clay, Gaara uses his chakra to create a giant sand shield.

1.name: Run, Kankuro
1.overview: Gaara, his strength completely exhausted, is whisked away by Deidara. Kankuro ignores Baki’s efforts to stop him and immediately sets out in pursuit with a platoon to rescue Gaara.

1.name: Team Kakashi, Deployed
1.overview: An urgent message from the Sand Village detailing the Akatsuki’s kidnapping of the Kazekage reaches the Hidden Leaf Village. Tsunade wastes no time in ordering Team Kakashi to the Sand Village.

1.name: The Jinchuriki's Tears
1.overview: On her way to the Sand Village, Temari encounters Kakashi and his team. Kakashi admonishes Naruto when he tries to rush ahead…

1.name: Sealing Jutsu: Nine Phantom Dragons
1.overview: The Sand ninja fight against time to treat Kankuro. Even the Sand’s poison expert, Granny Chiyo, is baffled. The only hope lies with the reinforcements sent by Tsunade.

1.name: The Medical Ninja's Student
1.overview: Sakura treats a critically ill Kankuro. After extensive training she’s now a full-fledged Medic Ninja, and Sakura amazes everyone with her sure, steady hands.

1.name: The Retired Granny's Determination
1.overview: Pakkun finds the hideout of the Akatsuki. Team Kakashi and Temari prepare to set out to get Gaara back, but Temari is ordered to stay behind and help guard the village.

1.name: A Meeting With Destiny
1.overview: Guy prepares to use a forbidden secret jutsu. Meanwhile, Naruto falls under Itachi’s genjutsu, and all the anti-genjutsu training he underwent with Jiraiya races through Naruto’s mind.

1.name: Naruto's Growth
1.overview: Guy prepares to use a forbidden secret jutsu. Meanwhile, Naruto falls under Itachi’s genjutsu, and all the anti-genjutsu training he underwent with Jiraiya races through Naruto’s mind.

1.name: The Secret Weapon is Called...
1.overview: Granny Chiyo and Sakura rescue Naruto from Itachi’s genjutsu. Without a moment’s delay, Kakashi begins a counterattack.

1.name: The Secret of Jinchuriki
1.overview: Chiyo and Kakashi realize that the attack was just a diversion, and that the Akatsuki have already begun the process of extracting the Tailed Beast from Gaara.

1.name: The Death of Gaara!
1.overview: Teams Kakashi and Guy take a short rest. Granny Chiyo watches Naruto dozing off and is reminded of Sasori as a child. The pursuit resumes, and when Chiyo wonders why Naruto puts such effort into...

1.name: Charge Tactic! Button Hook Entry!!
1.overview: Teams Kakashi and Guy reach the Akatsuki hideout. They hurry to infiltrate but are thwarted by a five-seal barrier. The only way to break the barrier is to remove all five seals at once.

1.name: Traps Activate! Team Guy's Enemy
1.overview: Breaking the five-seal barrier set off a trap, which now has Team Guy battling amazingly accurate copies of themselves. Back at the Akatsuki hideout, Deidara and Sasori struggle to take the Nine-Tail Jinchûriki.

1.name: Hiruko Vs. Two Kunoichi!
1.overview: At last, the showdown between the old woman and her grandson begins. Sakura is confused by Sasori’s strange appearance, and Granny Chiyo explains that this is Hiruko…

1.name: Sasori's Real Face
1.overview: Granny Chiyo and Sakura manage to expose Sasori, who amazingly looks no older than he did twenty years earlier.

1.name: Chiyo's Secret Skills
1.overview: Sakura is caught by Sasori’s tactic and surrounded by a poison cloud.

1.name: Father and Mother
1.overview: Chiyo and Sakura take cover, and Sasori wastes no time unleashing a ruthless attack.

1.name: The Third Kazekage
1.overview: Sakura counters the Iron Sand attack of the Third Kazekage puppet with superhuman strength.

1.name: Three Minutes Between Life and Death
1.overview: Sakura destroys the Third Kazekage puppet thanks to a secret antidote she had taken.

1.name: Puppet Fight: 10 vs. 100!
1.overview: Sakura and Granny Chiyo are engaged in a fierce battle with Sasori, who is able turn himself into a human puppet. They somehow bring Sasori down within the time limit, but he ends up reviving.

1.name: Impossible Dream
1.overview: Although stung with poison herself, Granny Chiyo uses the last of the antidote on Sakura. Mocking the tender scene between Granny Chiyo and Sakura, Sasori attempts to end Granny Chiyo's life.

1.name: Revival of the Beasts
1.overview: Team Guy senses the result of the Sakura and Granny Chiyo’s desperate struggle while still in battle with his deadly copy. Although Guy’s team members are showing fatigue, their copies remain strong!

1.name: Kakashi's Enlightened!
1.overview: Sakura hurries to get to Naruto with Granny Chiyo, who is suffering from the poison. The members of Team Guy rush to assist Team Kakashi. Meanwhile, with all preparations complete, Kakashi reveals his Mangekyo Sharingan.

1.name: Aesthetics of an Instant
1.overview: Naruto loses all reason to anger and is gradually taken over by the Nine-Tailed Fox Spirit. Having been forewarned by Jiraiya, Kakashi narrowly manages to suppress the Nine-Tailed Fox.

1.name: The Legacy
1.overview: Relying on Naruto's power, Granny Chiyo performs the Transmigration Jutsu on Gaara.

1.name: Return of the Kazekage
1.overview: Gaara and his rescuers make a triumphant return to the Hidden Sand Village.

1.name: The Day a New Demon was Born
1.overview: On August 10, 2010, a.t.b., Japan was conquered by the Holy Empire of Britannia. Seven years later, teenage student Lelouch Lamperouge finds himself pulled into a battle between anti-government terrorists and the Britannian Army in the Shinjuku Ghetto. In the midst of the conflict, a mysterious, green-haired girl saves him from death by granting him "the power of the king", which allows him to compel others to do his bidding.

1.name: The White Knight Awakens
1.overview: Using his newfound power, Lelouch hijacks an enemy Sutherland and leads the rebels in a counterattack against the Britannian army, forcing Viceroy Clovis la Britannia to call for the release of an experimental Knightmare Frame, the Lancelot, piloted by Suzaku Kururugi. The Lancelot proves to be far superior to the previous Knightmare Frame models and Lelouch is forced to change his plans. Just as the Britannian Army corners the terrorists, Prince Clovis orders an immediate cease-fire, as he is b

1.name: The False Classmate
1.overview: Lelouch confronts Clovis about the murder of his mother, Marianne vi Britannia, before killing him. When he returns to Ashford Academy, he discovers that Kallen Kōzuki, one of the terrorists he helped in Shinjuku, attends the same school. The limitations to his newfound power are also revealed to him when he attempts to question her then erase her memory, so he creates a cunning deception to ease her suspicions of his identity. When the death of Prince Clovis is announced in the media, it is Suz

1.name: His Name is Zero
1.overview: The Purist faction within the Britannian Army scapegoats Suzaku for Clovis' death, planning to use him as an excuse to rid the army of Honorary Britannians. Lelouch concocts a plan to save his childhood friend, with some help from Kallen and Kaname Ohgi, leader of Kallen's resistance group. Announcing himself publicly as Zero, Lelouch declares it was he who killed Clovis, and uses his power on Jeremiah Gottwald to force him to assist in Suzaku's rescue. In private, Lelouch offers Suzaku the oppo

1.name: The Princess and the Witch
1.overview: To Lelouch's surprise, C.C., the girl who gave him his power, is alive and now living in his residence. Suzaku, having been acquitted of all charges, accidentally meets Third Princess Euphemia li Britannia and ends up intervening in an internal Purist faction struggle. Meanwhile, Second Princess Cornelia li Britannia endeavors to take charge of Area 11 as Viceroy and bring Zero, now the Empire's number one enemy and most wanted man, to justice.

1.name: The Stolen Mask
1.overview: Suzaku transfers into Ashford Academy and faces the scorn of the Britannian students. Cornelia continues her hunt for Zero, destroying several rebel strongholds but finding no clues to his whereabouts. A stray cat slips into the Lamperouge residence on campus and takes off with Lelouch's Zero mask and a massive, comedic chase involving the entire student body follow. The Emperor of Britannia makes a speech during Prince Clovis' funeral on the virtues of inequality and the social battle for evolu

1.name: Attack Cornelia
1.overview: Cornelia sets a trap for Zero at the Saitama Ghetto as she begins to clear another resistance cell. Despite C.C. trying to stop him, Lelouch takes the bait and goes to the aid of the Saitama resistance. His plan falls apart from a combination of Cornelia's superior tactics and the resistance cell's dissimilar motivations. Lelouch is cornered and nearly discovered, but C.C. dons his Zero costume and distracts the Britannian Army, allowing Lelouch to escape. Lelouch blames his defeat on the undisc

1.name: The Black Knights
1.overview: A group from the Japan Liberation Front takes a hotel and its occupants hostage, including most of the Ashford Student council and a disguised Princess Euphemia. As such, Princess Cornelia cannot make a move against the hostage takers, which Lelouch realizes and takes advantage of. He mounts a rescue with Ohgi's resistance, using his knowledge of Euphemia to barter his way past Cornelia's blockade. As Lelouch speaks with the hostage takers, Suzaku sinks the floating hotel using the Lancelot. Usi

1.name: Refrain
1.overview: Told mostly from Kallen's perspective, her rocky relationship with her biological mother is revealed. The Black Knights are sent on a mission to take out the drug "Refrain", and find themselves to be popular among the Elevens. Kallen's mother is found among the Refrain users, and is arrested following the Black Knights' destruction of the drug stockpiles. Kallen promises to have changed the world by the time she is released.

1.name: Guren Dances
1.overview: Cornelia and the Britannian Army heads to Narita, hoping to destroy the remnants of the Japan Liberation Front. Lelouch has his Knights follow her in the hope of capturing her alive so he can question her about his mother's death. As the Britannian forces close in on the Front's headquarters, Kallen utilizes her new Knightmare Frame, the Guren Mk-II, to cause a massive landslide that takes out much of the Britannian forces.

1.name: Battle for Narita
1.overview: The Black Knights' assault on the Britannian Army in Narita proves successful, and Cornelia is cornered by Kallen and Lelouch. The army is pinned down by the Japan Liberation Front when they attempt to assist her. At Euphemia's request, Suzaku rushes onto the battlefield in the Lancelot to rescue Cornelia. He saves Cornelia and manages to corner Lelouch. C.C. comes to Lelouch's rescue by mentally traumatizing Suzaku, but is injured when Suzaku begins firing wildly. As he takes care of her, Lelou

1.name: The Messenger from Kyoto
1.overview: Zero and the core members of the Black Knights meet with Taizō Kirihara, one of the most powerful people in the Japanese underground and an acquaintance of Lelouch from his younger days at the Kururugi Shrine. Lelouch deftly displays his tactical prowess and wit before Taizō and reveals his true identity to the man to gain his trust and support. When Lelouch returns to Tokyo, Shirley informs him of her father's death, indirectly caused by Zero during the Battle of Narita.

1.name: Shirley at Gunpoint
1.overview: Kallen and Lelouch separately reflect upon the deaths of innocents in the Narita campaign. Shirley secretly follows Lelouch and witnesses the battle between the Japan Liberation Front and the Britannian Army, which Lelouch ends by detonating the Japan Liberation Front freighter as the Britannian Knightmares begin to board it, killing all personnel on board and giving the Black Knights the element of surprise. Suzaku attacks Lelouch, easily overpowering his weaker Burai with the Lancelot, forcing

1.name: Geass vs. Geass
1.overview: Lelouch believes Shirley may have discovered his identity as Zero, so he and C.C. pursue her to Narita. Ohgi explores the battlefield of the previous night, discovering the wounded Villetta Nu left for dead out of sight. Lelouch encounters Mao, a young man who also has the power of Geass. Mao uses his mind-reading power to play on Shirley's insecurities, manipulating her into shooting Lelouch, but she falters at the last moment and C.C. sends Mao away temporarily. Since Shirley is being torn apa

1.name: Cheering Mao
1.overview: C.C. explains her history with Mao, and how his inability to turn his Geass off drove him insane. An injured Villetta wakes up in Ohgi's apartment and he discovers she has selective amnesia. C.C. leaves Lelouch to take care of Mao herself, but Mao gains the upper hand when he incapacitates her. Lelouch utilizes his intellect to fool Mao and rescue C.C. from him, using the Britannian Police to surround and shoot Mao. Safe on a rooftop away from the scene, Lelouch affirms his contract with her, pr

1.name: Nunnally Held Hostage
1.overview: C.C. departs as a messenger to the Chinese Federation and Milly has a marriage interview with Lloyd Asplund, creator of the Lancelot. Mao returns to kidnap Lelouch's sister, Nunnally, and holds her hostage in the Ashford Academy sewers. Lelouch and Suzaku work together to rescue her, with Suzaku's physical adeptness and the clever use of Lelouch's Geass proving to be beyond Mao's planning. Before he can be arrested, Mao reveals that Suzaku killed his own father, and in return Lelouch silences hi

1.name: Knight
1.overview: An inauguration ceremony of Clovis' memorial art museum is being held, with Euphemia judging the art works. Lelouch agrees to help Kyoshiro Tohdoh's comrades rescue their leader and Shirley finds an old crumpled letter detailing her previous knowledge of Zero's identity. During the rescue mission, Lelouch convinces Tohdoh to join the Black Knights. The Lancelot appears and attempts to stop them, but Lelouch is able to predict its movements and plan a counterattack. When Tohdoh slices open the co

1.name: I Order you, Suzaku Kururugi
1.overview: As Euphemia knights Suzaku, Lelouch establishes the hierarchy of the Black Knights. Diethard Reid suggests assassinating Suzaku, but Lelouch has other plans for him. He launches a plan to disable and capture Suzaku and the Lancelot at a Britannia military base on Shikinejima. The plan almost succeeds, but Second Prince Schneizel el Britannia appears and orders his floating battleship, the Avalon, to bombard the island.

1.name: Island of the Gods
1.overview: The aftermath of the Avalon's arrival inexplicably leaves Lelouch, Euphemia, Kallen, and Suzaku on the island of Kaminejima. Suzaku encounters Kallen while Euphemia is found by Zero. Suzaku learns Kallen is a Black Knight and pilot of the Guren Mk-II, and in turn tells her about how he killed his father. Euphemia confirms her suspicions that Lelouch is Zero. Schneizel, Lloyd, and Cécile Croomy survey the island's ancient ruins. When Lelouch, Kallen, Suzaku, and Euphemia suddenly fall into the ru

1.name: Battle for  Kyushu
1.overview: The Britannian Army fights back against the Kyūshū invaders with the Lancelot. Meanwhile, Nina meets Princess Euphemia and inadvertently gives Euphemia peace of mind about her feelings for Suzaku. As Suzaku becomes cornered when his Lancelot's battery runs out, Euphemia encourages Suzaku to fight on and live. Zero and C.C. fly into the battlefield in the Gawain to recharge the Lancelot, and the two Knightmares end the Kyūshū campaign together.

1.name: The School Festival Declaration
1.overview: The Ashford Academy holds their annual school festival. Ohgi, Villeta, Euphemia, and Kallen all make their separate ways to the event. A series of close encounters risks the revealing of hidden identities, but all those involved escape. Suzaku pilots the Ganymede for the festival's main event: making a giant pizza, slated to be the world's largest. When Euphemia's presence is revealed, mass panic ensues. On live television, she declares the Mount Fuji area to be the "Specially Administrated Zone

1.name: Bloodstained Euphy
1.overview: During the commemoration ceremony for the Specially Administrated Zone, Lelouch and Euphemia privately discuss Japan's future. She convinces him, and Lelouch summarily halts his rebellion, until he suddenly loses control of his Geass while jokingly telling her to kill all the Japanese. The Geass-influenced Euphemia orders a bloody massacre of the people attending the ceremony. Blaming himself, a resolute Lelouch decides to salvage the situation by declaring Euphemia's Specially Administrated Zon

1.name: At Least with Sorrow
1.overview: Left with no choice, Lelouch shoots and mortally wounds Euphemia in front of Suzaku. Suzaku returns to the Avalon with her battered body as the Black Knights continue to contain the violence. She succumbs to her injuries as Lelouch announces his plan for the creation of the United State of Japan. Alone, Lelouch grieves over his actions as C.C. comforts him, reminding him that she will stay alongside him, as per their contract. Soon, the entirety of Area 11 revolts against the Britannian Empire.

1.name: The Collapsing Stage
1.overview: Lelouch's strategies give the Black Knights and their allies the upper hand in their battle against the Britannian Army. As riots break out through the country, the Black Knights take over the Ashford Academy as their headquarters, and the students are spared on Lelouch's orders. An enraged Suzaku, now informed of Zero's identity by a mysterious young boy named V.V., pursues Lelouch for revenge, which Cornelia also covets.

1.name: Zero
1.overview: After managing to capture Cornelia, Lelouch forces her to reveal what little information she knows of Marianne's murder, but the answers do not please him one bit. V.V. takes Nunnally to Kaminejima, and Lelouch abandons the Black Knights to rescue his sister. Without Lelouch, the Black Knights begin to lose ground to the Britannian Army. Suzaku follows Lelouch, leading to a final confrontation between the former friends.

1.name: Rebirth
1.overview: Brilliant but bored high school student Light Yagami suddenly finds himself holding the power of life and death in his hands—the power of the Death Note. He decides to rid the world of evil—by killing off criminals one by one. When the murders start to pile up, genius detective L is on the case, and an epic battle of wits unfolds.

1.name: Confrontation
1.overview: While the world’s criminals continue to drop dead, L meets by computer with representatives from various nations. He requests that a task force be set up in Japan, under the direction of none other than Soichiro Yagami, Light’s father.

1.name: Dealings
1.overview: Ryuk, the Shinigami, or god of death, who dropped the Death Note into the human world, warns Light that someone is on his trail. Light is troubled that he can’t find out the identity of his tracker, and Ryuk suggests an amazing deal...

1.name: Pursuit
1.overview: Light—now known to the world as Kira—tests the Death Note to understand the scope of its powers by killing off six convicts in various ways—and confirms he can control his victims’ actions before they die.

1.name: Tactics
1.overview: Soichiro Yagami demands to meet with L in person when he finds out that L has secretly brought FBI agents into Japan. Light, meanwhile, has found a way to get those very FBI agents off the case—permanently...

1.name: Unraveling
1.overview: Light meets a woman at the Police Department with an urgent message for the Kira task force. As son of the chief investigator, Light listens to her story, and is startled to discover she may have information that could lead to his arrest.

1.name: Overcast
1.overview: Light uses the Death Note to try to get rid of the woman who could get him captured, and is shocked when it doesn’t work. Realizing she must have given him an alias, he’s only got minutes to find out her real name before she tells her story to the task force.

1.name: Glare
1.overview: L insists on setting up bugs and cameras in the homes of Chief Yagami and Deputy Director Kitamura—whom Raye Penber was tracking. But Light is a step ahead as usual—he knows he’s being watched.

1.name: Encounter
1.overview: The murders continue, and L grows suspicious of Light’s too-perfect behavior and decides to investigate him on his own. In order to get closer to Light, L enrolls at the same university and reveals himself to be L.

1.name: Doubt
1.overview: L's suspicion of Light deepens, compelling him to invite Light into the investigation. But then a phone call alerts them that Soichiro Yagami has suffered a heart attack!

1.name: Assault
1.overview: As predicted on the tapes sent to Sakura TV, news anchors and commentators who expressed doubt about Kira die one by one. On further investigation, L concludes that this Kira is not the original—there's a second Kira!

1.name: Love
1.overview: With a second Kira now on the loose, L asks Light to join the task force and pose as the real Kira in order to catch the copycat. Light agrees, hoping to divert suspicion from himself. To his surprise, this new Kira has a special ability even Light lacks…

1.name: Confession
1.overview: Light goes to Aoyama to discover the identity of the second Kira before L becomes more suspicious. But Misa Amane, the new Kira, uses her unusual gift to find Light before he finds her.

1.name: Friend
1.overview: Light and Misa show each other their Death Notes, and Light asks Misa to have her shinigami Rem get rid of L. But Misa asks something of Light in return—to fall in love with her!

1.name: Wager
1.overview: Evidence turns up that points to Misa Amane as the second Kira. In an effort to spare her, Rem forces Misa to forfeit her ownership of the Death Note.

1.name: Decision
1.overview: Misa is in confinement, though her memories of the Death Note have been completely wiped away. When Light is confined as well, the murders stop and suspicion of Light grows stronger. Then suddenly, the killings resume.

1.name: Execution
1.overview: After fifty days of confinement the killings continue, and Misa and Light are released. But L has devised a plan to ensure no more murders occur, and has Light's father, Soichiro, take the two for a ride that may be their last.

1.name: Ally
1.overview: Though L is still suspicious, Light and Misa, their memories of being Kira wiped clean, return to headquarters, where Light notices a strange connection between the recent Kira killings and the Yotsuba Group.

1.name: Matsuda
1.overview: Matsuda, the task force member assigned to watch Misa, is eager to distinguish himself, and while on a job with Misa, he decides to do a little snooping on his own at the Yotsuba Group’s Tokyo headquarters.

1.name: Makeshift
1.overview: L's team discovers that the Yotsuba Group meet in secret to discuss the elimination of individuals who are troublesome to their company, and concludes that Kira must be one of the eight executives. Can Light posing as L ferret out the right one?

1.name: Performance
1.overview: The Task Force uses Misa as a way to get closer to the Yotsuba corporation. But things get complicated when Rem tries to communicate with her.

1.name: Guidance
1.overview: Thanks to Misa, the Task Force now knows the identity of the new Kira and L plans an elaborate scheme to smoke him out of hiding.

1.name: Frenzy
1.overview: L, Light and Misa watch from the investigation team building and wonder who he is talking to. L wonders if Higuchi is talking to a shinigami. Rem convinces Higuchi to go to the station, but she has her own selfish motives for doing so.

1.name: Revival
1.overview: While Higuchi is finally captured, Light inadvertently regains his memories as Kira.

1.name: Silence
1.overview: Light, his memory recovered, orders Misa to begin killing after Higuchi dies. The Shinigami Rem realizes that everything is going according to Light's plan, and that L will arrest Misa as Kira-unless Rem acts quickly.

1.name: Renewal
1.overview: Light has removed everyone in his way and is closer to achieving his perfect world.

1.name: Abduction
1.overview: A new investigator steps forward-Near, a central figure in the SPK, an organization that is trying to catch Kira without relying on L. Near is aware of the existence of the Death Notes and wants to get his hands on one.

1.name: Impatience
1.overview: Light, acting as L, reveals to Near that his sister Sayu has been kidnapped by someone wanting to trade her for the Death Note. Near finds out that the trade will happen in Los Angeles and promises to help, while secretly planning to steal the Death Note and capture Kira.

1.name: Father
1.overview: Mortified over allowing the Death Note to fall into Mello's hands in order to save his daughter, Soichiro puts himself into harm's way in order to get it back.

1.name: Justice
1.overview: Mello busts into SPK headquarters to retrieve a photograph of himself to make sure he won't be killed by Kira. In exchange for Near giving him the picture, Mello drops an important hint about the Death Notes: some of the rules are fake.

1.name: Transfer
1.overview: Near contacts the Japanese task force and determines that Kira is among their members. He asks for insider information, and Aizawa, beginning to doubt Light, responds. Near suspects that the new L is really Light Yagami and that Light is Kira.

1.name: Selection
1.overview: Star newscaster Kiyomi Takada becomes Kira's spokesperson to the world, after Demegawa is deleted by Mikami, and she just so happens to have been Light's girlfriend in college. Aizawa's suspicions about Light grow.

1.name: Scorn
1.overview: Near goes to Japan, allegedly as bait for Kira. Following Light's instructions, Takada asks Mikami to send her five pages of the Death Note. She tells him that he will continue his work in a fake book made to look like the real one.

1.name: Vigilance
1.overview: Aizawa figures out what's going on and tells Near, who already knows about the notes. Near instructs Aizawa to continue watching Light, and then puts in motion a plan to separate Misa from Light.

1.name: Malice
1.overview: Light and Near agree upon a meeting place for the final confrontation. A key player is kidnapped and the end results are shocking.
The Japanese Task Force and the SPK finally meet at YellowBox Warehouse on January 28th. However, a third party has come to the warehouse as well, on Kira's orders to kill everyone else there.

1.name: New World
1.overview: Though Mikami has written all the investigators' names in the Death Note, a minute passes and everyone is still alive. Near seizes Mikami's Death Note, and all is at last revealed.

1.name: The Day I Became a Shinigami
1.overview: Fifteen-year-old Ichigo Kurosaki has the uncanny ability to see ghosts, but otherwise lives an ordinary life. However, once a Shinigami named Rukia Kuchiki appears before him, everything changes.

1.name: A Shinigami's Work
1.overview: After becoming a Shinigami, Ichigo Kurosaki refuses to help Rukia Kuchiki with her work as the local Shinigami of Karakura Town.

1.name: The Older Brother's Wish, the Younger Sister's Wish
1.overview: When a Hollowfied Sora Inoue attacks his younger sister, Ichigo Kurosaki and Rukia Kuchiki set out to save her.

1.name: Cursed Parakeet
1.overview: When Yasutora Sado receives a parakeet that contains the Soul of a young boy, it is up to Ichigo Kurosaki and Rukia Kuchiki to protect him from the Hollow that is after them.

1.name: Beat the Invisible Enemy!
1.overview: Rukia Kuchiki and Yasutora Sado team up to take on the Hollow Shrieker.

1.name: Fight to the Death! Ichigo vs. Ichigo
1.overview: At Rukia Kuchiki's behest, Ichigo Kurosaki puts an artificial soul in his body to take care of it and not arouse suspicion while he carries out his Substitute Shinigami duties, but the artificial soul has its own agenda.

1.name: Greetings from a Stuffed Lion
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki becomes friends with the Modified Soul, Kon, and puts him into a plushie.

1.name: June 17, Memories in the Rain
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki goes to his mother's grave with the rest of his family.

1.name: Unbeatable Enemy
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki battles against Grand Fisher.

1.name: Assault on Trip at Sacred Ground!
1.overview: While grudgingly attending Don Kanonji's show with the rest of his family, Ichigo Kurosaki is forced to fight a Hollow inadvertently created by Don Kanonji himself.

1.name: The Legendary Quincy
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and Rukia Kuchiki meet Uryū Ishida, a Quincy.

1.name: A Gentle Right Arm
1.overview: As Ichigo Kurosaki begins his duel with Uryū Ishida, Yasutora Sado gains a new power.

1.name: Flower and Hollow
1.overview: Orihime Inoue gains a new power in order to protect Tatsuki Arisawa.

1.name: Back to Back, a Fight to the Death!
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and Uryū Ishida work together to defeat a Menos Grande.

1.name: Kon's Great Plan
1.overview: Kon decides to run away from the Kurosaki Clinic as Soul Society comes after Rukia Kuchiki.

1.name: The Encounter, Abarai Renji!
1.overview: Two Shinigami, 6th Division Lieutenant Renji Abarai and Captain Byakuya Kuchiki, arrive in the Human World to take Rukia Kuchiki back to the Soul Society.

1.name: Ichigo Dies!
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki loses his Shinigami powers and Rukia Kuchiki is taken back to Soul Society.

1.name: Reclaim! The Power of the Shinigami!
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki begins his training with Kisuke Urahara to regain his Shinigami powers and save Rukia Kuchiki.

1.name: Ichigo Becomes a Hollow!
1.overview: Kisuke Urahara helps Ichigo Kurosaki regain his Shinigami powers.

1.name: Ichimaru Gin's Shadow
1.overview: After completing their training, Ichigo Kurosaki and his friends depart to Soul Society to rescue Rukia Kuchiki.

1.name: Enter! The World of the Shinigami
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and his friends enter Soul Society.

1.name: The Man who Hates Shinigami
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and his friends are forced to find another way into Seireitei due to 3rd Division Captain Gin Ichimaru's intervention.

1.name: 14 Days Before Rukia's Execution
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and his friends enter the household of the Shiba Clan.

1.name: Assemble! The 13 Divisions
1.overview: As Ichigo Kurosaki and his friends begin their preparations to get into the Seireitei, the Gotei 13 captains assemble for a meeting.

1.name: Penetrate the Center with an Enormous Bombshell?
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and his friends enter the Seireitei.

1.name: Formation! The Worst Tag
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and his friends are scattered throughout the Seireitei, where they encounter new enemies.

1.name: Release the Death Blow!
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki completes his battle with 11th Division 3rd Seat Ikkaku Madarame while his friends continue to progress through the Seireitei.

1.name: Orihime Targeted
1.overview: Ganju Shiba wins his battle against 11th Division 5th Seat Yumichika Ayasegawa while Uryū Ishida begins his own.

1.name: Breakthrough! The Shinigami's Encompassing Net
1.overview: Uryū Ishida defeats 7th Division 4th Seat Jirōbō Ikkanzaka while Ichigo Kurosaki and Ganju Shiba encounter 4th Division 7th Seat Hanatarō Yamada, who personally knows Rukia Kuchiki.

1.name: Renji's Confrontation
1.overview: Having been led to the base of Senzaikyū, Ichigo Kurosaki begins his rematch with 6th Division Lieutenant Renji Abarai.

1.name: The Resolution to Kill
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and 6th Division Lieutenant Renji Abarai conclude their rematch.

1.name: Stars and the Stray
1.overview: 6th Division Lieutenant Renji Abarai remembers his past with Rukia Kuchiki and begs Ichigo Kurosaki to save her in his stead.

1.name: Miracle! The Mysterious New Hero
1.overview: In the Human World, Yuzu Kurosaki finds a cat named Raku and is drawn into an adventure with Don Kanonji and his Karakura-Raizer Team.

1.name: Tragedy of Dawn
1.overview: As the Gotei 13 reacts to 6th Division Lieutenant Renji Abarai's defeat, Captain-Commander Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto declares war against the Ryoka.

1.name: Aizen Assassinated! The Darkness which Approaches
1.overview: While the Gotei 13 deals with the death of 5th Division Captain Sōsuke Aizen, Ichigo Kurosaki and his group attempt to enter Senzaikyū once again.

1.name: Zaraki Kenpachi Approaches!
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki begins his battle with 11th Division Captain Kenpachi Zaraki.

1.name: Motive of the Fist
1.overview: Yasutora Sado battles with 8th Division captain, Shunsui Kyōraku.

1.name: Desperation! The Broken Zangetsu
1.overview: As the high-ranking members of the Gotei 13 continue to react to 5th Division Captain Sōsuke Aizen's murder, Ichigo Kurosaki continues his battle with 11th Division Captain Kenpachi Zaraki.

1.name: The Immortal Man
1.overview: After learning to access the power of Zangetsu in addition to his own, Ichigo Kurosaki concludes his battle with 11th Division Captain Kenpachi Zaraki.

1.name: The Shinigami whom Ganju Met
1.overview: While 11th Division Lieutenant Yachiru Kusajishi reminisces about her history with her captain, Kenpachi Zaraki, Ganju Shiba and 4th Division 7th Seat Hanatarō Yamada reach Rukia Kuchiki's cell in Senzaikyū.

1.name: Reunion, Ichigo and Rukia
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki arrives at the White Tower and reunites with Rukia Kuchiki.

1.name: Yoruichi, Goddess of Flash, Dances!
1.overview: Yoruichi Shihōin saves Ichigo Kurosaki and decides to help him attain Bankai.

1.name: The Despicable Shinigami
1.overview: Uryū Ishida and Orihime Inoue are confronted by 12th Division Captain Mayuri Kurotsuchi.

1.name: Ishida Ultimate Power!
1.overview: Uryū Ishida removes his Sanrei Glove to defeat 12th Division Captain Mayuri Kurotsuchi.

1.name: Overcome Your Limits!
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki begins his Bankai Training.

1.name: Authentic Records! School of Shinigami
1.overview: 5th Division Lieutenant Momo Hinamori recalls her past at the Shin'ō Academy.

1.name: The Avengers
1.overview: As Ichigo Kurosaki continues his Bankai Training, 5th Division Lieutenant Momo Hinamori confronts 10th Division Captain Tōshirō Hitsugaya over the contents of the letter left by her captain, Sōsuke Aizen.

1.name: Hitsugaya Roars!
1.overview: 10th Division Captain Tōshirō Hitsugaya battles 3rd Division Captain Gin Ichimaru.

1.name: Rukia's Nightmare
1.overview: Rukia Kuchiki recalls her past with Kaien Shiba.

1.name: The Reviving Lion
1.overview: The Karakura Superheroes come together once more and fight a Hollow.

1.name: Morning of the Sentence
1.overview: As the day of Rukia Kuchiki's execution arrives, various groups around the Seireitei move out and clash with one another.

1.name: Renji, Oath of the Soul! Death Match with Byakuya
1.overview: 6th Division Lieutenant Renji Abarai battles his captain, Byakuya Kuchiki.

1.name: Ichimaru Gin's Temptation, Resolution Shattered
1.overview: 11th Division Captain Kenpachi Zaraki and his subordinates battle the 7th and 9th Division captains and lieutenants.

1.name: An Accomplished Oath! Get back Rukia!
1.overview: Rukia Kuchiki's execution ceremony commences, but does not proceed as planned.

1.name: The Strongest Shinigami! Ultimate Confrontation Between Teacher and Students
1.overview: After the interruption of Rukia Kuchiki's execution, battles commence all across the Seireitei.

1.name: Supersonic Battle! Determine the Goddess of Battle
1.overview: Yoruichi Shihōin battles 2nd Division Captain Suì-Fēng.

1.name: Senbonzakura, Crushed! Zangetsu Thrusts through the Sky
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and Captain Byakuya Kuchiki continue their battle.

1.name: Unseal! The Black Blade, the Miraculous Power
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and 6th Division Captain Byakuya Kuchiki activate their Bankai.

1.name: Conclusion of the Death Match! White Pride and Black Desire
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and 6th Division Captain Byakuya Kuchiki's battle reaches its conclusion.

1.name: Reality of the Despair, the Assassin's Dagger is Swung
1.overview: A conspiracy connecting several recent events in Soul Society is revealed.

1.name: Aizen Stands! Horrible Ambitions
1.overview: 4th Division Lieutenant Isane Kotetsu informs the Gotei 13 that Sōsuke Aizen is alive as the latter reveals his machinations.

1.name: Gather Together! Group of the Strongest Shinigami!
1.overview: 5th Division Captain Sōsuke Aizen removes the Hōgyoku from Rukia Kuchiki's Soul and retreats to Hueco Mundo.

1.name: Rukia's Resolution, Ichigo's Feelings
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and his friends say their goodbyes in Soul Society before heading back home through the Dangai.

1.name: New School Term, Renji Has Come to the Material World?!
1.overview: As the lives of Ichigo Kurosaki and his friends begin to return to normal, three mysterious figures appear and abduct Orihime Inoue.

1.name: Creeping Terror, the Second Victim
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki, Uryū Ishida, Yasutora Sado, and 6th Division Lieutenant Renji Abarai are forced to play a game in order to find Orihime Inoue.

1.name: Breakthrough! The Trap Hidden in the Labyrinth
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki, Lieutenant Renji Abarai, and Uryū Ishida must navigate a labyrinth in order to free their friends.

1.name: Death Game! The Missing Classmate
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and his friends must deduce the identity of an impostor in their midst.

1.name: True Identity of the Devil, the Secret which Is Revealed
1.overview: The truth about the Mod-Souls is revealed as a new enemy appears.

1.name: Bount! The Ones Who Hunt Souls
1.overview: The Mod-Souls receive new bodies as Ichigo Kurosaki encounters a Bount for the first time.

1.name: Rukia's Return! Revival of the Substitute Team!
1.overview: Two new Bount appear as one takes an interest in Uryū Ishida.

1.name: The Moment of Collision! An Evil Hand Draws Near to the Quincy
1.overview: With Ryō Utagawa attempting to devour his Soul, Uryū Ishida finds himself abducted and saved by Yoshino Sōma.

1.name: Water Attack! Escape from the Shutdown Hospital
1.overview: While Uryū Ishida is in the hospital, his friends must fight two Bount who can control water.

1.name: Gathering Bounts! The Man Who Makes His Move
1.overview: Ganju Shiba and 4th Division 7th Seat Hanatarō Yamada help conclude the fight against Hō and Ban.

1.name: Memories of an Eternally Living Clan
1.overview: Uryū Ishida gets to know Yoshino Sōma while 11th Division Captain Kenpachi Zaraki and his lieutenant, Yachiru Kusajishi, discover that a former member of their division is in Karakura Town.

1.name: Earth-Shattering Event at 11th Squad! The Shinigami Who Rises Again
1.overview: 12th Division Captain Mayuri Kurotsuchi informs the Gotei 13 of his missing data on the Bount while Ichigo Kurosaki and his friends break into the Bount Mansion to save Uryū Ishida.

1.name: Crashing Force! Fried vs. Zangetsu
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki faces off against Ryō Utagawa, who ends up betraying Jin Kariya with the intention of dethroning him.

1.name: Unfading Grudge! The Shinigami whom Kenpachi Killed
1.overview: Maki Ichinose remembers his past as he and Jin Kariya battle Ichigo Kurosaki.

1.name: Shocking Revelations for the 13 Divisions!! The Truth Buried in History
1.overview: Uryū Ishida tries to understand more about Yoshino Sōma as Ichigo Kurosaki spars with 6th Division Lieutenant Renji Abarai and Ganju Shiba in order to regain his fighting spirit.

1.name: Yoshino's Decision of Death
1.overview: Yoshino Sōma makes a final stand against Jin Kariya in order to redeem herself.

1.name: Assault from a Formidable Enemy! A Tiny Final Line of Defense?!
1.overview: At Kisuke Urahara's request, Ririn, Kurōdo, and Noba prepare anti-Bount traps around the Kurosaki Clinic, but are angered when Ichigo Kurosaki brushes them off as pointless and unhelpful.

1.name: Hitsugaya Moves! The Attacked City
1.overview: The Bitto' attack Karakura Town, allowing the Bount to grow stronger, while 10th Division Captain Tōshirō Hitsugaya briefs his strike force on their mission in Soul Society.

1.name: Ichigo vs. Dalk! Appearance of the Faded Darkness
1.overview: 6th Division Lieutenant Renji Abarai fights off the Bitto, who are quickly recalled, while Ichigo Kurosaki battles Gō Koga's Doll, Dalk, in her new form.

1.name: Grey Shadow, the Secret of the Dolls
1.overview: Gō Koga tells Ichigo Kurosaki that he reminds him of a boy from his past, Cain, whom Koga was assigned to train by Jin Kariya until tragedy struck.

1.name: Dissension in the Substitute Team? Rukia's Betrayal
1.overview: 3rd Division Lieutenant Izuru Kira fends off Gō Koga's Doll, Dalk, while Mabashi arrives to take over for a struggling Yoshi.

1.name: Deadly Battle of Tears! Rukia vs. Orihime
1.overview: Mabashi uses his Doll, Ritz, to take control of Rukia Kuchiki's body and force her to fight her friends.

1.name: Rangiku Dances! Slice the Invisible Enemy!
1.overview: Lieutenant Rangiku Matsumoto, Yasutora Sado, Noba, and Ururu Tsumugiya face off against the old Bount, Sawatari, and his Doll, Baura.

1.name: Byakuya is summoned! The Gotei 13 start to move!
1.overview: Sawatari retreats while an invisible intruder enters Soul Society. Uryū Ishida remembers training to become a Quincy.

1.name: Annihilation of the Lieutenants!? Trap in the Underground Cave
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and company head off to the Bounts' cave, only to encounter Ugaki's Doll, Gesell.

1.name: Rematch?! Ishida vs. Nemu
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and friends continue to fight Gesell as Lieutenant Nemu Kurotsuchi presents Uryū Ishida with a battle accessory.

1.name: Renji Abarai, Bankai of the Soul!
1.overview: Gesell turns on its master. Ichigo Kurosaki attempts to fight Jin Kariya with little success.

1.name: Shinigami and Quincy, the Reviving Power
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki initiates Bankai, but Uryū Ishida completes the Bounts' portal, allowing them to enter Soul Society.

1.name: Invasion of the Shinigami World, Again
1.overview: The Bounts arrive in Soul Society. Rukia Kuchiki meets up with Yoshi once more.

1.name: The Bount Assault! The Gotei 13 of Destructive Earthquake
1.overview: Rukia Kuchiki squares off against Yoshi. Captain-Commander Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto informs the other captains of the Bounts' origins.

1.name: Hitsugaya's Decision! The Clash Approaches
1.overview: Jin Kariya recruits men from Kusajishi as Ichigo Kurosaki and friends finally arrive at Kūkaku Shiba's house.

1.name: Byakuya Takes the Field! Dance of the Wind-Splitting Cherry Blossoms
1.overview: Captain Byakuya Kuchiki battles Jin Kariya when Ichigo Kurosaki shows up to help.

1.name: Ichigo, Byakuya, Kariya, The Battle of the Three Extremes!
1.overview: As Ichigo Kurosaki and Captain Byakuya Kuchiki continue to fight a continuously healing Jin Kariya, Ran'Tao shows up, prompting Kariya to leave.

1.name: Hitsugaya Strikes! Slice the Enemy in the Middle of the Forest
1.overview: Ran'Tao reveals the reason for her resemblance to Yoshino Sōma as Captain Tōshirō Hitsugaya faces off against Maki Ichinose.

1.name: Clash! Kenpachi Zaraki vs. Maki Ichinose
1.overview: Captain Kenpachi Zaraki arrives to stop Maki Ichinose.

1.name: Shinigami vs. Shinigami! The Uncontrollable Power
1.overview: The Bounts break into Seireitei and Captain Suì-Fēng encounters Mabashi.

1.name: Suì-Fēng Dies? The Last of the Special Forces
1.overview: Captain Suì-Fēng survives her poisoning by using her own poison to nullify Mabashi's, and kills Mabashi.

1.name: Mayuri's Bankai!! Sawatari: Clash of the Demon
1.overview: Captain Mayuri Kurotsuchi, of the 12th Division, battles against the Bount, Sawatari.

1.name: The Last Quincy! The Exploding Power
1.overview: As Jin Kariya looks for the Jokai Crest, Uryū Ishida battles the Bount, Yoshi.

1.name: Ishida, Exceeding the Limits to Attack!
1.overview: As Uryū Ishida defeats the Bount, Yoshi, Jin Kariya prepares to destroy the Soul Society.

1.name: 10th Division's Death Struggle! The Release of Hyōrinmaru
1.overview: 10th Division Captain Tōshirō Hitsugaya battles against the Bount, Gō Koga.

1.name: Kariya! Countdown to the Detonation
1.overview: As the Shinigami learn more about the Jōkaishō, Ran'Tao confronts Jin Kariya.

1.name: Life and Revenge! Ishida, the Ultimate Choice
1.overview: Uryū Ishida confronts the Bount, Jin Kariya.

1.name: The Swung-Down Edge! The Moment of Ruin
1.overview: As Ichigo Kurosaki and Jin Kariya battle each other, the Shinigami look for the other Jōkaishō to re-seal them.

1.name: The Wailing Bount! The Last Clash
1.overview: The battle between Ichigo Kurosaki and Jin Kariya concludes.

1.name: Ichigo and Rukia, Thoughts in the Revolving Around Heaven
1.overview: Following the battle with the Bounts, things slowly return to normal.

1.name: Reopening of the Substitute Business! The Terrifying Transfer Student
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki goes back to slaying Hollows in the Human World, but he is soon confronted by Shinji Hirako - a Visored.

1.name: Shock! The Father's True Identity
1.overview: Isshin Kurosaki reveals himself as a Shinigami and fights Grand Fisher.

1.name: The Commencement of War, Vizards and the Arrancars
1.overview: Information on the Visored and Arrancar is revealed.

1.name: Prelude to the Apocalypse, The Arrancar's Offensive
1.overview: Arrancar arrive in the Human World.

1.name: Reunion, Ichigo and Rukia and Soul Reapers
1.overview: The Arrancar leave the Human World while the Gotei 13 send help to protect the Human World.

1.name: Mission! The Soul Reapers Have Come
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki regains his confidence to fight again. Later, more facts about the Arrancar are revealed.

1.name: The Evil Eye, Aizen Returns
1.overview: The Arrancar arrive in the Human World, again.

1.name: Rukia's Battle Commences! The Freezing White Blade
1.overview: Rukia Kuchiki battles against the Arrancar, Di Roy Rinker.

1.name: Ikkaku's Bankai! The Power That Breaks Everything
1.overview: 3rd Seat Ikkaku Madarame battles against the Arrancar, Edrad Liones.

1.name: Zaraki Division's Secret Story! The Lucky Men
1.overview: 3rd Seat Ikkaku Madarame recalls when he joined the 11th Division.

1.name: Hitsugaya Scatters! The Broken Hyōrinmaru
1.overview: The battles with the Arrancar continue.

1.name: Clash! The Protector vs. The Bearer
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and Grimmjow Jaegerjaquez battle each other.

1.name: Vizard! The Power of the Awakened
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki goes to where the Visored are in hopes of learning how to control his Hollowfication.

1.name: Ichigo, Complete Hollowification!?
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki begins training to control his Hollowfication.

1.name: Collision! Black Bankai and the White Bankai
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki continues his battle with his inner Hollow.

1.name: Urgent Report! Aizen's Terrifying Plan!
1.overview: As Ichigo Kurosaki successfully controls his Hollow, Sōsuke Aizen's plans are revealed.

1.name: Uryū vs. Ryūken! Clash of the Parent-Child Quincys
1.overview: As Ichigo Kurosaki is informed of Sōsuke Aizen's plans, Uryū Ishida finishes his training.

1.name: Urahara's Decision, Orihime's Thoughts
1.overview: Orihime Inoue is told that she won't be allowed to fight in the upcoming battles.

1.name: The Nightmare Arrancar! Team Hitsugaya Moves Out
1.overview: The Shinigami in the Human World find a boy named Shōta Toyokawa.

1.name: The Swooping Descent of the Dark Emissary! The Propagation of Malice
1.overview: The Shinigami help out Shōta Toyokawa and Yui Toyokawa.

1.name: The Invisible Enemy! Hitsugaya's Merciless Decision
1.overview: The Shinigami look for the Cloning Arrancar.

1.name: Rangiku's Tears, the Sorrowful Parting of Brother and Sister
1.overview: The Shinigami face off against the Cloning Arrancar.

1.name: Hitsugaya, Karin, and Soccer Ball
1.overview: Karin Kurosaki tries to get Captain Tōshirō Hitsugaya to help her win an upcoming soccer match.

1.name: Ikkaku: The Hot-Blooded Kendo Tale
1.overview: 3rd Seat Ikkaku Madarame helps a school student named Shinji Iijima win a Kendō tournament.

1.name: The Beautiful Patissier, Yumichika!
1.overview: 5th Seat Yumichika Ayasegawa helps a Plus named Heita Momoyama bake a cake for his mother.

1.name: Kon is Deceived! Rangiku on the Lookout...
1.overview: Kon is forced to live with a girl named Miyuki.

1.name: Civil War in Hueco Mundo! Ulquiorra's Death
1.overview: Several Arrancar betray Sōsuke Aizen and steal the Hōgyoku.

1.name: The Malicious Battle, Aizen's Trap
1.overview: The rogue Arrancar are defeated by the Shinigami.

1.name: Hueco Mundo moves again! Hitsugaya vs. Yammy
1.overview: Several Arrancar head into the Human World.

1.name: Ichigo vs. Grimmjow, the 11-second battle!
1.overview: As the battles with the Arrancar continue, Ichigo Kurosaki shows off his new power.

1.name: Ulquiorra's Scheme, the Moment when the Sun Sets!
1.overview: The battles conclude as the Arrancar head back into Hueco Mundo.

1.name: Goodbye..., Kurosaki!
1.overview: Orihime Inoue says goodbye to Ichigo Kurosaki before leaving for Hueco Mundo.

1.name: Strict Order! The Forbidden Rescue of Orihime Inoue
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki learns of Orihime Inoue's disappearance and decides to rescue her.

1.name: Grimmjow Revived
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki, Uryū Ishida, and Yasutora Sado head to Hueco Mundo.

1.name: Ishida and Chad, The Quickening of a New Power
1.overview: Uryū Ishida and Yasutora Sado show off their new strength after arriving in Hueco Mundo.

1.name: The Espada Gather! Aizen's Royal Assembly
1.overview: As Ichigo Kurosaki and his friends head to Las Noches, Sōsuke Aizen holds a meeting with the Espada.

1.name: The Name's Nel! The Appearance of a Strange Arrancar
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki meets the Arrancar Nel Tu and a Guardian causes some trouble.

1.name: Forest of Menos! Search for the Missing Rukia
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and the others are forced into the Forest of Menos.

1.name: Ashido, The Soul Reaper Who Came from the Past
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and the others continue exploring the Forest of Menos.

1.name: Through the Crumbling Forest, a Million Menos
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and the others escape the Forest of Menos.

1.name: Oath! Back Here Alive Again
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and his group arrive in Las Noches.

1.name: The Raging Storm! Encounter with the Dancing Arrancar
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki battles against the Arrancar, Dordoni Alessandro Del Socaccio.

1.name: Ichigo Strikes Back! This Is My Bankai
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki concludes his battle with Dordoni Alessandro Del Socaccio.

1.name: The Devilish Research! Szayelaporro's Plan
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and the others continue going on through Las Noches.

1.name: Rukia and Kaien, the Sorrowful Reunion
1.overview: Rukia Kuchiki reunites with her deceased mentor, Kaien Shiba.

1.name: Rukia Retaliates! Release the Desperate Kidō
1.overview: As Rukia Kuchiki battles Kaien Shiba, she struggles with wondering on whether or not he's truly Kaien.

1.name: Ishida & Pesche, the United Attack of Friendship
1.overview: Uryū Ishida and Pesche Guatiche battle against Cirucci Sanderwicci.

1.name: Ishida's Trump Card, Seele Schneider
1.overview: Uryū Ishida battles Cirucci Sanderwicci with a new weapon called Seele Schneider.

1.name: Right Arm of the Giant, Left Arm of the Devil
1.overview: Yasutora Sado realizes his true power and battles against Gantenbainne Mosqueda.

1.name: Yasutora Sado Dies! Orihime's Tears
1.overview: Yasutora Sado is defeated by Nnoitra Gilga and Lieutenant Renji Abarai is confronted by the Espada Szayelaporro Granz.

1.name: Testament, Your Heart is Right Here...
1.overview: Rukia Kuchiki recalls her past with Kaien Shiba before she kills Aaroniero Arruruerie.

1.name: The Cruel Arrancar, Ulquiorra's Provocation
1.overview: As the Espada react to the death of Aaroniero Arruruerie, Ichigo Kurosaki is confronted by Ulquiorra Cifer.

1.name: Szayelaporro Laughs, The Net Trapping Renji is Complete
1.overview: As Ichigo Kurosaki battles Ulquiorra Cifer, Lieutenant Renji Abarai struggles with his fight against Szayelaporro Granz.

1.name: Shinigami and Quincy, The Battle with Madness
1.overview: As Grimmjow Jaegerjaquez saves Orihime Inoue from Loly Aivirrne and Menoly Mallia, Uryū Ishida joins Lieutenant Renji Abarai's battle against Szayelaporro Granz.

1.name: Ishida's Strategy, 20-Second Offense and Defense
1.overview: While Uryū Ishida and Lieutenant Renji Abarai continue their battle against Szayelaporro Granz, Ichigo Kurosaki is healed by Orihime Inoue.

1.name: The Murderous Intent Boils! The Joyful Grimmjow
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki begins his final battle with Grimmjow Jaegerjaquez.

1.name: Desperate Effort vs. Desperate Effort! Hollowfied Ichigo
1.overview: As Ichigo Kurosaki continues his battle with Grimmjow Jaegerjaquez, Orihime Inoue struggles dealing with Ichigo's Hollowfication form.

1.name: The Moment of Conclusion, The End of Grimmjow
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and Grimmjow Jaegerjaquez conclude their battle.

1.name: The New Captain Appears! His Name Is Shūsuke Amagai
1.overview: Shūsuke Amagai is appointed as new captain of the 3rd Division.

1.name: New Development, the Dangerous Transfer Student Appears!
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki meets Rurichiyo Kasumiōji and her two Shinigami guards in the Human World.

1.name: Desperate Struggle Under the Moonlit Night, the Mysterious Assassin and Zanpakutō
1.overview: As Ichigo Kurosaki learns more about Rurichiyo Kasumiōji, he is forced to fight off an assassin going after the girl.

1.name: Kenryū, the Profusion of Blooming Crimson Flowers
1.overview: As Ichigo Kurosaki is forced to take care of Rurichiyo Kasumiōji, another assassin attempts to kill her.

1.name: Kibune Goes to War! The Violent Wind that Rages
1.overview: Izuru Kira begins to get depressed over the fact that the 3rd Division members like Makoto Kibune more than him.

1.name: The Appearance of the Great Evil! The Darkness in the House of Kasumiōji
1.overview: Rurichiyo Kasumiōji is targeted by more assassins after secretly returning to the Soul Society.

1.name: Break the Mirror's Boundary! Ichigo's Captivity
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki faces off against the assassin Hanza Nukui.

1.name: The Revenging Assassin, Ichigo is Targeted
1.overview: Hanza Nukui and his subordinates attack the Human World to kill Ichigo Kurosaki and Rurichiyo Kasumiōji.

1.name: Mystery! The Sword-Consuming Assassin
1.overview: The fights with the assassins continue.

1.name: The Reversal of Rukia! The Rampaging Blade
1.overview: Rukia Kuchiki, Uryū Ishida, and Yasutora Sado finish their battles against the assassins.

1.name: The Nightmare Which is Shown, Ichigo's Inside the Mirror
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki finishes his battle with Hanza Nukui.

1.name: Confrontation!? Amagai vs. Gotei 13
1.overview: Captain-Commander Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto orchestrates a Menos Grande attack on Soul Society to help him decide on Captain Shūsuke Amagai's proposal to have joint training between the Divisions.

1.name: The Princess's Decision, the Sorrowful Bride
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki heads to the Soul Society to stop Rurichiyo Kasumiōji's wedding.

1.name: The 2nd Division Sorties! Ichigo is Surrounded
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and Rukia Kuchiki try to stop Rurichiyo Kasumiōji's wedding, but they end up getting attacked by the Gotei 13 in the process.

1.name: Amagai's True Strength, the Released Zanpakuto!
1.overview: As Ichigo Kurosaki looks for Rurichiyo Kasumiōji, he is confronted by Captain Shūsuke Amagai.

1.name: The Darkness Which Moves! Kibune's True Colors
1.overview: Lieutenant Izuru Kira and Makoto Kibune face off against each other.

1.name: Kira and Kibune, Offense and Defense of the 3rd Division
1.overview: Lieutenant Izuru Kira and Makoto Kibune continue their battle.

1.name: Ice and Flame! Fierce Fight of Amagai vs. Hitsugaya
1.overview: As Lieutenant Izuru Kira concludes his battle with Makoto Kibune, Captain Shūsuke Amagai is forced to battle against Captain Tōshirō Hitsugaya.

1.name: Sortie Orders! Suppress the House of Kasumiōji
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki is able to save Rurichiyo Kasumiōji, but more problems arise when it is revealed that Captain Shūsuke Amagai was working with Gyōkaku Kumoi.

1.name: Ichigo Rages! The Assassin's Secret
1.overview: Captain Shūsuke Amagai reveals his true intentions to Captain-Commander Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto.

1.name: Duel! Amagai vs. Ichigo
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and Captain Shūsuke Amagai battle each other.

1.name: The Fallen Shinigami's Pride
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and Captain Shūsuke Amagai conclude their battle.

1.name: Hueco Mundo Chapter, Restart!
1.overview: Following a lengthy recap of the events since Sōsuke Aizen betrayed Soul Society, Ichigo Kurosaki concludes his duel with Grimmjow Jaegerjaquez before being confronted by Nnoitra Gilga.

1.name: The Frightening Banquet, Szayelaporro Theater
1.overview: Szayelaporro Granz releases his Zanpakutō, while Nnoitra Gilga provides a surprising revelation about the true identity of the Arrancar Nel Tu.

1.name: Nel's Secret, A Busty Beauty Joins the Battle!?
1.overview: Nel Tu transforms back into her original Espada form.

1.name: Irresistible, Puppet Show of Terror
1.overview: Szayelaporro Granz demonstrates a new technique, whilst Nnoitra Gilga is taken aback by Nelliel Tu Odelschwanck's onslaught.

1.name: Neliel's Past
1.overview: Nnoitra Gilga recalls his past with Nelliel Tu Odelschwanck.

1.name: The Ultimate Union! Pesche's Seriousness
1.overview: Nelliel Tu Odelschwanck returns to her child form, leaving Ichigo Kurosaki in the hands of Tesra Lindocruz. Szayelaporro Granz is seemingly impervious to attack, Zommari Rureaux is about to finish off Rukia Kuchiki, whilst the Exequias plan to execute Yasutora Sado.

1.name: Joining the Battle! The Strongest Soul Reaper Army Appears
1.overview: The Gotei 13 come to the rescue of Ichigo Kurosaki and his comrades.

1.name: Byakuya's Bankai, The Quiet Anger
1.overview: Zommari Rureaux releases his Zanpakutō, forcing Captain Byakuya Kuchiki to take drastic action to avoid defeat.

1.name: The Two Scientists, Mayuri's Trap
1.overview: Captain Byakuya Kuchiki finishes off Zommari Rureaux, while Captain Mayuri Kurotsuchi gains the upper hand against Szayelaporro Granz.

1.name: Holy Birth, The Resurrected Szayel Aporro
1.overview: Captain Mayuri Kurotsuchi decides to end his battle against a reborn Szayelaporro Granz.

1.name: The Hardest Body!? Cut Down Nnoitra
1.overview: Captain Kenpachi Zaraki and Nnoitra Gilga continue their brawling.

1.name: Nnoitra Released! Multiplying Arms
1.overview: The battle between Captain Kenpachi Zaraki and Nnoitra Gilga becomes more fierce as Nnoitra releases his Zanpakutō.

1.name: Fierce Fighting Conclusion! Who's the Strongest?
1.overview: Captain Kenpachi Zaraki and Nnoitra Gilga conclude their battle.

1.name: Karakura Town Gathers! Aizen Versus the Soul Reapers
1.overview: Sōsuke Aizen reveals his plans and heads to Karakura Town.

1.name: Ichigo's Seppuku Persuasion Strategy ☆
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki tries to help out a feuding Rurichiyo Kasumiōji and Kenryū.

1.name: Thump! A Kemari Tournament Filled with Hollows
1.overview: Rurichiyo Kasumiōji and Kenryū have a kemari match.

1.name: The Past Chapter Begins! The Truth from 110 Years Ago
1.overview: The past of several Shinigami from 110 years ago is revealed.

1.name: 12th Division's New Captain, Urahara Kisuke
1.overview: The 12th Division deals with Kisuke Urahara being the new captain.

1.name: Aizen and the Genius Boy
1.overview: Captain Kisuke Urahara takes Lieutenant Hiyori Sarugaki to the Nest of Maggots.

1.name: Muguruma 9th Division, Moves Out
1.overview: The Gotei 13 attempt to figure what's behind the disappearances of Rukongai citizens.

1.name: Hiyori Dies? The Beginning of Tragedy
1.overview: Several Gotei 13 captains and lieutenants face off against a Hollowfied Captain Kensei Muguruma and Lieutenant Mashiro Kuna.

1.name: Betrayal! Aizen's Secret Maneuvers
1.overview: Lieutenant Sōsuke Aizen reveals himself as a traitor.

1.name: Rescue Hirako! Aizen vs. Urahara
1.overview: Captains Kisuke Urahara, Tessai Tsukabishi, and Yoruichi Shihōin leave to the Human World with the Hollowfied captains and lieutenants.

1.name: The Konso Cop Karakuraizer is Born
1.overview: Kisuke Urahara creates the Karakura-Raizer Team to protect Karakura Town.

1.name: Karakuraizer's Last Day
1.overview: The Karakura-Raizer Team face off against a female Arrancar.

1.name: Defend Karakura Town! Entire Appearance of the Shinigami
1.overview: As the Gotei 13 prepare to face off against the top three Espada, Ichigo Kurosaki confronts Ulquiorra Cifer.

1.name: Elite! The Four Shinigami
1.overview: As Ichigo Kurosaki confronts Ulquiorra Cifer, the battle for the four pillars begins in Karakura Town.

1.name: Beautiful Little Devil Charlotte
1.overview: 5th Seat Yumichika Ayasegawa and Charlotte Chuhlhourne battle each other.

1.name: Kira, The Battle Within Despair
1.overview: Lieutenant Izuru Kira, Lieutenant Shūhei Hisagi, and 3rd Seat Ikkaku Madarame continue their fights against Baraggan Louisenbairn's Fracción.

1.name: Hisagi's Shikai! The Name is...
1.overview: Lieutenant Shūhei Hisagi and Findorr Calius battle each other.

1.name: Ikkaku Falls! The Shinigami's Crisis
1.overview: 3rd Seat Ikkaku Madarame loses his fight against Choe Neng Poww, forcing Captain Sajin Komamura to take over his battle.

1.name: The Full Showdown! Soul Reapers vs. Espada
1.overview: Captain Suì-Fēng begins her battle with Ggio Vega while the other two Espada and their Fracción begin their fights.

1.name: The Most Evil Tag!? Suì-Fēng & Ōmaeda
1.overview: Ggio Vega and Nirgge Parduoc release their Zanpakutōs, prompting Lieutenant Marechiyo Ōmaeda to use his true power.

1.name: A Miraculous Body! Ggio Releases
1.overview: Lieutenant Marechiyo Ōmaeda and Captain Suì-Fēng struggle against their opponents, but are eventually able to win.

1.name: 3 vs. 1 Battle! Rangiku's Crisis
1.overview: Lieutenant Momo Hinamori arrives to help out Lieutenant Rangiku Matsumoto, prompting Harribel's Fracción to bring forth Ayon.

1.name: Vice-Captains Annihilated! The Terrifying Demonic Beast
1.overview: Ayon overpowers the lieutenants, greatly injuring them, but Captain-Commander Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto appears to fight the beast.

1.name: Fierce Fighting Concludes? Towards a New Battle!
1.overview: Captain-Commander Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto effortlessly finishes Ayon and Harribel's Fracción. Starrk reveals himself to be the Primera Espada. Rukia Kuchiki fights Rudbornn as Ichigo Kurosaki struggles against Ulquiorra Cifer.

1.name: Wonderful Error
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and Yasutora Sado become classmates with Mizuiro Kojima and Keigo Asano. Rukia Kuchiki is assigned to Karakura Town and Renji Abarai is promoted.

1.name: Summer! Sea! Swimsuit Festival!!
1.overview: The characters take a break on the beach.

1.name: Cry of the Soul? The Rug Shinigami is Born!
1.overview: Ikkaku and Yumichika are forced to stay with Mizuho again while on a mission in the Human World.

1.name: A New Enemy! The Materialization of Zanpakutō
1.overview: A mysterious Zanpakutō Spirit named Muramasa releases the spirits of many Zanpakutō from their swords and attacks Soul Society.

1.name: Byakuya, Disappearing with the Cherry Blossoms
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki battles against the manifested Zanpakutō Spirit of Sode no Shirayuki, who arrives in the Human World while chasing Rukia Kuchiki.

1.name: Sode no Shirayuki vs. Rukia! Confused Heart
1.overview: Rukia Kuchiki and Ichigo Kurosaki battle Sode no Shirayuki, and Muramasa reveals he is a Zanpakutō Spirit.

1.name: Zangetsu Becomes an Enemy
1.overview: Muramasa releases Zangetsu, and Ichigo Kurosaki fights him as his inner Hollow begins to take control.

1.name: Renji Surprised?! The Two Zabimarus
1.overview: 6th Division Lieutenant Renji Abarai is confronted by the spirit of his Zanpakutō, and Muramasa enters Ichigo Kurosaki's inner world.

1.name: Clash! Hisagi vs. Kazeshini
1.overview: 9th Division Lieutenant Shūhei Hisagi fights his Zanpakutō spirit while Hollow Ichigo fights Muramasa and 6th Division Lieutenant Renji Abarai regains the ability to release his Shikai, Zabimaru.

1.name: Release! The New Getsuga Tenshō
1.overview: 3rd Division Lieutenant Izuru Kira aids 9th Division Lieutenant Shūhei Hisagi, who is fighting Kazeshini, while 6th Division Lieutenant Renji Abarai and Ichigo Kurosaki conclude their battles.

1.name: Suì-Fēng, Surrounding the Zanpakutō
1.overview: 11th Division 3rd Seat Ikkaku Madarame and 2nd Division Lieutenant Marechiyo Ōmaeda encounter their Zanpakutō Spirits, and Ichigo Kurosaki spots 6th Division Captain Byakuya Kuchiki.

1.name: Friendship? Hatred? Haineko & Tobiume
1.overview: 10th Division Lieutenant Rangiku Matsumoto and 5th Division Lieutenant Momo Hinamori battle their Zanpakutō Spirits, and 10th Division Captain Tōshirō Hitsugaya tells Hyōrinmaru what his name is while Muramasa limps through the Forest of Menos.

1.name: The Awakening Hyōrinmaru! Hitsugaya's Fierce Fight
1.overview: As 5th Division Lieutenant Momo Hinamori and 10th Division Lieutenant Rangiku Matsumoto conclude their battle, 10th Division Captain Tōshirō Hitsugaya tries to convince Hyōrinmaru he is his master, but the Zanpakutō Spirit does not believe it.

1.name: Byakuya's Betrayal
1.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki attacks Muramasa, but Senbonzakura, and later 6th Division Captain Byakuya Kuchiki, shows up to protect him.

1.name: For the Sake of Pride! Byakuya vs. Renji
1.overview: Muramasa has 6th Division Captain Byakuya Kuchiki perform a test of loyalty. Afterwards, Byakuya invades the 6th Division barracks and is forced to fight his lieutenant, Renji Abarai.

1.name: Shinigami and Zanpakutō, Total Sortie
1.overview: As Ichigo Kurosaki, 2nd Division Captain Suì-Fēng, and 3rd Division Lieutenant Izuru Kira begin their battles, 11th Division 3rd Seat Ikkaku Madarame fights and defeats his Zanpakutō Spirit, Hōzukimaru.

1.name: One-to-One Fight! Ichigo vs. Senbonzakura
1.overview: As the Shinigami battle the Zanpakutō Spirits, 3rd Division Lieutenant Izuru Kira defeats Kazeshini, only to be attacked by Wabisuke. Meanwhile, 11th Division Captain Kenpachi Zaraki arrives at the battlefield.

1.name: The Long Awaited... Kenpachi Appears!
1.overview: 11th Division Captain Kenpachi Zaraki arrives and defeats Wabisuke before moving on to 6th Division Captain Byakuya Kuchiki. Meanwhile, 11th Division 5th Seat Yumichika Ayasegawa defeats his manifested Zanpakutō Spirit, Ruri'iro Kujaku.

1.name: Pursue Byakuya! The Confused Gotei Divisions
1.overview: As 11th Division Captain Kenpachi Zaraki and 6th Division Byakuya Kuchiki fight, 11th Division Lieutenant Yachiru Kusajishi chases Ashisogi Jizō before 12th Division Captain Mayuri Kurotsuchi forces his Zanpakutō Spirit to self-destruct and tells others to not interfere. Muramasa takes Byakuya to see Captain-Commander Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto, who is inside of a barrier guarded by a dark-haired woman, two white-haired boys, and a cloaked figure.

1.name: Special Mission! Rescue Captain Commander Yamamoto!
1.overview: A group of Shinigami attempt to rescue Captain-Commander Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto, but they are held back by several Zanpakutō Spirits. Meanwhile, Ichigo Kurosaki arrives at the barrier surrounding Yamamoto and prepares to destroy it.

1.name: Deceived Shinigami! The World Collapse Crisis
1.overview: As Yoruichi Shihōin, 8th Division Captain Shunsui Kyōraku, 11th Division Captain Jūshirō Ukitake, and 11th Division Captain Kenpachi Zaraki continue to fight against the Zanpakutō Spirits, Ichigo Kurosaki frees Captain-Commander Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto, only to learn this was all part of Muramasa's plan.

1.name: Dragon of Ice and Dragon of Flame! The Strongest Showdown!
1.overview: Captain-Commander Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto and the others are held back by Ryūjin Jakka's flames as Muramasa attempts to free Kōga Kuchiki.

1.name: Senbonzakura's Bankai! Offense and Defense of the Living World
1.overview: 11th Division Captain Kenpachi Zaraki faces off against Tenken's Bankai, Kokujō Tengen Myō'ō, as Muramasa frees his master, Kōga.

1.name: That Man, for the Sake of the Kuchiki
1.overview: Kōga Kuchiki's past is revealed.

1.name: Dark History! The Worst Shinigami Is Born
1.overview: 6th Division Captain Ginrei Kuchiki and Captain-Commander Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto are forced to seal Kōga Kuchiki away. In the present, 6th Division Captain Byakuya Kuchiki stops Kōga from killing Muramasa.

1.name: Byakuya, the Truth Behind His Betrayal
1.overview: As Senbonzakura reveals the truth about 6th Division Captain Byakuya Kuchiki's betrayal, Byakuya fights against Kōga Kuchiki. Meanwhile, Muramasa loses controls and unleashes hundreds of Gillians.

1.name: Muramasa's True Identity Revealed
1.overview: 6th Division Captain Byakuya Kuchiki defeats Kōga Kuchiki as Muramasa loses control and transforms into a Hollow version of himself. As Ichigo Kurosaki battles Muramasa, several Shinigami and their Zanpakutō Spirits arrive to help.

1.name: Byakuya and Renji, the 6th Division Returns
1.overview: The Shinigami and their Zanpakutō Spirits try to deal with the Gillians.
